### File: `js/events.js`

```javascript
/**
 * VocabVault - UI Event Orchestration & App Lifecycle Engine
 *
 * 【設計思想・単一責任】
 * DOMイベント委譲（クリック・キーボード・IME・ドラッグ＆ドロップ）、
 * ウィンドウライフサイクル（PWAインストール・印刷・オンライン/オフライン・リサイズ）、
 * クラウドアカウントUI連携、データベース自己修復診断の集中制御。
 */

(function (global) {
  'use strict';

  function $(id) {
    if (global.VocabCore && typeof global.VocabCore.$ === 'function') {
      return global.VocabCore.$(id);
    }
    return typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.getElementById(id) : null;
  }

  function $$(sel) {
    if (global.VocabCore && typeof global.VocabCore.$$ === 'function') {
      return global.VocabCore.$$(sel);
    }
    return typeof document !== 'undefined' ? [...document.querySelectorAll(sel)] : [];
  }

  function showToast(msg, type = 'info', ms = 3000) {
    if (global.VocabModal && typeof global.VocabModal.showToast === 'function') {
      return global.VocabModal.showToast(msg, type, ms);
    }
  }

  let lastManualSyncTime = 0;

  /**
   * クラウド差分同期を手動または自動で即時実行
   */
  async function syncCloudNow(manual = false, ctx = {}) {
    const lockFn = global.VocabSync?.acquireSyncLock || (fn => fn());
    return lockFn(async () => {
      const appState = ctx.appState || global.VocabCore?.App;
      if (!global.VocabSync?.isCloudReady?.()) {
        if (manual && typeof ctx.openSettings === 'function') ctx.openSettings();
        return;
      }

      // [Pro限定 Paywall] 複数端末クラウド自動差分同期は Proプラン専用機能
      if (!appState?.isPro) {
        if (manual) {
          const upsellMsg = '複数端末間のクラウド自動差分同期は Proプラン（月480円）限定機能です。スマホ・PC・タブレット間で学習履歴や復習スケジュールを完全自動同期できます。\n（※Freeプランでは「JSON保存/復元」による手動バックアップを永久無料でご利用いただけます）';
          if (typeof ctx.openUpsellModal === 'function') {
            ctx.openUpsellModal(upsellMsg);
          } else if (global.VocabModal?.openUpsellModal) {
            global.VocabModal.openUpsellModal(upsellMsg);
          } else {
            alert(upsellMsg);
          }
        }
        return;
      }

      const now = Date.now();
      if (manual && now - lastManualSyncTime < 4000) {
        showToast('同期が完了したばかりです。数秒後に再度お試しください。', 'info', 2500);
        return;
      }
      if (appState && appState.isSyncing) return;
      if (appState) appState.isSyncing = true;
      if (manual) lastManualSyncTime = now;

      const topBadge = $('cloudSyncBadge');
      if (topBadge) topBadge.textContent = '同期中...';

      try {
        const hooks = typeof ctx.getAppSyncHooks === 'function' ? ctx.getAppSyncHooks() : (global.VocabCore?.getAppSyncHooks?.());
        let totalPulled = 0, totalPushed = 0;
        const getPairsFn = ctx.getAllKnownPairConfigs || global.VocabCore?.getAllKnownPairConfigs || (() => []);
        const allKnown = getPairsFn();
        // デフォルト4ペアと既存ペアを正規のペアID（src_tgt）で一意に統合
        const syncTargets = new Set(['en_ja', 'fr_ja', 'de_ja', 'ja_ja']);
        allKnown.forEach(p => {
          const pairId = p.pairId || (p.src && p.tgt ? `${p.src}_${p.tgt}` : null);
          if (pairId) syncTargets.add(pairId);
        });
        for (const l of syncTargets) {
          const res = await global.VocabSync.syncLangWithSupabase(l, hooks);
          totalPulled += res.pulled;
          totalPushed += res.pushed;
        }
        if (typeof global.VocabSync?.syncAppSettingsWithSupabase === 'function') {
          await global.VocabSync.syncAppSettingsWithSupabase().catch(() => null);
        }
        if ($('anki')?.style.display !== 'block' && typeof ctx.load === 'function' && appState) {
          ctx.load(appState.page);
        } else if (typeof ctx.renderSidebarTree === 'function') {
          ctx.renderSidebarTree();
        }
        updCloudUI(ctx);
        if (manual) alert(`クラウド差分同期完了\n・受信(Pull): ${totalPulled} 件\n・送信(Push): ${totalPushed} 件`);
        return true;
      } catch (e) {
        if (manual) alert(`同期エラー: ${e.message}`);
        updCloudUI(ctx);
        return false;
      } finally {
        if (appState) appState.isSyncing = false;
      }
    });
  }

  /**
   * クラウドUIバッジ・アカウント状態を更新
   */
  function updCloudUI(ctx = {}) {
    const appState = ctx.appState || global.VocabCore?.App;
    const syncMod = global.VocabSync;
    const ready = Boolean(syncMod?.isCloudReady?.());
    const sess = syncMod?.getSession?.();
    const topBadge = $('cloudSyncBadge');
    const sbBadge = $('sbStatusBadge') || $('sbCloudStatusBadge');
    const authRow = $('sbAuthFormRow') || $('sbCloudAuthRow');
    const loggedRow = $('sbLoggedInRow') || $('sbCloudLoggedRow');
    const userTxt = $('sbUserText') || $('sbCloudUserText');
    const quotaTxt = $('sbQuotaText') || $('sbCloudQuotaText');
    const aiQuotaBadge = $('aiQuotaBadge');

    const curLocale = global.VocabI18n?.getLocale?.() || 'ja';
    const isJa = curLocale === 'ja';
    const t = (k, fb) => (global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t(k, fb) : fb);

    const usageInfo = global.VocabStorage?.getDailyAiUsageInfo ? global.VocabStorage.getDailyAiUsageInfo({ appState }) : null;
    if (aiQuotaBadge && usageInfo) {
      if (usageInfo.isUnlimited) {
        aiQuotaBadge.className = 'badge ok';
        aiQuotaBadge.textContent = isJa ? 'AI生成: 無制限' : (t('common.ai_unlimited') || 'AI Gen: Unlimited');
        aiQuotaBadge.title = isJa ? 'AI生成: 無制限 (Pro / 開発者 / BYOK)' : (t('common.ai_unlimited_title') || 'AI Gen: Unlimited (Pro / Dev / BYOK)');
      } else {
        const rem = usageInfo.remaining;
        aiQuotaBadge.textContent = isJa ? `AI残: ${rem}/${usageInfo.limit}語` : (t('common.ai_quota_left', { rem, limit: usageInfo.limit }) || `AI Left: ${rem}/${usageInfo.limit}`);
        if (rem === 0) {
          aiQuotaBadge.className = 'badge ng';
          aiQuotaBadge.title = isJa ? '本日の無料AI生成枠（5語/日）に達しました。Proで無制限' : (t('common.ai_quota_zero_title') || 'Daily free AI quota reached (5 words/day). Unlimited with Pro');
        } else if (rem <= 2) {
          aiQuotaBadge.className = 'badge warn';
          aiQuotaBadge.title = isJa ? `残り${rem}語。Proで無制限解放` : (t('common.ai_quota_warn_title', { rem }) || `${rem} remaining. Unlock unlimited with Pro`);
        } else {
          aiQuotaBadge.className = 'badge ok';
          aiQuotaBadge.title = isJa ? `本日のAI新規生成残り枠: ${rem}語 (キャッシュ時は消費なし)` : (t('common.ai_quota_rem_title', { rem }) || `Daily AI generation remaining: ${rem} (Zero cost when cached)`);
        }
      }
    }

    // メトリクス表示更新
    if (global.VocabStorage?.getMetricsSummary) {
      const summary = global.VocabStorage.getMetricsSummary();
      const mTotal = $('metricTotalWords');
      const mCache = $('metricCacheRate');
      const mTokens = $('metricTokensSaved');
      const mQuota = $('metricDailyQuota');
      const wordsUnit = isJa ? '語' : (t('common.unit_words') || 'words');
      if (mTotal) mTotal.innerHTML = `${summary.totalWords} <small style="font-size:11px">${wordsUnit}</small>`;
      if (mCache) mCache.textContent = `${summary.cacheRate}%`;
      if (mTokens) mTokens.innerHTML = `${summary.tokensSaved.toLocaleString()} <small style="font-size:11px">tok</small>`;
      if (mQuota && usageInfo) {
        if (usageInfo.isUnlimited) {
          const unlimLabel = isJa ? '無制限' : (t('common.unlimited') || 'Unlimited');
          mQuota.innerHTML = `${unlimLabel} <small style="font-size:11px">(Pro)</small>`;
        } else {
          const unit = isJa ? `/${usageInfo.limit}語` : `/${usageInfo.limit} ${wordsUnit}`;
          mQuota.innerHTML = `${usageInfo.remaining} <small style="font-size:11px">${unit}</small>`;
        }
      }
    }

    if (topBadge) {
      if (ready) {
        const email = sess?.user?.email || '';
        const shortMail = email ? email.split('@')[0] : '';
        topBadge.className = 'badge ok';
        const cloudLabel = isJa ? 'クラウド' : (t('common.cloud') || 'Cloud');
        topBadge.textContent = appState?.isPro ? `${cloudLabel}: Pro` : (shortMail ? `${cloudLabel}: Free (${shortMail})` : `${cloudLabel}: Free`);
        topBadge.style.cursor = 'pointer';
        topBadge.onclick = () => {
          if (appState && appState.quotaRemaining === 0 && typeof ctx.openUpsellModal === 'function') {
            ctx.openUpsellModal(isJa ? '本日のAI新規生成無料枠（5語/日）をすべて消費しました。Proプラン（月480円）で実質無制限（月3,000語）にアップグレードできます。' : (t('common.quota_exhausted_modal') || 'Daily free AI generation quota exhausted. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited generation.'));
          } else if (typeof ctx.openSettings === 'function') {
            ctx.openSettings();
          }
        };
      } else if (ctx.getKey && ctx.getKey()) {
        topBadge.className = 'badge ok';
        topBadge.textContent = isJa ? 'カスタムAPI(BYOK)' : (t('common.custom_byok') || 'Custom API (BYOK)');
        topBadge.style.cursor = 'pointer';
        topBadge.onclick = ctx.openSettings || global.VocabCore?.openSettings;
      } else {
        topBadge.className = 'badge ok';
        topBadge.textContent = isJa ? '内蔵AI: 稼働中 (完全機密保護)' : (t('settings.ai_engine_badge') || 'Embedded AI: Active (Full Privacy)');
        topBadge.style.cursor = 'pointer';
        topBadge.onclick = ctx.openSettings || global.VocabCore?.openSettings;
      }
    }
    if (sbBadge) {
      sbBadge.className = `badge ${ready ? 'ok' : 'ng'}`;
      if (ready) {
        sbBadge.textContent = appState?.isPro
          ? (isJa ? 'ログイン済・同期有効 (Pro)' : (t('settings.logged_in_pro') || 'Logged in & Syncing (Pro)'))
          : (isJa ? 'ログイン中 (Free: 1端末ローカル保持)' : (t('settings.logged_in_free') || 'Logged in (Free: 1 device)'));
      } else {
        sbBadge.textContent = isJa ? '未ログイン' : (t('settings.not_logged_in') || 'Not Logged In');
      }
    }
    if (authRow && loggedRow) {
      authRow.style.display = ready ? 'none' : 'flex';
      loggedRow.style.display = ready ? 'flex' : 'none';
    }
    if (userTxt && sess?.user?.email) {
      userTxt.textContent = isJa
        ? `ログイン中: ${sess.user.email} (${appState?.isPro ? 'Proプラン' : 'Freeプラン'})`
        : `${t('settings.logged_in_as') || 'Logged in:'} ${sess.user.email} (${appState?.isPro ? (t('settings.pro_plan') || 'Pro Plan') : (t('settings.free_plan') || 'Free Plan')})`;
    }
    if (quotaTxt && usageInfo) {
      if (usageInfo.isUnlimited) {
        quotaTxt.textContent = isJa
          ? 'AI新規生成クォータ: 無制限（Pro・BYOK・開発者モード）'
          : (t('settings.quota_unlimited_desc') || 'Daily AI Generation Quota: Unlimited (Pro / BYOK / Dev)');
      } else {
        quotaTxt.textContent = isJa
          ? `本日のAI新規生成クォータ残り: ${usageInfo.remaining} / ${usageInfo.limit} 語（共有辞書キャッシュ・スターターパックは無制限。全自動クラウド同期はPro限定）`
          : (t('settings.quota_limited_desc', { remaining: usageInfo.remaining, limit: usageInfo.limit }) || `Daily AI Generation Quota remaining: ${usageInfo.remaining} / ${usageInfo.limit} words (Shared cache & starter packs are unlimited. Cloud Sync is Pro only)`);
      }
    }
    if ($('cfgDot')) {
      const canGen = typeof ctx.canGenerateWords === 'function' ? ctx.canGenerateWords() : true;
      $('cfgDot').classList.toggle('warn', !canGen || Boolean(appState?.storageError));
    }

    const delSec = $('sbDeleteAccountSec');
    if (delSec) delSec.style.display = ready ? 'block' : 'none';

    if (ready && syncMod?.fetchUserProfile) {
      syncMod.fetchUserProfile().then(p => {
        if (!p) return;
        const isPro = (p.plan === 'pro' || p.plan === 'academic');
        if (appState) appState.isPro = isPro;
        const curLocale = global.VocabI18n?.getLocale?.() || 'ja';
        const tFn = (k, fb) => (global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t(k, fb) : fb);
        const planBadge = $('curPlanBadge');
        if (planBadge) {
          if (p.grace_period_until && new Date(p.grace_period_until) > new Date()) {
            const graceStr = new Date(p.grace_period_until).toLocaleDateString(curLocale);
            planBadge.textContent = curLocale === 'ja'
              ? `決済更新待ち (猶予: ${graceStr}まで)`
              : `Pending Payment (Grace: until ${graceStr})`;
            planBadge.className = 'badge warn';
          } else if (isPro && p.cancel_at_period_end) {
            const expStr = p.current_period_end ? ` (${new Date(p.current_period_end).toLocaleDateString(curLocale)})` : '';
            planBadge.textContent = `${tFn('settings.pro_plan', 'Pro プラン')} ${tFn('settings.plan_canceling', '(期間満了で終了予定)')}${expStr}`;
            planBadge.className = 'badge warn';
          } else {
            planBadge.textContent = isPro ? tFn('settings.pro_plan', 'Pro プラン') : tFn('settings.free_plan', 'Free プラン');
            planBadge.className = `badge ${isPro ? 'ok' : 'ng'}`;
          }
        }
        $('planCardFree')?.classList.toggle('current', !isPro);
        $('planCardPro')?.classList.toggle('current', isPro);
        if ($('btnUpgradePro')) $('btnUpgradePro').style.display = isPro ? 'none' : 'block';
        if ($('btnManageSub')) $('btnManageSub').style.display = isPro ? 'block' : 'none';
      });
    }

    if (appState && appState.isDev) {
      const tFn = (k, fb) => (global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t(k, fb) : fb);
      const planBadge = $('curPlanBadge');
      if (planBadge) {
        planBadge.textContent = tFn('settings.dev_badge', 'Developer Edition (全機能永久無制限)');
        planBadge.className = 'badge ok';
      }
      $('planCardFree')?.classList.remove('current');
      $('planCardPro')?.classList.add('current');
      if ($('btnUpgradePro')) $('btnUpgradePro').style.display = 'none';
      if ($('btnManageSub')) $('btnManageSub').style.display = 'none';
      let devNotice = $('devEditionNotice');
      if (!devNotice && $('planCardPro')) {
        devNotice = document.createElement('div');
        devNotice.id = 'devEditionNotice';
        devNotice.style.cssText = 'margin-top:8px;padding:8px 10px;background:var(--bg-hov);border-radius:6px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ac);font-weight:600;text-align:center';
        devNotice.textContent = tFn('settings.dev_notice', '開発者マスター権限により全機能が無制限解放されています（課金不要）');
        $('planCardPro').appendChild(devNotice);
      } else if (devNotice) {
        devNotice.textContent = tFn('settings.dev_notice', '開発者マスター権限により全機能が無制限解放されています（課金不要）');
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * クラウドログイン / 新規登録
   */
  async function cloudLogin(isSignUp = false, ctx = {}) {
    if (!global.VocabSync) return alert('VocabSyncモジュールが読み込まれていません。');
    const defCfg = global.VocabSync.getConfig ? global.VocabSync.getConfig() : {};
    const url = $('sbUrlInput')?.value.trim() || defCfg.url || '';
    const anon = $('sbAnonInput')?.value.trim() || defCfg.anonKey || '';
    const email = $('sbEmailInput')?.value.trim() || '';
    const pass = $('sbPassInput')?.value || '';
    if (!url || !anon) return alert('Supabase URL と Anon Key を入力してください。');
    if (!email || pass.length < 6) return alert('メールアドレスと6文字以上のパスワードを入力してください。');

    if (isSignUp) {
      const agreed = $('chkTermsAgree')?.checked;
      if (!agreed) {
        return alert('新規登録を行うには、利用規約およびプライバシーポリシーへの同意が必要です。チェックボックスをオンにしてください。');
      }
    }

    global.VocabSync.saveConfig(url, anon);
    try {
      const res = await global.VocabSync.signInOrSignUp(email, pass, isSignUp);
      if (isSignUp && !res.access_token) {
        alert('確認メールを送信しました。メール内のリンクを確認後にログインしてください。');
        return;
      }
      updCloudUI(ctx);
      await syncCloudNow(true, ctx);
    } catch (e) {
      alert(`クラウド認証エラー: ${e.message}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * クラウドログアウト
   */
  async function cloudLogout(ctx = {}) {
    const appState = ctx.appState || global.VocabCore?.App;
    if (!global.VocabSync) return;
    await global.VocabSync.signOut();
    if (appState) appState.quotaRemaining = null;
    updCloudUI(ctx);
  }

  /**
   * アカウント完全抹消（GDPR対応）
   */
  async function deleteAccountPermanently(ctx = {}) {
    const appState = ctx.appState || global.VocabCore?.App;
    if (!global.VocabSync?.isCloudReady?.()) {
      alert('クラウドにログインしていません。');
      return;
    }
    const sess = global.VocabSync.getSession();
    const email = sess?.user?.email || '';
    const curLocale = global.VocabI18n?.getLocale?.() || 'ja';
    const DELETE_KEYWORDS = {
      ja: '退会', en: 'DELETE', fr: 'SUPPRIMER', de: 'LÖSCHEN',
      es: 'ELIMINAR', it: 'ELIMINA', pt: 'EXCLUIR', nl: 'VERWIJDEREN',
      zh: '注销', ko: '탈퇴'
    };
    const keyword = DELETE_KEYWORDS[curLocale] || 'DELETE';
    const t = (k, params, fb) => (global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t(k, params, curLocale) : fb);

    const firstMsg = t('settings.delete_first_confirm', { email }, `【重要・警告】\n${email} の全データ（クラウド単語帳、学習履歴、アカウント情報）を完全に抹消します。\n※Proプラン契約中の方はStripeサブスクリプションも即時自動解約されます。\nこの操作は取り消せません。本当に退会しますか？`);
    if (!confirm(firstMsg)) return;

    const backupMsg = t('settings.delete_backup_confirm', {}, '退会する前に、登録した単語帳データをJSONファイルとしてダウンロード（保存）しますか？');
    if (confirm(backupMsg)) {
      await global.VocabSync?.exportAllUserDataJson?.();
    }

    const finalMsg = t('settings.delete_final_confirm', { keyword }, `最終確認: データを完全に消去する場合は「${keyword}」と入力してください。`);
    const userInput = prompt(finalMsg);
    if (!userInput || userInput.trim() !== keyword) {
      alert(t('settings.delete_cancelled', {}, '入力内容が一致しなかったため、退会処理を中止しました。'));
      return;
    }

    try {
      await global.VocabSync.deleteUserAccount();
      // IndexedDB の全ストアおよび LocalStorage の全関連データを完全物理消去
      if (global.VocabStorage?.idbClearAll) {
        await global.VocabStorage.idbClearAll();
      }
      try {
        if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
          const keysToWipe = [];
          for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
            const k = localStorage.key(i);
            if (k && (k.startsWith('distinction_entries') || k.startsWith('vocab_snapshot') || k.startsWith('vv_'))) {
              keysToWipe.push(k);
            }
          }
          keysToWipe.forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k));
        }
      } catch {}
      if (appState) {
        appState.entries = [];
        appState.aList = [];
        appState.quotaRemaining = null;
      }
      updCloudUI(ctx);
      if (typeof ctx.load === 'function') ctx.load(1);
      if (global.VocabModal && typeof global.VocabModal.toggleModal === 'function') {
        global.VocabModal.toggleModal('settingsModal', false);
      }
      showToast(t('settings.delete_completed', {}, 'アカウントおよび全てのクラウドデータが完全に抹消されました。ご利用ありがとうございました。'), 'ok', 6000);
    } catch (e) {
      alert(t('settings.delete_failed', { error: e.message }, `退会処理エラー: ${e.message}`));
    }
  }

  /**
   * データベース整合性診断 & 自動修復（Self-Healing Diagnostics）
   */
  async function runDatabaseDiagnosticsAndRepair(ctx = {}) {
    showToast('データベース整合性診断を実行中...', 'info', 2000);
    const now = Date.now();
    let totalScanned = 0;
    let issuesFixed = 0;
    let tombstonesPruned = 0;
    const reportDetails = [];

    const allKnown = (ctx.getAllKnownPairConfigs || global.VocabCore?.getAllKnownPairConfigs || (() => []))();
    const targetPairs = new Map();
    (global.VocabStorage?.LANG_KEYS || ['en', 'fr', 'de', 'ja']).forEach(l => {
      const cfg = global.VocabStorage?.resolveConfig ? global.VocabStorage.resolveConfig(l) : null;
      const key = cfg ? cfg.key : `distinction_entries_${l}`;
      targetPairs.set(key, { key, srcLang: l });
    });
    allKnown.forEach(p => {
      const key = p.key || (p.pairId ? `distinction_entries_${p.pairId}` : null);
      if (key && !targetPairs.has(key)) {
        targetPairs.set(key, { key, srcLang: p.srcLang || p.lang || 'en' });
      }
    });

    for (const [key, pairMeta] of targetPairs.entries()) {
      const getJsonFn = ctx.getJson || global.VocabCore?.getJson;
      const setJsonFn = ctx.setJson || global.VocabCore?.setJson;
      const list = typeof getJsonFn === 'function' ? getJsonFn(key) : [];
      if (!Array.isArray(list) || !list.length) continue;

      totalScanned += list.length;
      let langFixed = 0;
      const seenIds = new Set();
      const validEntries = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
        const item = list[i];
        let itemModified = false;

        // 1. IDの補完・重複修復
        if (!item.id || typeof item.id !== 'string') {
          item.id = (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.randomUUID) ? crypto.randomUUID() : `id_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
          itemModified = true;
        }
        if (seenIds.has(item.id)) {
          item.id = `${item.id}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 5)}`;
          itemModified = true;
        }
        seenIds.add(item.id);

        // 2. タイムスタンプ・SRS状態の正規化
        let srsModified = false;
        if (!Number.isFinite(item.updatedAt) || item.updatedAt <= 0 || item.updatedAt > now + 86400000 * 365) {
          item.updatedAt = now;
          itemModified = true;
        }
        if (!Number.isFinite(item.nextReview) || item.nextReview < 0) {
          item.nextReview = now + 86400000;
          itemModified = true;
          srsModified = true;
        }
        if (!Number.isFinite(item.interval) || item.interval < 0) {
          item.interval = 1;
          itemModified = true;
          srsModified = true;
        }
        if (!Number.isFinite(item.efactor) || item.efactor < 1.3 || item.efactor > 4.0) {
          item.efactor = 2.5;
          itemModified = true;
          srsModified = true;
        }

        // 3. wordKey の補完
        if (!item.wordKey) {
          const mkWk = global.VocabMorphology?.makeWordKey || global.VocabCore?.makeWordKey;
          if (mkWk) {
            item.wordKey = mkWk(item.word, pairMeta.srcLang, item.meanings?.[0]?.pos, item.homographIndex);
            itemModified = true;
          }
        }

        if (itemModified) {
          item.version = (Number(item.version) || 1) + 1;
          item.updatedAt = now;
          if (srsModified) item.reviewUpdatedAt = now;
          langFixed++;
          issuesFixed++;
        }
        validEntries.push(item);
      }

      if (langFixed > 0 && typeof setJsonFn === 'function') {
        setJsonFn(key, validEntries, true);
        reportDetails.push(`${key}: ${langFixed}件の不整合を修復`);
      }

      // 4. Tombstone バキューム
      if (global.VocabStorage?.vacuumOldTombstones) {
        const preTombCount = global.VocabStorage.getTombstones(key).size;
        const cleaned = global.VocabStorage.vacuumOldTombstones(key);
        const pruned = preTombCount - cleaned.size;
        if (pruned > 0) {
          tombstonesPruned += pruned;
          reportDetails.push(`${key}: ${pruned}件の期限切れTombstoneをパージ`);
        }
      }
    }

    if (typeof ctx.load === 'function' && ctx.appState) ctx.load(ctx.appState.page);

    const summaryMsg = issuesFixed > 0 || tombstonesPruned > 0
      ? `診断・修復完了: ${totalScanned}語を検証、${issuesFixed}件の不整合を自動修復、${tombstonesPruned}件の不要Tombstoneを削除しました。`
      : `診断完了: 全${totalScanned}語の整合性は100%正常です（エラーなし・データ完全性維持）。`;

    showToast(summaryMsg, 'ok', 5000);
    alert(`【データベース健全性診断レポート】\n\n・検証対象単語: ${totalScanned} 語\n・修復した不整合: ${issuesFixed} 箇所\n・パージした古い削除マーカー: ${tombstonesPruned} 件\n・データベース状態: 最適化済み（Healthy: 100%）\n\n${reportDetails.join('\n') || 'すべてのデータが完全整合しています。'}`);
  }

  /**
   * 期日超過カードを今後7日間に均等スヌーズ再分散（SSOT統一処理）
   */
  function rescheduleOverdueReviews(ctx = {}) {
    const now = Date.now();
    const activeCfg = typeof ctx.getActivePairConfig === 'function' ? ctx.getActivePairConfig() : (global.VocabCore?.getActivePairConfig?.());
    const getJsonFn = ctx.getJson || global.VocabCore?.getJson;
    const setJsonFn = ctx.setJson || global.VocabCore?.setJson;
    const pairKey = activeCfg ? activeCfg.key : (ctx.pairKey || 'distinction_entries');
    const rawList = typeof ctx.getList === 'function' ? ctx.getList(pairKey) : (typeof getJsonFn === 'function' ? getJsonFn(pairKey) : []);
    const list = Array.isArray(rawList) ? rawList : [];
    const overdue = list.filter(i => i && !i.isDeleted && (i.nextReview || 0) <= now);
    if (!overdue.length) return alert('期日超過の復習単語はありません。');

    if (!confirm(`期日超過の ${overdue.length} 語を、今後7日間に均等になだらかに再分散（スヌーズ）しますか？\n（毎日の復習負担が分散され、無理なく再開できます）`)) return;

    overdue.forEach((item, idx) => {
      const dayOffset = (idx % 7) + 1;
      const jitterMs = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3600000 * 3);
      item.nextReview = now + dayOffset * 86400000 + jitterMs;
      item.version = (Number(item.version) || 1) + 1;
      item.updatedAt = now;
      item.reviewUpdatedAt = now;
    });

    if (typeof ctx.saveList === 'function') {
      if (ctx.saveList.length >= 2) {
        ctx.saveList(pairKey, list);
      } else {
        ctx.saveList(list);
      }
    } else if (typeof setJsonFn === 'function') {
      setJsonFn(pairKey, list, true);
    }
    if (typeof ctx.onReload === 'function') {
      ctx.onReload();
    } else if (typeof ctx.load === 'function' && ctx.appState) {
      ctx.load(ctx.appState.page);
    }
    const showToast = ctx.showToast || (global.VocabModal ? global.VocabModal.showToast : null);
    if (showToast) {
      showToast(`${overdue.length} 語の復習スケジュールを今後7日間に均等再配分しました。`, 'ok');
    }
  }

  /**
   * 1日の最大復習数を設定
   */
  function setDailyReviewCap(val, ctx = {}) {
    const appState = ctx.appState || global.VocabCore?.App;
    const cap = parseInt(val, 10) || 30;
    if (appState) appState.dailyReviewCap = cap;
    if (global.VocabCore?.lsSet) global.VocabCore.lsSet('vv_daily_review_cap', String(cap));
    else try { localStorage.setItem('vv_daily_review_cap', String(cap)); } catch {}
    showToast(`1日の最大復習数を ${cap >= 99999 ? '無制限' : cap + ' 語'} に設定しました`, 'ok');
  }

  let _delegatedEventsBound = false;

  /**
   * DOMイベント委譲の一括バインド (二重登録防止ガード付き)
   */
  function bindDelegatedEvents(ctx = {}) {
    if (_delegatedEventsBound || typeof document === 'undefined') return;
    _delegatedEventsBound = true;
    const appState = ctx.appState || global.VocabCore?.App || global.App;

    document.addEventListener('click', e => {
      const el = e.target.closest?.('[data-act]');
      if (!el) return;
      const act = el.dataset.act;

      if (act === 'speak') {
        e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
        const curApp = ctx.appState || global.VocabCore?.App || global.App || appState;
        // ターゲット要素（発話対象の例文・成句・見出し語テキスト）をボタンのコンテキストから安全に特定
        let targetEl = null;
        const exParent = typeof el.closest === 'function' ? el.closest('.ex-en, .anki-ex-foreign, .ph-line, .sub-p, .sub-h') : null;
        if (exParent) {
          targetEl = (typeof exParent.querySelector === 'function' ? exParent.querySelector('span:not(.spk-btn), strong') : null) || exParent;
        } else {
          const cardEl = typeof el.closest === 'function' ? el.closest('.card') : null;
          if (cardEl && el.dataset?.text) {
            targetEl = (typeof cardEl.querySelector === 'function' ? cardEl.querySelector('.hw') : null) || cardEl;
          }
        }
        if (global.VocabSpeech) global.VocabSpeech.speakText(el.dataset.text, el.dataset.lang || curApp?.lang, null, targetEl);
      } else if (act === 'speak-current') {
        e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
        const curApp = ctx.appState || global.VocabCore?.App || global.App || appState;
        const c = curApp?.aList?.[0];
        const cardWord = c?.word || el.dataset.text || $('aWord')?.textContent?.replace(/\s*#\d+$/, '').trim();
        const cardLang = c?.lang || el.dataset.lang || curApp?.lang || 'en';
        if (cardWord && global.VocabSpeech) global.VocabSpeech.speakText(cardWord, cardLang);
      } else if (act === 'set-anki-mode') {
        const targetMode = el.dataset.mode;
        if (global.VocabAnkiView) global.VocabAnkiView.setAnkiMode(targetMode, ctx.ankiCtx?.() || {});
      } else if (act === 'reveal-cloze') {
        el.classList.add('revealed');
        if (el.dataset.ans) el.textContent = el.dataset.ans;
      } else if (act === 'toggle-playlist' || act === 'playlist-toggle') {
        if (global.VocabSpeech) global.VocabSpeech.toggleAudioPlaylist();
      } else if (act === 'playlist-next') {
        if (global.VocabSpeech) global.VocabSpeech.nextPlaylistItem();
      } else if (act === 'playlist-prev') {
        if (global.VocabSpeech) global.VocabSpeech.prevPlaylistItem();
      } else if (act === 'playlist-close') {
        if (global.VocabSpeech) global.VocabSpeech.stopAudioPlaylist();
      } else if (act === 'undo-anki') {
        if (global.VocabAnkiView) global.VocabAnkiView.undoAnkiRev(ctx.ankiCtx?.() || {});
        else if (typeof ctx.undoAnkiRev === 'function') ctx.undoAnkiRev();
      } else if (act === 'reveal-mask') {
        if (document.body.classList.contains('mask')) el.classList.toggle('revealed');
      } else if (act === 'filter') {
        if (typeof ctx.setFilter === 'function') ctx.setFilter(el.dataset.type, el.dataset.val);
      } else if (act === 'set-pair') {
        if (typeof ctx.setLanguagePair === 'function') ctx.setLanguagePair(el.dataset.src, el.dataset.tgt);
      } else if (act === 'search-root') {
        if (typeof ctx.setSearch === 'function') ctx.setSearch(el.dataset.query, true, el.dataset.xlang === '1' ? true : null);
      } else if (act === 'open-graph') {
        if (global.VocabGraph && typeof global.VocabGraph.openGraphModal === 'function') global.VocabGraph.openGraphModal(el.dataset.root);
        else if (typeof ctx.openGraphModal === 'function') ctx.openGraphModal(el.dataset.root);
      } else if (act === 'load-starter') {
        const packType = el.dataset.pack || 'academic';
        if (typeof global.VocabCore?.loadStarterPack === 'function') global.VocabCore.loadStarterPack(packType);
        else if (typeof global.loadStarterPack === 'function') global.loadStarterPack(packType);
      } else if (act === 'open-starter-modal') {
        if (global.VocabModal && typeof global.VocabModal.openStarterPackModal === 'function') global.VocabModal.openStarterPackModal();
      } else if (act === 'open-anki-import') {
        if (global.VocabModal && typeof global.VocabModal.openAnkiImportModal === 'function') global.VocabModal.openAnkiImportModal();
      } else if (act === 'jump') {
        const jw = el.dataset.word;
        const jl = el.dataset.lang || appState?.lang;
        if (typeof ctx.jumpToWord === 'function') ctx.jumpToWord(jw, jl);
        showToast(`「${jw}」のカードへ移動しました`, 'ok', 2000);
      } else if (act === 'edit') {
        if (global.VocabModal && typeof global.VocabModal.openEditModal === 'function') global.VocabModal.openEditModal(el.dataset.id || parseInt(el.dataset.num, 10), el.dataset.lang || appState?.lang);
        else if (typeof ctx.openEditModal === 'function') ctx.openEditModal(el.dataset.id || parseInt(el.dataset.num, 10), el.dataset.lang || appState?.lang);
      } else if (act === 'del') {
        e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
        const num = parseInt(el.dataset.num, 10);
        const cardWord = el.closest('.card')?.dataset?.word;
        if (typeof ctx.delW === 'function') ctx.delW(el.dataset.id || (Number.isInteger(num) ? num : cardWord), el.dataset.lang || appState?.lang);
      } else if (act === 'report-ety') {
        e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
        const cardWord = el.dataset.word || el.closest('.card')?.dataset?.rawWord || '';
        const cardEty = el.dataset.ety || '';
        const cardLang = el.dataset.lang || appState?.lang || 'en';
        if (global.VocabFeedback && typeof global.VocabFeedback.openFeedbackModal === 'function') {
          global.VocabFeedback.openFeedbackModal({
            title: `語源の誤り・修正報告: ${cardWord}`,
            initialMessage: `単語「${cardWord}」(${cardLang.toUpperCase()}) の語源解説に関する報告:\n【現在の語源】\n${cardEty}\n\n【正しい情報・修正提案】\n`
          });
        } else {
          prompt('語源の誤りや修正提案を入力してください（開発チームに送信されます）:', `【${cardWord}】`);
          showToast('語源に関するフィードバックを受け付けました。ご協力ありがとうございます！', 'ok', 3500);
        }
      } else if (act === 'toggle-clamp') {
        el.classList.toggle('clamp');
      } else if (act === 'switch-detail-tab') {
        e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
        const tabName = el.dataset.tab;
        const body = el.closest('.card-details-body');
        if (body) {
          body.querySelectorAll('.detail-tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
            const isMatch = btn.dataset.tab === tabName;
            btn.classList.toggle('active', isMatch);
            btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', isMatch ? 'true' : 'false');
          });
          body.querySelectorAll('.detail-panel').forEach(panel => {
            panel.style.display = (tabName === 'all' || panel.dataset.panel === tabName) ? 'block' : 'none';
          });
          const accordion = el.closest('.card-details-accordion');
          const sumLbl = accordion?.querySelector('.sum-lbl');
          if (sumLbl) {
            const labelText = tabName === 'all' ? '詳細（すべて）' : (el.textContent?.trim() || '詳細');
            sumLbl.textContent = `${labelText} を表示中`;
          }
        }
      } else if (act === 'page' || act === 'page-jump') {
        if (appState) {
          if (el.dataset.page !== undefined) {
            const p = parseInt(el.dataset.page, 10);
            if (Number.isFinite(p) && p >= 1) appState.page = p;
          } else if (el.dataset.dir !== undefined) {
            appState.page += Number(el.dataset.dir);
          }
          if (typeof ctx.render === 'function') ctx.render();
          $('mainScroll')?.scrollTo?.(0, 0);
        }
      } else if (act === 'reset-filter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (typeof ctx.resetAllFilters === 'function') {
          ctx.resetAllFilters();
        } else if (typeof global.VocabCore?.resetAllFilters === 'function') {
          global.VocabCore.resetAllFilters();
        } else if (typeof global.VocabListView?.resetFilters === 'function') {
          global.VocabListView.resetFilters(appState, () => ctx.render?.());
        }
      } else if (act === 'open-upsell') {
        const reason = el.dataset.reason || '';
        if (global.VocabModal && typeof global.VocabModal.openUpsellModal === 'function') {
          global.VocabModal.openUpsellModal(reason);
        } else if (typeof ctx.openUpsellModal === 'function') {
          ctx.openUpsellModal(reason);
        }
      } else if (act === 'rate') {
        const rateVal = Number(el.dataset.rate);
        if (global.VocabAnkiView) global.VocabAnkiView.procRev(rateVal, ctx.ankiCtx?.() || {});
        else if (typeof ctx.procRev === 'function') ctx.procRev(rateVal);
      } else if (act === 'retry-batch') {
        const card = el.closest('.card');
        if (!card) return;
        try {
          const retryItems = JSON.parse(card.dataset.retryItems || '[]');
          const { fName = '', useHist, useWikt, srcLang, tgtLang, pairKey, requestId } = card.dataset;
          const reqQueue = appState?.reqQueue || [];
          const qIdx = reqQueue.findIndex(q => q.card === card);
          if (qIdx !== -1) reqQueue.splice(qIdx, 1);
          card.remove();
          if (retryItems.length && typeof ctx.enqueueTask === 'function') {
            ctx.enqueueTask({
              items: retryItems,
              fName,
              useHist: useHist === '1',
              useWikt: useWikt !== '0',
              targetLang: srcLang || appState?.srcLang,
              srcLang: srcLang || appState?.srcLang,
              tgtLang: tgtLang || appState?.tgtLang,
              pairKey: pairKey || (ctx.getActivePairConfig ? ctx.getActivePairConfig().key : ''),
              requestId: requestId || undefined
            });
          }
        } catch {}
      } else if (act === 'close-load') {
        const card = el.closest('.card');
        const reqQueue = appState?.reqQueue || [];
        const task = reqQueue.find(q => q.card === card);
        if (task) task.isCancelled = true;
        const qIdx = reqQueue.findIndex(q => q.card === card);
        if (qIdx !== -1) reqQueue.splice(qIdx, 1);
        card?.remove();
        if (global.VocabQueue && typeof global.VocabQueue.syncPersistedQueue === 'function') global.VocabQueue.syncPersistedQueue(appState);
        if (typeof ctx.render === 'function') ctx.render();
      }

      // カード本体クリック時のキーボードフォーカス連動
      const card = e.target.closest('.card');
      if (card && !e.target.closest('button, a, input, select, textarea, [data-act]')) {
        const cards = $$('#list .card');
        const idx = cards.indexOf(card);
        if (idx !== -1 && typeof ctx.updateCardFocus === 'function') ctx.updateCardFocus(idx);
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
      if ((e.key !== 'Enter' && e.key !== ' ') || e.isComposing) return;
      const el = e.target.closest?.('[data-act]');
      if (el && !['BUTTON', 'INPUT', 'TEXTAREA', 'SELECT', 'A'].includes(el.tagName)) {
        e.preventDefault();
        el.click();
      }
    });

    $('extCandidateGrid')?.addEventListener('change', e => {
      const i = e.target.dataset?.extIdx;
      if (i === undefined || !appState?.extCandidates?.[i]) return;
      appState.extCandidates[i].checked = e.target.checked;
      e.target.closest('.ext-item')?.classList.toggle('checked', e.target.checked);
      if (global.VocabModal && typeof global.VocabModal.updateExtCounts === 'function') {
        global.VocabModal.updateExtCounts();
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('change', e => {
      const el = e.target.closest?.('[data-act="page-select"]');
      if (el && appState) {
        const val = parseInt(el.value, 10);
        if (Number.isFinite(val) && val >= 1) {
          appState.page = val;
          if (typeof ctx.render === 'function') ctx.render();
          $('mainScroll')?.scrollTo?.(0, 0);
        }
      }
    });

    const qIn = $('qSearch');
    if (qIn) {
      qIn.addEventListener('compositionstart', () => { if (appState) appState.isComposing = true; });
      qIn.addEventListener('compositionend', e => {
        if (appState) appState.isComposing = false;
        clearTimeout(appState?.searchDebounceTimer);
        if (typeof ctx.setSearch === 'function') ctx.setSearch(e.target.value);
      });
      qIn.addEventListener('input', e => {
        if (!appState?.isComposing) {
          clearTimeout(appState?.searchDebounceTimer);
          if (appState) {
            const v = e.target.value || '';
            const delay = /^[a-zA-Z0-9\s*_-]*$/.test(v) ? 70 : 120;
            appState.searchDebounceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
              if (typeof ctx.setSearch === 'function') ctx.setSearch(e.target.value);
            }, delay);
          }
        }
      });
      qIn.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
          e.preventDefault();
          const val = e.target.value.trim();
          if (val && typeof ctx.jumpToWord === 'function') ctx.jumpToWord(val);
        }
      });
    }

    const inWordEl = $('inWord');
    if (inWordEl) {
      inWordEl.addEventListener('compositionstart', () => { if (appState) appState.isComposing = true; });
      inWordEl.addEventListener('compositionend', () => {
        setTimeout(() => { if (appState) appState.isComposing = false; }, 50);
      });
      inWordEl.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && (appState?.isComposing || e.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229)) {
          e.preventDefault();
        }
      });
    }

    const inFolEl = $('inFol');
    if (inFolEl) {
      inFolEl.addEventListener('compositionstart', () => { if (appState) appState.isComposing = true; });
      inFolEl.addEventListener('compositionend', () => {
        setTimeout(() => { if (appState) appState.isComposing = false; }, 50);
      });
      inFolEl.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' && (appState?.isComposing || e.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229)) {
          e.preventDefault();
        }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * ウィンドウ・ライフサイクルイベントの一括バインド
   */
  function bindWindowEvents(ctx = {}) {
    const appState = ctx.appState || global.VocabCore?.App;
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

    // 音声アンロック (iOS Safari / モバイルWebKit対応)
    const unlockAudio = () => {
      try {
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.speechSynthesis && window.speechSynthesis.paused) {
          window.speechSynthesis.resume();
        }
      } catch {}
      window.removeEventListener('touchstart', unlockAudio);
      window.removeEventListener('click', unlockAudio);
    };
    window.addEventListener('touchstart', unlockAudio, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('click', unlockAudio, { passive: true });

    // リサイズハンドラ
    let resizeTimer = null;
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      if (window.innerWidth > 768 && document.body?.classList.contains('side-open-lock')) {
        document.body.classList.remove('side-open-lock');
      }
      clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
      resizeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        const cIdx = appState?.focusedCardIndex;
        if (Number.isInteger(cIdx) && cIdx >= 0 && typeof document !== 'undefined') {
          const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('#list .card')];
          const el = cards[cIdx];
          if (el && global.VocabCardView?.scrollToCard) {
            global.VocabCardView.scrollToCard(el, document.getElementById('mainScroll'), { immediate: true, skipRetry: true });
          }
        }
      }, 150);
    }, { passive: true });

    // ブラウザ履歴ナビゲーション (戻る・進む) に伴うURL単語ジャンプ連動
    window.addEventListener('popstate', () => {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location?.search) {
        try {
          const p = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
          const w = p.get('w') || p.get('word');
          if (w && typeof ctx.jumpToWord === 'function') {
            ctx.jumpToWord(w, p.get('lang') || appState?.lang);
          }
        } catch {}
      }
    });

    // 印刷モード
    window.addEventListener('beforeprint', () => {
      if (appState) appState.printAllMode = true;
      if (typeof ctx.render === 'function') ctx.render();
    });
    window.addEventListener('afterprint', () => {
      if (appState) appState.printAllMode = false;
      if (typeof ctx.render === 'function') ctx.render();
    });

    // ストレージ間同期
    window.addEventListener('storage', e => {
      if (e.key && global.VocabStorage && typeof ctx.syncFromIdbForLang === 'function') {
        const isPairScopedKey = e.key.startsWith('distinction_entries') || e.key.startsWith('vv_tombstones_') || e.key.startsWith('vv_cleared_at_');
        if (!isPairScopedKey) return;
        const target = typeof global.VocabStorage.resolveConfig === 'function'
          ? (global.VocabStorage.resolveConfig(e.key)?.key || e.key)
          : (e.key.startsWith('distinction_entries') ? e.key : global.VocabStorage.keyToLang(e.key));
        ctx.syncFromIdbForLang(target);
      }
    });

    // オンライン / オフライン自動復帰 (項目25: 直列化パイプライン & 排他ミューテックス)
    window.addEventListener('online', async () => {
      try {
        if (global.VocabSRS?.flushOfflineReviews) {
          await global.VocabSRS.flushOfflineReviews();
        }
        if (global.VocabSync?.isCloudReady?.()) {
          await syncCloudNow(false, ctx);
        }
        showToast('オンラインに復帰しました。クラウド同期を完了しました。', 'info', 2500);
      } catch (err) {
        if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && typeof console.warn === 'function') {
          console.warn('[Sync] Online recovery error:', err);
        }
      }
    });
    window.addEventListener('offline', () => {
      showToast('オフラインモードです。復習や編集は端末内に安全に保持されます。', 'info', 3000);
    });

    // クリップボード画像ペーストによる自動OCR受付
    window.addEventListener('paste', e => {
      const modal = $('extractModal');
      if (modal?.classList.contains('open')) return;
      const imgItem = [...(e.clipboardData?.items || [])].find(it => it.type && it.type.startsWith('image/'));
      if (imgItem) {
        const file = imgItem.getAsFile();
        if (file) {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (global.VocabModal && typeof global.VocabModal.openExtractModal === 'function') global.VocabModal.openExtractModal();
          if (global.VocabOCR && typeof global.VocabOCR.handleOcrImageFile === 'function') {
            global.VocabOCR.handleOcrImageFile(file, 'スクリーンショット (貼り付け)');
          }
        }
      }
    });

    // PWA インストールプロンプト監視
    const isStandalone = (
      window.matchMedia?.('(display-mode: standalone)').matches ||
      window.navigator?.standalone === true
    );
    const ribInstallBtn = $('ribInstallBtn');
    if (isStandalone) {
      if (ribInstallBtn) ribInstallBtn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
      if (ribInstallBtn) ribInstallBtn.style.display = 'flex';
    }

    window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (appState) appState.deferredInstallPrompt = e;
      if (ribInstallBtn && !isStandalone) ribInstallBtn.style.display = 'flex';
    });

    window.addEventListener('appinstalled', () => {
      if (appState) appState.deferredInstallPrompt = null;
      if (ribInstallBtn) ribInstallBtn.style.display = 'none';
      showToast('Vocab Vault をインストールしました。Dockやホーム画面から独立起動できます。', 'ok', 6000);
    });

    // グローバルキーボードショートカット委譲
    window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
      if (global.VocabNavigation && typeof global.VocabNavigation.handleGlobalKeydown === 'function') {
        const handled = global.VocabNavigation.handleGlobalKeydown(e, {
          isAnkiOpen: () => $('anki')?.style.display === 'block',
          anyModalOpen: () => Boolean(document.querySelector('.modal-ov.open')),
          closeAllModals: () => global.VocabModal?.closeAllModals?.(),
          exitAnki: () => ctx.exitAnki?.(),
          getFocusedCardIndex: () => appState?.focusedCardIndex ?? -1,
          clearCardFocus: () => {
            if (appState) appState.focusedCardIndex = -1;
            $$('#list .card.card-focused').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('card-focused'));
          },
          focusSearch: () => {
            document.body?.classList.remove('side-collapsed');
            $('qSearch')?.focus();
          },
          focusInput: () => {
            global.VocabModal?.closeAllModals?.();
            if ($('anki')?.style.display === 'block') ctx.exitAnki?.();
            $('inWord')?.focus();
          },
          openExtractModal: () => global.VocabModal?.openExtractModal?.(),
          toggleMask: () => ctx.toggleMask?.(),
          ankiSpeak: () => {
            const curApp = ctx.appState || global.VocabCore?.App || global.App || appState;
            const curWord = curApp?.aList?.[0]?.word || $('aWord')?.textContent?.replace(/\s*#\d+$/, '').trim();
            const curLang = curApp?.aList?.[0]?.lang || curApp?.lang || 'en';
            if (curWord && global.VocabSpeech) {
              global.VocabSpeech.speakText(curWord, curLang);
            }
          },
          ankiUndo: () => {
            if (appState?.ankiHistory?.length) {
              if (global.VocabAnkiView) global.VocabAnkiView.undoAnkiRev(ctx.ankiCtx?.() || {});
              else ctx.undoAnkiRev?.();
            }
          },
          ankiAdvance: () => {
            if ($('btnAns')?.style.display !== 'none') {
              if (global.VocabAnkiView) global.VocabAnkiView.showAns(ctx.ankiCtx?.() || {});
              else ctx.showAns?.();
            } else if ($('aRat')?.style.display === 'flex') {
              if (global.VocabAnkiView) global.VocabAnkiView.procRev(2, ctx.ankiCtx?.() || {});
              else ctx.procRev?.(2);
            }
          },
          ankiRate: rating => {
            if ($('aRat')?.style.display === 'flex') {
              if (global.VocabAnkiView) global.VocabAnkiView.procRev(rating, ctx.ankiCtx?.() || {});
              else ctx.procRev?.(rating);
            }
          },
          moveCardFocus: delta => {
            if (typeof ctx.updateCardFocus === 'function' && appState) {
              ctx.updateCardFocus(appState.focusedCardIndex + delta);
            }
          },
          speakFocusedCard: () => {
            const item = typeof ctx.getFocusedCardItem === 'function' ? ctx.getFocusedCardItem() : null;
            if (item && global.VocabSpeech) global.VocabSpeech.speakText(item.word, item.lang || appState?.lang);
          },
          editFocusedCard: () => {
            const item = typeof ctx.getFocusedCardItem === 'function' ? ctx.getFocusedCardItem() : null;
            if (item && global.VocabModal) global.VocabModal.openEditModal(item.id || item.num, item.lang || appState?.lang);
          },
          deleteFocusedCard: () => {
            const item = typeof ctx.getFocusedCardItem === 'function' ? ctx.getFocusedCardItem() : null;
            if (item && typeof ctx.delW === 'function') ctx.delW(item.id || item.num, item.lang || appState?.lang);
          },
          startAnki: () => {
            if (global.VocabAnkiView) global.VocabAnkiView.startAnki(null, ctx.ankiCtx?.() || {});
            else ctx.startAnki?.();
          },
          openGraph: () => {
            if (global.VocabGraph) global.VocabGraph.openGraphModal();
            else ctx.openGraphModal?.();
          },
          openAnalyticsModal: () => {
            if (global.VocabAnkiView) global.VocabAnkiView.openAnalyticsModal();
            else if (typeof global.openAnalyticsModal === 'function') global.openAnalyticsModal();
          },
          openShortcutsModal: () => {
            if (global.VocabModal) global.VocabModal.toggleModal('shortcutsModal', true);
          },
          ankiToggleMode: () => {
            if (global.VocabAnkiView) global.VocabAnkiView.toggleAnkiMode(ctx.ankiCtx?.() || {});
          },
          togglePlaylist: () => {
            if (global.VocabSpeech) global.VocabSpeech.toggleAudioPlaylist();
          }
        });
        if (handled) return;
      }
    });
  }

  // グローバルエクスポート
  global.VocabEvents = {
    syncCloudNow,
    updCloudUI,
    cloudLogin,
    cloudLogout,
    deleteAccountPermanently,
    runDatabaseDiagnosticsAndRepair,
    rescheduleOverdueReviews,
    setDailyReviewCap,
    bindDelegatedEvents,
    bindWindowEvents
  };
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);
```

```javascript
/**
 * Vocab Vault — Modal Dialog & UI Workflow Engine (js/modal.js)
 * High-performance Modal Lifecycle Management, Card Editor, Passage Extractor, Legal & Toast System
 */
(function (global) {
  'use strict';

  const esc = s => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&':'&amp;', '<':'&lt;', '>':'&gt;', '"':'&quot;', "'":'&#39;' }[c]));
  const cleanPho = global.VocabStorage?.cleanPho || (p => String(p ?? '').replace(/^[\[/\s]+/, '').replace(/[\]/\s]+$/, '').trim());
  const $ = id => typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.getElementById(id) : null;

  let lastFocus = null;

  /**
   * モーダル開閉ライフサイクル制御
   */
  function toggleModal(id, open) {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
    if (open) lastFocus = document.activeElement;
    const el = $(id);
    if (el) {
      if (typeof open === 'boolean') {
        el.classList.toggle('open', open);
      } else {
        el.classList.toggle('open');
      }
    }
    if (id === 'graphModal' && el && !el.classList.contains('open')) {
      try {
        global.VocabGraph?.stopTimelineAutoPlay?.();
        if (global.graphState?.animId) { cancelAnimationFrame(global.graphState.animId); global.graphState.animId = null; }
        const vs = global.VocabGraph?.state;
        if (vs?.animId) { cancelAnimationFrame(vs.animId); vs.animId = null; }
        if (vs?.treeEasingTimer) { cancelAnimationFrame(vs.treeEasingTimer); vs.treeEasingTimer = null; }
      } catch {}
    }
    if (id === 'cameraOcrModal' && el && !el.classList.contains('open')) {
      try { global.VocabOCR?.stopCameraOcr?.(); } catch {}
    }
    const any = Boolean(document.querySelector?.('.modal-ov.open'));
    const ws = document.querySelector?.('.workspace');
    if (ws) ws.inert = any;
    if (!any && lastFocus?.focus) {
      try { lastFocus.focus(); } catch {}
    }
  }

  /**
   * 全モーダル一括クローズ
   */
  function closeAllModals() {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
    document.querySelectorAll?.('.modal-ov.open').forEach(el => {
      el.classList.remove('open');
    });
    try {
      if (typeof global.graphState !== 'undefined' && global.graphState?.animId) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(global.graphState.animId);
        global.graphState.animId = null;
      }
      const vs = global.VocabGraph?.state;
      if (vs?.animId) { cancelAnimationFrame(vs.animId); vs.animId = null; }
      if (vs?.treeEasingTimer) { cancelAnimationFrame(vs.treeEasingTimer); vs.treeEasingTimer = null; }
      global.VocabOCR?.stopCameraOcr?.();
    } catch {}
    const ws = document.querySelector?.('.workspace');
    if (ws) ws.inert = false;
    try {
      if (typeof lastFocus !== 'undefined' && lastFocus?.focus) {
        lastFocus.focus();
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  /**
   * スクリーンリーダー向け動的ライブリージョン通知 (WCAG 2.1 AA 準拠)
   */
  function announceA11y(msg) {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined' || !msg) return;
    const el = document.getElementById('a11yAnnouncer');
    if (el) {
      el.textContent = '';
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (el) el.textContent = String(msg);
      }, 50);
    }
  }

  /**
   * フローティングトースト通知
   */
  function showToast(msg, type = 'info', duration = 4500) {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
    announceA11y(msg);
    let container = document.getElementById('vvToastContainer');
    if (!container) {
      container = document.createElement('div');
      container.id = 'vvToastContainer';
      container.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:16px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:99999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;pointer-events:none;max-width:92vw;width:440px;';
      document.body.appendChild(container);
    }
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    const bg = type === 'ok' ? '#107c41' : type === 'warn' ? '#d97706' : type === 'error' || type === 'err' ? '#d13438' : '#7c3aed';
    t.style.cssText = `background:${bg};color:#fff;padding:12px 18px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.28);pointer-events:auto;transition:all .3s ease;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-10px);line-height:1.45;`;
    t.textContent = msg;
    container.appendChild(t);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      t.style.opacity = '1';
      t.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
    });
    setTimeout(() => {
      t.style.opacity = '0';
      t.style.transform = 'translateY(-10px)';
      setTimeout(() => t.remove(), 350);
    }, duration);
  }

  /**
   * ダークモード切り替え
   */
  function toggleDarkMode(d) {
    const isDark = (typeof d === 'boolean') ? d : (typeof document !== 'undefined' && (document.body ? !document.body.classList.contains('dark') : !document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')));
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      if (document.body) document.body.classList.toggle('dark', isDark);
      if (document.documentElement) document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', isDark);
    }
    if (global.lsSet) global.lsSet('vv_theme_dark', isDark ? '1' : '0');
    else if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
      try { localStorage.setItem('vv_theme_dark', isDark ? '1' : '0'); } catch {}
    }
    const themeBtn = $('btnTheme');
    if (themeBtn) {
      const curLocale = global.VocabI18n?.getLocale?.() || 'ja';
      const isJa = curLocale === 'ja';
      themeBtn.textContent = isDark ? (isJa ? 'ライト' : 'Light') : (isJa ? 'ダーク' : 'Dark');
    }
    if ($('chkDark')) $('chkDark').checked = isDark;
    if (global.VocabGraph?.invalidateTreeBgCache) {
      global.VocabGraph.invalidateTreeBgCache();
      global.VocabGraph.drawGraph?.();
    }
  }

      if (el) {

  // --- Proアップセル & 設定モーダル ---
  function getRootTreeProgress() {
    const App = global.App || {};
    const entries = App.entries || [];
    const rootCountMap = new Map();
    let validCount = 0;
    for (const e of entries) {
      if (!e || e.isDeleted) continue;
      validCount++;
      const tags = Array.isArray(e.etymologyTags) ? e.etymologyTags : [];
      for (const t of tags) {
        if (t && typeof t === 'string' && t.startsWith('*')) {
          rootCountMap.set(t, (rootCountMap.get(t) || 0) + 1);
        }
      }
    }
    let bestRoot = '*sta-';
    let bestCount = 0;
    for (const [r, c] of rootCountMap.entries()) {
      if (c > bestCount) {
        bestCount = c;
        bestRoot = r;
      }
    }
    const targetCluster = 5;
    const remToCluster = Math.max(1, targetCluster - (bestCount % targetCluster || targetCluster));
    return {
      totalWords: validCount,
      totalRoots: rootCountMap.size,
      leadingRoot: bestRoot,
      leadingCount: bestCount,
      remToCluster
    };
  }

  function openUpsellModal(reason = '') {
    const App = global.App || {};
    const isJa = global.VocabI18n ? global.VocabI18n.getLocale() === 'ja' : true;
    if (App.isDev) {
      if (showToast) showToast(isJa ? '開発者マスターモード: Pro機能を制限なく実行しました' : 'Developer Master Mode: Executed Pro feature without limits', 'ok', 3000);
      return;
    }
    const rEl = $('upsellModalReason') || $('upsellReason');
    const defaultReason = isJa ? '本日のAI新規生成無料枠（5語/日）に達しました' : 'Daily free AI word generation quota reached (5 words/day)';
    if (rEl) {
      rEl.textContent = reason || defaultReason;
      rEl.style.display = 'block';
    }

    // 項目11: 語根ネットワーク成長プログレス (Value-Driven Upsell)
    const progEl = $('upsellRootProgress');
    if (progEl) {
      const p = getRootTreeProgress();
      const titleTxt = isJa ? 'あなたの語根ネットワーク成長度' : 'Your Root Network Progress';
      const rootTxt = isJa ? `発掘済: ${p.totalRoots} 語根` : `Discovered: ${p.totalRoots} roots`;
      const descTxt = isJa
        ? `現在 <strong>${p.totalWords}語</strong> の知識が蓄積されています。主要語根 <code>${p.leadingRoot}</code> ファミリーは<strong>あと ${p.remToCluster} 語</strong>で次のクラスタが完成します！`
        : `Currently <strong>${p.totalWords} words</strong> accumulated. Root family <code>${p.leadingRoot}</code> needs only <strong>${p.remToCluster} more words</strong> to complete the next cluster!`;
      progEl.innerHTML = `
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:6px">
          <div style="font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--t)">
            <span>${titleTxt}</span>
          </div>
          <span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ac);background:rgba(99,102,241,0.1);padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px">
            ${rootTxt}
          </span>
        </div>
        <p style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--s);margin:0 0 8px;line-height:1.5">
          ${descTxt}
        </p>
        <div style="background:var(--bg);height:6px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--b)">
          <div style="background:var(--ac);height:100%;width:${Math.min(100, Math.max(15, (p.leadingCount % 5 || 5) * 20))}%;transition:width 0.3s ease"></div>
        </div>
      `;
      progEl.style.display = 'block';
    }

    if (global.VocabI18n?.updatePricingUI) {
      global.VocabI18n.updatePricingUI();
    }
    if (global.VocabI18n?.applyI18nToDOM) {
      const upModal = typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.getElementById('upsellModal') : null;
      if (upModal) global.VocabI18n.applyI18nToDOM(upModal);
    }

    toggleModal('upsellModal', true);
  }

      } else {
        const installBtnLabel = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('settings.pwa_install_btn') : (isJa ? 'アプリをインストール（単独起動）' : 'Install App (Standalone)');
        $('btnPwaInstall').innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="margin-right:4px"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/><polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"/><line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"/></svg><span data-i18n="settings.pwa_install_btn">${esc(installBtnLabel)}</span>`;
        $('btnPwaInstall').disabled = false;
      }
    }
    if (global.updStats) global.updStats();
    if (global.updKeyUI) global.updKeyUI();
    if (global.updCloudUI) global.updCloudUI();

    // 観点1: FSRSオプティマイザおよびスマートPush通知のステータス同期
    updateFSRSOptimizerUI();
    updateSmartNotifyUI();

    const curQuota = global.App?.quotaRemaining ?? 30;
    if ($('quotaNum')) $('quotaNum').textContent = curQuota;

    const isSessionOnly = (global.lsGet ? global.lsGet('vv_key_session_only', '0') : '0') === '1' || Boolean(typeof sessionStorage !== 'undefined' && sessionStorage.getItem('vv_gemini_api_key'));
    if ($('chkApiKeySessionOnly')) $('chkApiKeySessionOnly').checked = isSessionOnly;
    if ($('apiKeyInput')) $('apiKeyInput').value = global.getKey ? global.getKey() : '';

    const savedTab = (global.lsGet ? global.lsGet('vv_active_cfg_tab', 'general') : (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('vv_active_cfg_tab') : 'general')) || 'general';
    switchSettingsTab(savedTab);

    toggleModal('settingsModal', true);
  }

  function switchSettingsTab(tabName) {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
    const tabBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.settings-tab-btn');
    const panels = document.querySelectorAll('.settings-panel');
    const validTabs = ['general', 'account', 'plans', 'ai', 'storage'];
    const activeTab = validTabs.includes(tabName) ? tabName : 'general';

    tabBtns.forEach(btn => {
      const match = btn.getAttribute('data-tab') === activeTab;
      btn.classList.toggle('active', match);
      btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', match ? 'true' : 'false');
    });

    panels.forEach(p => {
      const match = p.id === `cfgPanel${activeTab.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + activeTab.slice(1)}`;
      p.classList.toggle('active', match);
    });

    try {
      if (global.lsSet) global.lsSet('vv_active_cfg_tab', activeTab);
      else if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') localStorage.setItem('vv_active_cfg_tab', activeTab);
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  function updateFSRSOptimizerUI() {
    const fsrsWeights = global.VocabSRS?.getUserFSRSWeights ? global.VocabSRS.getUserFSRSWeights() : null;
    const historyLogs = global.VocabSRS?.getReviewHistoryLog ? global.VocabSRS.getReviewHistoryLog() : [];
    const count = historyLogs.length;
    const curLocale = global.VocabI18n?.getLocale?.() || 'ja';
    const isJa = curLocale === 'ja';

    const badge = $('fsrsOptBadge');
    const desc = $('fsrsOptDesc');
    if (badge) {
      if (fsrsWeights) {
        badge.textContent = isJa ? `最適化稼働中 (+${fsrsWeights.improvement || '0'}%)` : `Optimized (+${fsrsWeights.improvement || '0'}%)`;
        badge.className = 'badge ok';
      } else if (count >= 20) {
        badge.textContent = isJa ? `最適化可能 (${count}件ログ)` : `Ready to Optimize (${count} logs)`;
        badge.className = 'badge ok';
      } else {
        badge.textContent = isJa ? `初期係数 (${count}/20件)` : `Default Parameters (${count}/20)`;
        badge.className = 'badge';
        badge.style.background = 'var(--b)';
        badge.style.color = 'var(--s)';
      }
    }
    if (desc) {
      if (fsrsWeights) {
        desc.textContent = isJa
          ? `FSRSパーソナライズ学習: 有効（学習ログ ${fsrsWeights.logCount || count}件に基づき最適化中・精度改善 +${fsrsWeights.improvement || '0'}%）`
          : `FSRS Personalized Learning: Active (optimized on ${fsrsWeights.logCount || count} logs, +${fsrsWeights.improvement || '0'}% retention improvement)`;
      } else {
        desc.textContent = isJa
          ? `FSRSパーソナライズ学習: 初期係数稼働中（学習ログ ${count}/20件。20件蓄積で自動最適化されます）`
          : `FSRS Personalized Learning: Running default parameters (${count}/20 logs. Automatically optimizes after 20 reviews)`;
      }
    }
  }

  function updateSmartNotifyUI() {
    const isEnabled = global.VocabSRS?.isSmartNotifyEnabled ? global.VocabSRS.isSmartNotifyEnabled() : true;
    if ($('chkSmartNotify')) $('chkSmartNotify').checked = isEnabled;

    const badge = $('smartNotifyBadge');
    const desc = $('smartNotifyPermDesc');
    const btn = $('btnReqNotify');
    const curLocale = global.VocabI18n?.getLocale?.() || 'ja';
    const isJa = curLocale === 'ja';

    const perm = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'Notification' in window) ? Notification.permission : 'unsupported';
    if (badge) {
      if (!isEnabled) {
        badge.textContent = isJa ? '通知無効' : 'Disabled';
        badge.className = 'badge';
        badge.style.background = 'var(--b)';
        badge.style.color = 'var(--s)';
      } else if (perm === 'granted') {
        badge.textContent = isJa ? '通知稼働中' : 'Active';
        badge.className = 'badge ok';
      } else if (perm === 'denied') {
        badge.textContent = isJa ? '通知ブロック中' : 'Blocked';
        badge.className = 'badge ng';
      } else {
        badge.textContent = isJa ? '通知未許可' : 'Not Granted';
        badge.className = 'badge';
        badge.style.background = 'var(--b)';
        badge.style.color = 'var(--s)';
      }
    }
    if (desc) {
      if (perm === 'granted') desc.textContent = isJa ? 'ブラウザ通知許可済み（記憶定着率90%直前で自動アラート）' : 'Notifications granted (alerts right before memory retention drops to 90%).';
      else if (perm === 'denied') desc.textContent = isJa ? 'ブラウザ設定で通知がブロックされています。設定から許可してください。' : 'Notifications are blocked in browser settings. Please enable them.';
      else desc.textContent = isJa ? '通知ボタンを押してブラウザ通知を許可してください。' : 'Click the button below to enable browser study reminder alerts.';
    }
    if (btn) {
      btn.style.display = perm === 'granted' ? 'none' : 'inline-block';
      if (!isJa) {
        btn.textContent = 'Enable Notifications';
      }
    }
  }

  async function requestSmartNotifyPermission() {
    if (global.VocabSRS?.requestNotificationPermission) {
      const res = await global.VocabSRS.requestNotificationPermission();
      updateSmartNotifyUI();
      if (global.VocabModal?.showToast) {
        if (res === 'granted') {
          global.VocabModal.showToast('忘却臨界点スマートPush通知を許可しました。', 'ok');
        } else {
          global.VocabModal.showToast('通知は許可されませんでした。', 'info');
        }
      }
    }
  }

  async function saveKeyFromModal() {
    const k = $('apiKeyInput')?.value?.trim() || $('customApiKey')?.value?.trim() || '';
    const isSessionOnly = $('chkApiKeySessionOnly')?.checked === true;
    if (global.setKey) {
      global.setKey(k, isSessionOnly);
    } else if (isSessionOnly) {
      try { sessionStorage.setItem('vv_gemini_api_key', k); } catch {}
      try { localStorage.removeItem('vv_gemini_api_key'); } catch {}
      if (global.lsSet) global.lsSet('vv_key_session_only', '1');
    } else if (global.lsSet) {
      global.lsSet('vv_gemini_api_key', k);
      try { sessionStorage.removeItem('vv_gemini_api_key'); } catch {}
      global.lsSet('vv_key_session_only', '0');
    } else if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
      try { localStorage.setItem('vv_gemini_api_key', k); } catch {}
      try { sessionStorage.removeItem('vv_gemini_api_key'); } catch {}
    }
    if (global.App) global.App.cachedModels = null;
    if (global.updKeyUI) global.updKeyUI();
    if (global.updCloudUI) global.updCloudUI();
    if (!k) {
      const msg = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('settings.byok_cleared', 'ローカルAPIキーを消去しました。') : 'ローカルAPIキーを消去しました。';
      if (global.showToast) global.showToast(msg, 'info');
      else alert(msg);
      return;
    }
    if (global.fetchModels) {
      try {
        const m = await global.fetchModels(k, true);
        if (global.updKeyUI) global.updKeyUI(true);
        const msg = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('settings.byok_connected', { count: m.length }) : `接続確認完了 (${m.length}モデル)`;
        if (global.showToast) global.showToast(msg, 'ok');
        else alert(msg);
      } catch (e) {
        if (global.updKeyUI) global.updKeyUI(false);
        const msg = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('settings.byok_error', { err: e.message }) : `接続エラー: ${e.message}`;
        if (global.showToast) global.showToast(msg, 'error');
        else alert(e.message);
      }
    }
    toggleModal('settingsModal', false);
  }

  // --- 単語カード編集モーダル ---
  function parsePipeLines(text, mapFn) {
    return String(text ?? '').split('\n').map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(l => mapFn(l.split('|').map(s => s.trim()))).filter(Boolean);
  }

  function openEditModal(idOrNum, tL = null) {
    const App = global.App || {};
    const targetLang = tL || App.lang || 'en';
    const activeCfg = global.getActivePairConfig ? global.getActivePairConfig() : { key: 'distinction_entries' };
    const curPairKey = activeCfg.key;
    const preferKey = (!App.crossLang || !tL || targetLang === App.srcLang) ? curPairKey : (global.LANGS?.[targetLang]?.key || curPairKey);

    let targetKey = preferKey;
    let list = [...(global.getJson ? global.getJson(preferKey) : [])];
    if (!list.length && App.entries?.length) list = [...App.entries];

    let it = list.find(x => x.id === idOrNum) || list.find(x => x.word === idOrNum || (typeof idOrNum === 'number' && x.num === idOrNum));

    if (!it && global.getAllKnownPairConfigs) {
      const allPairs = global.getAllKnownPairConfigs();
      for (const p of allPairs) {
        const otherList = [...(global.getJson ? global.getJson(p.key) : [])];
        const found = otherList.find(x => x.id === idOrNum) || otherList.find(x => x.word === idOrNum || (typeof idOrNum === 'number' && x.num === idOrNum));
        if (found) {
          it = found;
          targetKey = p.key;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    if (!it) return;

    if ($('editId')) $('editId').value = it.id || '';
    if ($('editLang')) $('editLang').value = it.lang || targetLang;
    if ($('editTargetKey')) $('editTargetKey').value = targetKey;
    if ($('editWord')) $('editWord').value = it.word || '';
    if ($('editHomo')) $('editHomo').value = it.homographIndex || 1;
    if ($('editPho')) $('editPho').value = it.phonetic || '';
    if ($('editGram')) $('editGram').value = it.grammar_forms || '';
    if ($('editCat')) $('editCat').innerHTML = (global.CATS || []).map(c => `<option value="${esc(c)}" ${c === it.category ? 'selected' : ''}>${esc(c)}</option>`).join('');
    if ($('editFol')) $('editFol').value = it.folder || '';
    if ($('editMeanings')) $('editMeanings').value = (it.meanings || []).map(m => `${m.pos} | ${m.text}`).join('\n');
    if ($('editHistNote')) $('editHistNote').value = it.history_note || '';
    if ($('editCore')) $('editCore').value = it.core || '';
    if ($('editConf')) $('editConf').value = it.etymologyConfidence || '';
    if ($('editEty')) $('editEty').value = it.etymology || '';
    if ($('editEtyTags')) $('editEtyTags').value = (it.etymologyTags || []).join(', ');
    const tgtL = App.tgtLang || 'ja';
    const exTrans = it.example?.trans || it.example?.[tgtL] || it.example?.ja || '';
    if ($('editExForeign')) $('editExForeign').value = it.example?.foreign || '';
    if ($('editExUsed')) $('editExUsed').value = it.example?.used_form || '';
    if ($('editExJa')) $('editExJa').value = exTrans;
    if ($('editPhrases')) $('editPhrases').value = (it.phrases || []).map(p => `${p.foreign} | ${p.trans || p[tgtL] || p.ja || ''}`).join('\n');
    if ($('editDerivatives')) $('editDerivatives').value = (it.derivatives || []).map(d => [d.word, d.phonetic || '', d.pos || 'N[C]', d.meaning || '', d.sub_phrase || '', d.sub_trans || ''].join(' | ')).join('\n');
    if ($('editGenMeta')) $('editGenMeta').textContent = it.gen?.model ? `Generated by ${it.gen.model} (pv: ${it.gen.pv})` : (global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('edit.manual_or_legacy', '手動または旧版データ') : '手動または旧版データ');

    toggleModal('editModal', true);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => $('editWord')?.focus());
  }

  function saveEditCard() {
    const App = global.App || {};
    const id = $('editId')?.value;
    let tL = $('editLang')?.value || App.lang || 'en';
    let targetKey = $('editTargetKey')?.value || (global.getActivePairConfig ? global.getActivePairConfig().key : 'distinction_entries');
    let list = [...(global.getJson ? global.getJson(targetKey) : [])];
    let idx = list.findIndex(x => x.id === id);

    if (idx === -1 && global.getAllKnownPairConfigs) {
      const allPairs = global.getAllKnownPairConfigs();
      for (const p of allPairs) {
        const otherList = [...(global.getJson ? global.getJson(p.key) : [])];
        const foundIdx = otherList.findIndex(x => x.id === id);
        if (foundIdx !== -1) {
          list = otherList;
          idx = foundIdx;
          targetKey = p.key;
          tL = p.srcLang || p.lang || tL;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    if (idx === -1) return;

    const w = $('editWord')?.value?.trim().normalize('NFC') || '';
    if (!w) return alert(global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('edit.word_required') : '見出し語を入力してください。');
    const homoIdx = Math.max(1, parseInt($('editHomo')?.value, 10) || 1);

    const meanings = parsePipeLines($('editMeanings')?.value, p => p.length === 1 ? { pos:'N[C]', text:p[0] } : { pos:p[0] || 'N[C]', text:p.slice(1).join(' | ') });
    const prev = list[idx], finalMeanings = meanings.length ? meanings : prev.meanings;
    const makeWordKeyFn = global.VocabMorphology?.makeWordKey || global.makeWordKey || ((word, lang, pos, homo) => `${lang}:${word}#${homo || 1}`);
    const newWk = makeWordKeyFn(w, tL, finalMeanings[0]?.pos, homoIdx);

    const conflictIdx = list.findIndex((x, i) => i !== idx && (x.wordKey || makeWordKeyFn(x.word, tL, x.meanings?.[0]?.pos, x.homographIndex)) === newWk);
    if (conflictIdx !== -1) {
      const msg = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('edit.conflict_confirm', { word: w, homo: homoIdx }) : `既に同じ見出し語・同形番号のカード「${w} (#${homoIdx})」が存在します。\n別カードとして残す場合は「キャンセル」、既存カードを上書き統合する場合は「OK」を押してください。`;
      if (!confirm(msg)) return;
    }

    const tgtL = App.tgtLang || 'ja';
    const phrases = parsePipeLines($('editPhrases')?.value, p => {
      if (!p[0]) return null;
      const res = { foreign: p[0], trans: p[1] || '' };
      res[tgtL] = p[1] || '';
      res.ja = p[1] || '';
      return res;
    });
    const derivatives = parsePipeLines($('editDerivatives')?.value, p => p[0] ? { word:p[0], phonetic:cleanPho(p[1] || ''), pos:p[2] || 'N[C]', meaning:p[3] || '', sub_phrase:p[4] || '', sub_trans:p[5] || '' } : null);

    const confVal = $('editConf')?.value, rawTags = ($('editEtyTags')?.value || '').split(/[,、]+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    const exF = $('editExForeign')?.value?.trim() || '', exTransVal = $('editExJa')?.value?.trim() || '', exU = $('editExUsed')?.value?.trim() || '', now = Date.now();

    const oldWk = prev.wordKey || makeWordKeyFn(prev.word, tL, prev.meanings?.[0]?.pos, prev.homographIndex);
    const tombMap = global.VocabStorage ? global.VocabStorage.getTombstones(targetKey) : new Map();
    if (oldWk && oldWk !== newWk) tombMap.set(`wk:${oldWk}`, now);
    tombMap.delete(`wk:${newWk}`);
    tombMap.delete(`id:${prev.id}`);

    const sanitizeItemFn = global.sanitizeItem || (x => x);
    const validateEntryFn = global.validateEntry || (() => []);
    const etyConfEnum = global.ETY_CONF_ENUM || ['certain', 'probable', 'disputed', 'unknown'];

    const updated = sanitizeItemFn({
      ...prev, word: w, homographIndex: homoIdx, wordKey: newWk,
      version: (Number(prev.version) || 1) + 1,
      phonetic: cleanPho($('editPho')?.value), grammar_forms: $('editGram')?.value?.trim() || undefined,
      category: $('editCat')?.value, folder: $('editFol')?.value?.trim() || undefined,
      meanings: finalMeanings, history_note: $('editHistNote')?.value?.trim() || undefined, core: $('editCore')?.value?.trim(),
      etymologyConfidence: etyConfEnum.includes(confVal) ? confVal : undefined,
      etymology: $('editEty')?.value?.trim(), etymologyTags: confVal === 'unknown' ? [] : rawTags,
      example: (exF || exTransVal) ? { foreign: exF, trans: exTransVal, [tgtL]: exTransVal, ja: exTransVal, used_form: exU || undefined } : null,
      phrases, derivatives, updatedAt: now
    }, idx, tL);

    updated.flags = validateEntryFn(updated);
    list[idx] = updated;
    if (conflictIdx !== -1) {
      const [removed] = list.splice(conflictIdx, 1);
      if (removed?.id) tombMap.set(`id:${removed.id}`, now);
      if (removed?.wordKey && removed.wordKey !== newWk && removed.wordKey !== updated.wordKey) {
        tombMap.set(`wk:${removed.wordKey}`, now);
      }
    }
    if (global.VocabStorage) global.VocabStorage.saveTombstones(targetKey, tombMap);

    const nextList = list.map((it, i) => ({ ...it, num: i + 1 }));
    if (global.setJson) {
      global.setJson(targetKey, nextList, true, true);
    } else if (global.VocabStorage) {
      global.VocabStorage.state.mem[targetKey] = nextList;
    }
    if (targetKey === (global.getActivePairConfig ? global.getActivePairConfig().key : '')) {
      App.entries = global.VocabStorage?.state?.mem?.[targetKey] || nextList;
    }
    toggleModal('editModal', false);
    if (global.load) global.load(App.page);
    showToast(global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('edit.updated', { word: w }) : `「${w}」を更新しました`, 'ok');
  }

  const LEVEL_NAMES = {

    fr: { b1: 'Intermédiaire inférieur', b2: 'Intermédiaire', c1: 'Avancé', acad: 'Académique & Spécialisé (Articles / Concepts & Sciences)', all_key: 'Tous les termes clés (Mots-clés, polysémie, locutions)' },
    de: { b1: 'Untere Mittelstufe', b2: 'Mittelstufe', c1: 'Oberstufe', acad: 'Akademisch & Fachspezifisch (Publikationen / Wissenschaft)', all_key: 'Alle Schlüsselwörter (Fachbegriffe, Mehrdeutige, Idiome)' },
    es: { b1: 'Intermedio inicial', b2: 'Intermedio', c1: 'Avanzado', acad: 'Académico y especializado (Artículos / Ciencias y leyes)', all_key: 'Todos los términos clave (Palabras clave, giros, modismos)' },
    it: { b1: 'Intermedio inferiore', b2: 'Intermedio', c1: 'Avanzado', acad: 'Accademico e specialistico (Articoli / Scienze e diritto)', all_key: 'Tutti i termini chiave (Parole chiave, polisemia, idiomi)' },
    pt: { b1: 'Intermediário inferior', b2: 'Intermediário', c1: 'Avançado', acad: 'Acadêmico e especializado (Artigos / Ciências e leis)', all_key: 'Todos os termos-chave (Palavras-chave, polissemias, expressões)' },
    nl: { b1: 'Lager gevorderd', b2: 'Gevorderd', c1: 'Vergevorderd', acad: 'Academisch & Vakspecifiek (Publicaties / Wetenschap)', all_key: 'Alle kernwoorden (Trefwoorden, polysemie, uitdrukkingen)' },
    zh: { b1: '初中级', b2: '中级', c1: '高级', acad: '学术与专业 (学术论文 / 概念史 / 政法与科学)', all_key: '全部核心词 (关键词 / 多义词 / 熟语成语)' },
    ko: { b1: '초중급', b2: '중급', c1: '고급', acad: '학술·전문 (논문 / 개념사·법정·과학)', all_key: '모든 중요 어휘 (핵심어·다의어·숙어)' },
    ja: { b1: '初中級', b2: '中級', c1: '上級', acad: '学術・専門 (論文 / 概念史・法政・科学)', all_key: '重要語すべて (キーワード・多義語・熟語)' }
  };

    en: { b1: 'CEFR B1 / TOEIC 500-650 / EIKEN 2', b2: 'CEFR B2 / TOEIC 700-850 / EIKEN Pre-1', c1: 'CEFR C1 / TOEFL 100+ / EIKEN 1' },
    fr: { b1: 'DELF A2-B1', b2: 'DELF B2', c1: 'DALF C1-C2' },

    es: { b1: 'DELE A2-B1', b2: 'DELE B2', c1: 'DELE C1-C2' },
    it: { b1: 'CILS A2-B1', b2: 'CILS B2', c1: 'CILS C1-C2' },
    pt: { b1: 'CELPE-Bras B1', b2: 'CELPE-Bras B2', c1: 'CELPE-Bras C1-C2' },
    nl: { b1: 'NT2 A2-B1 / CNaVT', b2: 'NT2 B2 / Staatsexamen I', c1: 'NT2 C1-C2 / Staatsexamen II' },
    zh: { b1: 'HSK 3-4', b2: 'HSK 5', c1: 'HSK 6-9' },
```
