```javascript
  };

  function getLocalizedLevelLabel(targetLang, levelId, uiLocale, fallbackLabel) {
    if (uiLocale === 'ja') return fallbackLabel || LEVEL_NAMES.ja[levelId] || levelId;
    const loc = LEVEL_NAMES[uiLocale] ? uiLocale : 'en';
    if (levelId === 'acad') return LEVEL_NAMES[loc].acad;
    if (levelId === 'all_key') return LEVEL_NAMES[loc].all_key;
    const prefix = LEVEL_NAMES[loc][levelId] || LEVEL_NAMES.en[levelId] || levelId;
    const exam = TARGET_LANG_EXAMS_INTL[targetLang]?.[levelId];
    return exam ? `${prefix} (${exam})` : prefix;
  }

  function refreshExtractLevelOptions() {
    const App = global.App || {};
    const cfg = global.LANGS?.[App.lang] || global.LANGS?.en || { badge: 'EN', levels: [] };
    const sel = $('extLevelSel');
    if (!sel) return;
    const currentVal = sel.value || (global.lsGet ? global.lsGet('vv_ext_level', 'b2') : 'b2');
    const curLoc = global.VocabI18n?.getLocale ? global.VocabI18n.getLocale() : 'ja';
    sel.innerHTML = '';
    (cfg.levels || []).forEach(o => {
      const lbl = getLocalizedLevelLabel(App.lang, o.id, curLoc, o.label);
      const el = new Option(lbl, o.id);
      if (o.id === currentVal) el.selected = true;
      sel.add(el);
    });
    if ($('extLangBadge')) {
      $('extLangBadge').textContent = (curLoc === 'ja' ? cfg.badge : (cfg.label || cfg.badge));
    }
  }

  // --- パッセージ抽出モーダル ---
  function openExtractModal() {
    const App = global.App || {};
    refreshExtractLevelOptions();
    if ($('inFol')?.value?.trim() && !$('extFolInput')?.value?.trim() && $('extFolInput')) {
      $('extFolInput').value = $('inFol').value.trim();
    }
    const getKeyFn = global.getKey || (() => '');
    if ($('ocrInlineApiKey') && getKeyFn()) $('ocrInlineApiKey').value = getKeyFn();
    toggleModal('extractModal', true);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => $('extTextarea')?.focus());
  }

  function updateExtCounts() {
    const App = global.App || {};
    const list = App.extCandidates || [];
    const n = list.filter(c => c.checked).length;
    const alr = list.filter(c => c.already).length;
    const unadded = list.length - alr;
    const curLoc = global.VocabI18n?.getLocale ? global.VocabI18n.getLocale() : 'ja';
    const isEn = curLoc !== 'ja';
    if ($('extResCount')) {
      if (isEn) {
        $('extResCount').innerHTML = `<span>Candidates: ${list.length} words</span> <small style="font-size:11px;color:var(--s);margin-left:6px">(New: <strong style="color:var(--ok)">${unadded}</strong> / In wordbook: <strong style="color:var(--m)">${alr}</strong>)</small>`;
      } else {
        $('extResCount').innerHTML = `<span>抽出候補: ${list.length} 語</span> <small style="font-size:11px;color:var(--s);margin-left:6px">（未登録: <strong style="color:var(--ok)">${unadded}</strong> 語 / 登録済: <strong style="color:var(--m)">${alr}</strong> 語）</small>`;
      }
    }
    if ($('btnCommitExt')) {
      $('btnCommitExt').disabled = !n;
      $('btnCommitExt').textContent = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('ext.commit_batch', { n }) : (isEn ? `Add ${n} Selected Words` : `選択した ${n} 語を一括登録`);
    }
  }

  function renderExtCandidates() {
    const App = global.App || {};
    updateExtCounts();
    const curLoc = global.VocabI18n?.getLocale ? global.VocabI18n.getLocale() : 'ja';
    const isEn = curLoc !== 'ja';
    const spkFn = (txt, l) => global.VocabSpeech ? global.VocabSpeech.mkSpkBtn(txt, l, true) : (global.mkSpkBtn ? global.mkSpkBtn(txt, l, true) : '');
    if ($('extCandidateGrid')) {
      $('extCandidateGrid').innerHTML = (App.extCandidates || []).map((c, i) => `<label class="ext-item ${c.checked ? 'checked' : ''} ${c.already ? 'already' : ''}"><input type="checkbox" data-ext-idx="${i}" ${c.checked ? 'checked' : ''}><div class="ext-info"><div class="ext-w"><span>${esc(c.word)}</span>${c.pos ? `<span class="ext-p">${esc(c.pos)}</span>` : ''}${c.already ? `<span class="ext-alr-badge">${isEn ? 'Added' : '登録済'}</span>` : ''}${spkFn(c.word, App.lang)}</div><div class="ext-m" title="${esc(c.sentence || c.meaning)}">${esc(c.meaning)}</div></div></label>`).join('');
    }
  }

  function toggleAllExtChecks(mode) {
    const App = global.App || {};
    (App.extCandidates || []).forEach(c => {
      if (mode === 'all') c.checked = true;
      else if (mode === true) c.checked = !c.already;
      else c.checked = false;
    });
    renderExtCandidates();
  }

  let _isCommittingExt = false;

  function commitExtractedWords() {
    if (_isCommittingExt) return;
    const App = global.App || {};
    const sel = (App.extCandidates || []).filter(c => c.checked).map(({ word, pos, meaning, sentence }) => ({ word, pos, meaning, sentence }));
    if (!sel.length) return;

    _isCommittingExt = true;
    try {
      const getKeyFn = global.getKey || (() => '');
      const usageInfo = global.VocabStorage?.getDailyAiUsageInfo ? global.VocabStorage.getDailyAiUsageInfo({ appState: App }) : null;
      if (usageInfo && !usageInfo.isUnlimited && usageInfo.remaining <= 0 && !getKeyFn()) {
        toggleModal('extractModal', false);
        openUpsellModal('本日のAI新規生成無料枠（5語/日）をすべて消費しました。抽出した単語を一括登録するにはProプランをご利用いただくか、明日以降に再度お試しください。');
        return;
      }
      const f = $('extFolInput')?.value?.trim() || $('inFol')?.value?.trim() || '';
      if (f && $('inFol')) $('inFol').value = f;
      toggleModal('extractModal', false);
      const regFn = global.VocabQueue?.registerWordsList || global.registerWordsList;
      if (regFn) {
        regFn(sel, f, $('chkHist')?.checked, $('chkWikt')?.checked);
      }
    } finally {
      setTimeout(() => { _isCommittingExt = false; }, 600);
    }
  }

  // --- スターターパック ギャラリーモーダル ---
  function openStarterPackModal() {
    const modal = $('starterPackModal');
    if (!modal) return;
    const body = $('starterPackModalBody');
    const currentLang = global.App?.srcLang || global.App?.lang || 'en';
    if (body && global.VocabStarterPack?.buildStarterPackGalleryHtml) {
      body.innerHTML = global.VocabStarterPack.buildStarterPackGalleryHtml(currentLang);
    }
    toggleModal('starterPackModal', true);
  }

  function installStarterPackFromModal(packId) {
    if (!packId || !global.VocabStarterPack?.populateStarterPack) return;
    const App = global.App || {};
    const meta = global.VocabStarterPack.PACK_METADATA?.[packId];
    const packLang = meta?.lang || 'en';

    // パックの対象言語と現在の選択言語が異なる場合は自動同期切り替え
    if (meta?.lang && App.srcLang && meta.lang !== App.srcLang) {
      const tgt = App.tgtLang || 'ja';
      if (typeof global.VocabCore?.setLanguagePair === 'function') {
        global.VocabCore.setLanguagePair(meta.lang, tgt);
      } else if (typeof global.setLanguagePair === 'function') {
        global.setLanguagePair(meta.lang, tgt);
      }
    }

    const curPairKey = global.VocabCore?.getActivePairConfig?.()?.key || (meta?.lang ? (meta.lang === 'en' ? 'distinction_entries' : `distinction_entries_${meta.lang}`) : 'distinction_entries');
    const curEntries = (typeof global.VocabCore?.getJson === 'function' ? global.VocabCore.getJson(curPairKey) : (global.VocabStorage?.state?.mem?.[curPairKey] || []));
    const lang = App.srcLang || App.lang || packLang;
    const targetTgt = App.tgtLang || 'ja';
    const { added, merged } = global.VocabStarterPack.populateStarterPack(curEntries, lang, packId, curPairKey, targetTgt);

    if (added.length === 0) {
      showToast('このスターターパックの単語はすべて既にライブラリに存在します。', 'info');
      return;
    }

    if (global.setJson) {
      global.setJson(curPairKey, merged, true, true);
    } else if (global.VocabStorage) {
      global.VocabStorage.state.mem[curPairKey] = merged;
    }
    App.entries = global.VocabStorage?.state?.mem?.[curPairKey] || merged;
    const activePairId = global.VocabCore?.getActivePairConfig?.()?.pairId || `${lang}_ja`;
    try { localStorage.setItem(`vv_starter_loaded_${activePairId}`, '1'); } catch {}

    toggleModal('starterPackModal', false);
    if (global.load) global.load(1);

    const packName = global.VocabStarterPack.PACK_METADATA?.[packId]?.name || packId;
    showToast(`「${packName}」（${added.length}語）をライブラリに取り込みました。`, 'ok', 4000);
  }

  // --- Anki インポートモーダル ---
  function openAnkiImportModal() {
    const modal = $('ankiImportModal');
    if (!modal) return;
    const textEl = $('ankiImportText');
    if (textEl) textEl.value = '';
    const fileEl = $('ankiFileInput');
    if (fileEl) fileEl.value = '';
    const previewEl = $('ankiImportPreview');
    if (previewEl) previewEl.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--m)">TSV/CSVテキストを貼り付けるか、ファイルを選択してください</span>';
    toggleModal('ankiImportModal', true);
  }

  async function handleAnkiFileSelect(ev) {
    const f = ev.target?.files?.[0];
    if (!f) return;
    if (f.name.endsWith('.apkg')) {
      const previewEl = $('ankiImportPreview');
      if (previewEl) previewEl.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--m)">Anki (.apkg) パッケージを解析中...</span>';
      try {
        if (global.VocabExport?.importAnkiFile) {
          await global.VocabExport.importAnkiFile(f, {
            showToast: showToast
          });
          toggleModal('ankiImportModal', false);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (previewEl) previewEl.innerHTML = `<span style="color:var(--err)">APKG解析失敗: ${esc(err.message)}</span>`;
      }
      return;
    }
    const r = new FileReader();
    r.onload = e => {
      const text = e.target.result;
      const textEl = $('ankiImportText');
      if (textEl) textEl.value = text;
      previewAnkiImport(text);
    };
    r.readAsText(f);
  }

  function previewAnkiImport(text = null) {
    const raw = text !== null ? text : ($('ankiImportText')?.value || '');
    const previewEl = $('ankiImportPreview');
    if (!previewEl) return;

    if (!raw.trim()) {
      previewEl.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--m)">テキストを入力するか、ファイルを選択してください</span>';
      return;
    }

    const items = global.VocabExport?.parseAnkiExport ? global.VocabExport.parseAnkiExport(raw) : [];
    if (!items.length) {
      previewEl.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--err)">有効な単語が検出されませんでした。フォーマットをご確認ください。</span>';
      return;
    }

    const sample = items.slice(0, 3).map(i => `
      <div style="padding:4px 8px;background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--b);border-radius:4px;margin-top:4px;font-size:11.5px">
        <strong>${esc(i.word)}</strong> ${i.phonetic ? `<em>[${esc(i.phonetic)}]</em>` : ''} - <span>${esc(i.meanings?.[0]?.text || '')}</span>
      </div>
    `).join('');

    previewEl.innerHTML = `
      <div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ok)">検出された単語: ${items.length} 語</div>
      <div style="margin-top:4px">${sample}</div>
      ${items.length > 3 ? `<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--m);margin-top:4px">他 ${items.length - 3} 語...</div>` : ''}
    `;
  }

  function executeAnkiImport() {
    const raw = $('ankiImportText')?.value || '';
    if (!raw.trim()) {
      showToast('インポートするAnkiデータがありません。', 'warn');
      return;
    }

    try {
      if (global.VocabExport?.importAnkiText) {
        global.VocabExport.importAnkiText(raw);
        toggleModal('ankiImportModal', false);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(`インポートに失敗しました: ${err.message}`, 'err');
    }
  }

  // --- 共有デッキインポートモーダル ---
  let pendingShareDeck = null;
  function openShareDeckModal(deckData) {
    if (!deckData || !Array.isArray(deckData.items)) return;
    pendingShareDeck = deckData;
    const titleEl = $('shareDeckModalTitle');
    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = deckData.title || '共有デッキのインポート';
    const countEl = $('shareDeckModalCount');
    if (countEl) countEl.textContent = `${deckData.count || deckData.items.length} 語 (${(deckData.lang || 'en').toUpperCase()})`;
    const listEl = $('shareDeckModalList');
    if (listEl) {
      listEl.innerHTML = deckData.items.slice(0, 30).map(i => `
        <div style="padding:6px 10px;background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--b);border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:6px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center">
          <div>
            <strong>${esc(i.word)}</strong> ${i.phonetic ? `<small style="color:var(--m)">[${esc(i.phonetic)}]</small>` : ''}
            <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--t-m);margin-top:2px">${esc(i.meanings?.[0]?.text || '')}</div>
          </div>
          ${(i.etymologyTags && i.etymologyTags.length) ? `<span class="badge" style="background:rgba(217,119,6,0.12);color:var(--w-root);border:1px solid rgba(217,119,6,0.3)">*${esc(i.etymologyTags[0].replace(/^\*/, ''))}</span>` : ''}
        </div>
      `).join('') + (deckData.items.length > 30 ? `<div style="text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:var(--m);padding:6px">他 ${deckData.items.length - 30} 語...</div>` : '');
    }
    toggleModal('shareDeckModal', true);
  }

  function executeShareDeckImport() {
    if (!pendingShareDeck || !pendingShareDeck.items) return;
    const items = pendingShareDeck.items;
    const lang = pendingShareDeck.lang || 'en';
    const activeCfg = global.VocabCore?.getActivePairConfig?.();
    const curSrc = activeCfg?.srcLang || global.App?.srcLang || global.App?.lang || 'en';
    const pairKey = (activeCfg && (global.App?.lang === lang || activeCfg.sourceLang === lang || curSrc === lang))
      ? activeCfg.key
      : (global.LANGS?.[lang]?.key || (lang === 'en' ? 'distinction_entries' : `distinction_entries_${lang}_ja`));
    const cur = (global.VocabStorage ? global.VocabStorage.getJson(pairKey) : null) || (lang === (global.App?.lang || 'en') ? (global.App?.entries || []) : []);
    const existingWords = new Set(cur.map(i => String(i.word || '').toLowerCase()));
    let added = 0;
    let skipped = 0;
    const toAdd = [];
    let maxNum = cur.reduce((m, i) => Math.max(m, i.num || 0), 0);

    const tombMap = global.VocabStorage ? global.VocabStorage.getTombstones(pairKey) : null;
    const sanitizeFn = global.sanitizeItem || (x => x);

    items.forEach(rawIt => {
      const it = sanitizeFn(rawIt, maxNum, lang);
      const wLower = String(it.word || '').toLowerCase();
      if (tombMap) {
        tombMap.delete(`word:${wLower}`);
        if (it.id) tombMap.delete(`id:${it.id}`);
        if (it.wordKey) tombMap.delete(`wk:${it.wordKey}`);
      }
      if (existingWords.has(wLower)) {
        skipped++;
      } else {
        existingWords.add(wLower);
        maxNum++;
        it.num = maxNum;
        toAdd.push(it);
        added++;
      }
    });

    if (tombMap && global.VocabStorage) {
      global.VocabStorage.saveTombstones(pairKey, tombMap);
    }

    const merged = [...cur, ...toAdd];
    if (global.setJson) {
      global.setJson(pairKey, merged, true, true);
    } else if (global.VocabStorage) {
      global.VocabStorage.state.mem[pairKey] = merged;
    }
    if (lang === curSrc) {
      if (global.App) global.App.entries = merged;
      if (global.load) global.load(1);
    }

    toggleModal('shareDeckModal', false);
    if (global.VocabModal?.showToast) {
      global.VocabModal.showToast(`共有デッキを取り込みました: ${added} 語を追加（${skipped} 語は既存登録済）`, 'ok');
    }
    pendingShareDeck = null;
  }

  // グローバルクリックハンドラ（starter pack install 等のデリゲーション）
  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    document.addEventListener('click', e => {
      const btn = e.target?.closest?.('[data-act="install-starter-pack"]');
      if (btn) {
        const packId = btn.getAttribute('data-pack');
        if (packId) installStarterPackFromModal(packId);
      }
      const starterBtn = e.target?.closest?.('[data-act="open-starter-modal"]');
      if (starterBtn) {
        openStarterPackModal();
      }
    });
  }

  // グローバル関数バインド
  global.exportAnkiAPKG = function () {
    if (global.VocabExport?.exportAnkiAPKG) {
      const items = global.App?.entries || [];
      const lang = global.App?.lang || 'en';
      global.VocabExport.exportAnkiAPKG(items, lang);
    }
  };

  global.syncObsidianVaultDirect = async function () {
    if (global.VocabExport?.syncObsidianVault) {
      const items = global.App?.entries || [];
      const lang = global.App?.lang || 'en';
      await global.VocabExport.syncObsidianVault(items, lang, { showToast });
    }
  };

  global.generateCurrentShareDeckUrl = function () {
    if (global.VocabExport?.generateShareDeckUrl) {
      const getFilteredFn = global.VocabCore?.getFiltered || global.getFiltered;
      const items = (typeof getFilteredFn === 'function' ? getFilteredFn() : null) || global.App?.entries || [];
      const lang = global.App?.srcLang || global.App?.lang || 'en';
      const folder = global.App?.fol || (lang.toUpperCase() + ' 重要語彙');
      const res = global.VocabExport.generateShareDeckUrl(items, folder, lang);
      if (res && res.shareUrl) {
        showToast(`共有URLを発行しました (${res.count}語)。クリップボードにコピー済みです。`, 'ok');
      }
    }
  };

  global.openShareDeckModal = openShareDeckModal;
  global.executeShareDeckImport = executeShareDeckImport;
  global.switchSettingsTab = switchSettingsTab;
  global.refreshExtractLevelOptions = refreshExtractLevelOptions;
  global.getLocalizedLevelLabel = getLocalizedLevelLabel;

  // --- グローバルエクスポート ---
  global.VocabModal = {
    toggleModal,
    closeAllModals,
    showToast,
    announceA11y,
    toggleDarkMode,
    LEGAL_TEXTS,
    switchLegalTab,
    openLegalModal,
    openUpsellModal,
    openSettings,
    switchSettingsTab,
    saveKeyFromModal,
    parsePipeLines,
    openEditModal,
    saveEditCard,
    openExtractModal,
    refreshExtractLevelOptions,
    getLocalizedLevelLabel,
    updateExtCounts,
    renderExtCandidates,
    toggleAllExtChecks,
    commitExtractedWords,
    updateFSRSOptimizerUI,
    updateSmartNotifyUI,
    requestSmartNotifyPermission,
    openStarterPackModal,
    installStarterPackFromModal,
    openAnkiImportModal,
    handleAnkiFileSelect,
    previewAnkiImport,
    executeAnkiImport,
    openShareDeckModal,
    executeShareDeckImport
  };
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);
```

### File: `js/navigation.js`

```javascript
/**
 * VocabVault - Keyboard Shortcuts, Word Suggest, and UI Navigation Module
 *
 * 【設計思想・単一責任】
 * キーボードファースト操作（Linear / Vim ライクな J/K/Space/E/R/? ナビゲーション）、
 * 単語登録時のインクリメンタルサジェスト（完全一致・部分一致・印欧祖語語根）、
 * カードフォーカス枠線およびアクセシビリティスクロールの統括。
 */

(function (global) {
  'use strict';

  // 重要印欧祖語語根リスト（サジェスト用マスターデータ）
  const DEFAULT_PIE_ROOTS = [
    '*sta-', '*genh₁-', '*bʰer-', '*sekʷ-', '*men-', '*wer-',
    '*kʷel-', '*dʰeh₁-', '*weid-', '*med-', '*kap-', '*ten-'
  ];

  /**
   * 文字列エスケープヘルパー
   */
  function esc(s) {
    if (global.VocabCore && typeof global.VocabCore.esc === 'function') {
      return global.VocabCore.esc(s);
    }
    return String(s || '')
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
      .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
      .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
      .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
      .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
  }

  /**
   * 単語および祖語語根の候補リストを抽出・ソート
   * @param {string} query
   * @param {Array} currentList - 現在の言語ペアの登録単語配列
   * @param {Array} [pieRoots] - 祖語語根配列
   * @returns {Array} suggestions
   */
  function buildSuggestions(query, currentList = [], pieRoots = DEFAULT_PIE_ROOTS) {
    const raw = (query || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!raw) return [];

    const suggestions = [];
    const list = Array.isArray(currentList) ? currentList : [];

    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      if (suggestions.length >= 7) break;
      const item = list[i];
      if (!item || !item.word) continue;
      const wLow = String(item.word).toLowerCase();
      const isExact = wLow === raw;
      if (isExact || wLow.startsWith(raw) || (raw.length >= 3 && wLow.includes(raw))) {
        const entry = {
          type: 'word',
          word: item.word,
          meaning: item.meanings?.[0]?.text || '',
          pos: item.meanings?.[0]?.pos || '',
          folder: item.folder || '',
          isRegistered: true,
          isExact,
          item
        };
        if (isExact) suggestions.unshift(entry);
        else suggestions.push(entry);
      }
    }

    const roots = Array.isArray(pieRoots) && pieRoots.length ? pieRoots : DEFAULT_PIE_ROOTS;
    for (let i = 0; i < roots.length; i++) {
      if (suggestions.length >= 8) break;
      const r = roots[i];
      const cleanR = r.replace(/[\*h₁-₃\-]/g, '').toLowerCase();
      if (cleanR.startsWith(raw) || r.toLowerCase().includes(raw)) {
        suggestions.push({
          type: 'root',
          word: r,
          meaning: '印欧祖語・重要語根',
          pos: 'Root',
          isRegistered: false,
          isExact: false
        });
      }
    }

    // スペルミス・タイポのサジェスト判定 (もしかして判定)
    if (!suggestions.some(s => s.isExact) && global.VocabMorphology?.findTypoSuggestion) {
      const typo = global.VocabMorphology.findTypoSuggestion(raw, 'en', list);
      if (typo) {
        suggestions.unshift({
          type: 'typo',
          word: typo.suggestion,
          meaning: `「${raw}」の修正候補（もしかして）`,
          pos: 'スペル修正',
          isRegistered: false,
          isExact: false,
          isTypo: true
        });
      }
    }

    return suggestions;
  }

  /**
   * サジェスト要素の HTML を生成
   * @param {Array} suggestions
   * @param {Function} [escFn]
   * @returns {string} HTML
   */
  function renderSuggestHtml(suggestions, escFn = esc) {
    if (!Array.isArray(suggestions) || !suggestions.length) return '';

    return suggestions.map((s, idx) => {
      if (s.isTypo) {
        return `
          <div class="suggest-item typo-suggest" data-idx="${idx}" data-type="typo" data-word="${escFn(s.word)}" style="background:rgba(245,158,11,0.08);border-left:3px solid var(--warn)">
            <div class="suggest-item-left">
              <span class="suggest-item-word" style="color:var(--warn)">もしかして: <strong style="color:var(--t)">${escFn(s.word)}</strong></span>
              <span class="suggest-item-meaning">${escFn(s.meaning)}</span>
            </div>
            <span class="suggest-item-badge" style="background:rgba(245,158,11,0.15);color:var(--warn);border:1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.3)">
              スペル補正
            </span>
          </div>
        `;
      }
      const jumpW = (s.item && s.item.homographIndex > 1) ? `${s.word}#${s.item.homographIndex}` : s.word;
      return `
        <div class="suggest-item ${s.isExact ? 'exact-match' : ''}" data-idx="${idx}" data-type="${s.type}" data-word="${escFn(jumpW)}">
          <div class="suggest-item-left">
            <span class="suggest-item-word">${escFn(s.word)}${s.folder ? `<small style="margin-left:6px;font-size:10px;color:var(--m)">[${escFn(s.folder)}]</small>` : ''}</span>
            <span class="suggest-item-meaning">${escFn(s.meaning)}</span>
          </div>
          <span class="suggest-item-badge ${s.isExact ? 'exact' : s.isRegistered ? 'registered' : s.type === 'root' ? 'root' : ''}">
            ${s.isExact ? '登録済(タップで移動)' : s.isRegistered ? '登録済' : s.type === 'root' ? '語根' : escFn(s.pos)}
          </span>
        </div>
      `;
    }).join('');
  }

  /**
   * カード要素のフォーカス状態を更新
   * @param {number} newIdx
   * @param {Array<HTMLElement>} cards
   * @returns {number} clampedIndex
   */
  function clampAndFocusCard(newIdx, cards) {
    if (!cards || !cards.length) return -1;
    const clampedIdx = Math.max(0, Math.min(newIdx, cards.length - 1));
    cards.forEach((c, i) => {
      if (c && c.classList && typeof c.classList.toggle === 'function') {
        c.classList.toggle('card-focused', i === clampedIdx);
      }
    });
    const targetCard = cards[clampedIdx];
    if (targetCard && typeof targetCard.scrollIntoView === 'function') {
      try {
        targetCard.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
      } catch {
        targetCard.scrollIntoView();
      }
    }
    return clampedIdx;
  }

  /**
   * 現在フォーカスされているカードに対応する単語データを取得
   * @param {number} focusedIndex
   * @param {Array<HTMLElement>} cards
   * @param {Function} getListFn
   * @param {string} currentLang
   * @param {Function} [makeLkFn]
   * @returns {Object|null}
   */
  function getFocusedCardItem(focusedIndex, cards, getListFn, currentLang, makeLkFn) {
    if (!cards || focusedIndex < 0 || focusedIndex >= cards.length) return null;
    const targetCard = cards[focusedIndex];
    if (!targetCard) return null;
    const cardId = targetCard.dataset?.id;
    const lk = targetCard.dataset?.word;
    const tL = targetCard.dataset?.lang || currentLang;
    const list = typeof getListFn === 'function' ? getListFn(tL) : [];
    if (!Array.isArray(list)) return null;

    if (cardId) {
      const byId = list.find(i => i && i.id === cardId);
      if (byId) return byId;
    }

    const mkLk = makeLkFn || ((w, l, idx) => {
      if (global.VocabMorphology && typeof global.VocabMorphology.makeLookupKey === 'function') {
        return global.VocabMorphology.makeLookupKey(w, l, idx);
      }
      const base = l === 'de' ? String(w || '').trim() : String(w || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      return Number(idx) > 1 ? `${base}#${Number(idx)}` : base;
    });

    return list.find(i => mkLk(i.word, tL, i.homographIndex) === lk) || null;
  }

  /**
   * 単語入力サジェスト UI の初期化とイベントバインド
   * @param {Object} options
   * @returns {Object} controls
   */
  function initWordSuggest(options = {}) {
    const doc = typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document : null;
    const input = options.input || (doc ? doc.getElementById('inWord') : null);
    const box = options.box || (doc ? doc.getElementById('wordSuggestBox') : null);
    if (!input || !box) return null;

    let activeIndex = -1;

    function renderSuggestions(query) {
      const currentList = typeof options.getCurrentList === 'function' ? options.getCurrentList() : [];
      const suggestions = buildSuggestions(query, currentList, options.pieRoots);

      if (!suggestions.length) {
        box.style.display = 'none';
        box.innerHTML = '';
        activeIndex = -1;
        return;
      }

      activeIndex = -1;
      box.innerHTML = renderSuggestHtml(suggestions, options.esc || esc);
      box.style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function updateActiveSuggestion(items) {
      items.forEach((it, idx) => {
        if (it.classList) it.classList.toggle('active', idx === activeIndex);
        if (idx === activeIndex && typeof it.scrollIntoView === 'function') {
          try {
            it.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
          } catch {}
        }
      });
    }

    function applySuggestion(el) {
      if (!el) return;
      const type = el.dataset?.type;
      const word = el.dataset?.word;
      box.style.display = 'none';
      if (type === 'typo') {
        input.value = word;
        input.focus();
        return;
      }
      input.value = '';
      try { input.blur(); } catch {}
      if (type === 'word') {
        if (typeof options.onJumpWord === 'function') options.onJumpWord(word);
      } else if (type === 'root') {
        if (typeof options.onOpenRootGraph === 'function') options.onOpenRootGraph(word);
      }
    }

    const onInput = e => renderSuggestions(e.target.value);
    input.addEventListener('input', onInput);

    const onKeydown = e => {
      if (box.style.display === 'none') return;
      const items = box.querySelectorAll('.suggest-item');
      if (!items.length) return;

      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
        e.preventDefault();
        activeIndex = (activeIndex + 1) % items.length;
        updateActiveSuggestion(items);
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
        e.preventDefault();
        activeIndex = (activeIndex - 1 + items.length) % items.length;
        updateActiveSuggestion(items);
      } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        if (activeIndex >= 0) {
          e.preventDefault();
          const selItem = items[activeIndex];
          applySuggestion(selItem);
        } else {
          const firstExact = box.querySelector('.suggest-item.exact-match');
          if (firstExact) {
            e.preventDefault();
            applySuggestion(firstExact);
          }
        }
      } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        box.style.display = 'none';
      }
    };
    input.addEventListener('keydown', onKeydown);

    const onBoxClick = e => {
      const item = e.target.closest?.('.suggest-item');
      if (item) applySuggestion(item);
    };
    box.addEventListener('click', onBoxClick);

    const onDocClick = e => {
      if (!e.target.closest?.('#inWordWrap')) {
        box.style.display = 'none';
      }
    };
    if (doc) doc.addEventListener('click', onDocClick);

    return {
      renderSuggestions,
      applySuggestion,
      destroy: () => {
        input.removeEventListener('input', onInput);
        input.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeydown);
        box.removeEventListener('click', onBoxClick);
        if (doc) doc.removeEventListener('click', onDocClick);
      }
    };
  }

  /**
   * グローバルキーボードショートカットのディスパッチャ
   * @param {KeyboardEvent} e
   * @param {Object} ctx
   * @returns {boolean} handled
   */
  function handleGlobalKeydown(e, ctx = {}) {
    if (!e || e.isComposing) return false;
    const doc = typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document : null;
    const activeEl = doc?.activeElement;
    const inInput = ['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA', 'SELECT'].includes(activeEl?.tagName) || Boolean(activeEl?.isContentEditable);
    const isAnkiOpen = typeof ctx.isAnkiOpen === 'function' ? ctx.isAnkiOpen() : Boolean(ctx.isAnkiOpen);
    const anyModalOpen = typeof ctx.anyModalOpen === 'function' ? ctx.anyModalOpen() : Boolean(ctx.anyModalOpen);

    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      if (anyModalOpen) {
        if (typeof ctx.closeAllModals === 'function') ctx.closeAllModals();
        return true;
      }
      if (isAnkiOpen) {
        if (typeof ctx.exitAnki === 'function') ctx.exitAnki();
        return true;
      }
      if (typeof ctx.getFocusedCardIndex === 'function' && ctx.getFocusedCardIndex() >= 0) {
        if (typeof ctx.clearCardFocus === 'function') ctx.clearCardFocus();
        return true;
      }
    }

    if (e.key === 'Tab' && anyModalOpen && doc?.querySelector) {
      const openModal = doc.querySelector('.modal-ov.open .modal') || doc.querySelector('.modal-ov.open');
      if (openModal && typeof openModal.querySelectorAll === 'function') {
        const focusables = Array.from(openModal.querySelectorAll('button, [href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'))
          .filter(el => {
            if (!el || typeof el.focus !== 'function') return false;
            if (typeof el.hasAttribute === 'function' && el.hasAttribute('disabled')) return false;
            if (el.getAttribute?.('aria-hidden') === 'true') return false;
            if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.getComputedStyle === 'function') {
              try {
                const s = window.getComputedStyle(el);
                if (s.display === 'none' || s.visibility === 'hidden') return false;
              } catch {}
            }
            return true;
          });
        if (focusables.length > 0) {
          const first = focusables[0];
          const last = focusables[focusables.length - 1];
          const active = doc.activeElement;
          if (e.shiftKey) {
            if (active === first || (openModal.contains && !openModal.contains(active))) {
              if (typeof e.preventDefault === 'function') e.preventDefault();
              last.focus();
              return true;
            }
          } else {
            if (active === last || (openModal.contains && !openModal.contains(active))) {
              if (typeof e.preventDefault === 'function') e.preventDefault();
              first.focus();
              return true;
            }
          }
        } else {
          // [P2-⑦ 解決] フォーカス可能要素がない空/ローディングモーダル時、背後要素への漏洩を遮断
          if (typeof e.preventDefault === 'function') e.preventDefault();
          if (typeof openModal.focus === 'function') {
            if (!openModal.hasAttribute('tabindex')) openModal.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
            openModal.focus();
          }
          return true;
        }
      }
    }

    if ((!inInput && e.key === '/' && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.altKey) || (e.altKey && e.code === 'KeyF')) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (typeof ctx.focusSearch === 'function') ctx.focusSearch();
      return true;
    } else if (e.altKey && e.code === 'KeyK') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (typeof ctx.focusInput === 'function') ctx.focusInput();
      return true;
    } else if (e.altKey && e.code === 'KeyL') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (typeof ctx.openExtractModal === 'function') ctx.openExtractModal();
      return true;
    } else if (e.altKey && e.code === 'KeyM') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (typeof ctx.toggleMask === 'function') ctx.toggleMask();
      return true;
    } else if (isAnkiOpen && !inInput) {
      if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return false;
      if (e.code === 'KeyM' || e.key === 'm' || e.key === 'M') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (typeof ctx.ankiToggleMode === 'function') ctx.ankiToggleMode();
        return true;
      } else if (e.code === 'KeyR' || e.key === 'r' || e.key === 'R' || e.key === 's' || e.key === 'S') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (typeof ctx.ankiSpeak === 'function') ctx.ankiSpeak();
        return true;
      } else if (e.code === 'KeyZ' || e.key === 'z' || e.key === 'Z') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (typeof ctx.ankiUndo === 'function') ctx.ankiUndo();
        return true;
      } else if (e.code === 'Space' || e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (typeof ctx.ankiAdvance === 'function') ctx.ankiAdvance();
        return true;
      } else if (['1', '2', '3', '4'].includes(e.key)) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (typeof ctx.ankiRate === 'function') ctx.ankiRate(parseInt(e.key, 10) - 1);
        return true;
      }
    } else if (!inInput && !anyModalOpen && !isAnkiOpen) {
      // OS標準ショートカット（Cmd+S, Cmd+D, Ctrl+R等）との衝突防止
      if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return false;

      // 耳学モード実行中の専用キー操作（Space: 一時停止/再開, J: 前へ, L: 次へ）
      const playlistState = global.VocabSpeech?.getPlaylistState ? global.VocabSpeech.getPlaylistState() : null;
      if (playlistState && playlistState.isRunning) {
        if (e.code === 'Space') {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (typeof ctx.togglePlaylist === 'function') ctx.togglePlaylist();
          return true;
        } else if (e.key === 'j' || e.key === 'J') {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (global.VocabSpeech?.prevPlaylistItem) global.VocabSpeech.prevPlaylistItem();
          return true;
        } else if (e.key === 'l' || e.key === 'L') {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (global.VocabSpeech?.nextPlaylistItem) global.VocabSpeech.nextPlaylistItem();
          return true;
        }
      }

      if (e.key === 'Home') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (typeof global.VocabCore?.setPage === 'function') global.VocabCore.setPage(1);
        return true;
      } else if (e.key === 'End') {
        e.preventDefault();
        const appState = ctx.appState || global.VocabCore?.App;
        if (appState && typeof global.VocabCore?.setPage === 'function') {
          const per = appState.per || 30;
          const filtered = global.VocabCore?.getFiltered?.() || appState.entries || [];
          const tot = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / per));
          global.VocabCore.setPage(tot);
        }
        return true;
      } else if (e.key === 'PageUp' || e.key === '[') {
        e.preventDefault();
        const appState = ctx.appState || global.VocabCore?.App;
        if (appState && typeof global.VocabCore?.setPage === 'function') {
          global.VocabCore.setPage((appState.page || 1) - 1);
        }
        return true;
      } else if (e.key === 'PageDown' || e.key === ']') {
        e.preventDefault();
        const appState = ctx.appState || global.VocabCore?.App;
        if (appState && typeof global.VocabCore?.setPage === 'function') {
          global.VocabCore.setPage((appState.page || 1) + 1);
        }
        return true;
      } else if (e.key === 'j' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (typeof ctx.moveCardFocus === 'function') ctx.moveCardFocus(1);
        return true;
      } else if (e.key === 'k' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (typeof ctx.moveCardFocus === 'function') ctx.moveCardFocus(-1);
        return true;
      } else if (e.key === 'l' || e.key === 'L' || e.key === 'p' || e.key === 'P') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (typeof ctx.togglePlaylist === 'function') ctx.togglePlaylist();
        return true;
      } else if (e.key === 's') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (typeof ctx.speakFocusedCard === 'function') ctx.speakFocusedCard();
        return true;
      } else if (e.key === 'e') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (typeof ctx.editFocusedCard === 'function') ctx.editFocusedCard();
        return true;
      } else if (e.key === 'd') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (typeof ctx.deleteFocusedCard === 'function') ctx.deleteFocusedCard();
        return true;
      } else if (e.key === 'n') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (typeof ctx.focusInput === 'function') ctx.focusInput();
        return true;
      } else if (e.key === 'r') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (typeof ctx.startAnki === 'function') ctx.startAnki();
        return true;
      } else if (e.key === 'a') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (typeof ctx.openAnalyticsModal === 'function') ctx.openAnalyticsModal();
        return true;
      } else if (e.key === 'g') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (typeof ctx.openGraph === 'function') ctx.openGraph();
        return true;
      } else if (e.key === '?') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (typeof ctx.openShortcutsModal === 'function') ctx.openShortcutsModal();
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  // --- グローバルエクスポート ---
  global.VocabNavigation = {
    DEFAULT_PIE_ROOTS,
    buildSuggestions,
    renderSuggestHtml,
    clampAndFocusCard,
    getFocusedCardItem,
    initWordSuggest,
    handleGlobalKeydown
  };
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);
```
