```javascript
      it: 'Vedi analisi di ritenzione',
      pt: 'Ver análises de retenção',
      nl: 'Bekijk retentie-analyse',
      zh: '查看记忆定着率分析',
      ko: '기억 정착도 분석 보기'
    };
    const todayPrefixMap = {
      ja: '本日',
      en: 'Today',
      fr: 'Aujourd\'hui',
      de: 'Heute',
      es: 'Hoy',
      it: 'Oggi',
      pt: 'Hoje',
      nl: 'Vandaag',
      zh: '今日',
      ko: '오늘'
    };

    const emptyRootsMsg = emptyRootsMsgMap[tL] || emptyRootsMsgMap.en;
    const sessCompTitle = sessCompTitleMap[tL] || sessCompTitleMap.en;
    const todayReviewedLbl = todayReviewedLblMap[tL] || todayReviewedLblMap.en;
    const todayPrefix = todayPrefixMap[tL] || todayPrefixMap.en;
    const accuracyLbl = accuracyLblMap[tL] || accuracyLblMap.en;
    const rootsHeading = rootsHeadingMap[tL] || rootsHeadingMap.en;
    const backBtnLbl = backBtnLblMap[tL] || backBtnLblMap.en;
    const reinforcedLbl = reinforcedLblMap[tL] || reinforcedLblMap.en;
    const stabilityUpLbl = stabilityUpLblMap[tL] || stabilityUpLblMap.en;
    const treeBtnLbl = treeBtnLblMap[tL] || treeBtnLblMap.en;
    const analyticsBtnLbl = analyticsBtnLblMap[tL] || analyticsBtnLblMap.en;

    const rootListHtml = topRoots.length > 0 ? topRoots.map(([r, d]) => {
      const growthPct = Math.min(100, Math.round((d.growth / Math.max(1, d.count)) * 20));
      return `
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 12px;background:var(--bg-hov);border:1px solid var(--b);border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:6px">
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px">
            <span style="font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:700;color:var(--ac);font-size:13px">${esc(r)}</span>
            <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--s)">${d.count}${reinforcedLbl}</span>
          </div>
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
            <span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ok)">+${Math.max(12, growthPct)}% ${stabilityUpLbl}</span>
            <button type="button" class="btn-xs btn-o" data-act="open-graph" data-root="${esc(r)}">${treeBtnLbl}</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }).join('') : `<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--s);text-align:center;padding:12px">${emptyRootsMsg}</div>`;

    if (aCard) {
      // [P1-6 解決] aCard の DOM 構造を破壊せず専用サマリーコンテナに描画
      let summaryWrap = $('aSessionSummaryWrap');
      if (!summaryWrap && typeof document !== 'undefined' && typeof document.createElement === 'function') {
        try {
          summaryWrap = document.createElement('div');
          summaryWrap.id = 'aSessionSummaryWrap';
          if (typeof aCard.appendChild === 'function') aCard.appendChild(summaryWrap);
        } catch {}
      }
      if (aCard.children) {
        try {
          Array.from(aCard.children).forEach(child => {
            if (child !== summaryWrap && child && child.style) child.style.display = 'none';
          });
        } catch {}
      }
      const targetEl = summaryWrap || aCard;
      if (targetEl && targetEl.style) targetEl.style.display = 'block';

      targetEl.innerHTML = `
        <div style="padding:24px 20px;text-align:center">
          <div style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(16,185,129,0.15);color:var(--ok);margin-bottom:12px">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg>
          </div>
          <h2 style="font-size:18px;font-weight:750;color:var(--t);margin:0 0 6px">${sessCompTitle}</h2>
          <p style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--s);margin:0 0 16px">${todayPrefix}: <strong>${finalGoal.count}</strong> ${todayReviewedLbl} ${streakTxt ? `(${streakTxt})` : ''} / ${accuracyLbl}: <strong>${accuracy}%</strong></p>

          <div style="text-align:left;margin-bottom:18px">
            <div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--t);margin-bottom:8px">${rootsHeading}</div>
            ${rootListHtml}
          </div>

          <div style="display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap">
            <button type="button" class="btn-ac" id="btnFinishAnkiSession" style="padding:9px 24px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600">${backBtnLbl}</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn-o" id="btnSummaryAnalytics" data-act="open-analytics" style="padding:9px 18px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M18 20V10M12 20V4M6 20v-6"/></svg>${analyticsBtnLbl}</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
      $('btnFinishAnkiSession')?.addEventListener?.('click', () => exitAnki(ctx));
    }
  }

  /**
   * 直前のレーティングを取り消し (Undo)
   */
  function undoAnkiRev(ctx = {}) {
    if (global.VocabSpeech?.stopSpeech) {
      global.VocabSpeech.stopSpeech();
    }
    const appState = ctx.appState || (global.VocabCore?.App);
    if (!appState || !appState.ankiHistory) return;
    const last = appState.ankiHistory.pop();
    if (!last) return;

    const curPairKey = ctx.getActivePairKey ? ctx.getActivePairKey() : (global.VocabCore?.getActivePairConfig?.()?.key);
    const targetKey = last.targetKey || curPairKey;
    const list = typeof ctx.getList === 'function' ? ctx.getList(targetKey) : [...(appState.entries || [])];
    const e = list.find(x => x.id === last.id);
    if (!e) return;

    const nextVersion = Math.max(Number(e.version) || 1, Number(last.prevProps?.version) || 1) + 1;
    const now = Date.now();
    Object.assign(e, last.prevProps, {
      version: nextVersion,
      updatedAt: now,
      reviewUpdatedAt: now
    });
    if (last.requeued && appState.aList) {
      const pIdx = appState.aList.findIndex(x => x.id === e.id);
      if (pIdx !== -1) appState.aList.splice(pIdx, 1);
    }
    if (appState.aList) appState.aList.unshift(e);

    // [P1-1 解決] オプティマイザ履歴ログと日次復習カウントのロールバック
    try {
      if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
        const rawLog = localStorage.getItem('vv_review_history_log');
        if (rawLog) {
          const logs = JSON.parse(rawLog);
          if (Array.isArray(logs) && logs.length > 0) {
            const lastLog = logs[logs.length - 1];
            if (lastLog && (lastLog.cardId === last.id || lastLog.id === last.id)) {
              logs.pop();
              if (global.VocabSRS?.saveReviewHistoryLog) {
                global.VocabSRS.saveReviewHistoryLog(logs);
              } else {
                localStorage.setItem('vv_review_history_log', JSON.stringify(logs));
              }
            }
          }
        }
        const todayStr = todayYmd();
        const dateKey = `vv_reviewed_${todayStr}`;
        const curCount = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(dateKey) || '0', 10);
        if (curCount > 0) {
          localStorage.setItem(dateKey, String(curCount - 1));
        }
        const legacyDateKey = `vv_rev_count_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}`;
        const legCount = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(legacyDateKey) || '0', 10);
        if (legCount > 0) {
          localStorage.setItem(legacyDateKey, String(legCount - 1));
        }
        // [NEW-P2-3 修正] オフライン復習キューからもUndo対象カードの最新レコードを取り消す
        const rawOffQ = localStorage.getItem('vv_offline_review_queue');
        if (rawOffQ) {
          const offQ = JSON.parse(rawOffQ);
          if (Array.isArray(offQ) && offQ.length > 0) {
            for (let qi = offQ.length - 1; qi >= 0; qi--) {
              if (offQ[qi] && (offQ[qi].id === last.id || (offQ[qi].word === e.word && offQ[qi].lang === (e.lang || 'en')))) {
                offQ.splice(qi, 1);
                localStorage.setItem('vv_offline_review_queue', JSON.stringify(offQ));
                break;
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    } catch {}

    if (typeof ctx.saveList === 'function') ctx.saveList(targetKey, list);
    if (targetKey === curPairKey) {
      appState.entries = list;
    }
    renderAnki(ctx);
  }

  /**
   * Anki復習セッションを終了し一覧へ復帰
   */
  function exitAnki(ctx = {}) {
    if (global.VocabSpeech?.stopSpeech) {
      global.VocabSpeech.stopSpeech();
    }
    const anki = $('anki'), listView = $('listView'), ctrlForm = $('ctrlForm');
    if (anki) anki.style.display = 'none';
    if (listView) listView.style.display = 'block';
    if (ctrlForm) ctrlForm.style.display = 'flex';

    const ribAnkiBtn = $('ribAnkiBtn'), ribListBtn = $('ribListBtn');
    if (ribAnkiBtn) ribAnkiBtn.classList.remove('active');
    if (ribListBtn) ribListBtn.classList.add('active');

    if (typeof ctx.onReload === 'function') ctx.onReload();
    else if (global.VocabCore?.load) global.VocabCore.load();
  }

  /**
   * [アナリティクス] 過去30〜90日間の学習コミットヒートマップデータ集計
   */
  function getCommitHeatmapData(days = 63, options = {}) {
    const lsGet = options.lsGet || (global.VocabCore?.lsGet) || (k => (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem(k) : null));
    const now = new Date();
    const cells = [];
    let totalReviews = 0;

    const historyLogs = (global.VocabSRS?.getReviewHistoryLog ? global.VocabSRS.getReviewHistoryLog() : []);
    const logDateMap = {};
    for (let i = 0; i < historyLogs.length; i++) {
      const ts = historyLogs[i].timestamp;
      if (ts) {
        const dStr = todayYmd(new Date(ts));
        logDateMap[dStr] = (logDateMap[dStr] || 0) + 1;
      }
    }

    for (let i = days - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const d = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate() - i);
      const dateStr = todayYmd(d);
      const storageCount = parseInt(lsGet(`vv_reviewed_${dateStr}`, '0'), 10) || 0;
      const count = Math.max(storageCount, logDateMap[dateStr] || 0);
      totalReviews += count;

      let level = 0;
      if (count >= 30) level = 4;
      else if (count >= 15) level = 3;
      else if (count >= 5) level = 2;
      else if (count >= 1) level = 1;

      cells.push({ date: dateStr, count, level, dayOfWeek: d.getDay() });
    }

    const streakInfo = getStreakInfo(options);
    return { cells, totalReviews, streak: streakInfo.streak, freezeAvailable: streakInfo.freezeAvailable };
  }

  /**
   * [アナリティクス] 向こう7〜30日間の日別予測復習負荷バーチャートデータ集計
   */
  function getFutureWorkloadData(days = 14, listInput = null) {
    const list = Array.isArray(listInput) ? listInput : (global.VocabCore?.App?.entries || []);
    const now = Date.now();
    const workload = [];
    const counts = new Array(days).fill(0);
    const dateStrings = [];

    const baseDate = new Date();
    for (let d = 0; d < days; d++) {
      const targetDate = new Date(baseDate.getFullYear(), baseDate.getMonth(), baseDate.getDate() + d);
      dateStrings.push(todayYmd(targetDate));
    }

    const todayStr = todayYmd(new Date(now));
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      const item = list[i];
      if (!item || !item.nextReview) continue;
      const targetYmd = todayYmd(new Date(item.nextReview));
      const diffDays = dayDiff(todayStr, targetYmd);
      if (diffDays <= 0) {
        counts[0]++; // 本日または過去の期日到来分
      } else if (diffDays < days) {
        counts[diffDays]++;
      }
    }

    let maxCount = 1;
    for (let d = 0; d < days; d++) {
      if (counts[d] > maxCount) maxCount = counts[d];
      workload.push({
        dayOffset: d,
        date: dateStrings[d],
        label: d === 0 ? '本日' : d === 1 ? '明日' : d === 2 ? '明後日' : `${d}日後`,
        shortDate: dateStrings[d].slice(5),
        count: counts[d]
      });
    }

    return { workload, maxCount, totalUpcoming: counts.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) };
  }

  /**
   * [アナリティクス] 全体平均想起率 (Retrievability R) ゲージおよび記憶健康度
   */
  function getOverallRetrievabilityStats(listInput = null) {
    const list = Array.isArray(listInput) ? listInput : (global.VocabCore?.App?.entries || []);
    if (!list.length) {
      return { avgR: 1.0, avgPct: '100.0%', total: 0, stable: 0, borderline: 0, critical: 0, grade: 'S' };
    }

    const now = Date.now();
    let sumR = 0;
    let stable = 0;     // R >= 0.90
    let borderline = 0; // 0.70 <= R < 0.90
    let critical = 0;   // R < 0.70

    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      const r = global.VocabSRS?.getRetrievability ? global.VocabSRS.getRetrievability(list[i], now) : 1.0;
      sumR += r;
      if (r >= 0.90) stable++;
      else if (r >= 0.70) borderline++;
      else critical++;
    }

    const avgR = sumR / list.length;
    const avgPct = (avgR * 100).toFixed(1) + '%';
    let grade = 'S';
    if (avgR < 0.70) grade = 'C';
    else if (avgR < 0.80) grade = 'B';
    else if (avgR < 0.90) grade = 'A';

    return {
      avgR: Number(avgR.toFixed(3)),
      avgPct,
      total: list.length,
      stable,
      borderline,
      critical,
      grade
    };
  }

  /**
   * アナリティクス・ダッシュボードのHTMLを生成
   */
  let _workloadForecastDays = 14;
  let _workloadTargetCap = 25;

  function buildAnalyticsDashboardHtml(options = {}) {
    const list = options.list || (global.VocabCore?.App?.entries || []);
    const retrievability = getOverallRetrievabilityStats(list);
    const heatmap = getCommitHeatmapData(63, options);
    const forecastDays = options.days || _workloadForecastDays || 14;
    _workloadForecastDays = forecastDays;
    const workload = getFutureWorkloadData(forecastDays, list);
    const fsrsWeights = global.VocabSRS?.getUserFSRSWeights ? global.VocabSRS.getUserFSRSWeights() : null;
    const reviewLogs = global.VocabSRS?.getReviewHistoryLog ? global.VocabSRS.getReviewHistoryLog() : [];

    const curLoc = options.locale || global.VocabI18n?.getLocale?.() || 'ja';
    const isEn = curLoc !== 'ja';
    const t = (k, p, def) => (global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t(k, p, def) : def);

    const radius = 36;
    const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
    const offset = circumference * (1 - retrievability.avgR);
    const gradeColor = retrievability.grade === 'S' ? 'var(--ok, #10b981)' : retrievability.grade === 'A' ? 'var(--ac, #6366f1)' : retrievability.grade === 'B' ? '#f59e0b' : '#ef4444';

    const gaugeHtml = `
      <div class="retrievability-gauge">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100">
          <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="${radius}" fill="none" stroke="var(--b)" stroke-width="8"/>
          <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="${radius}" fill="none" stroke="${gradeColor}" stroke-width="8"
            stroke-dasharray="${circumference}" stroke-dashoffset="${offset}" stroke-linecap="round"
            style="transition: stroke-dashoffset 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);"/>
        </svg>
        <div class="retrievability-val">
          <span>${retrievability.avgPct}</span>
          <small>Grade ${retrievability.grade}</small>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    const heatmapCellsHtml = heatmap.cells.map(c => `
      <div class="heatmap-cell l-${c.level}" title="${c.date}: ${c.count}${isEn ? ' words reviewed' : '語復習'}"></div>
    `).join('');

    const chartBarsHtml = workload.workload.map(w => {
      const pct = Math.max(4, Math.round((w.count / workload.maxCount) * 100));
      const isToday = w.dayOffset === 0;
      const isHeavy = w.count >= 30;
      return `
        <div class="workload-bar-col" title="${w.date} (${w.label}): ${w.count}${isEn ? ' words' : '語'}">
          <span class="workload-val">${w.count > 0 ? w.count : ''}</span>
          <div class="workload-bar ${isToday ? 'today' : ''} ${isHeavy ? 'heavy' : ''}" style="height:${pct}%;"></div>
          <span class="workload-label">${w.shortDate}</span>
        </div>
      `;
    }).join('');

    const calendarCellsHtml = workload.workload.map(w => {
      let level = 0;
      if (w.count > 0 && w.count <= 10) level = 1;
      else if (w.count <= 20) level = 2;
      else if (w.count <= 30) level = 3;
      else if (w.count > 30) level = 4;

      const isToday = w.dayOffset === 0;
      const levelLabels = isEn ? ['0 words', 'Calm', 'Normal', 'Heavy', 'Peak Overload'] : ['0語', '快適', '適正', '注意', '過密'];
      const levelText = levelLabels[level] || '適正';
      const badgeTitle = `${w.date} (${w.label}): ${w.count}${isEn ? ' words scheduled' : '語の復習予定'}`;
      return `
        <div class="workload-day-cell l-${level} ${isToday ? 'today' : ''}" title="${badgeTitle}" data-act="show-day-workload" data-date="${esc(w.date)}" data-count="${w.count}" onclick="VocabAnkiView.showDayWorkloadDetails('${esc(w.date)}', ${w.count})">
          <div class="day-header">${w.shortDate}${isToday ? (isEn ? ' (Today)' : ' (本日)') : ''}</div>
          <div class="day-count">${w.count}</div>
          <span class="day-pill">${levelText}</span>
        </div>
      `;
    }).join('');

    const peakDay = workload.workload.reduce((max, w) => (w.count > max.count ? w : max), { count: 0, date: '-', label: '-' });
    const isPeakHeavy = peakDay.count > _workloadTargetCap;

    const optStatusHtml = fsrsWeights
      ? `<span class="badge ok">${t('analytics.badge_optimized', { count: fsrsWeights.logCount || reviewLogs.length, imp: fsrsWeights.improvement || '0' }, isEn ? `Optimized (${fsrsWeights.logCount || reviewLogs.length} reviews / +${fsrsWeights.improvement || '0'}% precision)` : `最適化中 (${fsrsWeights.logCount || reviewLogs.length}件 / 精度+${fsrsWeights.improvement || '0'}%)`)}</span>`
      : reviewLogs.length >= 20
        ? `<span class="badge ok">${t('analytics.badge_ready', { count: reviewLogs.length }, isEn ? `Ready to Optimize (${reviewLogs.length} reviews logged)` : `最適化可能 (${reviewLogs.length}件蓄積)`)}</span>`
        : `<span class="badge" style="background:var(--b);color:var(--s)">${t('analytics.badge_init', { count: reviewLogs.length }, isEn ? `Standard Weights (${reviewLogs.length}/20 reviews)` : `初期係数 (${reviewLogs.length}/20件蓄積)`)}</span>`;

    const curPair = global.VocabCore?.getActivePairConfig ? global.VocabCore.getActivePairConfig() : null;
    const pairLabel = curPair ? (curPair.name || curPair.label || '') : '';

    return `
      <div class="analytics-grid">
        <div class="analytics-card">
          <div class="analytics-card-hd">
            <span data-i18n="analytics.retrievability_title">全体平均想起率 (Retrievability)${pairLabel ? ` <small style="color:var(--s);font-size:11px">(${esc(pairLabel)})</small>` : ''}</span>
            <span class="badge ok" data-i18n="analytics.memory_health">記憶健康度</span>
          </div>
          <div class="analytics-retrievability-wrap">
            ${gaugeHtml}
            <div style="flex:1;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6">
              <div style="font-weight:700;color:var(--t)"><span data-i18n="analytics.retrievability">現在の記憶維持率:</span> <strong style="color:${gradeColor}">${retrievability.avgPct}</strong></div>
              <div style="color:var(--s)">• <span data-i18n="analytics.stable">安定定着 (R≥90%):</span> <strong>${retrievability.stable} <span data-i18n="common.unit_words">語</span></strong></div>
              <div style="color:var(--s)">• <span data-i18n="analytics.borderline">境界領域 (70%≤R&lt;90%):</span> <strong>${retrievability.borderline} <span data-i18n="common.unit_words">語</span></strong></div>
              <div style="color:var(--s)">• <span data-i18n="analytics.critical">忘却危機 (R&lt;70%):</span> <strong style="color:#ef4444">${retrievability.critical} <span data-i18n="common.unit_words">語</span></strong></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="analytics-card">
          <div class="analytics-card-hd">
            <span data-i18n="analytics.fsrs_weights">個人適応型 FSRS 重み</span>
            ${optStatusHtml}
          </div>
          <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--s);line-height:1.6">
            <p style="margin:0 0 8px 0">${t('analytics.fsrs_weights_desc', { count: reviewLogs.length })}</p>
            <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px">
              <span class="badge" style="background:var(--b);font-family:monospace;font-size:11px" title="${isEn ? 'Stability Scaling Factor' : '安定度スケーリング係数'}">S-Scale: ${Number(fsrsWeights?.sScale || 1.0).toFixed(2)}x</span>
              <span class="badge" style="background:var(--b);font-family:monospace;font-size:11px" title="${isEn ? 'Forgetting Curve Decay Rate (Negative Exponent)' : '忘却曲線の減衰率（負の指数）'}">Decay: ${Number(fsrsWeights?.decayFactor || -0.5).toFixed(2)}</span>
              <span class="badge" style="background:var(--b);font-family:monospace;font-size:11px" title="${isEn ? 'Next Interval Multiplier on Hard' : 'Hard評価時の次回係数'}">Hard: ${Number(fsrsWeights?.wHard || 0.8).toFixed(2)}x</span>
              <span class="badge" style="background:var(--b);font-family:monospace;font-size:11px" title="${isEn ? 'Next Interval Multiplier on Good' : 'Good評価時の次回係数'}">Good: ${Number(fsrsWeights?.wGood || 1.2).toFixed(2)}x</span>
              <span class="badge" style="background:var(--b);font-family:monospace;font-size:11px" title="${isEn ? 'Next Interval Multiplier on Easy' : 'Easy評価時の次回係数'}">Easy: ${Number(fsrsWeights?.wEasy || 1.6).toFixed(2)}x</span>
            </div>
            <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">
              <button type="button" class="btn-ac-o btn-xs" data-act="manual-optimize" data-i18n="analytics.btn_optimize">${t('analytics.btn_optimize', '今すぐFSRS最適化を実行')}</button>
              <button type="button" class="btn-o btn-xs" data-act="reset-weights" data-i18n="analytics.btn_reset_weights">${t('analytics.btn_reset_weights', '標準重みにリセット')}</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="analytics-card" style="margin-top:14px">
        <div class="analytics-card-hd">
          <span data-i18n="analytics.heatmap_title">学習コミットヒートマップ (過去9週間)</span>
          <span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--s)">${t('analytics.heatmap_stats', { total: heatmap.totalReviews, streak: heatmap.streak }, isEn ? `Total: <strong>${heatmap.totalReviews} words</strong> | Streak: <strong>${heatmap.streak} days</strong>` : `累計: <strong>${heatmap.totalReviews}語</strong> | 連続: <strong>${heatmap.streak}日</strong>`)}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="heatmap-wrap">
          <div class="heatmap-grid">
            ${heatmapCellsHtml}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:10px;color:var(--m)">
          <span data-i18n="analytics.less">少</span>
          <div class="heatmap-cell l-0" style="display:inline-block"></div>
          <div class="heatmap-cell l-1" style="display:inline-block"></div>
          <div class="heatmap-cell l-2" style="display:inline-block"></div>
          <div class="heatmap-cell l-3" style="display:inline-block"></div>
          <div class="heatmap-cell l-4" style="display:inline-block"></div>
          <span data-i18n="analytics.more">多</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="analytics-card" style="margin-top:14px">
        <div class="analytics-card-hd">
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px">
            <span data-i18n="analytics.workload_title">向こうの日別予測復習負荷 (Workload Forecast)</span>
            <div class="workload-range-btns" style="display:flex;gap:4px">
              <button type="button" class="btn-o btn-xs ${forecastDays === 7 ? 'active' : ''}" data-act="set-workload-days" data-days="7">7日</button>
              <button type="button" class="btn-o btn-xs ${forecastDays === 14 ? 'active' : ''}" data-act="set-workload-days" data-days="14">14日</button>
              <button type="button" class="btn-o btn-xs ${forecastDays === 30 ? 'active' : ''}" data-act="set-workload-days" data-days="30">30日</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--s)">${t('analytics.workload_total', { total: workload.totalUpcoming, days: forecastDays }, isEn ? `${forecastDays}-Day Total: <strong>${workload.totalUpcoming} words</strong>` : `${forecastDays}日合計: <strong>${workload.totalUpcoming}語</strong>`)}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="workload-chart">
          ${chartBarsHtml}
        </div>
        <p style="margin:6px 0 10px 0;font-size:11px;color:var(--m)" data-i18n="analytics.workload_note">※各バーは各日に復習満期を迎える予定単語数です。緑は本日分、赤は30語以上の過密日を示します。</p>

        <div style="margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px dashed var(--b)">
          <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px">
            <span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--t)" data-i18n="analytics.calendar_heatmap_title">日別復習予測カレンダー (クリックで該当日詳細プレビュー)</span>
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:10px;color:var(--m)">
              <span class="day-pill" style="background:rgba(16,185,129,0.15);color:#10b981">快適 (1-10)</span>
              <span class="day-pill" style="background:rgba(59,130,246,0.15);color:#3b82f6">適正 (11-20)</span>
              <span class="day-pill" style="background:rgba(245,158,11,0.18);color:#f59e0b">注意 (21-30)</span>
              <span class="day-pill" style="background:rgba(239,68,68,0.2);color:#ef4444">過密 (31+)</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="workload-calendar-grid">
            ${calendarCellsHtml}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="analytics-card" style="margin-top:14px">
        <div class="analytics-card-hd">
          <span data-i18n="analytics.smoothing_title">復習負荷のスマート平滑化 &amp; バッファ調整 (Workload Smoothing)</span>
          <span class="badge ${isPeakHeavy ? 'warn' : 'ok'}">
            ${isPeakHeavy ? (isEn ? 'Peak Overload Detected' : '特定日過密あり') : (isEn ? 'Load Balanced' : '負荷バランス良好')}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--s);line-height:1.6">
          <p style="margin:0 0 10px 0" data-i18n="analytics.smoothing_desc">
            連休や多忙期の復習スパイクによる挫折を防ぐため、記憶定着度が高い安全な単語（R≥85%）を前後の空き日へなだらかに再配分（ファジング）します。
          </p>
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px;background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--b);border-radius:6px">
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px">
              <span style="font-weight:700;color:var(--t)" data-i18n="analytics.target_cap_lbl">1日の目標復習上限:</span>
              <select id="workloadCapSelect" class="input-sm" style="padding:4px 8px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid var(--b);background:var(--bg);color:var(--t)">
                <option value="15" ${_workloadTargetCap === 15 ? 'selected' : ''}>15語 / 日 (ゆったり)</option>
                <option value="20" ${_workloadTargetCap === 20 ? 'selected' : ''}>20語 / 日 (標準)</option>
                <option value="25" ${_workloadTargetCap === 25 ? 'selected' : ''}>25語 / 日 (推奨)</option>
                <option value="30" ${_workloadTargetCap === 30 ? 'selected' : ''}>30語 / 日 (集中)</option>
                <option value="40" ${_workloadTargetCap === 40 ? 'selected' : ''}>40語 / 日 (高負荷)</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px">
              <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--m)">最大集中日: <strong style="color:${isPeakHeavy ? '#ef4444' : 'var(--t)'}">${peakDay.date} (${peakDay.count}語)</strong></span>
              <button type="button" class="btn-ac btn-sm" data-act="smooth-workload" style="font-weight:700;padding:5px 14px" data-i18n="analytics.btn_smooth">
                過密日を平滑化 (Fuzz &amp; Smooth)
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  let _isRenderingAnalytics = false;
  function renderAnalyticsDashboard(containerId = 'analyticsDashboardBody') {
    if (_isRenderingAnalytics) return;
    const el = document.getElementById(containerId);
    if (!el) return;
    _isRenderingAnalytics = true;
    try {
      el.innerHTML = buildAnalyticsDashboardHtml();
      if (global.VocabI18n?.applyI18nToDOM) {
        global.VocabI18n.applyI18nToDOM(el);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[Analytics Render Error]', err);
      const errTxt = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('analytics.load_error', 'データの集計中にエラーが発生しました。単語一覧を更新してください。') : 'データの集計中にエラーが発生しました。単語一覧を更新してください。';
      el.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:24px 16px;text-align:center;color:var(--s)">${errTxt}</div>`;
    } finally {
      _isRenderingAnalytics = false;
    }
  }

  function openAnalyticsModal() {
    renderAnalyticsDashboard('analyticsDashboardBody');
    const toggleFn = (typeof global.toggleModal === 'function')
      ? global.toggleModal
      : (typeof global.VocabModal?.toggleModal === 'function')
        ? global.VocabModal.toggleModal
        : null;

    if (toggleFn) {
      toggleFn('analyticsModal', true);
    } else {
      const modal = document.getElementById('analyticsModal');
      if (modal) {
        modal.classList.add('open');
        modal.classList.add('active');
      }
    }
  }

  function closeAnalyticsModal() {
    const toggleFn = (typeof global.toggleModal === 'function')
      ? global.toggleModal
      : (typeof global.VocabModal?.toggleModal === 'function')
        ? global.VocabModal.toggleModal
        : null;

    if (toggleFn) {
      toggleFn('analyticsModal', false);
    } else {
      const modal = document.getElementById('analyticsModal');
      if (modal) {
        modal.classList.remove('open');
        modal.classList.remove('active');
      }
    }
  }

  function triggerManualOptimize() {
    if (!global.VocabSRS?.optimizeFSRSWeights) return;
    const res = global.VocabSRS.optimizeFSRSWeights();
    const showToast = global.VocabModal?.showToast || alert;
    if (res.success) {
      const msg = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('analytics.optimize_ok', { count: res.count, imp: res.improvement }) : `FSRS重みを最適化しました（学習ログ ${res.count}件、予測精度向上: ${res.improvement}）。`;
      showToast(msg, 'ok', 4000);
      renderAnalyticsDashboard();
    } else {
      const msg = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('analytics.optimize_need_more') : (res.message || '学習ログが20件以上蓄積されると最適化可能です。');
      showToast(msg, 'info', 3500);
    }
  }

  function triggerResetWeights() {
    const confirmMsg = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('analytics.reset_confirm') : 'FSRS重み係数をデフォルトの初期値にリセットしますか？';
    if (typeof confirm === 'function' && !confirm(confirmMsg)) return;
    if (global.VocabSRS?.resetUserFSRSWeights) {
      global.VocabSRS.resetUserFSRSWeights();
      const showToast = global.VocabModal?.showToast || alert;
      const okMsg = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('analytics.reset_ok') : 'FSRS重みを初期値にリセットしました。';
      showToast(okMsg, 'ok');
      renderAnalyticsDashboard();
    }
  }

  function showDayWorkloadDetails(dateStr, count) {
    if (!dateStr) return;
    const list = global.VocabCore?.App?.entries || [];
    const todayYmd = (d) => {
      const yr = d.getFullYear();
      const mo = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
      const da = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
      return `${yr}-${mo}-${da}`;
    };

    const matching = list.filter(item => {
      if (!item || !item.nextReview || item.isDeleted) return false;
      return todayYmd(new Date(item.nextReview)) === dateStr;
    });

    const showToast = global.VocabModal?.showToast || alert;
    const wordsPreview = matching.map(x => x.word || x.foreign || '').filter(Boolean).slice(0, 6).join(', ');
    const moreText = matching.length > 6 ? ` ほか${matching.length - 6}語` : '';

    const isEn = (global.VocabI18n?.getLocale?.() || 'ja') !== 'ja';
    const detailMsg = isEn
      ? `${dateStr}: ${matching.length || count} words scheduled${wordsPreview ? ` (${wordsPreview}${moreText})` : ''}`
      : `${dateStr}: ${matching.length || count}語予定${wordsPreview ? ` (${wordsPreview}${moreText})` : ''}`;

    showToast(detailMsg, 'info', 4500);
  }

  function triggerWorkloadSmoothing() {
    const sel = document.getElementById('workloadCapSelect');
    const cap = sel ? Number(sel.value) : _workloadTargetCap;
    _workloadTargetCap = cap;

    const list = global.VocabCore?.App?.entries || [];
    if (!list.length) {
      const showToast = global.VocabModal?.showToast || alert;
      const emptyMsg = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('analytics.empty_entries', '平滑化対象の単語が登録されていません。') : '平滑化対象の単語が登録されていません。';
      showToast(emptyMsg, 'info');
      return;
    }

    if (!global.VocabSRS?.smoothReviewWorkload) return;
    const res = global.VocabSRS.smoothReviewWorkload(list, cap, _workloadForecastDays);
    const showToast = global.VocabModal?.showToast || alert;

    if (res.success && res.shiftedCount > 0) {
      const activeCfg = global.VocabCore?.getActivePairConfig ? global.VocabCore.getActivePairConfig() : null;
      const pairKey = activeCfg ? activeCfg.key : 'distinction_entries';
      if (typeof global.VocabCore?.setJson === 'function') {
        global.VocabCore.setJson(pairKey, list, true);
      } else if (typeof global.VocabStorage?.setJson === 'function') {
        global.VocabStorage.setJson(pairKey, list, true);
      } else if (typeof global.VocabStorage?.idbCommitLangData === 'function') {
        global.VocabStorage.idbCommitLangData(pairKey, list);
      }

      const okMsg = global.VocabI18n?.t
        ? global.VocabI18n.t('analytics.smooth_workload_ok', { count: res.shiftedCount, days: res.affectedDays })
        : `${res.shiftedCount}語の復習期日を平滑化・分散しました（影響日数: ${res.affectedDays}日）。`;
      showToast(okMsg, 'ok', 4000);
      renderAnalyticsDashboard();
    } else {
      const noneMsg = global.VocabI18n?.t
        ? global.VocabI18n.t('analytics.smooth_workload_none')
        : (res.message || '平滑化が必要な過密日はありません。目標上限はすでに満たされています。');
      showToast(noneMsg, 'info', 3500);
    }
  }

  // --- グローバルエクスポート ---
  global.VocabAnkiView = {
    getAnkiMode,
    setAnkiMode,
    toggleAnkiMode,
    buildClozeSentenceHtml,
    buildClozeHintsHtml,
    checkClozeTyping,
    calcLevenshtein,
    getStemVariants,
    getOverdueRatio,
    setDailyReviewCap,
    getStreakInfo,
    recordReviewStreak,
    getDailyGoalInfo,
    incrementDailyGoal,
    buildAnkiBack,
    rescheduleOverdueReviews,
    startAnki,
    renderAnki,
    showAns,
    procRev,
    undoAnkiRev,
    exitAnki,
    showSessionSummary,
    getCommitHeatmapData,
    getFutureWorkloadData,
    getOverallRetrievabilityStats,
    buildAnalyticsDashboardHtml,
    renderAnalyticsDashboard,
    openAnalyticsModal,
    closeAnalyticsModal,
    triggerManualOptimize,
    triggerResetWeights,
    showDayWorkloadDetails,
    triggerWorkloadSmoothing,
    smoothReviewWorkload: (...args) => global.VocabSRS?.smoothReviewWorkload?.(...args)
  };

  global.openAnalyticsModal = global.openAnalyticsModal || openAnalyticsModal;
  global.closeAnalyticsModal = global.closeAnalyticsModal || closeAnalyticsModal;

  // [P2-1 解決] CSP準拠のイベント委譲リスナー（インライン onclick / onkeydown の完全排除）
  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      const btn = event.target && typeof event.target.closest === 'function' ? event.target.closest('[data-act]') : null;
      if (!btn || typeof btn.getAttribute !== 'function') return;
      const act = btn.getAttribute('data-act');
      if (act === 'cloze-check') {
        window.VocabAnkiView?.checkClozeTyping?.();
      } else if (act === 'open-analytics') {
        openAnalyticsModal();
      } else if (act === 'close-analytics') {
        closeAnalyticsModal();
      } else if (act === 'manual-optimize') {
        triggerManualOptimize();
      } else if (act === 'reset-weights') {
        triggerResetWeights();
      } else if (act === 'smooth-workload') {
        triggerWorkloadSmoothing();
      } else if (act === 'set-workload-days') {
        const days = Number(btn.getAttribute('data-days')) || 14;
        _workloadForecastDays = days;
        renderAnalyticsDashboard();
      } else if (act === 'show-day-workload') {
        const dStr = btn.getAttribute('data-date');
        const cVal = Number(btn.getAttribute('data-count')) || 0;
        showDayWorkloadDetails(dStr, cVal);
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
      if (event.target && event.target.id === 'workloadCapSelect') {
        _workloadTargetCap = Number(event.target.value) || 25;
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
      if (event.target && typeof event.target.matches === 'function' && event.target.matches('[data-act="cloze-input"]')) {
        if (event.key === 'Enter' && !event.isComposing && event.keyCode !== 229) {
          event.preventDefault();
          window.VocabAnkiView?.checkClozeTyping?.();
        }
      }
    });
  }
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);
```

```javascript
/**
 * Vocab Vault — Etymological Index, Hybrid Search & Sidebar Tree Engine (js/search.js)
 * Multi-token ASCII folding, PIE root indexing, multi-language pair filtering & dynamic sort
 */
(function (global) {
  'use strict';

  const $ = id => typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.getElementById(id) : null;
  const esc = s => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&':'&amp;', '<':'&lt;', '>':'&gt;', '"':'&quot;', "'":'&#39;' }[c]));
  const foldAscii = s => global.VocabMorphology?.foldAscii
    ? global.VocabMorphology.foldAscii(s)
    : String(s ?? '').toLowerCase().normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').replace(/œ/g, 'oe').replace(/æ/g, 'ae').replace(/ß/g, 'ss');

  const FOLD_CHAR_MAP = {
    a: '[aàáâãäåāăąǎ]', c: '[cçćĉċč]', d: '[dďđ]', e: '[eèéêëēĕėęě]',
    g: '[gĝğġģ]', h: '[hĥħ]', i: '[iìíîïĩīĭįı]', j: '[jĵ]', k: '[kķ]',
    l: '[lĺļľŀł]', n: '[nñńņňŉŋ]', o: '[oòóôõöøōŏőǒ]', r: '[rŕŗř]',
    s: '[sśŝşš]', t: '[tţťŧ]', u: '[uùúûüũūŭůűųǔ]', w: '[wŵ]', y: '[yýÿŷ]', z: '[zźżž]'
  };
  const FOLD_DIGRAPH_MAP = {
    oe: '(?:[oòóôõöøōŏőǒ]\\p{M}*[eèéêëēĕėęě]\\p{M}*|œ\\p{M}*)',
    ae: '(?:[aàáâãäåāăąǎ]\\p{M}*[eèéêëēĕėęě]\\p{M}*|æ\\p{M}*)',
    ss: '(?:[sśŝşš]\\p{M}*[sśŝşš]\\p{M}*|ß\\p{M}*)'
  };

  /**
   * 検索トークンをダイアクリティカル・フォールディング対応の正規表現パターンへ変換
   */
  function tokenToFoldPattern(token) {
    const chars = [...String(token ?? '').trim()];
    let out = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
      const ch = chars[i];
      const low = foldAscii(ch);
      if (low.length === 2 && FOLD_DIGRAPH_MAP[low]) {
        out += FOLD_DIGRAPH_MAP[low];
        continue;
      }
      if (i + 1 < chars.length) {
        const pair = low + foldAscii(chars[i + 1]);
        if (FOLD_DIGRAPH_MAP[pair]) {
          out += FOLD_DIGRAPH_MAP[pair];
          i++;
          continue;
        }
      }
      if (FOLD_CHAR_MAP[low]) out += `${FOLD_CHAR_MAP[low]}\\p{M}*`;
      else out += ch.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&') + '\\p{M}*';
    }
    return out;
  }

  /**
   * クエリ文字列から複合トークンを抽出（ReDoS 防護: 最大8トークン、各トークン最大40文字）
   */
  function extractQueryTokens(q) {
    const raw = String(q ?? '').trim();
    if (!raw) return [];
    const tokens = raw.split(/[\s,、，|｜/／;；]+/)
      .map(s => s.trim().slice(0, 40))
      .filter(Boolean);
    const unique = [...new Set(tokens.length ? tokens : [raw.slice(0, 40)])];
    return unique.slice(0, 8);
  }

  /**
   * 単語エントリのインデックスキャッシュ無効化
   */
  function invalidateMeta(it, appInstance = global.App) {
    const App = appInstance || global.App;
    if (App?.indexCache && it && typeof it === 'object') {
      try { App.indexCache.delete(it); } catch {}
    }
  }

  /**
   * 高速ハイライト用フォールディング正規表現生成
   */
  function buildFoldRegex(q) {
    const tokens = extractQueryTokens(q);
    if (!tokens.length) return null;
    const sorted = [...tokens].sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length);
    const pat = sorted.map(tokenToFoldPattern).filter(Boolean).join('|');
    if (!pat) return null;
    try { return new RegExp(pat, 'giu'); } catch { return null; }
  }

  /**
   * 単語エントリから語根・祖語再構形タグを抽出
   */
  function extractEtyTags(it) {
    if (Array.isArray(it?.etymologyTags)) {
      return it.etymologyTags.map(String).filter(Boolean);
    }
    const ety = String(it?.etymology || '');
    // Unicode letters (\p{L}) and marks (\p{M}) support for reconstructed languages (e.g. *dūbǭ, *h₂nḗr)
    const matches = ety.match(/\*[\p{L}\p{M}0-9₁₂₃₄ḱǵʷʰ-]+-?/gu);
    if (!matches) return [];

    const unique = [...new Set(matches)].slice(0, 4);
    const etyFold = ety.toLowerCase();
    return unique.map(m => {
      // 祖言語の文脈判定（ゲルマン祖語、印欧祖語など）
      if (etyFold.includes('ゲルマン祖語') || etyFold.includes('proto-germanic')) {
        return `ゲルマン祖語: ${m}`;
      }
      if (etyFold.includes('印欧祖語') || etyFold.includes('pie') || etyFold.includes('proto-indo-european')) {
        return `印欧祖語: ${m}`;
      }
      if (etyFold.includes('イタリック祖語') || etyFold.includes('proto-italic')) {
        return `イタリック祖語: ${m}`;
      }
      return `再構語: ${m}`;
    });
  }

  /**
   * 単語エントリのインデックス用メタデータを取得・キャッシュ
   */
  function getMeta(it, appInstance = global.App) {
    const App = appInstance || global.App || {};
    if (!App.indexCache) App.indexCache = new WeakMap();

    let meta = App.indexCache.get(it);
    if (!meta) {
      const tags = extractEtyTags(it), roots = new Set();
      const normRootKeyFn = global.VocabMorphology?.normRootKey || (r => r);
      const isValidRootForEntryFn = global.VocabMorphology?.isValidRootForEntry || (() => true);

      if (!['unknown', 'disputed'].includes(it.etymologyConfidence)) {
        tags.forEach(t => {
          const k = normRootKeyFn(t);
          if (k && isValidRootForEntryFn(k, it)) roots.add(k);
        });
      }
      const rawBlob = [
        it.word,
        it.homographIndex > 1 ? `${it.word}#${it.homographIndex}` : '',
        `#${it.num}`,
        it.phonetic,
        it.grammar_forms,
        it.category,
        it.folder,
        it.etymology,
        it.history_note,
        it.core,
        it.contextSentence,
        ...(it.meanings || []).flatMap(m => [m.pos, m.text]),
        ...tags,
        ...(it.phrases || []).flatMap(p => [p.foreign, p.ja, p.trans]),
        ...(it.derivatives || []).flatMap(d => [d.word, d.meaning, d.sub_phrase, d.sub_trans]),
        it.example?.foreign,
        it.example?.ja,
        it.example?.trans
      ].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
      meta = {
        tags,
        roots,
        wordFold: foldAscii(it.word),
        blob: rawBlob.toLowerCase(),
        foldedBlob: foldAscii(rawBlob)
      };
      App.indexCache.set(it, meta);
    }
    return meta;
  }

  /**
   * Trie（接頭辞木）ノードおよびプレフィックスツリー実装
   * プレフィックス検索を O(N) から O(K + M) へ高速化し、メインスレッドの凍結を防止
   */
  class PrefixTrieNode {
    constructor() {
      this.children = new Map();
      this.isWord = false;
      this.token = null;
    }
  }

  class PrefixTrie {
    constructor() {
      this.root = new PrefixTrieNode();
    }
    clear() {
      this.root = new PrefixTrieNode();
    }
    insert(tok) {
      if (!tok) return;
      let curr = this.root;
      for (let i = 0; i < tok.length; i++) {
        const ch = tok[i];
        let next = curr.children.get(ch);
        if (!next) {
          next = new PrefixTrieNode();
          curr.children.set(ch, next);
        }
        curr = next;
      }
      curr.isWord = true;
      curr.token = tok;
    }
    collectTokens(prefix, max = 250) {
      if (!prefix) return [];
      let curr = this.root;
      for (let i = 0; i < prefix.length; i++) {
        const ch = prefix[i];
        curr = curr.children.get(ch);
        if (!curr) return [];
      }
      const res = [];
      const stack = [curr];
      while (stack.length > 0 && res.length < max) {
        const node = stack.pop();
        if (node.isWord && node.token) {
          res.push(node.token);
        }
        for (const child of node.children.values()) {
          stack.push(child);
        }
      }
      return res;
    }
  }

  /**
   * 転置インデックス（Inverted Index）エンジン
   * 5,000〜50,000語規模でもサブミリ秒（O(1)〜O(K)）でマルチキーワード検索を実現
   */
  const VocabInvertedIndex = {
    postings: new Map(), // token -> Set<string(id|num)>
    itemsMap: new Map(), // string(id|num) -> item
    trie: new PrefixTrie(),
    indexedCount: 0,
    lastBuiltTs: 0,

    tokenize(text) {
      if (!text) return [];
      const s = String(text).toLowerCase();
      const folded = foldAscii(s);
      const tokens = new Set();

      const words = folded.match(/[a-z0-9\u00C0-\u024F]+/g) || [];
      words.forEach(w => {
        if (w.length >= 2) {
          tokens.add(w);
          for (let len = 2; len <= Math.min(4, w.length); len++) {
            tokens.add(w.slice(0, len));
          }
        }
      });

      // 日・中・韓（CJK + Hangul）の文字種を完全に網羅（1文字および隣接2文字バイグラムを転置インデックス化）
      const cjk = s.match(/[\u3040-\u309F\u30A0-\u30FF\u3400-\u4DBF\u4E00-\u9FFF\uAC00-\uD7AF\u1100-\u11FF\u3130-\u318F]/g) || [];
      for (let i = 0; i < cjk.length; i++) {
        tokens.add(cjk[i]);
        if (i + 1 < cjk.length) tokens.add(cjk[i] + cjk[i + 1]);
      }

      return [...tokens];
    },

    build(items) {
      this.postings.clear();
      this.itemsMap.clear();
      this.trie.clear();
      const list = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];

      list.forEach(it => {
        if (!it || !it.word) return;
        const key = String(it.id || it.num || Math.random());
        this.itemsMap.set(key, it);

        const meta = getMeta(it);
        const directRoots = (it.etymologyTags || it.tags || []).map(r => foldAscii(String(r).toLowerCase()).replace(/^\*|^-+|-+$/g, ''));
        const metaRoots = [...meta.roots].map(r => foldAscii(String(r).toLowerCase()).replace(/^\*|^-+|-+$/g, ''));
        const tokens = new Set([
          ...this.tokenize(it.word),
          ...this.tokenize(meta.blob),
          ...directRoots,
          ...metaRoots
        ]);

        tokens.forEach(tok => {
          if (!tok) return;
          let post = this.postings.get(tok);
          if (!post) {
            this.postings.set(tok, post = new Set());
            this.trie.insert(tok);
          }
          post.add(key);
        });
      });

      this.indexedCount = list.length;
      this.lastBuiltTs = Date.now();
      return this.indexedCount;
    },

    search(query, pool) {
      if (!query || !query.trim()) return pool || [];
      const tokens = extractQueryTokens(query).map(t => foldAscii(t.toLowerCase()).replace(/^\*|^-+|-+$/g, '')).filter(Boolean);
      if (!tokens.length) return pool || [];

      let candidateKeys = null;
      for (const tok of tokens) {
        let tokKeys = this.postings.get(tok);
        if (!tokKeys) {
          tokKeys = new Set();
          // [O(K) Trie プレフィックス検索] 全件線形走査を完全撤廃し、Trie木によるプレフィックス走査を実行
          const matchedToks = this.trie.collectTokens(tok, 250);
          for (let i = 0; i < matchedToks.length; i++) {
            const set = this.postings.get(matchedToks[i]);
            if (set) {
              set.forEach(id => tokKeys.add(id));
              if (tokKeys.size >= 1500) break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (!candidateKeys) {
          candidateKeys = new Set(tokKeys);
        } else {
          const next = new Set();
          candidateKeys.forEach(id => {
            if (tokKeys.has(id)) next.add(id);
          });
          candidateKeys = next;
        }

        if (candidateKeys.size === 0) break;
      }

      if (!candidateKeys || candidateKeys.size === 0) return [];

      const poolKeys = pool ? new Set(pool.map(i => String(i.id || i.num))) : null;
      const res = [];
      candidateKeys.forEach(key => {
        const item = this.itemsMap.get(key);
        if (item && (!poolKeys || poolKeys.has(key))) {
          res.push(item);
        }
      });
      return res;
    }
  };

  let _lastEtyIndexedRef = null;
  let _lastEtyIndexedLen = -1;

  /**
   * 全言語横断で語根インデックスマップを構築（アクティブペア即時 + 他ペア遅延インデックス化）
   */
  function buildEtyIndex(appInstance = global.App, force = false) {
    const App = appInstance || global.App || {};
    if (!App.rootIndexMap) App.rootIndexMap = new Map();

    const activeList = Array.isArray(App.entries) ? App.entries : [];
    // 変更がない場合は同期パース・再構築をスキップしてUI凍結を完全回避
    if (!force && App.rootIndexMap.size > 0 && _lastEtyIndexedRef === App.entries && _lastEtyIndexedLen === activeList.length) {
      return;
    }

    _lastEtyIndexedRef = App.entries;
    _lastEtyIndexedLen = activeList.length;
    App.rootIndexMap.clear();

    const rootBuckets = new Map();
    const getJsonFn = global.getJson || (global.VocabStorage ? global.VocabStorage.getJson : (() => []));
    const activePairKey = global.getActivePairConfig ? global.getActivePairConfig().key : '';
    const curSrc = App.srcLang || 'en';

    // 1. アクティブ言語ペアを即時同期インデックス化（メインスレッドを最優先で開放）
    activeList.forEach(it => {
      if (!it?.word) return;
      const l = it.lang || curSrc || 'en';
      it.lang = l;
      const uKey = `${activePairKey}:${it.id || it.num}`;
      const ref = { word: it.word, lang: l, num: it.num, id: it.id, homographIndex: it.homographIndex };
      getMeta(it, App).roots.forEach(k => {
        let rm = rootBuckets.get(k);
        if (!rm) rootBuckets.set(k, rm = new Map());
        rm.set(uKey, ref);
      });
    });
    rootBuckets.forEach((m, k) => App.rootIndexMap.set(k, [...m.values()]));

    // 2. 非アクティブな他言語ペアの走査
    // crossLang が不要な場合やメモリ外の巨大データはアイドル時または必要時に遅延インデックス化
    const allPairs = getAllKnownPairConfigs(App);
    const keysToScan = new Map();
    const langs = global.LANGS || {};
    ['en', 'fr', 'de', 'es', 'it', 'pt', 'nl', 'zh', 'ko', 'ja'].forEach(l => {
      const k = langs[l]?.key || (l === 'en' ? 'distinction_entries' : `distinction_entries_${l}`);
      if (k !== activePairKey) keysToScan.set(k, l);
    });
    allPairs.forEach(p => {
      if (p.key && p.key !== activePairKey) keysToScan.set(p.key, p.src || 'en');
    });

    const indexRemainingKeys = () => {
      keysToScan.forEach((srcLang, storageKey) => {
        const list = global.VocabStorage?.state?.mem?.[storageKey] || getJsonFn(storageKey) || [];
        list.forEach(it => {
          if (!it?.word) return;
          const l = it.lang || srcLang || 'en';
          it.lang = l;
          const uKey = `${storageKey}:${it.id || it.num}`;
          const ref = { word: it.word, lang: l, num: it.num, id: it.id, homographIndex: it.homographIndex };
          getMeta(it, App).roots.forEach(k => {
            let rm = rootBuckets.get(k);
            if (!rm) rootBuckets.set(k, rm = new Map());
            rm.set(uKey, ref);
          });
        });
      });
      rootBuckets.forEach((m, k) => App.rootIndexMap.set(k, [...m.values()]));
    };

    if (App.crossLang) {
      indexRemainingKeys();
    } else if (typeof requestIdleCallback === 'function') {
      requestIdleCallback(() => indexRemainingKeys(), { timeout: 2000 });
    } else if (typeof setTimeout === 'function') {
      setTimeout(indexRemainingKeys, 100);
    }
  }

  /**
   * 品詞一致判定
   */
  function matchPos(it, targetGroup) {
    if (!targetGroup || targetGroup === 'all') return true;
    return (it.meanings || []).some(m => {
      const p = String(m.pos || '').trim();
      const low = p.toLowerCase();
      const isN = p.startsWith('N') || low.startsWith('n.') || low.startsWith('subst') || p.includes('名詞');
      const isV = p.startsWith('V') || low.startsWith('v.') || p.includes('動詞');
      const isAdj = p.startsWith('Adj') || low.startsWith('adj') || p.includes('形容詞');
      const isAdv = p.startsWith('Adv') || low.startsWith('adv') || p.includes('副詞');
      if (targetGroup === 'N') return isN;
      if (targetGroup === 'V') return isV;
      if (targetGroup === 'Adj') return isAdj;
      if (targetGroup === 'Adv') return isAdv;
      if (targetGroup === 'Other') return !(isN || isV || isAdj || isAdv);
      return p.startsWith(targetGroup);
    });
  }

  /**
   * 学習ステータス判定
   */
  function matchStat(it, targetStat, now = Date.now()) {
    if (!targetStat || targetStat === 'all') return true;
    if (targetStat === 'due') return (it.nextReview || 0) <= now;
    if (targetStat === 'flag') return Array.isArray(it.flags) && it.flags.length > 0;
    if (targetStat === 'wikt') return Boolean(it.wiktGrounded);
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * 単一トークン照合
   */
  function matchSingleQueryToken(meta, tokObj) {
    return meta.blob.includes(tokObj.low)
      || (tokObj.fold && meta.foldedBlob.includes(tokObj.fold))
      || (tokObj.root && meta.roots.has(tokObj.root))
      || meta.roots.has(tokObj.low);
  }

  /**
   * 言語ペア短縮表示ラベル
   */
  function getPairShortLabel(src, tgt, locale = null) {
    const loc = (locale && global.VocabI18n?.SUPPORTED_LOCALES?.includes(locale))
      ? locale
      : (global.VocabI18n ? global.VocabI18n.getLocale() : 'ja');

    if (loc === 'ja') {
      const sMap = { en: '英', ja: '日', fr: '仏', de: '独', es: '西', it: '伊', pt: '葡', nl: '蘭', zh: '中', ko: '韓' };
      const s = sMap[src] || String(src || '').toUpperCase();
      const t = sMap[tgt] || String(tgt || '').toUpperCase();
      if (src === 'en' && tgt === 'ja') return '英和';
      if (src === 'ja' && tgt === 'en') return '和英';
      if (src === tgt) {
        return `${s}${s}`;
      }
      return `${s}${t}`;
    }

    if (loc === 'zh') {
      const sMap = { en: '英', ja: '日', fr: '法', de: '德', es: '西', it: '意', pt: '葡', nl: '荷', zh: '中', ko: '韩' };
      const s = sMap[src] || String(src || '').toUpperCase();
      const t = sMap[tgt] || String(tgt || '').toUpperCase();
      return `${s}${t}`;
    }

    if (loc === 'ko') {
      const sMap = { en: '영', ja: '일', fr: '불', de: '독', es: '서', it: '이', pt: '포', nl: '화', zh: '중', ko: '한' };
      const s = sMap[src] || String(src || '').toUpperCase();
      const t = sMap[tgt] || String(tgt || '').toUpperCase();
      return `${s}${t}`;
    }

    // 全ての欧米言語 (en, fr, de, es, it, pt, nl 等): 国際標準の2文字大文字コード (ES-EN, KO-ZH, EN-JA 等)
    const s = String(src || '').toUpperCase();
    const t = String(tgt || '').toUpperCase();
    return `${s}-${t}`;
  }

  /**
   * 言語ペア詳細表示ラベル
   */
  function getPairFullLabel(src, tgt, locale = null) {
    const loc = (locale && global.VocabI18n?.SUPPORTED_LOCALES?.includes(locale))
      ? locale
      : (global.VocabI18n ? global.VocabI18n.getLocale() : 'ja');
    const isJa = loc === 'ja';
    const langs = global.LANGS || {};
    const sName = isJa
      ? (langs[src]?.ja || langs[src]?.label || String(src || '').toUpperCase())
      : (langs[src]?.label || String(src || '').toUpperCase());
    const tName = isJa
      ? (langs[tgt]?.ja || langs[tgt]?.label || String(tgt || '').toUpperCase())
      : (langs[tgt]?.label || String(tgt || '').toUpperCase());
    const short = getPairShortLabel(src, tgt, loc);
    if (src === tgt) {
      return isJa ? `${sName} (${short}辞典)` : `${sName} (${short} Dict)`;
    }
    return `${sName} → ${tName} (${short})`;
  }

  const _pairCountCache = new Map(); // storageKey -> { rawLen: number, count: number }

  /**
   * 保存されている全言語ペアファイル一覧取得（パースキャッシュ適用で起動時のLong Taskを防止）
   */
  function getActivePairFiles(appInstance = global.App) {
    const App = appInstance || global.App || {};
    const pairMap = new Map();
    const getJsonFn = global.getJson || (global.VocabStorage ? global.VocabStorage.getJson : (() => []));
    const activePairKey = global.getActivePairConfig ? global.getActivePairConfig().key : '';

    const scanKeys = new Set();
    if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
          const k = localStorage.key(i);
          if (k && k.startsWith('distinction_entries')) scanKeys.add(k);
        }
      } catch {}
    }
    if (global.VocabStorage?.state?.mem) {
      Object.keys(global.VocabStorage.state.mem).forEach(k => {
        if (k && k.startsWith('distinction_entries')) scanKeys.add(k);
      });
    }

    scanKeys.forEach(k => {
      let count = 0;
      if (k === activePairKey && App.loadedKey === activePairKey && Array.isArray(App.entries)) {
        count = App.entries.length;
      } else if (global.VocabStorage?.state?.mem?.[k] && Array.isArray(global.VocabStorage.state.mem[k])) {
        count = global.VocabStorage.state.mem[k].length;
      } else if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(k);
        if (!raw || raw.trim() === '[]') {
          count = 0;
        } else {
          const cached = _pairCountCache.get(k);
          if (cached && cached.rawLen === raw.length) {
            count = cached.count;
          } else {
            const words = getJsonFn(k);
            count = Array.isArray(words) ? words.length : 0;
            _pairCountCache.set(k, { rawLen: raw.length, count });
          }
        }
      } else {
        const words = getJsonFn(k);
        count = Array.isArray(words) ? words.length : 0;
      }

      if (count > 0) {
        const p = global.VocabStorage ? global.VocabStorage.keyToPair(k) : { srcLang: 'en', tgtLang: 'ja' };
        const id = `${p.srcLang}_${p.tgtLang}`;
        pairMap.set(id, {
          src: p.srcLang,
          tgt: p.tgtLang,
          key: k,
          count
        });
      }
    });

    if (!pairMap.size) {
      pairMap.set('en_ja', { src: 'en', tgt: 'ja', key: global.LANGS?.en?.key || 'distinction_entries', count: 0 });
    }

    const curSrc = App.srcLang || 'en';
    const curTgt = App.tgtLang || 'ja';
    const curId = `${curSrc}_${curTgt}`;
    const cfg = global.getActivePairConfig ? global.getActivePairConfig() : { key: 'distinction_entries' };
    const curCount = (App.loadedKey === cfg.key && Array.isArray(App.entries))
      ? App.entries.length
      : (getJsonFn(cfg.key)?.length || 0);

    if (!pairMap.has(curId)) {
      pairMap.set(curId, {
        src: curSrc,
        tgt: curTgt,
        key: cfg.key,
        count: curCount
      });
    } else {
      const curObj = pairMap.get(curId);
      if (curObj) {
        curObj.count = curCount;
      }
    }

    return Array.from(pairMap.values()).map(p => ({
      ...p,
      short: getPairShortLabel(p.src, p.tgt),
      label: getPairFullLabel(p.src, p.tgt),
      isCur: (p.src === curSrc && p.tgt === curTgt)
    }));
  }

  function getAllKnownPairConfigs(appInstance = global.App) {
    return getActivePairFiles(appInstance);
  }

  /**
   * 言語ペアタブ一覧を描画
   */
  function renderPairFileTabs(appInstance = global.App) {
    const container = $('pairFileTabs');
    if (!container) return;
    const files = getActivePairFiles(appInstance);
    const isJa = global.VocabI18n ? global.VocabI18n.getLocale() === 'ja' : true;
    container.innerHTML = files.map(p => {
      const countLabel = p.count > 0 ? p.count : (isJa ? '新規' : 'New');
      const countClass = p.count > 0 ? 'tab-count' : 'tab-count empty';
      return `<button type="button" class="file-tab ${p.isCur ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="setLanguagePair('${p.src}','${p.tgt}')" title="${esc(p.label)}"><span class="tab-label">${esc(p.short)}</span><span class="${countClass}">${countLabel}</span></button>`;
    }).join('');
  }

  /**
   * フィルター・クエリ・ソート条件に基づく高速単語フィルタリング
   */
  function getFiltered(appInstance = global.App) {
    const App = appInstance || global.App || {};
    let rawQ = (App.qStr || '').trim(), now = Date.now();
    let queryPos = null, queryCat = null, queryStat = null;

    if (rawQ) {
      rawQ = rawQ.replace(/#([a-zA-Z\u3040-\u309F\u30A0-\u30FF\u4E00-\u9FAF]+)/g, (_, val) => {
        const vLow = val.toLowerCase();
        if (vLow === 'noun' || vLow === 'n' || val === '名詞') queryPos = 'noun';
        else if (vLow === 'verb' || vLow === 'v' || val === '動詞') queryPos = 'verb';
        else if (vLow === 'adj' || vLow === 'a' || val === '形容詞') queryPos = 'adj';
        else if (vLow === 'adv' || val === '副詞') queryPos = 'adv';
        else queryPos = val;
        return '';
      });
      rawQ = rawQ.replace(/@([^\s]+)/g, (_, val) => {
        queryCat = val;
        return '';
      });
      rawQ = rawQ.replace(/\?([a-zA-Z]+)/g, (_, val) => {
        queryStat = val.toLowerCase();
        return '';
      });
      rawQ = rawQ.trim();
    }

    const effectiveStat = queryStat || App.statF || 'all';
    const effectivePos = queryPos || App.posF || 'all';
    const effectiveCat = queryCat || App.cat || 'all';

    const getActivePairConfigFn = global.getActivePairConfig || (() => ({ key: 'distinction_entries' }));
    const curPairKey = getActivePairConfigFn().key;
    const getJsonFn = global.getJson || (global.VocabStorage ? global.VocabStorage.getJson : (() => []));

    const pool = App.crossLang ? getAllKnownPairConfigs(App).flatMap(p => {
      const cfg = global.VocabStorage ? global.VocabStorage.getPairConfig(p.src, p.tgt) : (global.LANGS?.[p.src] || global.LANGS?.en);
      return (cfg?.key === curPairKey) ? (App.entries || []) : getJsonFn(cfg?.key);
    }) : (App.entries || []);

    const baseFiltered = pool.filter(i => {
      if (!i?.word || !matchStat(i, effectiveStat, now)) return false;
      if (effectiveCat !== 'all' && i.category !== effectiveCat && (!queryCat || !String(i.category || '').toLowerCase().includes(queryCat.toLowerCase()))) return false;
      if (App.fol && App.fol !== 'all' && i.folder !== App.fol) return false;
      if (!matchPos(i, effectivePos)) return false;
      return true;
    });

    let matched = baseFiltered;
    if (rawQ) {
      const hasExplicitOr = /[,、，|｜/／;；]/.test(rawQ);
      const rawTokens = extractQueryTokens(rawQ);
      const normRootKeyFn = global.VocabMorphology?.normRootKey || (r => r);
      const tokObjs = rawTokens.map(t => ({
        low: t.toLowerCase(),
        fold: foldAscii(t),
        root: normRootKeyFn(t)
      }));

      if (hasExplicitOr) {
        matched = baseFiltered.filter(i => {
          const meta = getMeta(i, App);
          return tokObjs.some(tok => matchSingleQueryToken(meta, tok));
        });
      } else if (tokObjs.length <= 1) {
        const tok = tokObjs[0];
        matched = baseFiltered.filter(i => matchSingleQueryToken(getMeta(i, App), tok));
      } else {
        const andMatches = baseFiltered.filter(i => {
          const meta = getMeta(i, App);
          return tokObjs.every(tok => matchSingleQueryToken(meta, tok));
        });
        if (andMatches.length > 0) {
          matched = andMatches;
        } else {
          matched = baseFiltered.filter(i => {
            const meta = getMeta(i, App);
            return tokObjs.some(tok => matchSingleQueryToken(meta, tok));
          });
        }
      }
    }

    const sorted = [...matched];
    if (rawQ && (!App.sortBy || App.sortBy === 'new')) {
      const qFold = foldAscii(rawQ).toLowerCase().replace(/^\*|^-+|-+$/g, '');
      const calcRelevance = item => {
        let score = 0;
        const wFold = foldAscii(item.word || '').toLowerCase();
        if (wFold === qFold) score += 1000;
        else if (wFold.startsWith(qFold)) score += 500;
        else if (wFold.includes(qFold)) score += 200;

        const meanings = item.meanings || [];
        for (let mIdx = 0; mIdx < meanings.length; mIdx++) {
          const mText = foldAscii(meanings[mIdx]?.text || '').toLowerCase();
          if (mText === qFold) { score += 120; break; }
          if (mText.startsWith(qFold)) { score += 80; break; }
          if (mText.includes(qFold)) { score += 40; break; }
        }

        const tags = item.etymologyTags || item.tags || [];
        for (let tIdx = 0; tIdx < tags.length; tIdx++) {
          const tFold = foldAscii(String(tags[tIdx])).toLowerCase().replace(/^\*|^-+|-+$/g, '');
          if (tFold === qFold) { score += 90; break; }
          if (tFold.includes(qFold)) { score += 50; break; }
        }

        return score;
      };

      sorted.sort((a, b) => {
        const diff = calcRelevance(b) - calcRelevance(a);
        if (diff !== 0) return diff;
        return (b.num || 0) - (a.num || 0);
      });
    } else if (App.sortBy === 'old') {
      sorted.sort((a, b) => (a.num || 0) - (b.num || 0));
    } else if (App.sortBy === 'due') {
      sorted.sort((a, b) => (a.nextReview || 0) - (b.nextReview || 0));
    } else if (App.sortBy === 'alpha') {
      sorted.sort((a, b) => foldAscii(a.word).localeCompare(foldAscii(b.word)));
    } else {
      sorted.reverse();
    }
    return sorted;
  }

  const mkTreeItem = (t, id, l, c, cur) =>
    `<div class="tree-item ${cur === id ? 'active' : ''}" data-act="filter" data-type="${esc(t)}" data-val="${esc(id)}"><span>${esc(l)}</span><span class="tree-cnt">${c}</span></div>`;

  /**
   * サイドバーツリー（言語・ステータス・タイトル・品詞・カテゴリ）の集計・描画
   */
  function renderSidebarTree(appInstance = global.App) {
    const App = appInstance || global.App || {};
    if (!$('vaultLabel')) return;
    const curSrc = App.srcLang || 'en';
    const curTgt = App.tgtLang || 'ja';
    const pairBadge = curSrc === curTgt
      ? `${curSrc.toUpperCase()} (${getPairShortLabel(curSrc, curTgt)})`
      : `${curSrc.toUpperCase()} → ${curTgt.toUpperCase()}`;
    $('vaultLabel').textContent = `Vocab Vault (${pairBadge})`;

    const pairs = getAllKnownPairConfigs(App);
    if ($('treeLang')) {
      $('treeLang').innerHTML = pairs.map(p => {
        const isCur = (p.src === curSrc && p.tgt === curTgt);
        return `<div class="tree-item ${isCur ? 'active' : ''}" data-act="set-pair" data-src="${esc(p.src)}" data-tgt="${esc(p.tgt)}"><span>${esc(p.label)}</span><span class="tree-cnt">${p.count}</span></div>`;
      }).join('');
    }

    const entries = App.entries || [];
    const now = Date.now(), sC = { all: entries.length, due: 0, flag: 0, wikt: 0 };
    const fM = new Map(), cM = new Map(), pC = { all: entries.length, N: 0, V: 0, Adj: 0, Adv: 0, Other: 0 };
    const posGroups = global.POS_GROUPS || [
      { id: 'all', label: 'すべての品詞' },
      { id: 'N', label: '名詞 (Noun)' },
      { id: 'V', label: '動詞 (Verb)' },
      { id: 'Adj', label: '形容詞 (Adj)' },
      { id: 'Adv', label: '副詞 (Adv)' },
      { id: 'Other', label: 'その他 (Phr/Idiom)' }
    ];
    const statGroups = global.STAT_GROUPS || [
      { id: 'all', label: 'すべて' },
      { id: 'due', label: '復習期日' },
      { id: 'flag', label: '要確認フラグ' },
      { id: 'wikt', label: 'Wiktionary裏付' }
    ];
    const cats = global.CATS || [];

    entries.forEach(e => {
      if ((e.nextReview || 0) <= now) sC.due++;
      if (e.flags?.length) sC.flag++;
      if (e.wiktGrounded) sC.wikt++;
      if (e.folder) fM.set(e.folder, (fM.get(e.folder) ?? 0) + 1);
      if (e.category) cM.set(e.category, (cM.get(e.category) ?? 0) + 1);
      posGroups.slice(1).forEach(g => { if (matchPos(e, g.id)) pC[g.id]++; });
    });

    const allFieldsLbl = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('side.all_fields') : 'すべてのタイトル';
    const allCatsLbl = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('side.all_cats') : 'すべてのカテゴリ';
    const translateCat = global.VocabI18n?.translateCategory || (c => c);

    if ($('treeStat')) $('treeStat').innerHTML = statGroups.map(g => mkTreeItem('stat', g.id, g.label, sC[g.id], App.statF)).join('');
    if ($('treeFol')) $('treeFol').innerHTML = mkTreeItem('fol', 'all', allFieldsLbl, entries.length, App.fol) + [...fM.entries()].map(([f, c]) => mkTreeItem('fol', f, f, c, App.fol)).join('');
    if ($('treePos')) $('treePos').innerHTML = posGroups.map(g => mkTreeItem('pos', g.id, g.label, pC[g.id], App.posF)).join('');
    if ($('treeCat')) $('treeCat').innerHTML = mkTreeItem('cat', 'all', allCatsLbl, entries.length, App.cat)
      + [...cats].sort((a, b) => (cM.get(b) ?? 0) - (cM.get(a) ?? 0)).filter(c => (cM.get(c) ?? 0) > 0 || App.cat === c).map(c => mkTreeItem('cat', c, translateCat(c), cM.get(c) ?? 0, App.cat)).join('');
    if (global.enhanceA11y) global.enhanceA11y($('secLang')?.parentElement || document);

    document.body.classList.add('side-collapsed');
    document.body.classList.remove('side-open-lock');

    if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
    const shouldOpen = typeof force === 'boolean' ? force : document.body.classList.contains('side-collapsed');
    if (shouldOpen) {
      document.body.classList.remove('side-collapsed');

  const toggleSec = id => $(id)?.classList.toggle('closed');

  function toggleMask() {

    const m = document.body.classList.toggle('mask');
    if (!m) document.querySelectorAll('.revealed').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('revealed'));

    toggleSec,

})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);
```

```javascript
/**
 * VocabVault - List View & Keyed DOM Reconciliation Engine

(function (global) {

    if (!listContainer) return;

    // 1. 待機中タスクカード・失敗カード（.loading-card, .gen-err, [data-act="retry-batch"]）を特定・維持
    const loadingCards = [];

    if (typeof listContainer.querySelectorAll === 'function') {
      const qCards = [...listContainer.querySelectorAll('.loading-card, .gen-err, [data-act="retry-batch"]')];
      qCards.forEach(c => {

    reqQueue.forEach(t => {

            usedNodes.add(cardEl);
            finalNodes.push(cardEl);
          }
        }

    });

    // 4. 今回のページから外れた不要カードのみを安全に除去 (GC負荷最小化)
    existingCards.forEach(c => {

    // フォーカス（document.activeElement）、テキスト選択、スクロール位置を完全保持
    if (typeof listContainer.insertBefore === 'function' && listContainer.children !== undefined) {
      let nextRefNode = null;
      for (let i = finalNodes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const node = finalNodes[i];
        if (!node) continue;

        const validRef = (nextRefNode && nextRefNode.parentNode === listContainer) ? nextRefNode : null;

        toRemove.forEach(ch => ch.remove?.());

    } else {

      listContainer.innerHTML = '';

      });
    }

    if (typeof options.enhanceA11y === 'function') {

    }

  let _cardObserver = null;
  /**
   * 項目17: 画面外カードのレンダリング負荷を最小化する仮想Windowingオブザーバー

  /**

  function render(ctx = {}) {

      de: 'Ordner: ',
      fr: 'Dossier : ',
      es: 'Carpeta: ',
      it: 'Cartella: ',
      pt: 'Pasta: ',

      ko: '폴더: ',
      zh: '文件夹: ',

    };
    const folPrefix = FOL_PREFIXES[tL] || FOL_PREFIXES.en;

    const parts = [
      (appState.posF && appState.posF !== 'all') ? (posObj ? posObj.label || posObj.name : appState.posF) : null,
      (appState.cat && appState.cat !== 'all') ? (global.VocabI18n?.translateCategory ? global.VocabI18n.translateCategory(appState.cat, tL) : appState.cat) : ((appState.catF && appState.catF !== 'all') ? (global.VocabI18n?.translateCategory ? global.VocabI18n.translateCategory(appState.catF, tL) : appState.catF) : null),
      (appState.fol && appState.fol !== 'all') ? `${folPrefix}${appState.fol}` : ((appState.folF && appState.folF !== 'all') ? `${folPrefix}${appState.folF}` : null),
      (appState.statF && appState.statF !== 'all') ? (statObj ? statObj.label || statObj.name : appState.statF) : null
    ].filter(Boolean);

    const DEFAULT_HEADINGS = {
      ja: 'すべての単語',
      de: 'Alle Wörter',
      fr: 'Tous les mots',
      es: 'Todas las palabras',
      it: 'Tutte le parole',
      pt: 'Todas as palavras',
      nl: 'Alle woorden',

      zh: '全部单词',

    const defaultHeading = DEFAULT_HEADINGS[tL] || DEFAULT_HEADINGS.en;
    const countUnit = isJa ? '件' : (tL === 'ko' ? '개' : (tL === 'zh' ? '个' : 'words'));
    const headingText = parts.length ? parts.join(' › ') : defaultHeading;
    const docHeading = $('docHeading');

      const resetBtnLbl = isJa ? 'フィルタを解除する' : (tL === 'de' ? 'Filter zurücksetzen' : (tL === 'fr' ? 'Réinitialiser les filtres' : (tL === 'es' ? 'Restablecer filtros' : (tL === 'ko' ? '필터 해제' : (tL === 'zh' ? '重置筛选' : 'Reset filters')))));

      const academicLbl = isJa ? '学術・教養コア（20選）' : 'Academic Core (20)';

  /**
   * ページ番号ウィンドウ（現在ページ前後のピルと省略記号）を生成

  function buildPageWindow(current, total) {
    if (total <= 7) {
      return Array.from({ length: total }, (_, i) => i + 1);
    }
    const pages = new Set([1, total]);
    for (let i = Math.max(1, current - 1); i <= Math.min(total, current + 1); i++) {
      pages.add(i);
    }
    if (current <= 3) {
      pages.add(2);
      pages.add(3);
      pages.add(4);
    }
    if (current >= total - 2) {
      pages.add(total - 3);
      pages.add(total - 2);
      pages.add(total - 1);
    }
    const sorted = Array.from(pages).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const result = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {

    const lblFirst = isJa ? '最初' : (tL === 'ko' ? '처음' : (tL === 'zh' ? '首页' : (tL === 'de' ? 'Erste' : (tL === 'fr' ? 'Début' : (tL === 'es' ? 'Inicio' : 'First')))));
    const lblPrev = isJa ? '前へ' : (tL === 'ko' ? '이전' : (tL === 'zh' ? '上一页' : (tL === 'de' ? 'Zurück' : (tL === 'fr' ? 'Préc' : (tL === 'es' ? 'Ant' : 'Prev')))));
    const lblNext = isJa ? '次へ' : (tL === 'ko' ? '다음' : (tL === 'zh' ? '下一页' : (tL === 'de' ? 'Weiter' : (tL === 'fr' ? 'Suiv' : (tL === 'es' ? 'Sig' : 'Next')))));
    const lblLast = isJa ? '最後' : (tL === 'ko' ? '마지막' : (tL === 'zh' ? '末页' : (tL === 'de' ? 'Letzte' : (tL === 'fr' ? 'Fin' : (tL === 'es' ? 'Final' : 'Last')))));
    const lblPageOf = (p, total) => isJa ? `${p} / ${total} ページ` : (tL === 'ko' ? `${p} / ${total} 페이지` : (tL === 'zh' ? `第 ${p} / ${total} 页` : (tL === 'de' ? `Seite ${p} von ${total}` : (tL === 'fr' ? `Page ${p} sur ${total}` : (tL === 'es' ? `Página ${p} de ${total}` : `Page ${p} of ${total}`)))));
    const navAria = isJa ? 'ページネーション' : 'Pagination';
    const selectTitle = isJa ? 'クリックしてページを直接選択' : 'Select page';
    const selectAria = isJa ? 'ページ番号を選択' : 'Select page number';

    // 1. 最初へボタン (« 最初)
    const firstBtn = `<button type="button" class="btn-o btn-pag btn-pag-nav" data-act="page-jump" data-page="1" ${isFirst ? 'disabled' : ''} title="${lblFirst} (1)" aria-label="${lblFirst}"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="13" height="13" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="margin-right:2px"><polyline points="11 17 6 12 11 7"/><polyline points="18 17 13 12 18 7"/></svg><span class="pag-btn-lbl">${lblFirst}</span></button>`;

    // 2. 前へボタン (‹ 前へ)
    const prevBtn = `<button type="button" class="btn-o btn-pag btn-pag-nav" data-act="page" data-dir="-1" ${isFirst ? 'disabled' : ''} title="${lblPrev}" aria-label="${lblPrev}"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="13" height="13" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="margin-right:2px"><polyline points="15 18 9 12 15 6"/></svg><span class="pag-btn-lbl">${lblPrev}</span></button>`;

    // 3. ページ番号ピル（デスクトップ・タブレット用）
    const pageWindow = buildPageWindow(page, tot);
    const pillsHtml = pageWindow.map(p => {
      if (p === '...') {

      }
      const activeCls = p === page ? ' active' : '';
      return `<button type="button" class="btn-o btn-pag btn-pag-num${activeCls}" data-act="page-jump" data-page="${p}" aria-label="${p}" ${p === page ? 'aria-current="page"' : ''}>${p}</button>`;
    }).join('');

    // 4. クイックジャンプセレクター（全端末共通：タップで全ページから瞬時に選択）
    let selectOpts = '';

      selectOpts += `<option value="${p}" ${p === page ? 'selected' : ''}>${lblPageOf(p, tot)}</option>`;
    }

    // 5. 次へボタン (次へ ›)
    const nextBtn = `<button type="button" class="btn-o btn-pag btn-pag-nav" data-act="page" data-dir="1" ${isLast ? 'disabled' : ''} title="${lblNext}" aria-label="${lblNext}"><span class="pag-btn-lbl">${lblNext}</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="13" height="13" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="margin-left:2px"><polyline points="9 18 15 12 9 6"/></svg></button>`;

    // 6. 最後へボタン (最後 »)
    const lastBtn = `<button type="button" class="btn-o btn-pag btn-pag-nav" data-act="page-jump" data-page="${tot}" ${isLast ? 'disabled' : ''} title="${lblLast} (${tot})" aria-label="${lblLast}"><span class="pag-btn-lbl">${lblLast}</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="13" height="13" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" style="margin-left:2px"><polyline points="13 17 18 12 13 7"/><polyline points="6 17 11 12 6 7"/></svg></button>`;

    return `<div class="pag-bar" role="navigation" aria-label="${navAria}">${firstBtn}${prevBtn}<div class="pag-center">${selectHtml}<div class="pag-pills">${pillsHtml}</div></div>${nextBtn}${lastBtn}</div>`;
  }

  /**
   * 指定ページを読み込んで描画
   */
  function load(p = 1, ctx = {}) {
    const appState = ctx.appState || (global.VocabCore?.App);
    if (!appState) return;

    if (p) appState.page = p;
    const curPairKey = ctx.getActivePairKey ? ctx.getActivePairKey() : (global.VocabCore?.getActivePairConfig?.()?.key);
    if (typeof ctx.getJson === 'function' && curPairKey) {
      let items = ctx.getJson(curPairKey);
      if (typeof ctx.repairEntriesLocalization === 'function') {
        const pairCfg = ctx.getActivePairConfig ? ctx.getActivePairConfig() : null;
        items = ctx.repairEntriesLocalization(items, pairCfg);
      }
      appState.entries = items;
      appState.loadedKey = curPairKey;
    }
    if (typeof ctx.buildEtyIndex === 'function') ctx.buildEtyIndex();
    if (typeof ctx.renderSidebarTree === 'function') ctx.renderSidebarTree();
    render(ctx);
    if (typeof ctx.updStats === 'function') ctx.updStats();
    if (typeof ctx.renderPairFileTabs === 'function') {
      ctx.renderPairFileTabs();
    } else if (typeof global.VocabSearch?.renderPairFileTabs === 'function') {
      global.VocabSearch.renderPairFileTabs(appState);
    }
  }

  /**
   * フィルタが1つでもアクティブか判定
   */
  function hasActiveFilters(appState) {
    if (!appState) return false;
    return Boolean(
      (appState.q && appState.q.trim()) ||
      (appState.qStr && appState.qStr.trim()) ||
      (appState.cat && appState.cat !== 'all') ||
      (appState.catF && appState.catF !== 'all') ||
      (appState.fol && appState.fol !== 'all') ||
      (appState.folF && appState.folF !== 'all') ||
      (appState.posF && appState.posF !== 'all') ||
      (appState.statF && appState.statF !== 'all') ||

    );
  }

  /**
   * 全フィルタを一括クリア
   */
  function resetFilters(appState, onRender) {
    if (!appState) return;
    if (typeof appState.resetFilters === 'function') {
      appState.resetFilters();
    } else {
      appState.statF = appState.cat = appState.catF = appState.posF = appState.fol = appState.folF = 'all';
      appState.q = '';
      appState.qStr = '';
      appState.qReg = null;
      appState.crossLang = false;
    }

    if (qSearch) qSearch.value = '';
```
