  /**
   * 単語ジャンプ（該当ページへの直接遷移とスムーズスクロール・発光）
   */
  function jumpToWord(w, tLang, ctx = {}) {
    if ($('anki')?.style.display === 'block' && typeof ctx.exitAnki === 'function') ctx.exitAnki();
    try { document?.activeElement?.blur?.(); } catch {}
    if ($('wordSuggestBox')) $('wordSuggestBox').style.display = 'none';
    if (typeof ctx.closeSidebar === 'function' && typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth <= 768) ctx.closeSidebar();
    if (global.VocabModal && typeof global.VocabModal.closeAllModals === 'function') global.VocabModal.closeAllModals();

    const parseSpecFn = ctx.parseInputWordSpec || (global.VocabMorphology ? global.VocabMorphology.parseInputWordSpec : null);
    const spec = parseSpecFn ? parseSpecFn(w) : { cleanWord: String(w || '').trim(), homographIndex: 1 };
    const targetWord = (spec.cleanWord || '').trim();
    const homoIdx = spec.homographIndex || 1;
    if (!targetWord) return;

    const appState = ctx.appState || (global.VocabCore?.App);
    if (!appState) return;

    const sLang = tLang || appState.lang;
    let targetEntries = Array.isArray(appState.entries) ? appState.entries : [];
    let switchLang = false;

    if (sLang !== appState.lang && !appState.crossLang) {
      appState.lang = sLang;
      appState.srcLang = sLang;
      if (typeof ctx.lsSet === 'function') {
        ctx.lsSet('vv_active_lang', appState.lang);
        ctx.lsSet('vv_src_lang', appState.srcLang);
      }
      if (typeof ctx.getActivePairKey === 'function' && typeof ctx.getJson === 'function') {
        appState.entries = ctx.getJson(ctx.getActivePairKey());
        targetEntries = appState.entries;
      }
      switchLang = true;
    }

    const mkLk = (word, l, idx) => global.VocabMorphology ? global.VocabMorphology.makeLookupKey(word, l, idx) : `${word}_${l}`;
    const targetLk = mkLk(targetWord, sLang, homoIdx);
    const baseTargetLk = mkLk(targetWord, sLang, 1);
    const cleanTargetWord = targetWord.toLowerCase();

    let targetItem = targetEntries.find(it => mkLk(it.word, it.lang || sLang, it.homographIndex) === targetLk)
      || targetEntries.find(it => mkLk(it.word, it.lang || sLang, 1) === baseTargetLk)
      || targetEntries.find(it => String(it.word || '').trim().toLowerCase() === cleanTargetWord);

    if (!targetItem && !appState.crossLang && typeof ctx.getAllKnownPairs === 'function' && typeof ctx.getJson === 'function') {
      const allPairs = ctx.getAllKnownPairs();
      for (const p of allPairs) {
        if (p.src === sLang) continue;
        const list = ctx.getJson(p.key);
        const match = list.find(it => mkLk(it.word, p.src, it.homographIndex) === mkLk(targetWord, p.src, homoIdx)
          || mkLk(it.word, p.src, 1) === mkLk(targetWord, p.src, 1)
          || String(it.word || '').trim().toLowerCase() === cleanTargetWord);
        if (match) {
          targetItem = match;
          appState.srcLang = p.src;
          appState.tgtLang = p.tgt;
          appState.lang = p.src;
          if (typeof ctx.lsSet === 'function') {
            ctx.lsSet('vv_src_lang', p.src);
            ctx.lsSet('vv_tgt_lang', p.tgt);
            ctx.lsSet('vv_active_lang', p.src);
          }
          appState.entries = list;
          targetEntries = list;
          switchLang = true;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    if (!targetItem) {
      if (typeof ctx.setSearch === 'function') ctx.setSearch(targetWord, true);
      return;
    }

    if (typeof appState.resetFilters === 'function') {
      appState.resetFilters();
    } else {
      resetFilters(appState);
    }

    const filtered = typeof ctx.getFiltered === 'function' ? ctx.getFiltered() : [];
    const itemIndex = filtered.findIndex(it =>
      it === targetItem ||
      (it.id && targetItem.id && it.id === targetItem.id) ||
      (mkLk(it.word, it.lang || sLang, it.homographIndex) === targetLk) ||
      (String(it.word || '').trim().toLowerCase() === cleanTargetWord)
    );
    const perPage = (ctx.perPage && Number.isFinite(ctx.perPage)) ? ctx.perPage : ((appState.per && Number.isFinite(appState.per)) ? appState.per : 30);
    const targetPage = itemIndex >= 0 ? Math.floor(itemIndex / perPage) + 1 : 1;
    if (switchLang) {
      const srcSel = $('srcLangSel');
      const tgtSel = $('tgtLangSel');
      if (srcSel && appState.srcLang) srcSel.value = appState.srcLang;
      if (tgtSel && appState.tgtLang) tgtSel.value = appState.tgtLang;
    }

    appState.page = targetPage;
    if (typeof ctx.onRender === 'function') ctx.onRender();

    // ブラウザURLの同期（?w=単語&lang=言語）: Web版でURLを共有・再読込・ブックマークしても同一単語へ即座に復元
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.history && typeof window.history.replaceState === 'function' && window.location && window.location.protocol !== 'file:') {
      try {
        const u = new URL(window.location.href);
        if (u.searchParams && typeof u.searchParams.set === 'function') {
          u.searchParams.set('w', targetWord);
          if (sLang && sLang !== 'en') u.searchParams.set('lang', sLang);
          else if (typeof u.searchParams.delete === 'function') u.searchParams.delete('lang');
          window.history.replaceState(null, '', u.toString());
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    const scrollHelper = global.VocabCardView?.scrollToCard;
    const findHelper = global.VocabCardView?.findCardElement;
    const targetId = targetItem?.id || null;

    // モバイルでのサイドバー閉鎖（280msトランジション）やページ切替時のDOM再構築完了を完全にカバーするスケジュール
    const scheduleDelays = [0, 60, 140, 280, 420];

    function runAttempt(idx) {
      const cards = (typeof document !== 'undefined') ? [...document.querySelectorAll('#list .card')] : [];
      const el = findHelper ? findHelper(cards, targetWord, targetLk, baseTargetLk, targetId) : null;
      if (el && scrollHelper) {
        scrollHelper(el, $('mainScroll'), { immediate: idx === 0 });
      }
      if (idx + 1 < scheduleDelays.length) {
        const nextDelay = scheduleDelays[idx + 1] - scheduleDelays[idx];
        setTimeout(() => runAttempt(idx + 1), nextDelay);
      }
    }

    if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function') {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => runAttempt(0));
    } else {
      setTimeout(() => runAttempt(0), 10);
    }
  }

  // --- グローバルエクスポート ---
  global.VocabListView = {
    reconcileList,
    render,
    load,
    buildPageWindow,
    renderPaginationHtml,
    hasActiveFilters,
    resetFilters,
    jumpToWord,
    setupCardVisibilityObserver
  };
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);

  function hlText(str, allowBold = false, qReg = null) {
    const raw = String(str ?? '');
    if (!raw) return '';
    const reg = qReg || global.App?.qReg;
    if (!allowBold) return highlightPlain(raw, reg);
    return raw.split(/(<b>[\s\S]*?<\/b>)/gi).map(p => /^<b>[\s\S]*<\/b>$/i.test(p) ? `<b>${highlightPlain(p.slice(3, -4), reg)}</b>` : highlightPlain(p, reg)).join('');
  }

  /**
   * 相対時間の整形 (1分後, 2日後, 復習期日 / Due, in 5m, in 2h, in 3d)
   */
  function relTime(ts, targetLocale = null) {
    const tL = targetLocale || global.App?.tgtLang || global.VocabI18n?.getLocale?.() || 'ja';
    const m = Math.floor(((Number(ts) || Date.now()) - Date.now()) / 60000);
    if (tL === 'ja') {
      return m <= 0 ? '復習期日' : m < 60 ? `${m}分後` : m < 1440 ? `${Math.floor(m / 60)}時間後` : `${Math.floor(m / 1440)}日後`;
    }
    if (m <= 0) {
      if (tL === 'ko') return '복습 기한';
      if (tL === 'zh') return '到期复习';
      if (tL === 'de') return 'Fällig';
      if (tL === 'fr') return 'À réviser';
      if (tL === 'es') return 'Vencido';
      if (tL === 'it') return 'Scaduto';
      if (tL === 'pt') return 'Vencido';
      if (tL === 'nl') return 'Te herhalen';
      return 'Due';
    }
    if (m < 60) {
      if (tL === 'ko') return `${m}분 후`;
      if (tL === 'zh') return `${m}分钟后`;
      if (tL === 'de') return `in ${m}m`;
      if (tL === 'fr') return `dans ${m}m`;
      if (tL === 'es') return `en ${m}m`;
      if (tL === 'it') return `tra ${m}m`;
      if (tL === 'pt') return `em ${m}m`;
      if (tL === 'nl') return `over ${m}m`;
      return `in ${m}m`;
    }
    const h = Math.floor(m / 60);
    if (m < 1440) {
      if (tL === 'ko') return `${h}시간 후`;
      if (tL === 'zh') return `${h}小时后`;
      if (tL === 'de') return `in ${h}h`;
      if (tL === 'fr') return `dans ${h}h`;
      if (tL === 'es') return `en ${h}h`;
      if (tL === 'it') return `tra ${h}h`;
      if (tL === 'pt') return `em ${h}h`;
      if (tL === 'nl') return `over ${h}u`;
      return `in ${h}h`;
    }
    const d = Math.floor(m / 1440);
    if (tL === 'ko') return `${d}일 후`;
    if (tL === 'zh') return `${d}天后`;
    if (tL === 'de') return `in ${d}d`;
    if (tL === 'fr') return `dans ${d}j`;
    if (tL === 'es') return `en ${d}d`;
    if (tL === 'it') return `tra ${d}g`;
    if (tL === 'pt') return `em ${d}d`;
    if (tL === 'nl') return `over ${d}d`;
    return `in ${d}d`;
  }

  const hasJapaneseKana = str => typeof str === 'string' && /[\u3040-\u309f\u30a0-\u30ff]/.test(str);

  /**
   * 文法・字源行 (grammar_forms) の多言語ローカライズ整形
   */
  function formatGrammarForms(raw, targetLocale = 'ja', itemLang = '') {
    if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'string') return '';
    const currentLocale = global.VocabI18n?.getLocale?.() || 'ja';
    const tL = targetLocale || (currentLocale !== 'ja' ? currentLocale : (global.App?.tgtLang || 'ja'));
    if (tL === 'ja') return raw;

    let res = raw;

    // 1. ラベル部分のローカライズ
    const rootLabels = {
      de: 'Wurzel:',
      en: 'Root:',
      fr: 'Racine :',
      es: 'Raíz:',
      it: 'Radice:',
      pt: 'Raiz:',
      nl: 'Wortel:',
      zh: '字源:',
      ko: '자원:'
    };
    const rootLbl = rootLabels[tL] || 'Root:';
    res = res.replace(/(?:^|\s|\/)字源\s*[:：]/g, match => match.replace(/字源[:：]/, rootLbl));

    const tradLabels = {
      de: 'Trad.:',
      en: 'Trad.:',
      fr: 'Trad. :',
      es: 'Trad.:',
      it: 'Trad.:',
      pt: 'Trad.:',
      nl: 'Trad.:',
      zh: '繁体:',
      ko: '번체:'
    };
    const tradLbl = tradLabels[tL] || 'Trad.:';
    res = res.replace(/(?:^|\s|\/)繁体\s*[:：]/g, match => match.replace(/繁体[:：]/, tradLbl));

    const hanjaLabels = {
      zh: '汉字:',
      ko: '한자:'
    };
    const hanjaLbl = hanjaLabels[tL] || 'Hanja:';
    res = res.replace(/(?:^|\s|\/)한자\s*[:：]/g, match => match.replace(/한자[:：]/, hanjaLbl));

    // 2. 漢字直後の日本語新字体併記の除去 (例: "經濟 (経済)" -> "經濟", "觀點 (観点)" -> "觀點", "權利 (権利)" -> "權利")
    res = res.replace(/([\u4E00-\u9FFF])\s*[\(（][\u4E00-\u9FFF]+[\)）]/g, '$1');

    // 3. 語根・字源解説の多言語辞書
    const GLOSS_MAP = {
      '見分ける・記す': {
        de: 'unterscheiden / erfassen',
        en: 'discern / record',
        fr: 'discerner / noter',
        es: 'discernir / registrar',
        it: 'distinguere / registrare',
        pt: 'discernir / registrar',
        nl: 'onderscheiden / vastleggen',
        zh: '辨识·记述',
        ko: '분별하다·기록하다'
      },
      '見分ける・心に記す': {
        de: 'unterscheiden / erfassen',
        en: 'discern / record',
        fr: 'discerner / noter',
        es: 'discernir / registrar',
        it: 'distinguere / registrare',
        pt: 'discernir / registrar',
        nl: 'onderscheiden / vastleggen',
        zh: '辨识·心记',
        ko: '분별하다·마음에 새기다'
      },
      'はかりの分銅': {
        de: 'Waagegewicht / Macht',
        en: 'scale weight / authority',
        fr: 'poids de balance / autorité',
        es: 'pesa de balanza / autoridad',
        it: 'peso della bilancia / autorità',
        pt: 'peso da balança / autoridade',
        nl: 'weegschaalgewicht / gezag',
        zh: '秤砣·权柄',
        ko: '저울추·권세'
      },
      'はかりの分銅・力': {
        de: 'Waagegewicht / Befugnis',
        en: 'scale weight / power',
        fr: 'poids de balance / pouvoir',
        es: 'pesa de balanza / poder',
        it: 'peso della bilancia / potere',
        pt: 'peso da balança / poder',
        nl: 'weegschaalgewicht / gezag',
        zh: '秤砣·权力',
        ko: '저울추·힘'
      },
      '正しく治める': {
        de: 'recht regieren / leiten',
        en: 'govern justly / rule',
        fr: 'gouverner droitement',
        es: 'gobernar con justicia',
        it: 'governare rettamente',
        pt: 'governar com justiça',
        nl: 'rechtvaardig besturen',
        zh: '正道治理',
        ko: '바르게 다스리다'
      },
      '縦糸・治める': {
        de: 'Kettfaden / ordnen',
        en: 'warp thread / manage',
        fr: 'fil de chaîne / gérer',
        es: 'hilo de urdimbre / administrar',
        it: 'ordito / amministrare',
        pt: 'fio de urdidura / administrar',
        nl: 'schering / ordenen',
        zh: '经线·治理',
        ko: '날실·다스리다'
      },
      '縦糸を通す・治める': {
        de: 'Kettfaden / ordnen',
        en: 'warp thread / manage',
        fr: 'fil de chaîne / gérer',
        es: 'hilo de urdimbre / administrar',
        it: 'ordito / amministrare',
        pt: 'fio de urdidura / administrar',
        nl: 'schering / ordenen',
        zh: '穿经线·治理',
        ko: '날실을 꿰다·다스리다'
      },
      '玉の筋目・法則': {
        de: 'Maserung des Jade / Gesetz',
        en: 'veins in jade / reason',
        fr: 'veines du jade / principe',
        es: 'vetas del jade / razón',
        it: 'venature della giada / principio',
        pt: 'veios do jade / razão',
        nl: 'aderen in jade / rede',
        zh: '玉石纹理·法则',
        ko: '옥의 결·이치'
      },
      '見渡す': {
        de: 'überblicken / betrachten',
        en: 'look broadly / observe',
        fr: 'regarder au large / observer',
        es: 'contemplar / observar',
        it: 'guardare ampiamente / osservare',
        pt: 'contemplar amplamente / observar',
        nl: 'overzien / observeren',
        zh: '广泛观察',
        ko: '넓게 보다'
      },
      '広く見極める': {
        de: 'überblicken / betrachten',
        en: 'look broadly / observe',
        fr: 'regarder au large / observer',
        es: 'contemplar / observar',
        it: 'guardare ampiamente / osservare',
        pt: 'contemplar amplamente / observar',
        nl: 'overzien / observeren',
        zh: '广泛审视',
        ko: '널리 살피다'
      },
      '立つ': {
        de: 'stehen',
        en: 'stand',
        fr: 'se tenir debout',
        es: 'estar de pie',
        it: 'stare',
        pt: 'ficar de pé',
        nl: 'staan',
        zh: '立·站立',
        ko: '서다'
      },
      'つかむ': {
        de: 'greifen / fassen',
        en: 'grasp / seize',
        fr: 'saisir',
        es: 'agarrar / captar',
        it: 'afferrare',
        pt: 'agarrar / captar',
        nl: 'grijpen',
        zh: '抓取·把握',
        ko: '잡다·파악하다'
      },
      '保つ': {
        de: 'halten / bewahren',
        en: 'hold / maintain',
        fr: 'tenir / maintenir',
        es: 'mantener / sostener',
        it: 'mantenere / sostenere',
        pt: 'manter / sustentar',
        nl: 'houden / handhaven',
        zh: '保持·维持',
        ko: '유지하다'
      },
      '運ぶ': {
        de: 'tragen / befördern',
        en: 'carry / transport',
        fr: 'porter / transporter',
        es: 'llevar / transportar',
        it: 'portare / trasportare',
        pt: 'levar / transportar',
        nl: 'dragen / vervoeren',
        zh: '运送·承担',
        ko: '나르다·운반하다'
      },
      '見る': {
        de: 'sehen / schauen',
        en: 'look / see',
        fr: 'regarder / voir',
        es: 'mirar / ver',
        it: 'guardare / vedere',
        pt: 'olhar / ver',
        nl: 'kijken / zien',
        zh: '注视·观察',
        ko: '보다'
      },
      '言う': {
        de: 'sagen / sprechen',
        en: 'say / speak',
        fr: 'dire / parler',
        es: 'decir / hablar',
        it: 'dire / parlare',
        pt: 'dizer / falar',
        nl: 'zeggen / spreken',
        zh: '诉说·言语',
        ko: '말하다'
      },
      '座る': {
        de: 'sitzen',
        en: 'sit',
        fr: 's\'asseoir',
        es: 'sentarse',
        it: 'sedere',
        pt: 'sentar-se',
        nl: 'zitten',
        zh: '就坐·居留',
        ko: '앉다'
      }
    };

    for (const [jaGloss, transObj] of Object.entries(GLOSS_MAP)) {
      if (res.includes(jaGloss)) {
        const trans = transObj[tL] || transObj.en || jaGloss;
        res = res.replace(jaGloss, trans);
      }
    }

    return res;
  }

  /**
   * 意味・語源・歴史文脈のコンパクト整形
   */
  function formatMeaningAndEty(d, targetLocale = null) {
    const raw = String(d.etymology || '').trim(), meanings = d.meanings || [];
    const tL = targetLocale || d.tgtLang || global.App?.tgtLang || 'ja';
    let hn = String(d.history_note || '').trim();
    if (tL !== 'ja') {
      const transHn = d[`history_note_${tL}`] || d.history_note_trans || (tL !== 'en' ? d.history_note_en : '');
      if (transHn) hn = transHn;
    }
    const histDigest = hn ? (hn.startsWith('（') || hn.startsWith('(') ? hn : `（${hn}）`) : '';
    let compactEty = raw.replace(/[①②③④]?\s*【[^】]+】\s*/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (tL !== 'ja') {
      const transEty = d[`etymology_${tL}`] || (tL !== 'en' ? (d.etymology_en || d.etymology_trans) : d.etymology_trans) || '';
      if (transEty) compactEty = transEty;
    }
    return { meanings, histDigest, compactEty, isLongEty: compactEty.length > 115 };
  }

  /**
   * 同語根・他言語同族語の収集
   */
  function collectEtyPeers(d, rootIndexMap = null) {
    const iL = d.lang || global.App?.lang || 'en', samePeers = new Map(), crossPeers = new Map();
    const gate = !['unknown', 'disputed'].includes(d.etymologyConfidence);
    const rMap = rootIndexMap || global.App?.rootIndexMap;
    const metaTags = (d.etymologyTags && d.etymologyTags.length) ? d.etymologyTags : (global.extractEtyTags ? global.extractEtyTags(d) : []);
    const normRootFn = global.VocabMorphology?.normRootKey || global.normRootKey || (k => k);
    const makeLkFn = global.VocabMorphology?.makeLookupKey || global.makeLookupKey || ((w, l, h) => h > 1 ? `${w}#${h}` : w);

    const chipItems = metaTags.map(t => {
      const k = normRootFn(t);
      const all = (gate && rMap) ? (rMap.get(k) || []).filter(e => !(e.lang === iL && (e.id ? e.id === d.id : e.num === d.num))) : [];
      let hasCog = false;
      all.forEach(p => {
        (p.lang === iL ? samePeers : crossPeers).set(`${p.lang}:${makeLkFn(p.word, p.lang, p.homographIndex)}`, p);
        if (p.lang !== iL) hasCog = true;
      });
      return { tag: t, key: k, count: all.length, hasCog };
    });
    return { chipItems, sameList: [...samePeers.values()], crossList: [...crossPeers.values()] };
  }

  /**
   * カード右カラム (意味、例文、歴史文脈、語根ネットワーク、タブ) のHTML構築
   */
  function buildRight(d, options = {}) {
    const rootIndexMap = options.rootIndexMap || global.App?.rootIndexMap;
    const qReg = options.queryReg || global.App?.qReg;
    const viewMode = options.viewMode || global.App?.viewMode || 'academic';

    const iL = d.lang || options.lang || global.App?.lang || 'en';
    const tL = d.tgtLang || options.tgtLang || global.App?.tgtLang || 'ja';
    const { meanings, histDigest, compactEty, isLongEty } = formatMeaningAndEty(d, tL);
    const mHtml = meanings.map((x, idx) => {
      let mText = String(x.text || '').trim();
      if (tL !== 'ja') {
        const transM = x[`text_${tL}`] || x[`meaning_${tL}`] || (tL !== 'en' ? (x.en || x.text_en) : '') || x.trans || '';
        if (transM) mText = transM;
      }
      return `<div class="pos-block"><span class="pos">${esc(x.pos)}</span><span class="m-red" data-act="reveal-mask">${hlText(mText, false, qReg)}${idx === meanings.length - 1 && histDigest ? `<span class="m-hist-note">${hlText(histDigest, false, qReg)}</span>` : ''}</span></div>`;
    }).join('');

    const CORE_BADGE_LABELS = {
      ja: 'コア',
      ko: '핵심',
      zh: '核心',
      de: 'KERN',
      fr: 'CŒUR',
      es: 'NÚCLEO',
      it: 'NUCLEO',
      pt: 'NÚCLEO',
      nl: 'KERN',
      en: 'CORE'
    };
    const coreBadgeLabel = CORE_BADGE_LABELS[tL] || CORE_BADGE_LABELS.en;

    const HIST_BADGE_LABELS = {
      ja: '歴史・文脈',
      ko: '역사·맥락',
      zh: '历史·背景',
      de: 'Kontext',
      fr: 'Histoire',
      es: 'Historia',
      it: 'Storia',
      pt: 'História',
      nl: 'Geschiedenis',
      en: 'History'
    };
    const histBadgeLabel = HIST_BADGE_LABELS[tL] || HIST_BADGE_LABELS.en;

    let coreText = String(d.core || '').trim();
    if (tL !== 'ja') {
      const transCore = d[`core_${tL}`] || (tL !== 'en' ? (d.core_en || d.core_trans) : d.core_trans) || '';
      if (transCore) coreText = transCore;
    }
    const coreHtml = coreText ? `<div class="core-box" data-act="reveal-mask"><span class="core-badge">${coreBadgeLabel}</span><span class="core-text">${hlText(coreText, false, qReg)}</span></div>` : '';

    let hn = String(d.history_note || '').trim();
    if (tL !== 'ja') {
      const transHn = d[`history_note_${tL}`] || d.history_note_trans || (tL !== 'en' ? d.history_note_en : '') || '';
      if (transHn) hn = transHn;
    }
    const histHtml = hn ? `<div class="hist-box" data-act="reveal-mask"><span class="hist-badge">${histBadgeLabel}</span><span>${hlText(hn, false, qReg)}</span></div>` : '';

    const spkFn = (txt, l, sm) => global.VocabSpeech ? global.VocabSpeech.mkSpkBtn(txt, l, sm) : '';

    let exTrans = d.example ? (d.example[`trans_${tL}`] || d.example[tL] || (tL !== 'en' ? d.example.trans_en : '') || (d.example.en && iL !== 'en' ? d.example.en : '') || d.example.trans || d.example.ja || '') : '';
    const hasEx = d.example && (d.example.foreign || exTrans);
    const CTX_TAG_LABELS = {
      ja: '文脈',
      ko: '맥락',
      zh: '语境',
      de: 'Kontext',
      fr: 'Contexte',
      es: 'Contexto',
      it: 'Contesto',
      pt: 'Contexto',
      nl: 'Context',
      en: 'Context'
    };
    const ctxTagLabel = CTX_TAG_LABELS[tL] || CTX_TAG_LABELS.en;
    const ctxHtml = d.contextSentence ? `<div class="ctx-src"><span class="ctx-tag">${ctxTagLabel}</span>${hlText(d.contextSentence, false, qReg)}</div>` : '';
    const exHtml = (hasEx || ctxHtml) ? `<div class="ex-block">${hasEx ? `<div class="ex-en">${spkFn(d.example.foreign, iL, true)}<span>${hlText(d.example.foreign, false, qReg)}</span></div><div class="ex-ja" data-act="reveal-mask">${hlText(exTrans, true, qReg)}</div>` : ''}${ctxHtml}</div>` : '';

    const phHtml = (d.phrases || []).map(x => {
      let trans = x[`trans_${tL}`] || (tL && x[tL]) || (tL !== 'en' ? x.trans_en : '') || x.trans || x.ja || '';
      return `<div class="ph-line">${spkFn(x.foreign, iL, true)}<strong>${hlText(x.foreign, false, qReg)}</strong> <span>${hlText(trans, false, qReg)}</span></div>`;
    }).join('');
    const drvHtml = (d.derivatives || []).map(x => {
      let meaning = x[`meaning_${tL}`] || (tL && x[tL]) || (tL !== 'en' ? x.meaning_en : '') || x.meaning || '';
      const trans = x[`sub_trans_${tL}`] || x.sub_trans || (tL && x[tL]) || '';
      const sub = x.sub_phrase ? `<div class="sub-p">${spkFn(x.sub_phrase, iL, true)}<span>${hlText(x.sub_phrase, false, qReg)}</span> <span>${hlText(trans, false, qReg)}</span></div>` : '';
      return `<div><div class="sub-h">${spkFn(x.word, iL, true)}<strong>${hlText(x.word, false, qReg)}</strong> <span style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--s)">${esc(fmtPho(x.phonetic))}</span><span class="pos-lbl">${esc(x.pos)}</span><span class="sub-m">${hlText(meaning, false, qReg)}</span></div>${sub}</div>`;
    }).join('');

    const safeUrl = sanitizeWiktUrl(d.wiktUrl, iL);
    const wiktLabel = tL === 'ja' ? 'Wiktionary裏付' : (tL === 'de' ? 'Wiktionary geprüft' : (tL === 'fr' ? 'Vérifié Wiktionnaire' : (tL === 'es' ? 'Verificado Wiktionary' : (tL === 'ko' ? '위키낱말사전 검증' : (tL === 'zh' ? '维基词典查证' : 'Wiktionary Verified')))));
    const wiktTitle = tL === 'ja' ? 'Wiktionaryの言語セクションおよび語源・発音資料と照合済み (CC BY-SA)' : 'Cross-referenced with Wiktionary language, etymology & pronunciation sections (CC BY-SA)';
    const wiktPill = (d.wiktGrounded && safeUrl) ? `<a class="wikt-pill" href="${esc(safeUrl)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="${esc(wiktTitle)}">${esc(wiktLabel)}</a>` : '';

    const confDict = ETY_CONF_LABELS[tL] || ETY_CONF_LABELS.en;
    const confKey = (d.etymologyConfidence && confDict[d.etymologyConfidence]) ? d.etymologyConfidence : (compactEty ? 'probable' : 'unknown');
    const confText = confDict[confKey] || confDict.probable || confKey;
    const confTitle = tL === 'ja' ? `語源の学術的確度: ${esc(confText)}` : `Etymological Confidence: ${esc(confText)}`;
    const confPill = `<span class="conf-pill ${esc(confKey)}" title="${esc(confTitle)}">${esc(confText)}</span>`;

    const reportLabel = tL === 'ja' ? '誤り報告' : (tL === 'de' ? 'Fehler melden' : (tL === 'fr' ? 'Signaler' : (tL === 'es' ? 'Reportar' : (tL === 'ko' ? '오류 신고' : (tL === 'zh' ? '纠错' : 'Report Error')))));
    const reportTitle = tL === 'ja' ? '語源の誤り・修正を報告' : 'Report etymology issue or edit';
    const reportAria = tL === 'ja' ? '語源報告' : 'Report etymology';

      return `<span class="root-chip-wrap"><span class="root-chip ${c.count ? 'has-rel' : ''} ${c.hasCog ? 'has-cog' : ''}" data-act="search-root" data-query="${esc(c.key)}" data-xlang="${c.hasCog ? '1' : '0'}" title="${esc(filterChipTitle)}">${hlText(c.tag, false, qReg)}${c.count ? `<span class="cnt ${c.hasCog ?     const sLnk = sameList.length ? `<span class="ety-lbl">${sameLbl}</span>` + sameList.map(p => `<a class="rel-link" data-act="jump" data-word="${esc(fmtPeerLabel(p))}" data-lang="${esc(p.lang)}">${esc(fmtPeerLabel(p))}</a>`).join('') : '';
    const cLnk = crossList.length ? `<span class="ety-lbl">${crossLbl}</span>` + crossList.map(p => `<a class="cog-link" data-act="jump" data-word="${esc(fmtPeerLabel(p))}" data-lang="${esc(p.lang)}"><span class="cog-l">${esc(p.lang.toUpperCase())}</span><span>${esc(fmtPeerLabel(p))}</span></a>`).join('') : '';

    const panelHist = histHtml;

    const panelEty = `${coreHtml}${etyHtml}${matrixHtml}${netHtml}${flagHtml}`;

    const fullDetailsContent = `${histHtml}${exHtml}${phHtml ? `<div class="ph-wrap">${phHtml}</div>` : ''}${drvHtml ? `<div class="d-wrap">${drvHtml}</div>` : ''}${coreHtml}${etyHtml}${matrixHtml}${netHtml}${flagHtml}`;

    const etyTabLbl = (tL === 'en' ? 'Etymology' : (tL === 'ko' ? '어원·어근' : (tL === 'zh' ? '词源·词根' : (tL === 'de' ? 'Etymologie' : (tL === 'fr' ? 'Étymologie' : (tL === 'es' ? 'Etimología' : (tL === 'it' ? 'Etimologia' : (tL === 'pt' ? 'Etimologia' : (tL === 'nl' ? 'Etymologie' : '語源・語根')))))))));
    const exTabLbl = (tL === 'en' ? 'Examples' : (tL === 'ko' ? '예문·구문' : (tL === 'zh' ? '例句·成语' : (tL === 'de' ? 'Beispiele' : (tL === 'fr' ? 'Exemples' : (tL === 'es' ? 'Ejemplos' : (tL === 'it' ? 'Esempi' : (tL === 'pt' ? 'Exemplos' : (tL === 'nl' ? 'Voorbeelden' : '例文・成句')))))))));
    const histTabLbl = (tL === 'en' ? 'History' : (tL === 'ko' ? '역사·배경' : (tL === 'zh' ? '历史·背景' : (tL === 'de' ? 'Geschichte' : (tL === 'fr' ? 'Histoire' : (tL === 'es' ? 'Historia' : (tL === 'it' ? 'Storia' : (tL === 'pt' ? 'História' : (tL === 'nl' ? 'Geschiedenis' : '歴史・背景')))))))));
    const drvTabLbl = (tL === 'en' ? 'Derivatives' : (tL === 'ko' ? '파생어' : (tL === 'zh' ? '衍生词' : (tL === 'de' ? 'Ableitungen' : (tL === 'fr' ? 'Dérivés' : (tL === 'es' ? 'Derivados' : (tL === 'it' ? 'Derivati' : (tL === 'pt' ? 'Derivados' : (tL === 'nl' ? 'Afleidingen' : '派生語')))))))));
    const allTabLbl = (tL === 'en' ? 'All' : (tL === 'ko' ? '전체' : (tL === 'zh' ? '全部' : (tL === 'de' ? 'Alle' : (tL === 'fr' ? 'Tout' : (tL === 'es' ? 'Todo' : (tL === 'it' ? 'Tutto' : (tL === 'pt' ? 'Tudo' : (tL === 'nl' ? 'Alles' : 'すべて')))))))));

    const panels = [];
    if (panelEty) panels.push({ id: 'ety', label: etyTabLbl, html: panelEty });
    if (panelEx) panels.push({ id: 'ex', label: exTabLbl, html: panelEx });
    if (panelHist) panels.push({ id: 'hist', label: histTabLbl, html: panelHist });
    if (panelDrv) panels.push({ id: 'drv', label: drvTabLbl, html: panelDrv });

    const hasMultiPanels = panels.length > 1;
    const defaultTab = panels[0]?.id || 'all';

    let accordionBodyContent = '';
    if (hasMultiPanels) {
      const tabBtns = panels.map(p => `<button type="button" class="detail-tab-btn ${p.id === defaultTab ? 'active' : ''}" role="tab" aria-selected="${p.id === defaultTab ? 'true' : 'false'}" data-act="switch-detail-tab" data-tab="${p.id}">${p.label}</button>`).join('') +
        `<button type="button" class="detail-tab-btn ${defaultTab === 'all' ? 'active' : ''}" role="tab" aria-selected="${defaultTab === 'all' ? 'true' : 'false'}" data-act="switch-detail-tab" data-tab="all">${allTabLbl}</button>`;
      const tabsBar = `<div class="detail-tabs-bar" role="tablist">${tabBtns}</div>`;
      const panelDivs = panels.map(p => `<div class="detail-panel" role="tabpanel" data-panel="${p.id}" style="display:${p.id === defaultTab ? 'block' : 'none'}">${p.html}</div>`).join('');
      accordionBodyContent = `${tabsBar}${panelDivs}`;
    } else {
      accordionBodyContent = fullDetailsContent;
    }

    const isSimple = viewMode === 'simple';
    const openAttr = isSimple ? '' : ' open';
    const activeTabObj = panels.find(p => p.id === defaultTab);
    const activeTabLabel = activeTabObj ? activeTabObj.label : (tL === 'ja' ? '詳細' : 'Details');
    const VIEWING_LABELS = {
      ja: lbl => `${lbl} を表示中`,
      ko: lbl => `${lbl} 표시 중`,
      zh: lbl => `正在查看${lbl}`,

      fr: lbl => `Affichage : ${lbl}`,
      es: lbl => `Viendo ${lbl}`,
      it: lbl => `Visualizzazione: ${lbl}`,
      pt: lbl => `Visualizando: ${lbl}`,

      en: lbl => `Viewing ${lbl}`
    };
    const viewingFn = VIEWING_LABELS[tL] || VIEWING_LABELS.en;
    const viewingLabel = viewingFn(activeTabLabel);

    const FULL_DETAILS_LABELS = {
      ja: '詳細（語源・例文・歴史）を見る',
      ko: '상세 정보(어원·예문·배경) 보기',
      zh: '查看详情（词源·例句·背景）',
      de: 'Details anzeigen (Etymologie, Beispiele)',
      fr: 'Voir les détails (étymologie, exemples)',
      es: 'Ver detalles (etimología, ejemplos)',
      it: 'Visualizza dettagli (etimologia, esempi)',
      pt: 'Ver detalhes (etimologia, exemplos)',

      en: 'View Details (Etymology, Examples, Context)'
    };
    const fullDetailsLabel = FULL_DETAILS_LABELS[tL] || FULL_DETAILS_LABELS.en;
    const initialLabel = hasMultiPanels ? viewingLabel : fullDetailsLabel;
    const accordion = fullDetailsContent ? `<details class="card-details-accordion ${isSimple ? 'is-simple-mode' : ''}"${openAttr}><summary class="card-details-sum"><span class="sum-lbl">${initialLabel}</span><span class="sum-arrow">▾</span></summary><div class="card-details-body">${accordionBodyContent}</div></details>` : '';

    const quickChips = chipsHtml ? `<div class="card-quick-chips">${chipsHtml}</div>` : '';
    return `<div class="right"><div class="m-line">${mHtml}</div>${quickChips}${accordion}</div>`;
  }

  /**
   * DOMカード要素の完全生成 (Error Boundary 保護付き)
   */
  function createCardElement(i, options = {}) {
    try {
      if (!i || typeof i !== 'object') throw new Error('無効な単語データオブジェクトです。');
      const iL = i.lang || options.lang || global.App?.lang || 'en';
      const c = document.createElement('div');
      const due = Number(i.nextReview || 0) <= Date.now();
      const makeLkFn = global.VocabMorphology?.makeLookupKey || global.makeLookupKey || ((w, l, h) => h > 1 ? `${w}#${h}` : w);

      const currentLocale = global.VocabI18n?.getLocale?.() || 'ja';
      const tL = (options.tgtLang && options.tgtLang !== 'ja')
        ? options.tgtLang
        : (currentLocale !== 'ja' ? currentLocale : (i.tgtLang || global.App?.tgtLang || 'ja'));
      c.className = 'card';
      if (typeof c.setAttribute === 'function') {
        c.setAttribute('role', 'article');
        c.setAttribute('aria-label', tL === 'ja' ? `${i.word || '単語'} の単語カード` : `Flashcard for ${i.word || 'word'}`);
      }
      c.dataset.word = makeLkFn(i.word || '', iL, i.homographIndex);
      c.dataset.rawWord = i.word || '';
      c.dataset.lang = iL;
      if (i.id) c.dataset.id = i.id;

      const homoTitle = tL === 'ja' ? `同形異義語 #${i.homographIndex}` : `Homograph #${i.homographIndex}`;
      const homoHtml = i.homographIndex > 1 ? `<span class="homo-badge" title="${esc(homoTitle)}">#${i.homographIndex}</span>` : '';
      const gender = detectGrammaticalGender(i, iL, tL);
      const genderHtml = gender ? `<span class="gender-badge ${gender.cls}" title="${esc(gender.full)}">${esc(gender.label)}</span>` : '';
      const dispGram = formatGrammarForms(i.grammar_forms, tL, iL);
      const gramHtml = dispGram ? `<div class="gram-line">${hlText(dispGram, false, options.queryReg)}</div>` : '';
      const spkFn = (txt, l) => global.VocabSpeech ? global.VocabSpeech.mkSpkBtn(txt, l) : '';
      const crossPill = options.crossLang ? `<span class="lang-pill">${esc(iL.toUpperCase())}</span>` : '';

      const catVal = i.category || '';
      const displayCat = (global.VocabI18n?.translateCategory && catVal) ? global.VocabI18n.translateCategory(catVal, currentLocale) : catVal;
      const catHtml = catVal ? `<span class="tag" data-act="filter" data-type="cat" data-val="${esc(catVal)}">${esc(displayCat)}</span>` : '';

      let displayFol = i.folder || '';
      if (currentLocale !== 'ja' && (hasJapaneseKana(displayFol) || displayFol.includes('Starter Pack') || displayFol.includes('スターターパック'))) {
        const spLabel = (global.VocabI18n?.t) ? global.VocabI18n.t('folder.starter_pack', 'Starter Pack', currentLocale) : 'Starter Pack';
        displayFol = `${iL.toUpperCase()} ${spLabel}`;
      }
      const folHtml = i.folder ? `<span class="tag" style="border-style:dashed" data-act="filter" data-type="fol" data-val="${esc(i.folder)}">${esc(displayFol)}</span>` : '';

      const editTitle = currentLocale === 'ja' ? 'カードを編集' : 'Edit card';
      const editAria = currentLocale === 'ja' ? '編集' : 'Edit';
      const delTitle = currentLocale === 'ja' ? '削除' : 'Delete';
      const delAria = currentLocale === 'ja' ? '削除' : 'Delete';
      const spkTitle = currentLocale === 'ja' ? 'クリックでネイティブ発音' : 'Click to hear native pronunciation';

      c.innerHTML = `<div class="card-acts"><button type="button" class="act-icon-btn" data-act="edit" data-id="${esc(i.id)}" data-num="${i.num || 0}" data-lang="${esc(iL)}" title="${editTitle}" aria-label="${editAria}">${editSvg}</button><button type="button" class="act-icon-btn del-btn" data-act="del" data-id="${esc(i.id)}" data-num="${i.num || 0}" data-lang="${esc(iL)}" title="${delTitle}" aria-label="${delAria}">${delSvg}</button></div><div class="col-left"><div class="hw-wrap"><span class="id">#${i.num || 0}</span>${crossPill}${homoHtml}${genderHtml}<span class="hw" data-act="speak" data-text="${esc(i.word || '')}" data-lang="${esc(iL)}" title="${spkTitle}">${hlText(i.word || '', false, options.queryReg)}</span>${spkFn(i.word || '', iL)}</div>${gramHtml}<div class="tag-wrap">${catHtml}${folHtml}</div><div class="pho">${esc(fmtPho(i.phonetic))}<span class="due ${due ? 'is-due' : 'is-fut'}">${relTime(i.nextReview, currentLocale)}</span></div></div>${buildRight(i, options)}`;
      return c;
    } catch (err) {
      if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && typeof console.warn === 'function') {
        console.warn('[CardView Error Boundary] Failed to render card element:', err, i);
      }
      const errCard = document.createElement('div');
      errCard.className = 'card card-error-fallback';
      const safeId = esc(i?.id || '');
      const safeWord = esc(i?.word || '名称不明');
      const safeNum = i?.num || '?';
      const safeLang = esc(i?.lang || options.lang || 'en');
      errCard.dataset.word = safeWord;
      if (safeId) errCard.dataset.id = safeId;
      errCard.innerHTML = `
        <div class="card-acts">
          <button type="button" class="act-icon-btn del-btn" data-act="del" data-id="${safeId}" data-num="${safeNum}" data-lang="${safeLang}" title="破損カードを削除" aria-label="削除">${delSvg}</button>
        </div>
        <div style="grid-column:1/-1;padding:12px 14px;background:rgba(239,68,68,0.08);border:1px dashed var(--r);border-radius:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px">
          <div>
            <div style="font-weight:700;color:var(--r);font-size:12.5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M10.29 3.86L1.82 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.71 3h16.94a2 2 0 0 0 1.71-3L13.71 3.86a2 2 0 0 0-3.42 0z"/><line x1="12" y1="9" x2="12" y2="13"/><line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"/></svg>
              <span>カード表示エラー (#${safeNum}: ${safeWord})</span>
            </div>
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--s);margin-top:2px">データの構文解釈中にエラーが発生しました（${esc(err.message)}）。他のカードは安全に保持されています。</div>
          </div>
          <button type="button" class="btn-xs btn-o" data-act="edit" data-id="${safeId}" data-num="${safeNum}" data-lang="${safeLang}" style="white-space:nowrap">編集・修復</button>
        </div>
      `;
      return errCard;
    }
  }

  /**
   * スクロールコンテナ内における要素の累積Y絶対座標（scrollTop非依存）を算出
   */
  function getElementTopInContainer(el, container) {
    if (!el || !container) return 0;
    let offset = 0;
    let curr = el;
    let found = false;
    while (curr && curr !== container) {
      offset += (curr.offsetTop || 0);
      curr = curr.offsetParent;
      if (curr === container) {
        found = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (found) {
      return offset;
    }
    // offsetParentチェーンに container が含まれなかった場合（position設定差等）の安全フォールバック
    if (typeof el.getBoundingClientRect === 'function' && typeof container.getBoundingClientRect === 'function') {
      const eRect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      const cRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
      return (eRect.top - cRect.top) + (container.scrollTop || 0);
    }
    return el.offsetTop || 0;
  }

  /**
   * 対象カード要素を画面サイズ・レスポンシブ配置に応じて適切にスクロールし、発光ハイライトを付与
   * 画面サイズが異なる場合（モバイル、タブレット、小型/大型PC）や、仮想キーボード・サイドバー開閉等の
   * 動的レイアウト変化後でも確実にターゲット単語を可視領域内に収める堅牢設計
   */
  function scrollToCard(el, container = null, options = {}) {
    if (!el) return;
    const scrollContainer = container || (typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.getElementById('mainScroll') : null);
    const behavior = options.immediate ? 'auto' : 'smooth';

    function performScroll(smooth = true) {
      if (!el) return;
      if (scrollContainer) {
        const cHeight = scrollContainer.clientHeight || (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.innerHeight : 600);
        const eHeight = el.offsetHeight || el.clientHeight || 100;
        const elementTop = getElementTopInContainer(el, scrollContainer);

        const isMobile = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth <= 768;
        const topSafeOffset = isMobile ? 24 : 16;

        let targetScrollTop;
        // カードの高さが表示領域の60%を超える場合、またはモバイル画面の場合は、
        // 中央揃えだと見出し語が上部に隠れたり切れたりするため、上部安全余白を空けて上揃え配置
        if (eHeight >= cHeight * 0.6 || isMobile) {
          targetScrollTop = elementTop - topSafeOffset;
        } else {
          // デスクトップで通常カードの場合は視認性の高い中央揃え
          targetScrollTop = elementTop - (cHeight / 2) + (eHeight / 2);
        }

        const safeTop = Math.max(0, targetScrollTop);
        try {
          scrollContainer.scrollTo?.({ top: safeTop, behavior: smooth ? 'smooth' : 'auto' });
        } catch {
          scrollContainer.scrollTop = safeTop;
        }
      } else if (typeof el.scrollIntoView === 'function') {
        try {
          el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: smooth ? 'smooth' : 'auto', block: 'center' });
        } catch {
          el.scrollIntoView();
        }
      }
    }

    // 第1フェーズ: 即時/指定アニメーション実行
    performScroll(behavior === 'smooth');

    // 第2フェーズ: DOM reflow および サイドバー開閉(280ms)・仮想キーボード(300ms)後の位置ずれを自動補正
    if (!options.skipRetry) {
      if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function') {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => performScroll(behavior === 'smooth'));
      }
      setTimeout(() => performScroll(true), 80);
      setTimeout(() => performScroll(false), 320);
    }

    el.classList?.add?.('highlight-jump');
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('#list .card')];
      const cIdx = cards.indexOf(el);
      if (cIdx >= 0 && global.App) global.App.focusedCardIndex = cIdx;
    }
    setTimeout(() => el.classList?.remove?.('highlight-jump'), 2000);
  }

  /**
   * DOM上のカード一覧から指定単語の要素を特定（キー・生単語・見出し語・IDの多重照合）
   */
  function findCardElement(cards, targetWord, targetLk, baseTargetLk, targetId = null) {
    if (!Array.isArray(cards) || !cards.length) return null;
    if (targetId) {
      const byId = cards.find(c => c && c.dataset && c.dataset.id === targetId);
      if (byId) return byId;
    }
    const cleanW = (targetWord || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    return cards.find(c => c.dataset.word === targetLk)
      || cards.find(c => c.dataset.word === baseTargetLk)
      || cards.find(c => c.dataset.rawWord?.trim()?.toLowerCase() === cleanW)
      || cards.find(c => c.querySelector('.hw')?.textContent?.trim()?.toLowerCase() === cleanW)
      || null;
  }

  // --- グローバルエクスポート ---
  global.VocabCardView = {
    detectGrammaticalGender,
    highlightPlain,
    hlText,
    relTime,
    formatMeaningAndEty,
    formatGrammarForms,
    collectEtyPeers,
    buildRight,
    createCardElement,
    scrollToCard,
    findCardElement
  };
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);

/**

 * Master Facade integrating Layout, Renderer & Views Engines
 * 4-Tier Lineage Skill Tree, Celestial Physics, Viewport Culling & Deep Inspector
 */
(function (global) {
  'use strict';

  // Sub-modules references
  const Layout = () => global.VocabGraphLayout || {};
  const Renderer = () => global.VocabGraphRenderer || {};
  const Views = () => global.VocabGraphViews || {};

  const cleanRootKey = k => (Layout().cleanRootKey ? Layout().cleanRootKey(k) : String(k || '').replace(/^\*/, '').replace(/-$/, ''));
  const extractBranchInfo = (item, rk, l) => (Layout().extractBranchInfo ? Layout().extractBranchInfo(item, rk, l) : 'General');
  const computeOffThreadPositions = (n, e, iter) => (Layout().computeOffThreadPositions ? Layout().computeOffThreadPositions(n, e, iter) : n);
  const getRootMeaning = (rk, cw) => (Layout().getRootMeaning ? Layout().getRootMeaning(rk, cw) : '');

  let graphState = {
    canvas: null,
    ctx: null,
    nodes: [],
    edges: [],
    width: 800,
    height: 600,
    zoom: 1,
    panX: 0,
    panY: 0,
    isDragging: false,
    dragNode: null,
    dragStartX: 0,
    dragStartY: 0,
    dragMoved: false,
    hoverNode: null,
    selectedNode: null,
    filterQuery: '',
    langFilter: 'all',
    familyFilter: 'all',
    colorMode: 'language', // 'language' | 'retention'
    layoutMode: 'network', // 'network' | 'tree' (4階層系統樹)
    activeViewTab: 'mindmap', // 'mindmap' | 'matrix'
    focusedRootKey: '', // 1語根フォーカスモードで選択中の語根 (例: '*sta-')
    microTreeFocus: false, // 1語根マイクロツリー集中モード (ワーキングメモリ認知負荷低減)
    treeMaskMode: false, // 赤シート (Mask) モード
    timelineEra: 3, // 0: 印欧祖語, 1: 古代ギリシャ・ローマ, 2: 中世古仏・ノルマン, 3: 近代・現代 (すべて)
    treeEasingFrame: 0,
    treeEasingTimer: null,
    collapsedBranches: new Set(),
    collapsedRoots: new Set(),
    myWordsOnly: false,
    clusterOnly: false,
    physicsPaused: false,
    animId: null,
    isSleeping: true,
    touchDist: 0,
    eikenSkillMode: false,
    unlockParticles: []
  };
  if (global._sharedGraphState) {
    Object.assign(graphState, global._sharedGraphState);
  }
  function pruneUnlockParticles() {
    const arr = graphState.unlockParticles;
    if (!Array.isArray(arr) || !arr.length) return;
    const now = Date.now();
    for (let i = arr.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (!arr[i].__bornAt || (now - arr[i].__bornAt) > 3000) {
        arr.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * スキル習得・覚醒時のRPGファンファーレWeb Audioシンセチャイム（ゼロ外部依存）
   */
  function playSkillUnlockSound() {
    try {
      const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (!AudioCtx) return;
      const ctx = new AudioCtx();
      if (ctx.state === 'suspended') {
        ctx.resume();
      }
      const now = ctx.currentTime;
      const notes = [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.50]; // C5 -> E5 -> G5 -> C6 (RPG Fanfare)
      notes.forEach((freq, idx) => {
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = ctx.createGain();
        osc.type = 'triangle';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now + idx * 0.08);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.16, now + idx * 0.08);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + idx * 0.08 + 0.32);
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(ctx.destination);
        osc.start(now + idx * 0.08);
        osc.stop(now + idx * 0.08 + 0.32);
      });
      setTimeout(() => {
        try { ctx.close(); } catch (e) {}
      }, 800);
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  // 学術語根・派生形の正規化エイリアスマップ（VocabGraphLayout 側をSSOTとして参照）
  const CANONICAL_ROOT_ALIASES = (function() {
    return (typeof global !== 'undefined' && global.VocabGraphLayout?.CANONICAL_ROOT_ALIASES) || {};
  })();


  function buildGraphData(filterRootKey = '', clusterOnly = false, langFilter = 'all') {
    if (Layout().buildGraphData) {
      return Layout().buildGraphData(filterRootKey, clusterOnly, langFilter, graphState);
    }
    return { nodes: [], edges: [] };
  }

  function drawGraph() {
    if (Renderer().drawGraph) {
      Renderer().drawGraph(graphState);
    }
  }

  function invalidateTreeBgCache() {
    if (Renderer().invalidateTreeBgCache) Renderer().invalidateTreeBgCache();
  }

  function renderMindmap() {
    if (Views().renderMindmap) Views().renderMindmap(graphState);
  }

  function renderMorphologyMatrix() {
    if (Views().renderMorphologyMatrix) Views().renderMorphologyMatrix(graphState);
  }

  function promptMatrixGen(prefix, rootKey) {
    if (Views().promptMatrixGen) Views().promptMatrixGen(prefix, rootKey);
  }

  function populateRootJumpSelect(roots) {
    if (Views().populateRootJumpSelect) Views().populateRootJumpSelect(roots);
  }

  function updateBreadcrumbUI(roots) {
    if (Views().updateBreadcrumbUI) Views().updateBreadcrumbUI(roots);
  }

  function renderDetailDrawer(node) {
    if (Views().renderDetailDrawer) Views().renderDetailDrawer(node, graphState);
  }

  function unlockCurrentRootEikenWords() {
    if (Views().unlockCurrentRootEikenWords) Views().unlockCurrentRootEikenWords(graphState);
  }

  function toggleEikenExplorer(forceState) {
    if (Views().toggleEikenExplorer) Views().toggleEikenExplorer(forceState);
  }

  function renderEikenExplorer() {
    if (Views().renderEikenExplorer) Views().renderEikenExplorer(graphState);
  }

  function adoptGhostBud(budWord, rootLabel) {
    if (Views().adoptGhostBud) return Views().adoptGhostBud(budWord, rootLabel);
    return null;
  }

  function exportGraphImage() {
    // 1200x630 (X/Twitter OGP最適サイズ) のオフスクリーンキャンバスを生成
    // VOCAB VAULT — ETYMOLOGY LINEAGE TREE
    if (Views().exportGraphImage) {
      return Views().exportGraphImage(graphState);
    }
  }
  function clearRootFocus() {
    graphState.focusedRootKey = '';
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      const sel = document.getElementById('graphRootJumpSel');
      if (sel) sel.value = '';
    }
    updateGraphDataAndFit();
    if (graphState.layoutMode === 'tree') startTreeEasingAnimation();
    if (graphState.activeViewTab === 'mindmap') renderMindmap();
    if (graphState.activeViewTab === 'matrix') renderMorphologyMatrix();
  }

  /**
   * 特定語根へフォーカス
   */
  function focusRoot(rootKey) {
    graphState.focusedRootKey = cleanRootKey(rootKey);
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      const sel = document.getElementById('graphRootJumpSel');
      if (sel) sel.value = graphState.focusedRootKey;
    }
    updateGraphDataAndFit();
    if (graphState.layoutMode === 'tree') startTreeEasingAnimation();
    if (graphState.activeViewTab === 'mindmap') renderMindmap();
    if (graphState.activeViewTab === 'matrix') renderMorphologyMatrix();
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 1. UIの段階的開示を管理する状態遷移マネージャー (State Pattern)
  // =========================================================================
  class GraphUIManager {
    constructor() {
      // モードごとの可視コントロール定義（マインドマップ & 接頭辞マトリクスに最適化）
      this.modeConfig = {
        network: ['searchBox', 'langFilter', 'rootJump', 'colorModeBtn', 'clusterBtn', 'physicsBtn', 'wateringBtn', 'maskBtn', 'microTreeBtn'],
        tree: ['searchBox', 'langFilter', 'rootJump', 'skillTreeBtn', 'wateringBtn', 'maskBtn', 'microTreeBtn'],
        mindmap: ['searchBox', 'langFilter', 'rootJump', 'wateringBtn', 'maskBtn', 'microTreeBtn'],
        matrix: ['searchBox', 'langFilter', 'rootJump', 'wateringBtn', 'maskBtn']
      };
    }

    getControls() {
      if (typeof document === 'undefined') return {};
      return {
        searchBox: document.getElementById('graphFilterInput'),
        langFilter: document.getElementById('graphLangFilterSel'),
        rootJump: document.getElementById('graphRootJumpSel'),
        treeModeBtn: document.getElementById('graphTreeModeBtn'),
        skillTreeBtn: document.getElementById('graphEikenExplorerBtn'),
        colorModeBtn: document.getElementById('graphColorModeBtn'),
        clusterBtn: document.getElementById('graphClusterFilterBtn'),
        physicsBtn: document.getElementById('graphPhysicsBtn'),
        wateringBtn: document.getElementById('graphWateringBtn'),
        maskBtn: document.getElementById('graphTreeMaskBtn'),
        microTreeBtn: document.getElementById('graphMicroTreeBtn'),
        zoomControls: document.getElementById('graphZoomWrap') || document.getElementById('graphZoomVal')?.parentElement,
        fitBtn: document.getElementById('graphFitBtn') || document.querySelector('button[onclick*="fitGraphToView"]'),
        resetZoomBtn: document.getElementById('graphResetZoomBtn') || document.querySelector('button[onclick*="resetGraphZoom"]'),
        exportBtn: document.getElementById('graphExportBtn') || document.querySelector('button[onclick*="exportGraphImage"]')
      };
    }

    /**
     * モード変更時に不要なUIを隠蔽し、認知的過負荷を防ぐ
     * @param {string} mode - 'network', 'tree', 'mindmap', 'matrix'
     */
    applyMode(mode) {
      if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
      const targetConfig = this.modeConfig[mode] || this.modeConfig.network;
      const visibleSet = new Set(targetConfig);
      const controls = this.getControls();

      for (const [key, element] of Object.entries(controls)) {
        if (!element) continue;
        element.style.display = visibleSet.has(key) ? '' : 'none';
      }
      // タブ（graphTabTree）と機能重複する旧単体ボタンは常時非表示
      if (controls.treeModeBtn) controls.treeModeBtn.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 2. 空間ハッシュによる高速ビューポートカリング描画クラス
  // =========================================================================
  class SpatialCullingRenderer {
    constructor(cellSize = 150) {
      this.cellSize = cellSize;
      this.grid = new Map();
    }

    /**
     * 毎フレームの更新時にノードを空間グリッドに登録する
     * @param {Array} nodes - 描画対象の全ノード
     */
    buildGrid(nodes) {
      this.grid.clear();
      for (let i = 0; i < (nodes || []).length; i++) {
        const n = nodes[i];
        if (!n || !Number.isFinite(n.x) || !Number.isFinite(n.y)) continue;

        const col = Math.floor(n.x / this.cellSize);
        const row = Math.floor(n.y / this.cellSize);
        const key = `${col},${row}`;

        let cell = this.grid.get(key);
        if (!cell) {
          cell = [];
          this.grid.set(key, cell);
        }
        cell.push(n);
      }
    }

    /**
     * ビューポート内に存在するノードのみを抽出する O(K)
     * @param {number} viewLeft
     * @param {number} viewTop
     * @param {number} viewRight
     * @param {number} viewBottom
     * @returns {Array} 画面内に存在するノードの配列
     */
    getVisibleNodes(viewLeft, viewTop, viewRight, viewBottom) {
      const visibleNodes = [];
      const seen = new Set();
      const startCol = Math.floor(viewLeft / this.cellSize);
      const endCol = Math.floor(viewRight / this.cellSize);
      const startRow = Math.floor(viewTop / this.cellSize);
      const endRow = Math.floor(viewBottom / this.cellSize);

      for (let c = startCol; c <= endCol; c++) {
        for (let r = startRow; r <= endRow; r++) {
          const cell = this.grid.get(`${c},${r}`);
          if (cell) {
            for (let i = 0; i < cell.length; i++) {
              const n = cell[i];
              if (seen.has(n)) continue;
              // 境界値の厳密な判定（半径分のバッファを考慮）
              const buffer = n.radius || 10;
              if (n.x + buffer >= viewLeft && n.x - buffer <= viewRight &&
                  n.y + buffer >= viewTop && n.y - buffer <= viewBottom) {
                seen.add(n);
                visibleNodes.push(n);
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
      return visibleNodes;
    }
  }

  const graphUIManager = new GraphUIManager();
  const spatialCullingRenderer = new SpatialCullingRenderer(150);

  /**
   * 4つの実用ビューモード切り替え (ネットワーク / 系統樹ツリー / マインドマップ / 接頭辞×語根)
   */
  function switchViewMode(mode) {
    if (mode === 'tree') {
      graphState.layoutMode = 'tree';
      graphState.physicsPaused = true;
    } else if (mode === 'network') {
      graphState.layoutMode = 'network';
      graphState.physicsPaused = false;
    }

    // ネットワークとツリーのUIは廃止し、マインドマップと接頭辞マトリクスに特化
    const targetTab = (mode === 'matrix') ? 'matrix' : 'mindmap';
    graphState.activeViewTab = targetTab;

    if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      graphUIManager.applyMode(targetTab);

      const tabMindmap = document.getElementById('graphTabMindmap');
      const tabMatrix = document.getElementById('graphTabMatrix');
      if (tabMindmap) tabMindmap.classList.toggle('active', targetTab === 'mindmap');
      if (tabMatrix) tabMatrix.classList.toggle('active', targetTab === 'matrix');

      const canvasWrap = document.getElementById('graphCanvasWrap');
      const mindmapWrap = document.getElementById('graphMindmapWrap');
      const matrixWrap = document.getElementById('graphMatrixWrap');
      const bcBar = document.getElementById('graphTreeBreadcrumbBar');
      const timelineBar = document.getElementById('graphTimelineBar');

      if (canvasWrap) canvasWrap.style.display = 'none';
      if (timelineBar) timelineBar.style.display = 'none';

      if (targetTab === 'mindmap') {
        if (mindmapWrap) mindmapWrap.style.display = 'block';
        if (matrixWrap) matrixWrap.style.display = 'none';
        if (bcBar) bcBar.style.display = 'flex';
        renderMindmap();
      } else {
        if (mindmapWrap) mindmapWrap.style.display = 'none';
        if (matrixWrap) matrixWrap.style.display = 'block';
        if (bcBar) bcBar.style.display = 'none';
        renderMorphologyMatrix();
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * 放射状スキルツリー: 中心から外側へブワッと広がりピタッと静止するイージングアニメーション (easeOutBack)
   */
  function startTreeEasingAnimation() {
    if (graphState.animId) cancelAnimationFrame(graphState.animId);
    if (graphState.treeEasingTimer) cancelAnimationFrame(graphState.treeEasingTimer);

    const nodes = graphState.nodes;
    if (!nodes || !nodes.length) return;

    // 各ノードの親語根の中心を基準に、極座標の放射状アニメーション開始位置を設定
    const fallbackRoot = nodes.find(n => n.type === 'root') || { targetX: 0, targetY: 0 };

    nodes.forEach(n => {
      if (n.type === 'root') {
        n.startX = (n.x !== undefined && Number.isFinite(n.x)) ? n.x : (n.targetX || 0);
        n.startY = (n.y !== undefined && Number.isFinite(n.y)) ? n.y : (n.targetY || 0);
      } else {
        const pRoot = (n.rootLabel ? nodes.find(r => r.type === 'root' && r.label === n.rootLabel) : null) || fallbackRoot;
        const rcx = pRoot.targetX || 0;
        const rcy = pRoot.targetY || 0;
        const tx = n.targetX !== undefined ? n.targetX : 0;
        const ty = n.targetY !== undefined ? n.targetY : 0;
        const angle = Math.atan2(ty - rcy, tx - rcx);
        // 中心から微小半径 (r0 = 12) でブワッと放射状に噴出
        n.startX = rcx + Math.cos(angle) * 12;
        n.startY = rcy + Math.sin(angle) * 12;
        n.x = n.startX;
        n.y = n.startY;
      }
    });

    let frame = 0;
    const maxFrames = 22; // 約360ms (60fps)

    function easeStep() {
      frame++;
      const t = frame / maxFrames;
      // easeOutBack: 勢いよく広がりわずかにオーバーシュートしてピタッと静止
      const c1 = 0.70;
      const c3 = c1 + 1;
      const inv = t - 1;
      const progress = 1 + c3 * inv * inv * inv + c1 * inv * inv;

      nodes.forEach(n => {
        if (n.targetX !== undefined && n.targetY !== undefined) {
          n.x = n.startX + (n.targetX - n.startX) * progress;
          n.y = n.startY + (n.targetY - n.startY) * progress;
          n.vx = 0;
          n.vy = 0;
        }
      });

      drawGraph();

      if (frame < maxFrames) {
        graphState.treeEasingTimer = requestAnimationFrame(easeStep);
      } else {
        // イージング完了: 目標確定座標に一致させ、完全静止
        nodes.forEach(n => {
          if (n.targetX !== undefined && n.targetY !== undefined) {
            n.x = n.targetX;
            n.y = n.targetY;
            n.vx = 0;
            n.vy = 0;
          }
        });
        graphState.isSleeping = true;
        graphState.physicsPaused = true;
        drawGraph();
      }
    }

    graphState.treeEasingTimer = requestAnimationFrame(easeStep);
  }

  /**
   * アイデア①: 枯れ枝の一括水やり復習 (Branch Targeted Review)
   * FSRS想起率 R < 0.85 または期日到来の赤・黄色の単語をまとめてAnki復習
   */
  function startWateringReview() {
    const nodes = graphState.nodes || [];
    const now = Date.now();
    let words = [];

    // 現在フォーカスされている語根の単語、または全単語から要復習単語を抽出
    const targetWords = nodes.filter(n => n.type === 'word' && n.item).map(n => n.item);
    if (!targetWords.length) {
      const toastFn = global.showToast || global.VocabCore?.showToast;
      if (typeof toastFn === 'function') toastFn('復習対象の単語が見つかりませんでした。', 'info');
      return;
    }

    // FSRS想起率 R < 0.85 または期日到来の単語（要水やり単語）
    const dueOrWeakWords = targetWords.filter(item => {
      const r = global.VocabSRS?.getRetrievability ? global.VocabSRS.getRetrievability(item, now) : 0.7;
      const isDue = (item.nextReview || 0) <= now;
      return isDue || r < 0.85;
    });

    const finalReviewList = dueOrWeakWords.length > 0 ? dueOrWeakWords : targetWords;

    const toggleModalFn = global.toggleModal || global.VocabCore?.toggleModal;
    if (typeof toggleModalFn === 'function') toggleModalFn('graphModal', false);

    const startAnkiFn = global.startAnki || global.VocabCore?.startAnki;
    if (typeof startAnkiFn === 'function') {
      startAnkiFn(finalReviewList);
      const toastFn = global.showToast || global.VocabCore?.showToast;
      if (typeof toastFn === 'function') {
        const rootName = graphState.focusedRootKey ? `語根「${graphState.focusedRootKey}」の` : '';
        toastFn(`${rootName}要復習単語（全${finalReviewList.length}語）で水やり復習を開始しました！`, 'ok', 4000);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * 能動的想起テスト (Active Recall Mode) のトグル
   */
  function toggleTreeMask() {
    graphState.treeMaskMode = !graphState.treeMaskMode;
    const btn = document.getElementById('graphTreeMaskBtn');
    if (btn) {
      btn.textContent = graphState.treeMaskMode ? '想起テスト:ON' : '想起テスト:OFF';
      btn.classList.toggle('active', graphState.treeMaskMode);
    }
    drawGraph();
    if (graphState.activeViewTab === 'mindmap') renderMindmap();
    if (graphState.activeViewTab === 'matrix') renderMorphologyMatrix();
    if (graphState.selectedNode) renderDetailDrawer(graphState.selectedNode);
    const toastFn = global.showToast || global.VocabCore?.showToast;
    if (typeof toastFn === 'function') {
      toastFn(graphState.treeMaskMode ? '想起テストモードをONにしました。意味を伏せて想起テストができます。' : '想起テストモードをOFFにしました。', 'info', 2500);
    }
  }

  /**
   * 想起テスト: 伏せられた意味・語源を開示
   */
  function revealRecallAnswer() {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
    const maskBox = document.getElementById('graphRecallMaskContainer');
    const content = document.getElementById('graphRecallContent');
    const ratingBar = document.getElementById('graphRecallRatingBar');
    if (maskBox) maskBox.style.display = 'none';
    if (content) content.style.display = 'block';
    if (ratingBar) ratingBar.style.display = 'flex';
  }

  /**
   * 1語根マイクロツリー集中モード (ワーキングメモリ負荷低減)
   */
  function toggleMicroTreeFocus() {
    graphState.microTreeFocus = !graphState.microTreeFocus;
    const btn = document.getElementById('graphMicroTreeBtn');
    if (btn) {
      btn.textContent = graphState.microTreeFocus ? '1語根集中:ON' : '1語根集中:OFF';
      btn.classList.toggle('active', graphState.microTreeFocus);
    }
    if (graphState.microTreeFocus) {
      if (!graphState.focusedRootKey) {
        const rootNodes = (graphState.allRoots && graphState.allRoots.length > 0)
          ? graphState.allRoots
          : (graphState.nodes || []).filter(n => n.type === 'root');
        const sorted = [...rootNodes].sort((a, b) => (b.childCount || 0) - (a.childCount || 0));
        const top = sorted[0];
        if (top) {
          focusRoot(top.label);
        } else {
          updateGraphDataAndFit();
        }
      } else {
        updateGraphDataAndFit();
      }
    } else {
      graphState.focusedRootKey = '';
      if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
        const sel = document.getElementById('graphRootJumpSel');
        if (sel) sel.value = '';
      }
      updateGraphDataAndFit();
    }
    const toastFn = global.showToast || global.VocabCore?.showToast;
    if (typeof toastFn === 'function') {
      toastFn(graphState.microTreeFocus
        ? `1語根集中モードをONにしました (${graphState.focusedRootKey || '語根'}に絞り込み、認知負荷を低減)`
        : '1語根集中モードをOFFにしました (全系統樹を表示)', 'info', 2500);
    }
  }

  function getRootSequence() {
    if (Array.isArray(graphState.allRoots) && graphState.allRoots.length > 0) {
      return graphState.allRoots;
    }
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      const sel = document.getElementById('graphRootJumpSel');
      if (sel && sel.options && sel.options.length > 1) {
        const list = [];
        for (let i = 1; i < sel.options.length; i++) {
          if (sel.options[i].value) {
            list.push({ label: sel.options[i].value, childCount: 0 });
          }
        }
        if (list.length > 0) return list;
      }
    }
    return (graphState.nodes || []).filter(n => n.type === 'root');
  }

  /**
   * 次の語根へ順次ナビゲーション (Wキー)
   */
  function nextRoot() {
    const list = getRootSequence();
    if (!list.length) return;
    const curKey = graphState.focusedRootKey;
    let idx = list.findIndex(r => r.label === curKey);
    let nextIdx = (idx + 1) % list.length;
    const nextR = list[nextIdx];
    if (nextR) {
      focusRoot(nextR.label);
      const rootNode = (graphState.nodes || []).find(n => n.type === 'root' && n.label === nextR.label);
      if (rootNode) {
        selectNode(rootNode, false);
        centerOnNode(rootNode, 1.1, true);
      }
      const toastFn = global.showToast || global.VocabCore?.showToast;
      if (typeof toastFn === 'function') {
        toastFn(`次の語根: ${nextR.label}${nextR.childCount ? ` (${nextR.childCount}語)` : ''}`, 'info', 1500);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * 前の語根へ順次ナビゲーション (Qキー)
   */
  function prevRoot() {
    const list = getRootSequence();
    if (!list.length) return;
    const curKey = graphState.focusedRootKey;
    let idx = list.findIndex(r => r.label === curKey);
    if (idx === -1) idx = 0;
    let prevIdx = (idx - 1 + list.length) % list.length;
    const prevR = list[prevIdx];
    if (prevR) {
      focusRoot(prevR.label);
      const rootNode = (graphState.nodes || []).find(n => n.type === 'root' && n.label === prevR.label);
      if (rootNode) {
        selectNode(rootNode, false);
        centerOnNode(rootNode, 1.1, true);
      }
      const toastFn = global.showToast || global.VocabCore?.showToast;
      if (typeof toastFn === 'function') {
        toastFn(`前の語根: ${prevR.label}${prevR.childCount ? ` (${prevR.childCount}語)` : ''}`, 'info', 1500);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * 同一語根クラスタ内の次の単語へオートジャンプ
   */
  function jumpToNextWordInCluster(currentNode) {
    if (!currentNode) return;
    const rNode = (currentNode.connectedRoots && currentNode.connectedRoots[0]) ||
                  (graphState.nodes || []).find(n => n.type === 'root' && (n.connectedWords || []).includes(currentNode));
    let peerWords = [];
    if (rNode && Array.isArray(rNode.connectedWords) && rNode.connectedWords.length > 0) {
      peerWords = rNode.connectedWords.filter(w => w.type === 'word');
    } else {
      peerWords = (graphState.nodes || []).filter(n => n.type === 'word');
    }

    if (!peerWords.length) return;
    const curIdx = peerWords.indexOf(currentNode);
    const nextIdx = (curIdx + 1) % peerWords.length;
    const nextWord = peerWords[nextIdx];

    if (nextWord && nextWord !== currentNode) {
      selectNode(nextWord, false);
      centerOnNode(nextWord, 1.2, true);
    }
  }

  /**
   * 単語ノードに対する想起度(FSRS/SM-2)評価実行
   */
  function rateNodeWord(rating, targetNode = null) {
    const node = targetNode || graphState.selectedNode;
    if (!node || node.type !== 'word') return;

    if (global.VocabSRS?.triggerHaptic) {
      global.VocabSRS.triggerHaptic(rating === 0 ? 'again' : rating === 1 ? 'light' : rating === 2 ? 'good' : 'easy');
    }

    const app = global.VocabCore?.App || global.App;
    const lang = node.lang || node.item?.lang || app?.srcLang || app?.lang || 'en';
    const tgtLang = app?.tgtLang || 'ja';
    const storageMod = global.VocabStorage;
    const pairCfg = storageMod?.getPairConfig ? storageMod.getPairConfig(lang, tgtLang) : null;
    const saveKey = pairCfg?.key || storageMod?.LANGS?.[lang]?.key || `distinction_entries${lang === 'en' ? '' : '_' + lang}`;
    const getJsonFn = global.VocabCore?.getJson || global.getJson || storageMod?.getJson;
    const setJsonFn = global.VocabCore?.setJson || global.setJson || storageMod?.setJson;

    let entries = typeof getJsonFn === 'function' ? (getJsonFn(saveKey) || []) : (storageMod?.state?.mem?.[saveKey] || []);
    let item = entries.find(e => (e.word || '').toLowerCase() === node.label.toLowerCase() && !e.isDeleted);

    if (!item && global.VocabEikenCatalog?.getWord(node.label)) {
      adoptGhostBud(node.label, node.parentRoot?.label);
      entries = typeof getJsonFn === 'function' ? (getJsonFn(saveKey) || []) : (storageMod?.state?.mem?.[saveKey] || []);
      item = entries.find(e => (e.word || '').toLowerCase() === node.label.toLowerCase() && !e.isDeleted);
    }

    const now = Date.now();
    let rLabel = '';
    if (item) {
      item.version = (Number(item.version) || 1) + 1;
      item.updatedAt = now;
      if (global.VocabSRS?.calculateNextReview) {
        const nextSRS = global.VocabSRS.calculateNextReview(item, rating);
        Object.assign(item, nextSRS, { reviewUpdatedAt: now });
      } else {
        let iv = Number(item.interval) || 0, rep = Number(item.repetition) || 0, ef = Number(item.efactor) || 2.5;
        if (rating === 0) {
          rep = 0; iv = 0; item.nextReview = now + 60000;
        } else {
          iv = rating === 1 ? Math.max(1, iv * 1.2) : (rating === 2 ? (!rep ? 1 : iv * 2.5) : (!rep ? 4 : iv * ef));
          ef = Math.max(1.3, ef + (rating === 1 ? -0.15 : rating === 3 ? 0.15 : 0));
          if (rating >= 2) rep++;
          item.nextReview = now + Math.round(iv * 86400000);
        }
        item.interval = Number(iv.toFixed(2));
        item.repetition = rep;
        item.efactor = Number(ef.toFixed(2));
        item.reviewUpdatedAt = now;
      }
      if (typeof setJsonFn === 'function') {
        setJsonFn(saveKey, entries, true, true);
      }
      node.item = item;

      const srsPredict = global.VocabSRS?.predictIntervals ? global.VocabSRS.predictIntervals(item)[rating] : null;
      const baseLabels = ['忘却', '困難', '良好', '簡単'];
      rLabel = srsPredict ? `${baseLabels[rating]} (${srsPredict})` : (['忘却 (1分後)', '困難 (1日後)', '良好 (3日後)', '簡単 (7日後)'][rating] || '復習完了');
    } else {
      rLabel = ['忘却 (1分後)', '困難 (1日後)', '良好 (3日後)', '簡単 (7日後)'][rating] || '復習完了';
    }

    const toastFn = global.showToast || global.VocabCore?.showToast;
    if (typeof toastFn === 'function') {
      toastFn(`[${node.label}] ${rLabel} として記録しました`, 'ok', 1500);
    }

    drawGraph();
    if (graphState.activeViewTab === 'mindmap') renderMindmap();
    if (graphState.activeViewTab === 'matrix') renderMorphologyMatrix();

    jumpToNextWordInCluster(node);
  }

  /**
   * 指定単語に対する想起度評価実行 (マインドマップ等からの直通呼び出し)
   */
  function rateSpecificWord(word, rating, wordLang) {
    if (!word) return;
    const cleanWord = String(word).trim().toLowerCase();
    const node = (graphState.nodes || []).find(n => n.type === 'word' && n.label.toLowerCase() === cleanWord);
    if (node) {
      rateNodeWord(rating, node);
    } else {
      const storageMod = global.VocabStorage;
      const app = global.VocabCore?.App || global.App;
      const lang = wordLang || app?.srcLang || app?.lang || 'en';
      const tgtLang = app?.tgtLang || 'ja';
      const pairCfg = storageMod?.getPairConfig ? storageMod.getPairConfig(lang, tgtLang) : null;
      const saveKey = pairCfg?.key || storageMod?.LANGS?.[lang]?.key || `distinction_entries${lang === 'en' ? '' : '_' + lang}`;
      const getJsonFn = global.VocabCore?.getJson || global.getJson || storageMod?.getJson;
      const setJsonFn = global.VocabCore?.setJson || global.setJson || storageMod?.setJson;
      const entries = typeof getJsonFn === 'function' ? (getJsonFn(saveKey) || []) : (storageMod?.state?.mem?.[saveKey] || []);
      const item = entries.find(e => (e.word || '').toLowerCase() === cleanWord && !e.isDeleted);
      if (item) {
        const now = Date.now();
        item.version = (Number(item.version) || 1) + 1;
        item.updatedAt = now;
        if (global.VocabSRS?.calculateNextReview) {
          const nextSRS = global.VocabSRS.calculateNextReview(item, rating);
          Object.assign(item, nextSRS, { reviewUpdatedAt: now });
        }
        if (typeof setJsonFn === 'function') setJsonFn(saveKey, entries, true, true);
        const srsPredict = global.VocabSRS?.predictIntervals ? global.VocabSRS.predictIntervals(item)[rating] : null;
        const baseLabels = ['忘却', '困難', '良好', '簡単'];
        const rLabel = srsPredict ? `${baseLabels[rating]} (${srsPredict})` : (['忘却 (1分後)', '困難 (1日後)', '良好 (3日後)', '簡単 (7日後)'][rating] || '復習完了');
        const toastFn = global.showToast || global.VocabCore?.showToast;
        if (typeof toastFn === 'function') {
          toastFn(`[${word}] ${rLabel} として記録しました`, 'ok', 1500);
        }
        drawGraph();
        if (graphState.activeViewTab === 'mindmap') renderMindmap();
        if (graphState.activeViewTab === 'matrix') renderMorphologyMatrix();
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * アイデア④: 語源タイムトラベル・スライダー（年代・伝播フィルター）
   */
  function onTimelineChange(val) {
    const era = parseInt(val, 10);
    graphState.timelineEra = era;
    const lbl = document.getElementById('graphTimelineLabel');
    const eraNames = [
      '印欧祖語 (紀元前3000年〜)',
      '古代ギリシャ・ローマ (紀元前500年〜)',
      '中世古仏・古英 (11〜14世紀)',
      '近代・現代 (すべて)'
    ];
    if (lbl) lbl.textContent = eraNames[era] || 'すべて';
    drawGraph();
  }

  /**
   * 語根のみ表示（クラスタモード）のトグル
   */
  function toggleGraphClusterOnly() {
    graphState.clusterOnly = !graphState.clusterOnly;
    const btn = document.getElementById('graphClusterFilterBtn');
    if (btn) btn.classList.toggle('active', graphState.clusterOnly);
    updateGraphDataAndFit();
  }

  function togglePhysics() {
    graphState.physicsPaused = !graphState.physicsPaused;
    const btn = document.getElementById('graphPhysicsBtn');
    if (btn) {
      btn.textContent = graphState.physicsPaused ? '再開' : '停止';
      btn.classList.toggle('active', graphState.physicsPaused);
    }
    if (!graphState.physicsPaused) {
      wakeGraphSimulation();
    } else {
      drawGraph();
    }
  }

  function toggleTreeMode() {
    switchViewMode(graphState.layoutMode === 'tree' ? 'network' : 'tree');
  }

  function toggleColorMode() {
    graphState.colorMode = (graphState.colorMode === 'language') ? 'retention' : 'language';
    const btn = document.getElementById('graphColorModeBtn');
    if (btn) {
      btn.textContent = graphState.colorMode === 'language' ? '言語色' : '定着度色';
      btn.classList.toggle('active', graphState.colorMode === 'retention');
    }
    updateLegendUI();
    drawGraph();
  }

  function updateLegendUI() {
    const legend = document.getElementById('graphLegend');
    if (!legend) return;
    if (graphState.colorMode === 'retention') {
      legend.innerHTML = `
        <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px"><span style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#7c3aed"></span>語根</span>
        <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px"><span style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#fb7185"></span>要復習</span>
        <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px"><span style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#60a5fa"></span>新規</span>
        <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px"><span style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#f59e0b"></span>学習中(&lt;7日)</span>
        <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px"><span style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#10b981"></span>長期定着(7日+)</span>
      `;
    } else {
      legend.innerHTML = `
        <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px"><span style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#7c3aed"></span>語根</span>
        <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px"><span style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#38bdf8"></span>英</span>
        <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px"><span style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#a78bfa"></span>仏</span>
        <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px"><span style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#fbbf24"></span>独</span>
        <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px"><span style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#fb923c"></span>西</span>
        <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px"><span style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#2dd4bf"></span>伊</span>
        <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px"><span style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#84cc16"></span>葡</span>
        <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px"><span style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#f472b6"></span>蘭</span>
        <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px"><span style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#f43f5e"></span>中</span>
        <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px"><span style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#60a5fa"></span>韓</span>
        <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px"><span style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#34d399"></span>日</span>
      `;
    }
  }

  function updateGraphDataAndFit() {
    const { nodes, edges } = buildGraphData(graphState.filterQuery, graphState.clusterOnly, graphState.langFilter);
    graphState.nodes = nodes;
    graphState.edges = edges;
    const countEl = document.getElementById('graphMetaCount');
    if (countEl) {
      countEl.textContent = `${nodes.filter(n => n.type === 'root').length} 語根 / ${nodes.filter(n => n.type === 'word').length} 単語`;
    }
    const canvasWrap = document.getElementById('graphCanvasWrap');
    const isCanvasVisible = canvasWrap && canvasWrap.style.display !== 'none';
    if (isCanvasVisible) {
      fitGraphToView();
      wakeGraphSimulation();
    }
    if (typeof renderMindmap === 'function') renderMindmap();
    if (typeof renderMorphologyMatrix === 'function') renderMorphologyMatrix();
  }

  function updateZoomDisplay() {
    const el = document.getElementById('graphZoomVal');
    if (el) el.textContent = `${Math.round(graphState.zoom * 100)}%`;
  }

  function setZoomLevel(newZoom) {
    newZoom = Math.min(3.5, Math.max(0.35, newZoom));
    const cx = (graphState.width || 800) / 2;
    const cy = (graphState.height || 600) / 2;
    const oldZoom = graphState.zoom || 1;
    graphState.panX = cx - (cx - graphState.panX) * (newZoom / oldZoom);
    graphState.panY = cy - (cy - graphState.panY) * (newZoom / oldZoom);
    graphState.zoom = newZoom;
    updateZoomDisplay();
    drawGraph();
  }

  function zoomIn() {
    setZoomLevel(graphState.zoom * 1.30);
  }

  function zoomOut() {
    setZoomLevel(graphState.zoom / 1.30);
  }

  function fitGraphToView() {
    if (!graphState.nodes || !graphState.nodes.length) return;
    syncCanvasDimensions();

    // 異常値・極端な外れ値ノードに引っ張られて極小化するのを防ぐため、外れ値を除外した堅牢なバウンディングボックスを算出
    const xs = graphState.nodes.map(n => n.x).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const ys = graphState.nodes.map(n => n.y).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const pLow = Math.floor(xs.length * 0.02);
    const pHigh = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(xs.length * 0.98) - 1);
    const minX = xs[pLow], maxX = xs[pHigh];
    const minY = ys[pLow], maxY = ys[pHigh];

    const drawer = document.getElementById('graphDetailDrawer');
    const isDrawerOpen = drawer && drawer.style.display !== 'none';
    let availableW = graphState.width || 800;
    let availableH = graphState.height || 600;
    if (isDrawerOpen) {
      if (availableW <= 768) {
        const drawerH = drawer.offsetHeight || (availableH * 0.45);
        availableH = Math.max(120, availableH - drawerH);
      } else {
        const drawerW = drawer.offsetWidth || 360;
        availableW = Math.max(200, availableW - drawerW);
      }
    }

    const pad = 38;
    const w = Math.max(120, maxX - minX);
    const h = Math.max(120, maxY - minY);
    const scaleX = (availableW - pad * 2) / w;
    const scaleY = (availableH - pad * 2) / h;
    const isTree = (graphState.layoutMode === 'tree');
    const minZ = isTree ? 0.32 : 0.50;
    const maxZ = isTree ? 1.65 : 1.35;
    const targetZoom = Math.min(Math.max(Math.min(scaleX, scaleY), minZ), maxZ);
    const centerX = isTree ? 0 : (minX + maxX) / 2;
    const centerY = isTree ? 0 : (minY + maxY) / 2;

    const { cx, cy } = getEffectiveViewportCenter();
    graphState.zoom = targetZoom;
    graphState.panX = cx - centerX * targetZoom;
    graphState.panY = cy - centerY * targetZoom;
    updateZoomDisplay();
    drawGraph();
  }

  let smoothPanZoomRaf = null;
  let momentumRaf = null;

  /**
   * カメラの滑らかなイージング補間移動 (Smooth Pan & Zoom Transition)
   */
  function smoothPanZoomTo(targetPanX, targetPanY, targetZoom, onComplete) {
    if (momentumRaf) { cancelAnimationFrame(momentumRaf); momentumRaf = null; }
    if (smoothPanZoomRaf) { cancelAnimationFrame(smoothPanZoomRaf); smoothPanZoomRaf = null; }

    const startPanX = graphState.panX;
    const startPanY = graphState.panY;
    const startZoom = graphState.zoom;
    const finalZoom = Math.min(3.5, Math.max(0.35, targetZoom));
    const totalFrames = 18;
    let frame = 0;

    function step() {
      frame++;
      const t = frame / totalFrames;
      // easeOutCubic: 指数的な減速で心地よく着地
      const ease = 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

      graphState.panX = startPanX + (targetPanX - startPanX) * ease;
      graphState.panY = startPanY + (targetPanY - startPanY) * ease;
      graphState.zoom = startZoom + (finalZoom - startZoom) * ease;
      updateZoomDisplay();
      drawGraph();

      if (frame < totalFrames) {
        smoothPanZoomRaf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
      } else {
        graphState.panX = targetPanX;
        graphState.panY = targetPanY;
        graphState.zoom = finalZoom;
        updateZoomDisplay();
        drawGraph();
        smoothPanZoomRaf = null;
        if (typeof onComplete === 'function') onComplete();
      }
    }
