    '*mey-': 'motion', '*sekw-': 'motion',
    '*weid-': 'cognition', '*men-': 'cognition', '*spec-': 'cognition', '*gno-': 'cognition',
    '*sent-': 'cognition', '*sked-': 'cognition', '*med-': 'cognition', '*kred-': 'cognition',
    '*genh₁-': 'life', '*gen-': 'life', '*bhew-': 'life', '*wed-': 'life',
    '*ters-': 'life', '*blew-': 'life', '*mer-': 'life',
    '*leg-': 'communication', '*wer-': 'communication', '*deik-': 'communication',
    '*wek-': 'communication', '*skreybh-': 'communication', '*prek-': 'communication',
    '*kap-': 'structure', '*ten-': 'structure', '*bher-': 'structure', '*dhe-': 'structure',
    '*tag-': 'structure', '*per-': 'structure', '*port-': 'structure', '*sek-': 'structure',
    '*ster-': 'structure', '*tekw-': 'structure', '*pel-': 'structure', '*clud-': 'structure', '*mit-': 'structure',
    '*reg-': 'society', '*nem-': 'society', '*lau-': 'society', '*kwel-': 'society'
  };

  function getSemanticRealmForRoot(rootKey) {
    if (!rootKey) return SEMANTIC_REALMS.structure;
    const clean = normRootKey(rootKey);
    const key = ROOT_REALM_MAP[clean] || ROOT_REALM_MAP[clean + '-'] || ROOT_REALM_MAP[clean.replace(/-$/, '')];
    if (key && SEMANTIC_REALMS[key]) return SEMANTIC_REALMS[key];
    return SEMANTIC_REALMS.structure;
  }

  /**
   * 単語から形態素語幹（Level 4: Morphological Stem）を高精度に抽出
   * 接頭辞と接尾辞に挟まれた核となる基底語幹を同定
   */
  function extractMorphologicalStem(word, rootKey = '', item = null) {
    const rawW = String(word || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!rawW) return { stem: '', label: '一般語幹', core: '' };
    const cleanR = normRootKey(rootKey);

    // 代表的PIE語根ごとの古典語幹マッピング
    if (cleanR.includes('sta')) {
      if (/stitut/.test(rawW)) return { stem: '-stitut-', label: '-stitut- (据える・制定)', core: '制度・設置' };
      if (/sist/.test(rawW)) return { stem: '-sist-', label: '-sist- (留まる・維持)', core: '静止・持続' };
      if (/stant|stanc/.test(rawW)) return { stem: '-stant-', label: '-stant- (存続・持続)', core: '実体・継続' };
      if (/stand|stund|steh/.test(rawW)) return { stem: 'stand-', label: 'stand- (立つ)', core: '直立・支持' };
      if (/stat|status|state/.test(rawW)) return { stem: 'stat-', label: 'stat- (状態・確立)', core: '地位・状態' };
      if (/stab|stabl/.test(rawW)) return { stem: 'stabl-', label: 'stabl- (安定・基礎)', core: '強固・定着' };
    } else if (cleanR.includes('gen')) {
      if (/gener|gene/.test(rawW)) return { stem: 'gene-', label: 'gene- (生成・種類)', core: '発生・血統' };
      if (/nat|gna|nature/.test(rawW)) return { stem: 'nat-', label: 'nat- (生まれ・本性)', core: '自然・出生' };
      if (/kin|kind/.test(rawW)) return { stem: 'kin-', label: 'kin- (親族・同種)', core: '親族・親切' };
    } else if (cleanR.includes('bher')) {
      if (/fer/.test(rawW)) return { stem: '-fer-', label: '-fer- (運ぶ・差し出す)', core: '運搬・提示' };
      if (/bear|birth|burden/.test(rawW)) return { stem: 'bear-', label: 'bear- (耐える・生む)', core: '担う・出産' };
    } else if (cleanR.includes('kap')) {
      if (/ceiv|cept/.test(rawW)) return { stem: '-cept-', label: '-cept- (受容・把握)', core: '認識・捕捉' };
      if (/cap|capt/.test(rawW)) return { stem: 'cap-', label: 'cap- (能力・捕獲)', core: '器量・把持' };
    } else if (cleanR.includes('ten')) {
      if (/tain/.test(rawW)) return { stem: '-tain-', label: '-tain- (維持・保持)', core: '保全・所有' };
      if (/tend|tens|tent/.test(rawW)) return { stem: '-tens-', label: '-tens- (伸長・緊張)', core: '拡張・意図' };
    } else if (cleanR.includes('dhe')) {
      if (/pos|posit/.test(rawW)) return { stem: '-pose-', label: '-pose- (配置・提示)', core: '設置・構え' };
      if (/fect|fic|fact/.test(rawW)) return { stem: '-fic-', label: '-fic- (形成・効果)', core: '成果・作用' };
    } else if (cleanR.includes('leg')) {
      if (/lect/.test(rawW)) return { stem: '-lect-', label: '-lect- (収集・選抜)', core: '選択・読み' };
      if (/log/.test(rawW)) return { stem: '-log-', label: '-log- (論理・対話)', core: '言論・学問' };
    } else if (cleanR.includes('spec')) {
      if (/spect|spic/.test(rawW)) return { stem: '-spect-', label: '-spect- (注視・展望)', core: '観察・見渡す' };
    } else if (cleanR.includes('port')) {
      if (/port/.test(rawW)) return { stem: '-port-', label: '-port- (運搬・出入口)', core: '港・輸送' };
    } else if (cleanR.includes('tragh')) {
      if (/tract/.test(rawW)) return { stem: '-tract-', label: '-tract- (牽引・抽出)', core: '引く・契約' };
    } else if (cleanR.includes('vert')) {
      if (/vert|vers/.test(rawW)) return { stem: '-vert-', label: '-vert- (転換・方向)', core: '回転・向ける' };
    }

    // 一般的な形態素語幹抽出（主要接頭辞の除去）
    const prefixRegex = /^(?:con|com|col|cor|sub|suc|suf|sug|sup|sur|sus|in|im|il|ir|ex|ef|per|trans|tra|re|pro|pre|de|ad|ac|af|ag|al|an|ap|ar|as|at|ob|oc|of|op|dis|dif|di|inter|intra|mis|un|non|en|em)-?/;
    const withoutPrefix = rawW.replace(prefixRegex, '');
    const cleanStem = withoutPrefix.length >= 3 ? withoutPrefix.slice(0, Math.min(6, withoutPrefix.length)) : rawW;
    return {
      stem: `-${cleanStem}-`,
      label: `-${cleanStem}- (基本語幹)`,
      core: '基底形態素'
    };
  }

  /**
   * レーベンシュタイン距離の計算 (O(min(N, M)) メモリ最適化)
   */
  function calcLevenshtein(a, b) {
    if (a === b) return 0;
    if (!a.length) return b.length;
    if (!b.length) return a.length;
    const row = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= b.length; i++) row[i] = i;
    for (let i = 1; i <= a.length; i++) {
      let prev = i;
      for (let j = 1; j <= b.length; j++) {
        const val = a[i - 1] === b[j - 1] ? row[j - 1] : Math.min(row[j - 1] + 1, prev + 1, row[j] + 1);
        row[j - 1] = prev;
        prev = val;
      }
      row[b.length] = prev;
    }
    return row[b.length];
  }

  const COMMON_TRICKY_WORDS = [
    'accommodate', 'definitely', 'occurrence', 'embarrass', 'millennium', 'privilege',
    'separate', 'necessary', 'maintenance', 'recommend', 'rhythm', 'conscience',
    'discipline', 'gauge', 'hierarchy', 'liaison', 'maneuver', 'perseverance',
    'supersede', 'surveillance', 'threshold', 'vacuum', 'withhold', 'independent',
    'experience', 'government', 'environment', 'calendar', 'cemetery', 'pronunciation'
  ];

  /**
   * スペルミス・タイポのサジェスト判定 (もしかして判定)
   */
  function findTypoSuggestion(rawWord, lang = 'en', entries = []) {
    if (!rawWord || typeof rawWord !== 'string') return null;
    const clean = rawWord.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (clean.length < 4 || clean.includes(' ')) return null;

    // 候補セットの収集（英検カタログ語彙、現在の単語帳、頻出難関語）
    const candidates = new Set(COMMON_TRICKY_WORDS);
    if (global.VocabEikenCatalog?.getAllWords) {
      global.VocabEikenCatalog.getAllWords().forEach(w => candidates.add(w.toLowerCase()));
    }
    if (Array.isArray(entries)) {
      entries.forEach(e => {
        if (e && e.word && !e.isDeleted) candidates.add(e.word.toLowerCase());
      });
    }

    if (candidates.has(clean)) return null;

    let bestMatch = null;
    let minDistance = 3;

    for (const cand of candidates) {
      if (Math.abs(cand.length - clean.length) > 2) continue;
      if (cand[0] !== clean[0] && Math.abs(cand.length - clean.length) > 1) continue;

      const dist = calcLevenshtein(clean, cand);
      if (dist < minDistance) {
        minDistance = dist;
        bestMatch = cand;
        if (dist === 1) break;
      }
    }

    if (bestMatch && minDistance <= 2) {
      return {
        original: rawWord,
        suggestion: bestMatch,
        distance: minDistance
      };
    }
    return null;
  }

  // --- グローバルエクスポート ---
  global.VocabMorphology = {
    foldAscii,
    calcLevenshtein,
    findTypoSuggestion,
    ROOT_PREFIXES,
    normRootKey,
    matchRootInText,
    isValidRootForEntry,
    isKnownPieRoot,
    SUPPLETIVE_MAP,
    DE_SEP_PREFIXES,
    POS_BY_LANG,
    IPA_OK,
    WIKT_BAD_BRACKET,
    IPA_SPEC_CHAR,
    lcsLen,
    isRelatedWordForm,
    checkWordInSentence,
    validateEntry,
    parseInputWordSpec,
    makeWordKey,
    makeLookupKey,
    COGNATE_KNOWLEDGE,
    buildCognateMatrix,
    renderCognateMatrixHtml,
    // 多層階層オントロジー & 形態素語幹エンジン
    SEMANTIC_REALMS,
    ROOT_REALM_MAP,
    getSemanticRealmForRoot,
    extractMorphologicalStem
  };

  // 即時参照互換性
  global.normRootKey = normRootKey;
  global.isValidRootForEntry = isValidRootForEntry;
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);

   */
  function splitInputWords(raw, lang = 'en') {
    const rawStr = String(raw ?? '').trim();
    if (!rawStr) return [];

    const norm = s => s.replace(/[！-～]/g, c => String.fromCharCode(c.charCodeAt(0) - 0xFEE0)).replace(/^["'「『【]+/, '').replace(/["'」』】]+$/, '').trim().normalize('NFC');
    const hasExplicitDelimiter = /[,、，\n\r\t;；/／]/.test(rawStr);

    if (hasExplicitDelimiter) {
      // カンマ、改行、セミコロン等の明示的区切り文字がある場合はそれで分割し、各項目内のスペース（熟語）をそのまま維持
      return rawStr
        .split(/[,、，\n\r\t;；/／]+/)
        .map(norm)
        .filter(Boolean);
    }

    const cleaned = norm(rawStr);
    if (!cleaned) return [];
    if (!cleaned.includes(' ')) return [cleaned];

    // 明示的な同形異義語指定 (#1, #2) 等が全トークンにある場合のみ複数語分割
    const tokens = [];

    let m;
    while ((m = re.exec(cleaned)) !== null) tokens.push(m[0].trim());

    const allHaveExplicitSpec = tokens.length > 1 && tokens.every(t => /#\d+$|[\(（][^\)）]+[\)）]/.test(t));
    if (allHaveExplicitSpec) return tokens;

    // スペースを含む単一の入力は、熟語・イディオム（例: "wet blanket", "take into account"）としてそのまま1件で保持
    return [cleaned];

  function registerWordsList(rawItems, fName, useHist, useWikt = true) {

      if (!uMap.has(key)) uMap.set(key, { word: w });
    });
    if ($('inWord')) $('inWord').value = '';
    if ($('wordSuggestBox')) $('wordSuggestBox').style.display = 'none';
    $('inWord')?.focus();
    registerWordsList([...uMap.values()], f, $('chkHist')?.checked, $('chkWikt')?.checked);
  }

  /**
   * ローディングカードDOM生成とキューへのタスク投入
   */
  function enqueueTask(task) {
    const App = global.App || {};
    if (!App.reqQueue) App.reqQueue = [];

    const $ = global.$ || (id => typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.getElementById(id) : null);
    const reqId = task.requestId || (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : ('req_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)));
    const c = typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.createElement('div') : { classList: { add(){}, remove(){} }, dataset: {} };
    c.className = 'card loading-card';
    if (c.dataset) c.dataset.requestId = reqId;
    c.innerHTML = `<div class="card-acts" style="opacity:1"><button type="button" class="act-icon-btn del-btn" data-act="close-load" aria-label="キャンセル">×</button></div><div class="col-left"><span class="hw">${esc((task.items || []).map(x => x.word).join(', '))}</span></div><div class="right"><div class="load"><div class="spin"></div><span class="st-text">待機中 (${(task.items || []).length}語)...</span></div></div>`;

    const list = $('list');
    if (list) list.prepend(c);
    App.reqQueue.push({ ...task, requestId: reqId, card: c, isCancelled: false, isDone: false });
    syncPersistedQueue();
    processQueue();
  }

  /**
   * 非同期キュー実行プロセッサ
   */
  async function processQueue() {
    const App = global.App || {};
    const canGenFn = global.canGenerateWords || (() => true);
    if (App.isProcessing || !App.reqQueue?.length || !canGenFn()) return;
    App.isProcessing = true;
    const $ = global.$ || (id => typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.getElementById(id) : null);

    try {
      while (true) {
        // キャンセルされたタスクのカード除去とキュー掃除
        App.reqQueue = (App.reqQueue || []).filter(q => {
          if (q.isCancelled) {
            q.card?.remove?.();
            return false;
          }
          return true;
        });

        // 次に処理可能なタスク（未キャンセル・未完了・未失敗）を検索
        const nextIdx = App.reqQueue.findIndex(q => !q.isCancelled && !q.isDone && !q.isFailed);
        if (nextIdx === -1) {
          // 実行可能なタスクがない場合は終了
          break;
        }

        const t = App.reqQueue[nextIdx];
        // もしカードがDOM内に見当たらない場合（再描画直後等）は安全に最前面に再アタッチして進捗表示を維持
        if (t.card && typeof document !== 'undefined' && !document.body.contains(t.card) && $('list')) {
          $('list').prepend(t.card);
        }

        let ok = false;
        try {
          ok = await executeBatch(t);
        } catch {
          ok = false;
        }

        if (!ok) {
          t.isFailed = true;
          t.isDone = false;
          syncPersistedQueue();
          // 先頭詰まり(Head-of-Line Blocking)を回避: 失敗タスクは保留にし、後続タスクを継続処理
          continue;
        }

        t.isDone = true;
        if (t.card && !t.card.classList?.contains('gen-err') && !t.card.querySelector?.('[data-act="retry-batch"]')) {
          t.card.remove?.();
        }
        const doneIdx = App.reqQueue.indexOf(t);
        if (doneIdx !== -1) App.reqQueue.splice(doneIdx, 1);
        syncPersistedQueue();

        if (App.reqQueue.some(q => !q.isCancelled && !q.isDone && !q.isFailed)) {
          await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 50));
        }
      }
      if (!App.reqQueue.some(q => !q.isDone) && $('list')) {
        $('list').querySelectorAll('.loading-card').forEach(c => {
          if (!c.classList.contains('gen-err') && !c.querySelector('[data-act="retry-batch"]')) c.remove();
        });
      }
    } finally {
      App.isProcessing = false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * 単一バッチ（Wiktionary並行取得、AI通信、エントリ保存）の実行
   */
  async function executeBatch(task) {
    const { items, fName, card, useHist, useWikt, targetLang, srcLang, tgtLang, pairKey } = task;
    const reqId = task.requestId || card?.dataset?.requestId || (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : ('req_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)));
    task.requestId = reqId;
    if (card && card.dataset) card.dataset.requestId = reqId;
    const App = global.App || {};
    const LANGS = global.LANGS || {};
    const sLang = srcLang || targetLang || App.srcLang || 'en';
    const tLang = tgtLang || App.tgtLang || 'ja';
    const pairCfg = global.VocabStorage ? global.VocabStorage.getPairConfig(sLang, tLang) : (LANGS[sLang] || LANGS.en);
    const saveKey = pairKey || pairCfg.key;
    const cfg = LANGS[sLang] || LANGS.en || {};
    const sName = cfg.ja || sLang, tCfg = LANGS[tLang] || LANGS.ja || {}, tName = tCfg.ja || tLang;
    const stEl = card?.querySelector ? card.querySelector('.st-text') : null;
    const wiktByIdx = new Map();

    const fetchWiktFn = global.VocabDictionary?.fetchWiktOne || global.fetchWiktOne;
    if (useWikt && fetchWiktFn) {
      if (stEl) stEl.textContent = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('queue.fetching_wiktionary') : 'Wiktionaryから対象言語セクションを取得中...';
      // [接地品質向上] モバイル・低速ネットワークでのWiktionary語源・IPA欠落（Grounding喪失）を防ぐため待機枠を2500msへ拡張
      const timedFetch = (word, lang) => Promise.race([
        fetchWiktFn(word, lang),
        new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(() => resolve(null), 2500))
      ]);
      await Promise.all(items.map(async (it, idx) => {
        try {
          const res = await timedFetch(it.word, sLang);
          if (res) wiktByIdx.set(idx, res);
        } catch {}
      }));
    }

    const isMono = (sLang === tLang);
    let mInst = '', eInst = '', sys = '';
    const catMap = global.CAT_PROMPT_MAP || '1:日常, 2:学術, 3:ビジネス';

    if (isMono) {
      if (sLang === 'en') {
        mInst = 'Precise English dictionary definition(s) (max 2-3 senses). CRITICAL: If the word has notable historical, political, or institutional usages (e.g. "wet" for anti-prohibitionist / favoring legal alcohol sales, "dry" for prohibitionist, "hawk/dove" for Cold War factions), MUST include that historical sense with a clear context tag like [History/Prohibition]';
        eInst = useHist
          ? 'Provide detailed etymology in English (PIE roots, Latin/Greek origins, semantic shift to modern usage, 40-70 words)'
          : 'Provide root breakdown and morphological origins in English (25-45 words)';
      } else if (sLang === 'fr') {
        mInst = 'Définition(s) précise(s) en français standard académique (max 2-3 acceptions). CRITICAL: Inclure les sens historiques, juridiques ou institutionnels marquants le cas échéant';
        eInst = useHist
          ? 'Étymologie savante en français (étymons latins/grecs/indo-européens, évolution sémantique historique, 40-70 mots)'
          : 'Décomposition morphologique et origine en français (25-45 mots)';
      } else if (sLang === 'de') {
        mInst = 'Präzise deutsche Wörterbuchdefinition(en) (max 2-3 Bedeutungen). WICHTIG: Bedeutende historische oder institutionelle Bedeutungen unbedingt einbeziehen';
        eInst = useHist
          ? 'Wissenschaftliche Etymologie auf Deutsch (Wortwurzeln, historische Bedeutungsverschiebung, 40-70 Wörter)'
          : 'Morphologische Zerlegung und Herkunft auf Deutsch (25-45 Wörter)';
      } else {
        mInst = '日本語での学術的・厳密な語義定義（最大2〜3個）。特定の時代・法制・歴史的文脈における重要語義があれば必ず含めること';
        eInst = useHist
          ? '日本語の語源・原義・漢字の成り立ち・意味の変遷を80〜120字以内で記述'
          : '語根・語源と成り立ちを50〜80字以内で記述';
      }

      sys = `学術的な${sName}モノリンガル辞書・語源辞典として全要求語(${items.length}件すべて漏れなく)のJSON配列を出力せよ。
すべての定義(meanings.text)、コアイメージ(core)、語源解説(etymology)、例文パラフレーズ(example.ja)は【${sName}のみ（同言語解説）】で厳密に出力せよ。
reqIndex/reqWord:入力値をそのまま返せ,
word:辞書見出し語(原形/単数形。独語名詞は語頭大文字、動詞は小文字),
category:分類番号(${catMap}),
phonetic:IPA([]無。wiktionaryIpaがあれば優先採用),
grammar_forms:${cfg.gramHint || ''},
meanings.text:${mInst},
history_note:その単語に特筆すべき歴史的・制度的・文化的用法や時代背景（例: wetなら米国禁酒法下の反禁酒・酒類販売支持派など）がある場合は必ずその背景を具体的に記述(70字以内)。特になければ"",
example:例文と${sName}でのパラフレーズ解説(ja内の見出し語相当箇所を<b>語</b>で囲み、used_formに文中の実際の活用形を記載。歴史的用法が強い語はその文脈を反映した自然な用例を優先),
phrases/derivatives:各0〜2個(derivativesは見出し語と同一語不可),
etymologyTags:0〜3個(【見出し語(word)自身】の語根のみを"*"付きで出力。例:["*sta-"]。例文や派生語に出る別単語の語根は絶対に含めるな。不明は[]),
core:${sName}でのコアイメージ(35字以内),
etymology:${eInst}`;
    } else {
      mInst = `${tName}での正確な訳語・定義${cfg.posHint || ''}(最大2〜3個)。【重要】もしその単語に特定の時代・歴史的出来事（例: wet＝米国禁酒法下の反禁酒・酒類合法化支持派、dry＝禁酒派、dove＝冷戦期ハト派等）における顕著な歴史的・政治的用法がある場合、現代の通常語義に加えて必ずその歴史的用法（【歴史】や【禁酒法】等の文脈ラベル付き）を含めること`;
      eInst = useHist
        ? `wiktionaryRefがあれば最優先根拠とし、語根と歴史・思想的変遷を${tName}で80〜120字(または相当長)で記せ`
        : `wiktionaryRefがあれば根拠とし、語根の分解と成り立ちを${tName}で50〜80字(または相当長)で記せ`;

      sys = `学術的な${sName}から${tName}への対訳語彙・語源辞典として全要求語(${items.length}件すべて漏れなく)のJSON配列を出力せよ。
すべての定義(meanings.text)、コアイメージ(core)、語源解説(etymology)、例文対訳(example.ja)は【${tName}（解説言語）】で出力せよ。
reqIndex/reqWord:入力値をそのまま返せ,
word:辞書見出し語(原形/単数形。独語名詞は語頭大文字、動詞は小文字),
category:分類番号(${catMap}),
phonetic:IPA([]無。wiktionaryIpaがあれば優先採用),
grammar_forms:${cfg.gramHint || ''},
meanings.text:${mInst},
history_note:その単語に特筆すべき歴史的・制度的・文化的用法や時代背景（例: wetなら1920年代米国禁酒法下の反禁酒・酒類販売容認派、dryの対義語など）がある場合は必ずその歴史的背景を具体的に記述(70字以内)。特になければ"",
example:例文と${tName}訳(ja内の見出し語相当箇所を<b>語</b>で囲み、used_formに文中の実際の活用形を記載。歴史的用法が強い語はその文脈を反映した自然な用例を優先),
phrases/derivatives:各0〜2個(derivativesは見出し語と同一語不可),
etymologyTags:0〜3個(【見出し語(word)自身】の語根のみを"*"付きで出力。例:["*sta-"]。例文や派生語に出る別単語の語根は絶対に含めるな。不明は[]),
core:${tName}でのコアイメージ(35字以内),
etymology:${eInst}`;
    }

    const DUMMY_SENSES_LIST = ['文脈上の重要語', '重要語', '文脈語', '重要単語', '語彙', '抽出語', 'OCR抽出'];
    const payload = items.map((x, idx) => {
      const o = { reqIndex: idx, reqWord: x.word, homographIndex: x.homographIndex || 1 };
      if (x.pos) o.contextPos = x.pos;
      if (x.meaning && !DUMMY_SENSES_LIST.includes(x.meaning.trim())) {
        o.targetSenseOrMeaning = x.meaning.trim();
      }
      if (x.sentence) o.contextSentence = x.sentence;
      const wRef = wiktByIdx.get(idx);
      if (wRef) { o.wiktionaryRef = wRef.extract; if (wRef.ipa) o.wiktionaryIpa = wRef.ipa; }
      return o;
    });

    const getKeyFn = global.getKey || (() => '');
    const callGeminiFn = global.VocabDictionary?.callGemini || global.callGemini;
    const parseApiJsonFn = global.VocabDictionary?.parseApiJson || global.parseApiJson || (async res => {
      if (typeof res === 'string') {
        try { return JSON.parse(res); } catch {}
      }
      if (res && typeof res.text === 'function') {
        try {
          const txt = await res.text();
          const json = JSON.parse(txt);
          const cand = json.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text;
          if (cand) return JSON.parse(cand.replace(/^```json/i, '').replace(/```$/i, '').trim());
          return json;
        } catch {}
      }
      if (res?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text) {
        try {
          return JSON.parse(res.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text.replace(/^```json/i, '').replace(/```$/i, '').trim());
        } catch {}
      }
      return Array.isArray(res) ? res : [];
    });
    const genInternalFn = global.VocabDictionary?.generateWithInternalAI || global.generateWithInternalAI;
    const builtinKnowledge = global.VocabDictionary?.BUILTIN_ETYMOLOGY_KNOWLEDGE || global.BUILTIN_ETYMOLOGY_KNOWLEDGE || { roots: {}, historical: {} };
    const schema = global.VocabDictionary?.RESPONSE_SCHEMA || global.RESPONSE_SCHEMA;

    try {
      let returnedList = [], usedModel = '';
      const customKey = getKeyFn();
      if (customKey && callGeminiFn) {
        if (stEl) stEl.textContent = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('queue.generating_byok') : 'カスタムBYOKキーでAI生成中...';
        const res = await callGeminiFn(sys, `対象語(${items.length}件):${JSON.stringify(payload)}${fName ? `\n分野:${fName}` : ''}`, customKey, stEl, schema, useHist);
        const rawArr = await parseApiJsonFn(res);
        returnedList = Array.isArray(rawArr) ? rawArr : [rawArr];
        usedModel = res.usedModel || 'gemini-custom';
      } else if (global.VocabSync?.isProxyReady?.() && (typeof navigator === 'undefined' || navigator.onLine !== false)) {
        try {
          if (stEl) stEl.textContent = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('queue.generating_cloud') : 'クラウドAI (Gemini 3.8 Flash) で生成中...';
          const proxyRes = await global.VocabSync.callVocabGenerateProxy({
            lang: sLang,
            srcLang: sLang,
            tgtLang: tLang,
            useHist,
            fName,
            items: payload,
            requestId: reqId
          });
          returnedList = Array.isArray(proxyRes.items) ? proxyRes.items : [];
          usedModel = proxyRes.usedModel || 'gemini-2.0-flash-proxy';
          if (proxyRes.quotaRemaining !== undefined && proxyRes.quotaRemaining !== null) {
            App.quotaRemaining = proxyRes.quotaRemaining;
            if (global.updCloudUI) global.updCloudUI();
          }
        } catch (proxyErr) {
          if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.warn) {
            console.warn('[Proxy Error]', proxyErr?.message || proxyErr);
          }
          // [P0-4 解決] クォータ上限時は内蔵ダミー生成へ逃げず、直ちにアップセルモーダルを提示して安全に停止
          if (proxyErr.isQuotaExceeded || proxyErr.status === 429) {
            const quotaMsg = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('queue.daily_quota_reached') : '本日の無料AI新規生成枠の上限に達しました。Proプランで無制限にご利用いただけます。';
            if (typeof global.openUpsellModal === 'function') {
              global.openUpsellModal(proxyErr.message || quotaMsg);
            }
            if (global.showToast) {
              global.showToast(quotaMsg, 'warn', 5000);
            }
            if (card) {
              card.className = 'card gen-err';
              card.dataset.retryItems = JSON.stringify(items);
              card.dataset.fName = fName || '';
              card.dataset.useHist = useHist ? '1' : '0';
              card.dataset.useWikt = useWikt ? '1' : '0';
              card.dataset.srcLang = sLang;
              card.dataset.tgtLang = tLang;
              card.dataset.pairKey = saveKey;
              card.dataset.requestId = reqId;
              card.innerHTML = `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:12px 14px;background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--e);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:8px"><div><div style="font-weight:700;color:var(--e);font-size:13px">AI生成枠上限（${esc(items.map(x=>x.word).join(', '))}）</div><div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--s);margin-top:2px">本日の無料枠(5語/日)に達しました。Proプランで無制限に生成できます。</div></div><div style="display:flex;gap:6px"><button type="button" class="btn-ac btn-xs" data-act="open-upsell" data-reason="無料枠到達">アップグレード</button><button type="button" class="btn-o btn-xs" data-act="close-load">削除</button></div></div>`;
            }
            syncPersistedQueue();
            return false;
          }

          // クラウド一時障害・オフライン時のみ内蔵エンジン (Wiktionary & 組み込み語源ナレッジ & 形態素合成) へフォールバック
          if (genInternalFn) {
            if (stEl) stEl.textContent = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('queue.generating_local') : '内蔵AIエンジン (完全機密保護) で生成中...';
            const internalRes = await genInternalFn(payload, sLang, tLang, fName, useHist, wiktByIdx);
            returnedList = Array.isArray(internalRes?.items) ? internalRes.items : [];
            usedModel = internalRes?.usedModel || 'builtin-ai-internal';
          }

          if (!returnedList.length) {
            // 万一内蔵エンジンでも1件も生成できなかった場合のみエラーUIを提示
            if (global.showToast) global.showToast(proxyErr.message || 'AI生成エラーが発生しました。「再試行」をお試しください。', 'err', 5000);
            if (card) {
              card.className = 'card gen-err';
              card.dataset.retryItems = JSON.stringify(items);
              card.dataset.fName = fName || '';
              card.dataset.useHist = useHist ? '1' : '0';
              card.dataset.useWikt = useWikt ? '1' : '0';
              card.dataset.srcLang = sLang;
              card.dataset.tgtLang = tLang;
              card.dataset.pairKey = saveKey;
              card.dataset.requestId = reqId;
              card.innerHTML = `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:12px 14px;background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--e);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:8px"><div><div style="font-weight:700;color:var(--e);font-size:13px">AI生成エラー（${esc(items.map(x=>x.word).join(', '))}）</div><div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--s);margin-top:2px">${esc(proxyErr.message || '一時的な通信エラー')}</div></div><div style="display:flex;gap:6px"><button type="button" class="btn-ac btn-xs" data-act="retry-batch">再試行</button><button type="button" class="btn-o btn-xs" data-act="close-load">削除</button></div></div>`;
            }
            syncPersistedQueue();
            return false;
          }
        }
      } else if (genInternalFn) {
        // 内部組み込みAIエンジン (オンデバイスAI / ビルトイン語源ナレッジベース & Wiktionary)
        if (stEl) stEl.textContent = '内蔵AIエンジン (完全機密保護) で生成中...';
        const internalRes = await genInternalFn(payload, sLang, tLang, fName, useHist, wiktByIdx);
        returnedList = internalRes.items;
        usedModel = internalRes.usedModel || 'builtin-ai-internal';
      }

      if (!returnedList || !returnedList.length) {
        if (card) {
          card.className = 'card gen-err';
          card.dataset.retryItems = JSON.stringify(items);
          card.dataset.fName = fName || '';
          card.dataset.useHist = useHist ? '1' : '0';
          card.dataset.useWikt = useWikt ? '1' : '0';
          card.dataset.srcLang = sLang;
          card.dataset.tgtLang = tLang;
          card.dataset.pairKey = saveKey;
          card.dataset.requestId = reqId;
          card.innerHTML = `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:12px 14px;background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--e);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:8px"><div><div style="font-weight:700;color:var(--e);font-size:13px">AI生成エラー（${esc(items.map(x=>x.word).join(', '))}）</div><div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--s);margin-top:2px">エントリの取得に失敗しました</div></div><div style="display:flex;gap:6px"><button type="button" class="btn-ac btn-xs" data-act="retry-batch">再試行</button><button type="button" class="btn-o btn-xs" data-act="close-load">削除</button></div></div>`;
        }
        syncPersistedQueue();
        return false;
      }

      if (useWikt && fetchWiktFn) {
        await Promise.all(returnedList.map(async (raw, rIdx) => {
          if (!raw) return;
          const idx = Number.isInteger(raw.reqIndex) && raw.reqIndex >= 0 && raw.reqIndex < items.length ? raw.reqIndex : rIdx;
          if (!wiktByIdx.has(idx) && raw.word) {
            const postRef = await fetchWiktFn(raw.word, sLang);
            if (postRef) wiktByIdx.set(idx, postRef);
          }
        }));
      }

      const getJsonFn = global.VocabCore?.getJson || global.getJson || global.VocabStorage?.getJson;
      const cur = [...(getJsonFn ? getJsonFn(saveKey) : [])], tombMap = global.VocabStorage ? global.VocabStorage.getTombstones(saveKey) : new Map();
      let maxNum = cur.reduce((m, i) => Math.max(m, i.num || 0), 0);
      const clearedAt = global.VocabStorage?.getClearedAt ? global.VocabStorage.getClearedAt(saveKey) : 0;
      const now = Math.max(Date.now(), (Number(clearedAt) || 0) + 1);
      const gen = { model: usedModel, pv: global.PROMPT_VERSION || 1, at: now }, matchedIndices = new Set();
      const sanitizeItemFn = global.VocabStorage?.sanitizeItem || global.sanitizeItem || (x => x);
      const verifyWiktFn = global.VocabDictionary?.verifyWiktGrounding || global.verifyWiktGrounding;
      const validateEntryFn = global.VocabMorphology?.validateEntry || global.validateEntry || (() => []);
      const makeLkFn = global.VocabMorphology?.makeLookupKey || global.makeLookupKey || ((w, l, h) => h > 1 ? `${w}#${h}` : w);
      const setJsonFn = global.VocabCore?.setJson || global.setJson || global.VocabStorage?.setJson;
      const loadFn = global.VocabCore?.load || global.load || global.VocabListView?.load;

      returnedList.forEach((raw, rIdx) => {
        if (!raw) return;
        let idx = Number.isInteger(raw.reqIndex) && raw.reqIndex >= 0 && raw.reqIndex < items.length ? raw.reqIndex : -1;
        if (idx === -1 || matchedIndices.has(idx)) {
          const reqW = String(raw.reqWord || raw.word || '').trim().normalize('NFC');
          idx = items.findIndex((x, i) => !matchedIndices.has(i) && (makeLkFn(x.word, sLang, 1) === makeLkFn(reqW, sLang, 1) || makeLkFn(x.word, sLang, 1) === makeLkFn(raw.word, sLang, 1)));
        }
        if (idx === -1 && rIdx < items.length && !matchedIndices.has(rIdx)) idx = rIdx;
        const matchedInput = idx !== -1 ? items[idx] : null;
        if (idx !== -1) matchedIndices.add(idx);

        const homoIdx = matchedInput?.homographIndex || 1, wRef = idx !== -1 ? wiktByIdx.get(idx) : null;
        const a = sanitizeItemFn({
          ...raw, phonetic: cleanPho(wRef?.ipa || raw.phonetic), homographIndex: homoIdx,
          wiktGrounded: false, wiktUrl: wRef?.url, contextSentence: matchedInput?.sentence, gen, updatedAt: now,
          tgtLang: tLang
        }, maxNum, sLang);
        if (!a) return;
        if (a.etymologyConfidence === 'unknown') a.etymologyTags = [];
        a.wiktGrounded = Boolean(wRef && verifyWiktFn && verifyWiktFn(a, wRef));
        a.flags = validateEntryFn(a);

        tombMap.delete(`id:${a.id}`);
        tombMap.delete(`wk:${a.wordKey}`);
        const normW = String(a.word || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (normW) tombMap.delete(`word:${normW}`);

        const exIdx = cur.findIndex(e => (e.wordKey && e.wordKey === a.wordKey) || makeLkFn(e.word, sLang, e.homographIndex) === makeLkFn(a.word, sLang, homoIdx));
        if (exIdx !== -1) {
          const [ex] = cur.splice(exIdx, 1);
          cur.push({
            ...ex, ...a,
            id: ex.id || a.id,
            num: ++maxNum,
            folder: fName || ex.folder,
            interval: ex.interval,
            repetition: ex.repetition,
            efactor: ex.efactor,
            stability: ex.stability,
            difficulty: ex.difficulty,
            retrievability: ex.retrievability,
            nextReview: ex.nextReview > now ? ex.nextReview : now,
            version: (Number(ex.version) || 1) + 1,
            updatedAt: now,
            reviewUpdatedAt: ex.reviewUpdatedAt || now,
            isDeleted: false
          });
        } else {
          cur.push({ ...a, num: ++maxNum, folder: fName || undefined, version: Number(a.version) || 1, updatedAt: now, reviewUpdatedAt: Number(a.reviewUpdatedAt) || 0, isDeleted: false });
        }
      });

      if (global.VocabStorage) global.VocabStorage.saveTombstones(saveKey, tombMap);
      if (setJsonFn) setJsonFn(saveKey, cur.map((it, i) => ({ ...it, num: i + 1 })), false, true);
      if (saveKey === pairCfg.key && typeof loadFn === 'function') {
        try { loadFn(App.page || 1); } catch {}
      }
      if (global.showToast && matchedIndices.size > 0) {
        const wordsStr = items.map(x=>x.word).join(', ');
        const toastMsg = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('queue.generation_complete', { words: wordsStr, count: matchedIndices.size }) : `単語カード生成完了: ${wordsStr}（${matchedIndices.size}語）を追加しました`;
        global.showToast(toastMsg, 'ok', 3500);
      }

      if (global.VocabStorage && matchedIndices.size > 0) {
        if (usedModel === 'shared-cache') {
          global.VocabStorage.recordMetricsEvent('cache_hit', matchedIndices.size);
        } else if (usedModel.includes('builtin') || usedModel.includes('on-device') || usedModel.includes('ondevice')) {
          global.VocabStorage.recordMetricsEvent('on_device', matchedIndices.size);
          global.VocabStorage.recordAiGenerationUsage(matchedIndices.size);
        } else {
          global.VocabStorage.recordMetricsEvent('ai_gen', matchedIndices.size);
          global.VocabStorage.recordAiGenerationUsage(matchedIndices.size);
        }
      }
      if (global.updCloudUI) global.updCloudUI();

      const $ = global.$ || (id => typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.getElementById(id) : null);
      const missingItems = items.filter((_, i) => !matchedIndices.has(i));
      if (missingItems.length > 0) {
        if (card) {
          card.className = 'card gen-err';
          if (card.dataset) {
            Object.assign(card.dataset, {
              retryItems: JSON.stringify(missingItems),
              fName: fName || '',
              useHist: useHist ? '1' : '0',
              useWikt: useWikt ? '1' : '0',
              srcLang: sLang,
              tgtLang: tLang,
              pairKey: saveKey
            });
          }
          const loadEl = card.querySelector ? card.querySelector('.load') : null;
          if (loadEl) {
            const missingWordsStr = missingItems.map(x => esc(x.word)).join(', ');
            const missingMsg = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('queue.missing_items', { words: missingWordsStr }) : `未取得の語があります (${missingWordsStr})`;
            const retryTxt = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('btn.retry', '失敗分を再試行') : '失敗分を再試行';
            const closeTxt = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('btn.close', '閉じる') : '閉じる';
            loadEl.innerHTML = `<span style="color:var(--warn)">${missingMsg}</span><button type="button" class="btn-ac-o btn-xs" data-act="retry-batch">${retryTxt}</button><button type="button" class="btn-o btn-xs" data-act="close-load">${closeTxt}</button>`;
          }
        }
        if ($('anki')?.style.display !== 'block' && loadFn) loadFn(1);
        return false;
      } else {
        if (task) task.isDone = true;
        if (card) card.remove?.();
        if ($('anki')?.style.display !== 'block' && loadFn) loadFn(1);
        return true;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.isQuotaExceeded || err.status === 429 || (err.message && (err.message.includes('上限') || err.message.includes('クォータ')))) {
        card?.remove?.();
        if (global.openUpsellModal) global.openUpsellModal(err.message || '本日のAI新規生成無料枠（5語/日）に達しました。');
        if (task) task.isDone = true;
        return true;
      }
      if (err.code === 'MAX_TOKENS' && items.length > 1) {
        const h = Math.ceil(items.length / 2);
        card?.remove?.();
        if (task) task.isDone = true;
        [items.slice(0, h), items.slice(h)].forEach(part => enqueueTask({ items: part, fName, useHist, useWikt, targetLang: sLang, srcLang: sLang, tgtLang: tLang, pairKey: saveKey }));
        return true;
      }
      if (card) {
        card.className = 'card gen-err';
        if (card.dataset) {
          Object.assign(card.dataset, {
            retryItems: JSON.stringify(items),
            fName: fName || '',
            useHist: useHist ? '1' : '0',
            useWikt: useWikt ? '1' : '0',
            srcLang: sLang,
            tgtLang: tLang,
            pairKey: saveKey
          });
        }
        card.innerHTML = `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:12px 14px;background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--e);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:8px"><div><div style="font-weight:700;color:var(--e);font-size:13px">AI生成エラー（${esc(items.map(x=>x.word).join(', '))}）</div><div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--s);margin-top:2px">${esc(err.message || '一時的な通信エラー')}</div></div><div style="display:flex;gap:6px"><button type="button" class="btn-ac btn-xs" data-act="retry-batch">再試行</button><button type="button" class="btn-o btn-xs" data-act="close-load">削除</button></div></div>`;
      }
      return false;
    }
  }

  // --- グローバルエクスポート ---
  global.VocabQueue = {
    PHRASE_PARTICLES,
    splitInputWords,
    syncPersistedQueue,
    restorePersistedQueue,
    registerWordsList,
    submitW,
    enqueueTask,
    processQueue,
    executeBatch
  };
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);

  /**
   * タイムアウト付きフェッチヘルパー
   */
  async function fetchWithTimeout(url, options, timeoutMs = 45000) {
    if (typeof AbortController === 'undefined') {
      return fetch(url, options);
    }
    const ctrl = new AbortController();
    const id = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), timeoutMs);
    try {
      return await fetch(url, { ...options, signal: ctrl.signal });
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(id);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Wiktionary本文から発音記号(IPA)を抽出
   */
  function extractCleanIpa(section) {
    const pronM = /^===+\s*(?:Pronunciation|Prononciation|Aussprache)[^=]*===+\s*$/im.exec(section);
    const scope = pronM ? section.slice(pronM.index, pronM.index + 900) : section.slice(0, 700);
    const labeled = scope.match(/(?:IPA|API|Lautschrift)[^/\[\n]{0,30}(?:\/([^/\n]{2,35})\/|\[([^\]\n]{2,35})\])/i);
    if (labeled) {
      const cand = cleanPho(labeled[1] || labeled[2]);
      if (cand && IPA_OK.test(cand) && !WIKT_BAD_BRACKET.test(cand)) return cand;
    }
    const slashMatches = [...scope.matchAll(/\/([^/\n]{2,35})\//g)];
    for (const m of slashMatches) {
      const cand = cleanPho(m[1]);
      if (cand && IPA_OK.test(cand) && !WIKT_BAD_BRACKET.test(cand) && (IPA_SPEC_CHAR.test(cand) || Boolean(pronM))) return cand;
    }
    if (pronM) {
      const brMatches = [...scope.matchAll(/\[([^\]\n]{2,35})\]/g)];
      for (const m of brMatches) {
        const cand = cleanPho(m[1]);
        if (cand && IPA_OK.test(cand) && !WIKT_BAD_BRACKET.test(cand) && IPA_SPEC_CHAR.test(cand)) return cand;
      }
    }
    return '';
  }

  /**
   * Wiktionary本文から対象言語セクションと語源テキストを抽出
   */
  function extractWiktLangSection(fullText, targetLang = 'en', host = 'en') {
    const text = String(fullText ?? '');
    if (!text) return null;
    const langNames = {
      en: 'English', fr: 'French', de: 'German', es: 'Spanish',
      it: 'Italian', pt: 'Portuguese', nl: 'Dutch', zh: 'Chinese',
      ko: 'Korean', ja: 'Japanese'
    };
    const langName = (global.LANGS && global.LANGS[targetLang]?.wiktName) || langNames[targetLang] || 'English';
    let section = text;
    if (host === 'en') {
      const m = new RegExp(`^==\\s*${langName}\\s*==\\s*$`, 'm').exec(text);
      if (!m) return null;
      const rest = text.slice(m.index + m[0].length);
      const nextL2 = rest.search(/^==\s*[^=]+\s*==\s*$/m);
      section = nextL2 !== -1 ? rest.slice(0, nextL2) : rest;
    }
    const ipa = extractCleanIpa(section);
    const etyM = /^===+\s*(?:Etymology|Étymologie|Herkunft|Etimología|Etimologia|Herkomst|어원|字源)[^=]*===+\s*$/im.exec(section);
    const snippet = etyM ? `${section.slice(0, Math.min(400, etyM.index))}\n${section.slice(etyM.index, etyM.index + 1200)}`.trim() : section.slice(0, 1400).trim();
    return snippet ? { extract: snippet.slice(0, 1500), ipa } : null;
  }

  /**
   * Wiktionary API単体クエリ
   */
  async function fetchWiktOne(word, targetLang = 'en') {
    const cleanW = String(word ?? '').trim();
    if (!cleanW || /[\u3040-\u30ff\u4e00-\u9faf]/.test(cleanW)) return null;
    const toWikiSlug = s => encodeURIComponent(String(s).trim().replace(/\s+/g, '_'));
    const tryFetch = async (host, title) => {
      const url = `https://${host}.wiktionary.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=extracts&explaintext=1&redirects=1&titles=${encodeURIComponent(title)}&format=json&origin=*`;
      const r = await fetchWithTimeout(url, {}, 2500);
      if (!r.ok) return null;
      const pages = (await r.json())?.query?.pages;
      const page = pages ? Object.values(pages)[0] : null;
      if (!page || page.missing !== undefined || !page.extract) return null;
      const parsed = extractWiktLangSection(page.extract, targetLang, host);
      return parsed ? { extract: parsed.extract, ipa: parsed.ipa, url: `https://${host}.wiktionary.org/wiki/${toWikiSlug(page.title || title)}` } : null;
    };
    try {
      return (await tryFetch('en', cleanW)) || (targetLang !== 'en' ? await tryFetch(targetLang, cleanW) : null) || (cleanW !== cleanW.toLowerCase() ? await tryFetch('en', cleanW.toLowerCase()) : null);
    } catch { return null; }
  }

  /**
   * 単語エントリのWiktionary接地真正性検証
   */
  function verifyWiktGrounding(item, wRef) {
    if (!wRef?.extract || !wRef?.url) return false;
    const extFold = foldAscii(wRef.extract);
    if (extFold.length < 20) return false;

    // 1. 語根タグ（*sta-, *bher- 等）がWiktionary本文に実在するか照合
    if (Array.isArray(item.etymologyTags) && item.etymologyTags.length > 0) {
      if (item.etymologyTags.some(t => matchRootInText(t, extFold))) return true;
    }

    // 2. 語源解説（etymology）内に登場する再構形・借用語・原義語根がWiktionary本文と一致するか照合
    const etyText = foldAscii(item.etymology || '');
    if (etyText.length > 5) {
      // 再構形（*...）の照合
      const reconstructedStems = etyText.match(/\*[\p{L}\p{M}0-9₁₂₃₄ḱǵʷʰ-]+/gu);
      if (reconstructedStems && reconstructedStems.some(stem => extFold.includes(stem.toLowerCase()))) {
        return true;
      }
      // 単語の見出し語自身と異なる具体的祖語・借用元語（例: epiphaneia, stationem など）の照合
      const foreignTokens = etyText.match(/[a-z]{4,}/g);
      const headwordFold = foldAscii(item.word || '').toLowerCase();
      if (foreignTokens) {
        const significant = foreignTokens.filter(tok => tok !== headwordFold && !['from', 'with', 'that', 'this', 'into', 'have', 'been', 'word', 'root', 'term', 'etymology'].includes(tok));
        if (significant.some(tok => extFold.includes(tok))) {
          return true;
        }
      }
    }

    // 3. 発音（IPA）がWiktionaryの公式発音と一致するか照合
    if (wRef.ipa && item.phonetic && cleanPho(item.phonetic) === wRef.ipa) {
      return true;
    }

    return false;
  }

  /**
   * AI APIレスポンスJSONの厳密なサニタイズ＆パース
   */
  async function parseApiJson(r) {
    if (!r) return [];
    let data;
    if (typeof r === 'string') {
      try {
        const direct = JSON.parse(r);
        if (Array.isArray(direct)) return direct;
        data = direct;
      } catch {
        data = { candidates: [{ content: { parts: [{ text: r }] } }] };
      }
    } else if (r && typeof r.json === 'function') {
      data = await r.json();
    } else if (r && typeof r.text === 'function') {
      data = JSON.parse(await r.text());
    } else {
      data = r;
    }
    if (Array.isArray(data)) return data;

    const cand = data?.candidates?.[0];
    if (!cand) throw new Error(data?.promptFeedback?.blockReason ? `入力がブロックされました (${data.promptFeedback.blockReason})` : 'AIから有効な候補が返されませんでした。');
    const reason = cand.finishReason;
    if (reason && reason !== 'STOP') {
      if (reason === 'MAX_TOKENS') { const er = new Error('AI応答が最大トークン数に達し途中で切れました。'); er.code = 'MAX_TOKENS'; throw er; }
      if (reason === 'SAFETY' || reason === 'RECITATION') throw new Error(`安全フィルタにより出力が中断されました (${reason})。`);
    }
    const rawText = (cand.content?.parts || []).map(p => p.text || '').join('').trim();
    if (!rawText) throw new Error(`AI応答が空でした (finishReason: ${reason || 'UNKNOWN'})`);
    const cleaned = rawText.replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i, '').replace(/\s*```$/i, '').trim();

    const repairJson = str => str
      .replace(/,\s*([\]\}])/g, '$1') // 末尾カンマ修復
      .replace(/[\u0000-\u0008\u000B\u000C\u000E-\u001F]/g, ''); // 制御文字除去

    try { return JSON.parse(cleaned); } catch {
      try { return JSON.parse(repairJson(cleaned)); } catch {}
      const arrM = cleaned.match(/\[[\s\S]*\]/);
      if (arrM) {
        try { return JSON.parse(arrM[0]); } catch {}
        try { return JSON.parse(repairJson(arrM[0])); } catch {}
      }
      const objM = cleaned.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
      if (objM) {
        try { return JSON.parse(objM[0]); } catch {}
        try { return JSON.parse(repairJson(objM[0])); } catch {}
      }
      throw new Error('AI応答のJSON解析に失敗しました。');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Chrome Built-in AI (Prompt API: Gemini Nano) 呼び出し
   */
  async function callOnDeviceGeminiNano(sys, promptText) {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
    const aiObj = window.ai || window.model;
    if (!aiObj?.languageModel) return null;
    try {
      const caps = await aiObj.languageModel.capabilities?.();
      if (!caps || (caps.available !== 'readily' && caps.available !== 'after-download')) return null;
      const session = await aiObj.languageModel.create({
        systemPrompt: sys,
        temperature: 0.1
      });
      const res = await session.prompt(promptText);
      session.destroy?.();
      return res;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /**
   * 内蔵語源ナレッジベース ＆ ルール合成エンジン (完全オフライン対応)
   */
  async function generateWithInternalAI(payloadItems, sLang = 'en', tLang = 'ja', fName = '', useHist = false, wiktMap = null) {
    const itemsJson = JSON.stringify(payloadItems);
    const nanoPrompt = `対象語(${payloadItems.length}件):${itemsJson}${fName ? `\n分野:${fName}` : ''}`;
    const nanoSys = `あなたは端末内蔵の学術的語源・概念史辞書AIエンジンです。JSON配列を出力してください。`;
    const nanoRaw = await callOnDeviceGeminiNano(nanoSys, nanoPrompt);
    if (nanoRaw) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(nanoRaw.replace(/^```json/i, '').replace(/```$/i, '').trim());
        if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length) return { items: parsed, usedModel: 'gemini-nano-ondevice' };
      } catch {}
    }

    const items = payloadItems.map((it, idx) => {
      const rawW = String(it.reqWord || it.word || '').trim();
      const normW = rawW.toLowerCase().normalize('NFC');

      // 屈折語尾の原形推定 (Lemmatization: 複数形・過去形・進行形・重複子音対応)
      const stemCandidates = [normW];
      if (normW.endsWith('ies') && normW.length > 4) stemCandidates.push(normW.slice(0, -3) + 'y');
      if (normW.endsWith('ied') && normW.length > 4) stemCandidates.push(normW.slice(0, -3) + 'y');
      if (normW.endsWith('s') && !normW.endsWith('ss') && normW.length > 3) stemCandidates.push(normW.slice(0, -1));
      if (normW.endsWith('es') && normW.length > 3) stemCandidates.push(normW.slice(0, -2));
      if (normW.endsWith('ed') && normW.length > 3) {
        stemCandidates.push(normW.slice(0, -1));
        const baseEd = normW.slice(0, -2);
        stemCandidates.push(baseEd);
        if (baseEd.length >= 3 && baseEd[baseEd.length - 1] === baseEd[baseEd.length - 2]) {
          stemCandidates.push(baseEd.slice(0, -1));
        }
      }
      if (normW.endsWith('ing') && normW.length > 4) {
        const baseIng = normW.slice(0, -3);
        stemCandidates.push(baseIng + 'e');
        stemCandidates.push(baseIng);
        if (baseIng.length >= 3 && baseIng[baseIng.length - 1] === baseIng[baseIng.length - 2]) {
          stemCandidates.push(baseIng.slice(0, -1));
        }
      }

      // 英検準1級カタログの完全オフライン照合 (原形候補も含めて走査)
      let eikenCard = null;
      if (global.VocabEikenCatalog) {
        for (const cand of stemCandidates) {
          eikenCard = global.VocabEikenCatalog.getWord(cand);
          if (eikenCard) break;
        }
      }

      if (eikenCard) {
        return {
          reqIndex: idx,
          reqWord: rawW,
          word: rawW,
          category: typeof it.category === 'number' ? it.category : 29,
          phonetic: eikenCard.phonetic || '',
          grammar_forms: eikenCard.grammar_forms || '',
          etymologyConfidence: 'certain',
          etymology: eikenCard.etymology || '',
          etymologyTags: eikenCard.etymologyTags || [],
          history_note: eikenCard.history_note || '',
          core: eikenCard.core || '',
          meanings: eikenCard.meanings || [{ pos: 'Noun', text: rawW }],
          example: eikenCard.example || { foreign: '', ja: '', used_form: rawW },
          phrases: eikenCard.phrases || [],
          derivatives: eikenCard.derivatives || []
        };
      }

      const wRef = wiktMap?.get ? wiktMap.get(idx) : null;
      
      // 内蔵語源・歴史ナレッジの照合 (原形候補も含めて走査)
      let histData = null;
      for (const cand of stemCandidates) {
        if (BUILTIN_ETYMOLOGY_KNOWLEDGE.historical[cand]) {
          histData = BUILTIN_ETYMOLOGY_KNOWLEDGE.historical[cand];
          break;
        }
      }

      let rootKey = null;
      if (histData?.etymologyTags?.length) {
        rootKey = histData.etymologyTags[0];
      } else {
        for (const cand of stemCandidates) {
          for (const [rKey, rInfo] of Object.entries(BUILTIN_ETYMOLOGY_KNOWLEDGE.roots)) {
            if (rInfo.words && rInfo.words.includes(cand)) {
              rootKey = rKey;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (rootKey) break;
        }
      }

      if (!rootKey && wRef?.extract) {
        const m = wRef.extract.match(/\*([a-zA-Z0-9_äöüßÄÖÜāēīōūăĕĭŏŭáéíóúàèìòùâêîôûəǭḗ₁₂₃₄ḱǵʷʰ-]+-?)/);
        if (m) {
          const cand = `*${m[1].replace(/^-|-$/g, '')}-`;
          if (BUILTIN_ETYMOLOGY_KNOWLEDGE.roots[cand]) rootKey = cand;
        }
      }

      const rootInfo = rootKey ? BUILTIN_ETYMOLOGY_KNOWLEDGE.roots[rootKey] : null;

      let etymology = histData?.etymology;
      if (!etymology) {
        if (rootInfo) {
          etymology = `印欧祖語 ${rootKey}（${rootInfo.meaning}）に由来。語根のコアイメージが保持され、定着した。`;
        } else if (wRef?.extract) {
          etymology = `語源資料（Wiktionary等）の記録に基づく学術語彙。古期英語・ラテン語等の語形成を経る。`;
        } else {
          etymology = `個別語源（借用語・新造語等）。確固たるPIE語根は未確定。`;
        }
      }

      const etymologyTags = rootKey ? [rootKey] : (histData?.etymologyTags || []);
      const etymologyConfidence = rootKey ? 'certain' : (histData ? 'certain' : 'unknown');
      const core = histData?.core || (rootInfo ? `「${rootInfo.meaning}」をコアイメージとして語義が展開。` : `語根・派生関係から構成される学術的概念イメージ。`);
      const history_note = (useHist && histData?.history_note) ? histData.history_note : '';

      let meanings = histData?.meanings;
      if (!meanings || !meanings.length) {
        const isPhrase = rawW.includes(' ');
        const pos = isPhrase ? 'Idiom' : (rawW.endsWith('ly') ? 'Adv' : (rawW.endsWith('tion') || rawW.endsWith('ment') ? 'N[U]' : (rawW.endsWith('ed') || rawW.endsWith('ing') || rawW.endsWith('able') ? 'Adj' : 'N[C]')));
        
        // Wiktionaryの抜粋テキストが存在する場合は語義行のみを抽出し、語源・発音見出しや活用行は完全除外
        let defText = '';
        if (wRef?.extract) {
          const lines = wRef.extract.split('\n');
          let inSkipSection = false;
          for (const line of lines) {
            const trimmed = line.trim();
            if (!trimmed) continue;
            if (trimmed.startsWith('=')) {
              const sec = trimmed.replace(/=/g, '').trim().toLowerCase();
              inSkipSection = /^(etymology|pronunciation|alternative forms|derived terms|related terms|translations|anagrams|further reading|references)/.test(sec);
              continue;
            }
            if (inSkipSection) continue;
            const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
            if (
              lower.includes('borrowed from') ||
              lower.includes('etymology') ||
              /^(from |inherited from |derived from |learned borrowing |orthographic borrowing |calque of |cognate with |compare |see also |ipa\(|rhymes:)/i.test(trimmed) ||
              (lower.startsWith(normW + ' (') && /(plural|third-person|present participle|past tense|comparative|countable|uncountable)/i.test(lower))
            ) {
              continue;
            }
            const clean = trimmed.replace(/^[0-9#*.\s]+/, '').trim();
            if (clean.length > 5 && !clean.startsWith('(')) {
              defText = clean.slice(0, 120);
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        if (!defText) {
          if (tLang === 'ja') {
            defText = isPhrase ? '成句・熟語' : (pos.startsWith('N') ? '名詞（学術・文脈語義）' : (pos === 'Adj' ? '形容詞（状態・性質）' : '動詞・文脈語義'));
          } else {
            defText = isPhrase ? 'Phrase / Idiom' : (pos.startsWith('N') ? 'Noun (Contextual definition)' : (pos === 'Adj' ? 'Adjective' : 'Verb / Contextual'));
          }
        }
        meanings = [{ pos, text: defText }];
      }

      let example = histData?.example;
      if (!example) {
        const jaTrans = tLang === 'ja'
          ? `文脈における<b>${rawW}</b>の学術的用法。`
          : `Academic usage of <b>${rawW}</b> in context.`;
        example = {
          foreign: `This context illustrates the academic usage of ${rawW}.`,
          trans: jaTrans,
          [tLang]: jaTrans,
          ja: jaTrans,
          used_form: rawW
        };
      }

      return {
        reqIndex: it.reqIndex ?? idx,
        reqWord: rawW,
        word: rawW,
        homographIndex: it.homographIndex || 1,
        category: typeof it.category === 'number' ? it.category : 29,
        phonetic: wRef?.ipa || '',
        grammar_forms: '',
        etymologyConfidence,
        etymology,
        etymologyTags,
        history_note,
        core,
        meanings,
        example,
        phrases: [],
        derivatives: []
      };
    });

    return { items, usedModel: 'builtin-knowledge-engine' };
  }

  /**
   * Gemini API 利用可能モデル一覧の取得 (1時間TTLキャッシュ)
   */
  const EXCLUDE_MODELS = ['tts', 'image', 'vision', 'embedding', 'aqa', 'audio', 'learnlm', 'robotics'];
  let _cachedModels = null;
  let _cachedModelsTs = 0;
  const MODELS_CACHE_TTL = 3600000; // 1時間
  let _cachedModelsKey = '';

  async function fetchModels(key, strictCheck = false) {
    if (!key) return [];
    const now = Date.now();
    if (!strictCheck && _cachedModels && _cachedModelsKey === key && (now - _cachedModelsTs < MODELS_CACHE_TTL)) {
      return _cachedModels;
    }
    if (!strictCheck && _cachedModelsKey === key) {
      try {
        const saved = (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') ? localStorage.getItem('vv_cached_gemini_models') : null;
        if (saved) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
          if (parsed && Array.isArray(parsed.models) && (now - parsed.ts < MODELS_CACHE_TTL)) {
            _cachedModels = parsed.models;
            _cachedModelsTs = parsed.ts;
            return _cachedModels;
          }
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch('https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models', { headers: { 'x-goog-api-key': key } });
      if (res.ok) {
        const json = await res.json();
        const valid = (json.models || [])
          .filter(m => (m.supportedGenerationMethods || []).includes('generateContent'))
          .map(m => m.name.replace(/^models\//, ''))
          .filter(n => { const low = n.toLowerCase(); return low.startsWith('gemini') && !EXCLUDE_MODELS.some(t => low.includes(t)); });

        const scoreModel = n => {
          const isFlashStd = n.includes('flash') && !n.includes('lite') && !n.includes('8b');
          const ver = parseFloat(n.match(/gemini-(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/)?.[1] || '0');
          return (isFlashStd ? 400 : n.includes('lite') ? 300 : 100) + ver * 10 - (/preview|-exp/.test(n) ? 60 : 0);
        };
        valid.sort((a, b) => scoreModel(b) - scoreModel(a));
        if (valid.length) {
          _cachedModels = valid;
          _cachedModelsTs = now;
          _cachedModelsKey = key;
          try {
            if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
              localStorage.setItem('vv_cached_gemini_models', JSON.stringify({ ts: now, models: valid }));
            }
          } catch {}
          return valid;
        }
      } else {
        if (strictCheck || res.status === 400 || res.status === 401 || res.status === 403) {
          throw new Error(`APIキーが無効です (HTTP ${res.status})。正しいGemini APIキーを入力してください。`);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (strictCheck || e?.message?.includes('APIキーが無効')) {
        throw e;
      }
      console.warn('[fetchModels fallback]', e?.message || e);
    }
    return ['gemini-2.5-flash', 'gemini-2.0-flash', 'gemini-1.5-flash'];
  }

  /**
   * Gemini API 呼び出し (リトライ・Thinking予算・JSONスキーマフェイルセーフ対応)
   */
  async function callGemini(sys, parts, key, st = null, schema = RESPONSE_SCHEMA, deep = false, prefModel = 'auto') {
    const models = await fetchModels(key);
    const std = models.filter(m => m.includes('flash') && !m.includes('lite') && !m.includes('8b'));
    const order = (prefModel && prefModel !== 'auto' && models.includes(prefModel))
      ? [prefModel, ...std.filter(x => x !== prefModel)]
      : (std.length ? [...std, ...models.filter(x => !std.includes(x))] : models.slice(0, 3));
    const usrParts = Array.isArray(parts) ? parts : [{ text: parts }];

    const setStatus = msg => {
      if (typeof st === 'function') st(msg);
      else if (st && typeof st.textContent !== 'undefined') st.textContent = msg;
    };

    const req = (m, think) => {
      const userTxt = usrParts[0]?.text || '';
      const wCount = (userTxt.match(/"reqWord"|"word"/g) || []).length || 1;
      const dynamicTokens = wCount === 1 ? (deep ? 3000 : 2500) : (wCount <= 3 ? 4500 : (wCount <= 6 ? 6000 : 8192));
      const cfg = schema ? { temperature: 0.1, maxOutputTokens: dynamicTokens, responseMimeType: "application/json", responseSchema: schema } : { temperature: 0.1, maxOutputTokens: Math.max(dynamicTokens, 8192) };
      if (think && schema && (m.includes('gemini-2.5') || m.includes('gemini-3')) && !m.includes('pro')) {
        cfg.thinkingConfig = { thinkingBudget: deep ? 512 : 0 };
      }
      return fetchWithTimeout(`https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${encodeURIComponent(m)}:generateContent`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-goog-api-key': key },
        body: JSON.stringify({ systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: sys }] }, contents: [{ role: "user", parts: usrParts }], generationConfig: cfg })
      });
    };

    let lastErr;
    for (const m of [...new Set(order)].filter(Boolean).slice(0, 3)) {
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
        try {
          setStatus(`${m} で処理中...${attempt > 0 ? `(再試行${attempt})` : ''}`);
          let r = await req(m, true);
          if (r.status === 400) r = await req(m, false);
          if (r.status === 400 && schema) {
            r = await fetchWithTimeout(`https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${encodeURIComponent(m)}:generateContent`, {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-goog-api-key': key },
              body: JSON.stringify({ systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: `${sys}\n必ず純粋なJSONのみを出力し、解説文やマークダウンは除外せよ。` }] }, contents: [{ role: "user", parts: usrParts }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.1, maxOutputTokens: 8192 } })
            });
          }
          if (r.ok) { r.usedModel = m; return r; }
          if (r.status === 401 || r.status === 403) { const e = new Error(`APIキーが無効、または権限がありません (HTTP ${r.status})`); e.fatal = true; throw e; }
          if (r.status === 429 || r.status === 503) {
            lastErr = new Error(`${m}: レート制限または混雑 (HTTP ${r.status})`);
            const waitMs = Math.min(8000, 1200 * Math.pow(2, attempt) + Math.random() * 400);
            setStatus(`混雑中 (${r.status}) — ${Math.round(waitMs / 1000)}秒後に再試行...`);
            await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, waitMs));
            continue;
          }
          lastErr = new Error(`${m}: HTTP ${r.status}`);
          break;
        } catch (err) {
          if (err.fatal) throw err;
          lastErr = err.name === 'AbortError' ? new Error(`${m}: タイムアウトしました`) : err;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    throw lastErr || new Error('API通信エラー');
  }

  // --- グローバルエクスポート ---
  global.RESPONSE_SCHEMA = RESPONSE_SCHEMA;
  global.parseApiJson = parseApiJson;
  global.PROMPT_VERSION = '2026-10-f';

  global.VocabDictionary = {
    BUILTIN_ETYMOLOGY_KNOWLEDGE,
    RESPONSE_SCHEMA,
    EXTRACT_SCHEMA,
    fetchWithTimeout,
    extractCleanIpa,
    extractWiktLangSection,
    fetchWiktOne,
    verifyWiktGrounding,
    parseApiJson,
    callOnDeviceGeminiNano,
    generateWithInternalAI,
    fetchModels,
    callGemini
  };
  global.VocabAI = global.VocabDictionary;
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);
