```javascript
  // 日本語新字体のエイリアス定義 (STARTER_LOCALIZATIONS)
  STARTER_LOCALIZATIONS['経済'] = STARTER_LOCALIZATIONS['经济'];
  STARTER_LOCALIZATIONS['理論'] = STARTER_LOCALIZATIONS['理论'];
  STARTER_LOCALIZATIONS['観点'] = STARTER_LOCALIZATIONS['관점'];
  STARTER_LOCALIZATIONS['権利'] = STARTER_LOCALIZATIONS['权利'];
  STARTER_LOCALIZATIONS['認識'] = STARTER_LOCALIZATIONS['认识'];

  function localizeStarterItem(item, tgtLang = 'ja', srcLang = null) {
    if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return item;
    const t = String(tgtLang || 'ja').toLowerCase();
    if (t === 'ja' || !t) return item;
    const s = String(srcLang || item.lang || 'en').toLowerCase();
    if (t === s) return item;

    const w = String(item.word || '').trim();
    const locDict = STARTER_LOCALIZATIONS[w] || STARTER_LOCALIZATIONS[w.toLowerCase()];
    const loc = locDict ? (locDict[t] || locDict['en']) : null;

    const cloned = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(item));
    cloned.tgtLang = t;
    cloned.pair = `${s}_${t}`;

    if (loc) {
      if (loc.meanings) cloned.meanings = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(loc.meanings));
      if (loc.core) cloned.core = loc.core;
      if (loc.etymology) cloned.etymology = loc.etymology;
      if (loc.history_note) cloned.history_note = loc.history_note;
      if (cloned.example && loc.exTrans) {
        cloned.example.trans = loc.exTrans;
        cloned.example[t] = loc.exTrans;
      }
      if (Array.isArray(cloned.phrases) && Array.isArray(loc.phrases)) {
        cloned.phrases = cloned.phrases.map((p, idx) => {
          const lp = loc.phrases[idx];
          return { foreign: p.foreign, trans: lp?.trans || p.trans || p.ja || '' };
        });
      }
      if (Array.isArray(cloned.derivatives) && Array.isArray(loc.derivatives)) {
        cloned.derivatives = cloned.derivatives.map((d, idx) => {
          const ld = loc.derivatives[idx];
          return { ...d, meaning: ld?.meaning || d.meaning || '' };
        });
      }
      if (loc.category) cloned.category = loc.category;
    }

    if (global.VocabI18n?.translateCategory) {
      cloned.category = global.VocabI18n.translateCategory(cloned.category, t);
    }
    if (typeof cloned.folder === 'string' && /[\u3040-\u309f\u30a0-\u30ff]/.test(cloned.folder)) {
      cloned.folder = `${s.toUpperCase()} Starter Pack`;
    }

    return cloned;
  }

  const DEFAULT_PACK_BY_LANG = {
    fr: 'fr_pre1',
    de: 'de_pre1',
    es: 'es_pre1',
    it: 'it_pre1',
    pt: 'pt_pre1',
    nl: 'nl_pre1',
    zh: 'zh_pre1',
    ko: 'ko_pre1',
    ja: 'ja_pre1'
  };

  function getStarterPack(lang = 'en', packType = 'academic') {
    if ((packType === 'academic' || packType === 'default') && DEFAULT_PACK_BY_LANG[lang] && PACKS[DEFAULT_PACK_BY_LANG[lang]]) {
      return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(PACKS[DEFAULT_PACK_BY_LANG[lang]]));
    }
    if (PACKS[packType]) {
      return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(PACKS[packType]));
    }
    // 英検準1級パックの動的構築
    if (packType === 'eiken_pre1_pack1' && global.VocabEikenCatalog) {
      const w1 = global.VocabEikenCatalog.getWordsByRoot('*kap-');
      const w2 = global.VocabEikenCatalog.getWordsByRoot('*bher-');
      const w3 = global.VocabEikenCatalog.getWordsByRoot('*sta-');
      return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify([...w1, ...w2, ...w3]));
    }
    if (packType === 'eiken_pre1_pack2' && global.VocabEikenCatalog) {
      const w1 = global.VocabEikenCatalog.getWordsByRoot('*spec-');
      const w2 = global.VocabEikenCatalog.getWordsByRoot('*deik-');
      const w3 = global.VocabEikenCatalog.getWordsByRoot('*ten-');
      return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify([...w1, ...w2, ...w3]));
    }
    if (packType === 'eiken_pre1_pack3' && global.VocabEikenCatalog) {
      const w1 = global.VocabEikenCatalog.getWordsByRoot('*ag-');
      const w2 = global.VocabEikenCatalog.getWordsByRoot('*sed-');
      const w3 = global.VocabEikenCatalog.getWordsByRoot('*sekw-');
      return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify([...w1, ...w2, ...w3]));
    }
    if (packType === 'eiken_pre1_pack4' && global.VocabEikenCatalog) {
      const w1 = global.VocabEikenCatalog.getWordsByRoot('*grebh-');
      const w2 = global.VocabEikenCatalog.getWordsByRoot('*vert-');
      const w3 = global.VocabEikenCatalog.getWordsByRoot('*pel-');
      return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify([...w1, ...w2, ...w3]));
    }
    const fallbackKey = DEFAULT_PACK_BY_LANG[lang] || 'academic';
    const list = PACKS[packType] || PACKS[fallbackKey] || EN_JA_STARTER;
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(list));
  }

  function getStarterPacksInfo() {
    return Object.values(PACK_METADATA);
  }

  function populateStarterPack(currentEntries, lang = 'en', packType = 'academic', targetPairKey = null, targetTgtLang = null) {
    let resolvedPack = packType;
    if (packType === 'academic' && DEFAULT_PACK_BY_LANG[lang]) {
      resolvedPack = DEFAULT_PACK_BY_LANG[lang];
    }
    const starterItems = getStarterPack(lang, resolvedPack);
    if (!starterItems.length) return { added: [], merged: currentEntries };
    const cur = Array.isArray(currentEntries) ? currentEntries : [];
    const makeLookupKey = global.VocabMorphology?.makeLookupKey || ((w, l, h) => `${l}:${String(w || '').trim().toLowerCase()}${h && h > 1 ? '#' + h : ''}`);
    const makeWordKey = global.VocabMorphology?.makeWordKey || ((w, l, pos, h) => `${l}:${String(w || '').trim().toLowerCase()}${h && h > 1 ? '#' + h : ''}`);
    const existingWords = new Set(cur.filter(x => x && !x.isDeleted).map(x => makeLookupKey(x.word, x.lang || lang, x.homographIndex)));
    const toAdd = [];

    const pairKey = targetPairKey || (global.VocabStorage?.resolveConfig ? global.VocabStorage.resolveConfig(lang).key : (lang === 'en' ? 'distinction_entries' : `distinction_entries_${lang}`));
    const clearedAt = global.VocabStorage?.getClearedAt ? global.VocabStorage.getClearedAt(pairKey) : 0;
    const tombMap = global.VocabStorage?.getTombstones ? global.VocabStorage.getTombstones(pairKey) : null;
    const now = Math.max(Date.now(), (Number(clearedAt) || 0) + 1);

    let maxNum = cur.reduce((m, x) => Math.max(m, Number(x.num) || 0), 0);
    const meta = PACK_METADATA[resolvedPack] || PACK_METADATA.academic;
    const defaultFolder = meta ? meta.name : 'スターターパック';
    let tombChanged = false;

    starterItems.forEach(item => {
      const itemLang = item.lang || (meta && meta.lang ? meta.lang : 'en');
      const hIdx = Number(item.homographIndex) || 1;
      const k = makeLookupKey(item.word, itemLang, hIdx);
      if (!existingWords.has(k)) {
        maxNum++;
        const activeTgtLang = targetTgtLang || (global.App?.tgtLang) || 'ja';
        const localizedItem = (activeTgtLang && activeTgtLang !== 'ja' && typeof localizeStarterItem === 'function')
          ? localizeStarterItem(item, activeTgtLang, itemLang)
          : item;
        const cleanSlug = String(localizedItem.word || '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9\u00C0-\u024F\u3040-\u30FF\u4E00-\u9FFF\uAC00-\uD7AF]+/g, '_') || String(maxNum);
        const cardId = localizedItem.id || `starter_${resolvedPack}_${cleanSlug}${hIdx > 1 ? '_' + hIdx : ''}`;
        const cardWk = localizedItem.wordKey || makeWordKey(localizedItem.word, itemLang, localizedItem.meanings?.[0]?.pos, hIdx);
        const card = {
          ...localizedItem,
          id: cardId,
          wordKey: cardWk,
          homographIndex: hIdx,
          version: Number(localizedItem.version) || 1,
          num: maxNum,
          lang: itemLang,
          tgtLang: activeTgtLang,
          pair: `${itemLang}_${activeTgtLang}`,
          category: localizedItem.category || (resolvedPack.startsWith('eiken_') ? '英検準1級' : '一般・その他'),
          folder: localizedItem.folder || defaultFolder,
          interval: 0,
          repetition: 0,
          efactor: 2.5,
          nextReview: now,
          updatedAt: now,
          reviewUpdatedAt: 0,
          isDeleted: false
        };
        if (tombMap) {
          if (tombMap.delete(`id:${cardId}`)) tombChanged = true;
          if (tombMap.delete(`wk:${cardWk}`)) tombChanged = true;
          const normW = String(item.word || '').trim().toLowerCase();
          if (normW && tombMap.delete(`word:${normW}`)) tombChanged = true;
        }
        toAdd.push(card);
        existingWords.add(k);
      }
    });

    if (tombChanged && tombMap && global.VocabStorage?.saveTombstones) {
      global.VocabStorage.saveTombstones(pairKey, tombMap);
    }

    return { added: toAdd, merged: [...cur, ...toAdd] };
  }

  /**
   * 外部JSON / IndexedDB / バンドルフォールバック対応の非同期スターターパックデータローダー
   */
  async function loadStarterPackData(packId, lang = 'en') {
    const resolved = packId === 'academic' && DEFAULT_PACK_BY_LANG[lang] ? DEFAULT_PACK_BY_LANG[lang] : packId;
    if (PACKS[resolved] && PACKS[resolved].length > 0) {
      return PACKS[resolved];
    }
    if (typeof fetch === 'function') {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`./data/starter_packs/${resolved}.json`);
        if (res.ok) {
          const json = await res.json();
          if (Array.isArray(json) && json.length > 0) {
            PACKS[resolved] = json;
            return json;
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        // オフライン・フォールバック
      }
    }
    return getStarterPack(lang, resolved);
  }

  function registerPackData(packId, items) {
    if (packId && Array.isArray(items)) {
      PACKS[packId] = items;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  global.VocabStarterPack = {
    getStarterPack,
    getStarterPacksInfo,
    populateStarterPack,
    localizeStarterItem,
    STARTER_LOCALIZATIONS,
    buildStarterPackGalleryHtml,
    loadStarterPackData,
    registerPackData,
    PACKS,
    PACK_METADATA
  };

})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);


```

```javascript
        '*scrip-': '*skreybʰ-',
        '*scrip': '*skreybʰ-',
        '*scribe-': '*skreybʰ-',
        '*scribe': '*skreybʰ-',
        '*skreibh-': '*skreybʰ-',
        '*skreibh': '*skreybʰ-',
        '*skreybh-': '*skreybʰ-',
        '*skreybh': '*skreybʰ-',
        '*grebh-': '*skreybʰ-',
        '*grebh': '*skreybʰ-'
      };
      const normRoot = s => String(s || '').trim().toLowerCase()
        .replace(/h[1-3₁-₃]/g, '')
        .replace(/[āăáàâ]/g, 'a')
        .replace(/[ēĕéèêḗ]/g, 'e')
        .replace(/[īĭíìî]/g, 'i')
        .replace(/[ōŏóòôǭ]/g, 'o')
        .replace(/[ūŭúùû]/g, 'u');
      const rawR = normRoot(rootKey);
      const mappedR = CATALOG_ROOT_ALIASES[rawR] || rawR;
      const cleanR = normRoot(mappedR);
      for (const [rKey, list] of ROOT_WORD_MAP.entries()) {
        const c = normRoot(rKey);
        if (cleanR === c || cleanR.startsWith(c.replace(/-$/, ''))) {
          return list;
        }
      }
      return [];
    },

    /**
     * 単語名から完全なカードデータを取得 (O(1))
     */
    getWord: function(word) {
      if (!word) return null;
      return WORD_INDEX.get(String(word).trim().toLowerCase()) || null;
    },

    /**
     * 登録済みカタログ単語リストの全キーを配列で取得
     */
    getAllWords: function() {
      return Array.from(WORD_INDEX.keys());
    },

    /**
     * 現在の単語帳（currentEntries）と照合して、語根ごとの達成率・未学習語を計算
     */
    calcProgress: function(currentEntries) {
      const registered = new Set();
      if (Array.isArray(currentEntries)) {
        currentEntries.forEach(e => {
          if (e && e.word && !e.isDeleted) {
            registered.add(e.word.toLowerCase());
          }
        });
      }

      return EIKEN_PRE1_ROOTS.map(r => {
        const words = ROOT_WORD_MAP.get(r.rootKey) || [];
        const total = words.length;
        const learned = words.filter(w => registered.has(w.word.toLowerCase()));
        const unlearned = words.filter(w => !registered.has(w.word.toLowerCase()));
        const percent = total > 0 ? Math.round((learned.length / total) * 100) : 0;

        return {
          rootKey: r.rootKey,
          label: r.label,
          meaning: r.meaning,
          rank: r.rank,
          desc: r.desc,
          total,
          learnedCount: learned.length,
          unlearnedCount: unlearned.length,
          unlearnedWords: unlearned,
          percent
        };
      });
    }
  };

})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);
```

```javascript
/**
 * Vocab Vault — Need Validation & User Feedback Module (js/feedback.js)
 */
(function (global) {
  'use strict';

  const FEEDBACK_QUEUE_KEY = 'vv_pending_feedbacks';

  function openFeedbackModal(categoryOrOpts = 'opinion') {
    const el = document.getElementById('feedbackModal');
    if (!el) return;
    const catSel = document.getElementById('fbCategory');
    const contentEl = document.getElementById('fbContent');
    if (typeof categoryOrOpts === 'string') {
      if (catSel) catSel.value = categoryOrOpts;
    } else if (categoryOrOpts && typeof categoryOrOpts === 'object') {
      if (catSel) catSel.value = categoryOrOpts.category || 'bug';
      if (contentEl && categoryOrOpts.initialMessage) {
        contentEl.value = categoryOrOpts.initialMessage;
      }
    }
    if (typeof global.toggleModal === 'function') {
      global.toggleModal('feedbackModal', true);
    } else {
      el.classList.add('open');
    }
    setTimeout(() => {
      document.getElementById('fbContent')?.focus();
    }, 50);
  }

  function closeFeedbackModal() {
    if (typeof global.toggleModal === 'function') {
      global.toggleModal('feedbackModal', false);
    } else {
      const el = document.getElementById('feedbackModal');
      if (el) el.classList.remove('open');
    }
  }

  async function sendFeedbackToSupabase(dbRow) {
    const cfg = global.VocabSync?.getConfig?.();
    if (!cfg || !cfg.configured) return false;
    const sess = global.VocabSync?.getSession?.();
    const token = sess?.access_token;
    const reqHeaders = {
      apikey: cfg.anonKey,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Prefer: 'return=minimal'
    };
    if (token) reqHeaders['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;

    const res = await fetch(`${cfg.url}/rest/v1/user_feedbacks`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: reqHeaders,
      body: JSON.stringify({
        user_id: sess?.user?.id || null,
        category: String(dbRow.category || 'opinion').slice(0, 50),
        rating: Number(dbRow.rating) || 5,
        content: String(dbRow.content || '').slice(0, 5000),
        email: dbRow.email ? String(dbRow.email).slice(0, 255) : null,
        willingness_to_pay: String(dbRow.willingness_to_pay || dbRow.willingnessToPay || '').slice(0, 50),
        app_version: String(dbRow.app_version || dbRow.appVersion || '2026-10-pwa').slice(0, 50),
        active_lang: String(dbRow.active_lang || dbRow.activeLang || 'en').slice(0, 20)
      })
    });
    return res.ok;
  }

  async function flushPendingFeedbacks() {
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && !navigator.onLine) return;
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(FEEDBACK_QUEUE_KEY);
      if (!raw) return;
      const q = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (!Array.isArray(q) || !q.length) return;
      const remaining = [];
      for (const item of q) {
        const ok = await sendFeedbackToSupabase(item).catch(() => false);
        if (!ok) remaining.push(item);
      }
      if (remaining.length > 0) {
        localStorage.setItem(FEEDBACK_QUEUE_KEY, JSON.stringify(remaining.slice(-50)));
      } else {
        localStorage.removeItem(FEEDBACK_QUEUE_KEY);
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  async function submitFeedback() {
    const content = document.getElementById('fbContent')?.value.trim() || '';
    const category = document.getElementById('fbCategory')?.value || 'opinion';
    const email = document.getElementById('fbEmail')?.value.trim() || '';
    const willingnessToPay = document.getElementById('fbWtp')?.value || '';
    const rating = document.querySelector('input[name="fbRating"]:checked')?.value || '5';

    if (!content && category !== 'interview') {
      alert(global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('fb.alert_fill') : 'ご意見・ご感想をご記入ください。');
      return;
    }
    if (category === 'interview' && !email) {
      alert(global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('fb.alert_email') : 'ヒアリングにご協力いただける場合は、連絡先メールアドレスをご記入ください。');
      return;
    }

    const dbRow = {
      category,
      rating: parseInt(rating, 10) || 5,
      content,
      email: email || null,
      willingness_to_pay: willingnessToPay,
      app_version: '2026-10-pwa',
      active_lang: global.VocabCore?.App?.lang || 'en'
    };

    const btn = document.getElementById('btnSubmitFb');
    if (btn) {
      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.textContent = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('fb.sending') : '送信中...';
    }

    let sent = false;
    try {
      sent = await sendFeedbackToSupabase(dbRow);
    } catch {}

    if (!sent) {
      try {
        const q = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(FEEDBACK_QUEUE_KEY) || '[]');
        q.push(dbRow);
        localStorage.setItem(FEEDBACK_QUEUE_KEY, JSON.stringify(q.slice(-50)));
      } catch {}
    }

    if (btn) {
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.textContent = global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('fb.submit') : 'フィードバックを送信';
    }

    alert(global.VocabI18n?.t ? global.VocabI18n.t('fb.alert_thanks') : '貴重なご意見をありがとうございます！今後の機能開発およびサービス向上に活用させていただきます。');
    closeFeedbackModal();
    const form = document.getElementById('feedbackForm');
    if (form) form.reset();
  }

  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.addEventListener) {
    window.addEventListener('online', flushPendingFeedbacks);
    setTimeout(flushPendingFeedbacks, 4000);
  }

  global.VocabFeedback = {
    openFeedbackModal,
    closeFeedbackModal,
    submitFeedback,
    flushPendingFeedbacks
  };
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);
```

```javascript
  /**
   * 初期ロケールの決定
   */
  function detectInitialLocale() {
    if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (saved && SUPPORTED_LOCALES.includes(saved)) return saved;
    }
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined') {
      const navLang = (navigator.language || navigator.userLanguage || '').toLowerCase();
      if (navLang.startsWith('ja')) return 'ja';
      if (navLang.startsWith('fr')) return 'fr';
      if (navLang.startsWith('de')) return 'de';
      if (navLang.startsWith('es')) return 'es';
      if (navLang.startsWith('it')) return 'it';
      if (navLang.startsWith('pt')) return 'pt';
      if (navLang.startsWith('nl')) return 'nl';
      if (navLang.startsWith('zh')) return 'zh';
      if (navLang.startsWith('ko')) return 'ko';
    }
    return 'en'; // デフォルトは世界展開を見据えて英語
  }

  let currentLocale = detectInitialLocale();

  /**
   * 翻訳文字列の取得（パラメータ展開 {key} およびフォールバック対応）
   */
  function t(key, paramsOrFallback = '', targetLocale = null) {
    let fallback = '';
    let params = null;
    if (typeof paramsOrFallback === 'object' && paramsOrFallback !== null) {
      params = paramsOrFallback;
    } else if (typeof paramsOrFallback === 'string') {
      fallback = paramsOrFallback;
    }
    const loc = (targetLocale && SUPPORTED_LOCALES.includes(targetLocale)) ? targetLocale : currentLocale;
    const dict = TRANSLATIONS[loc] || TRANSLATIONS.en;
    let str = (dict && dict[key]) || (TRANSLATIONS.en && TRANSLATIONS.en[key]) || fallback || key;
    if (params && typeof str === 'string') {
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) {
        str = str.replace(new RegExp(`\\{${k}\\}`, 'g'), v);
      }
    }
    return str;
  }

  /**
   * ロケール切り替え
   */
  function setLocale(newLocale) {
    if (!SUPPORTED_LOCALES.includes(newLocale)) return;
    currentLocale = newLocale;
    if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, newLocale);
    }
    applyI18nToDOM();
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.dispatchEvent === 'function' && typeof CustomEvent !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('vocab-locale-changed', { detail: { locale: newLocale } }));
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  /**
   * 現在のロケール取得
   */
  function getLocale() {
    return currentLocale;
  }

  /**
   * カテゴリ文字列の多言語翻訳（複合カテゴリの自動分解・他言語フォールバック対応）
   */
  function translateCategory(rawCat, targetLocale = null) {
    if (!rawCat) return t('cat.general', 'General', targetLocale);
    const loc = (targetLocale && SUPPORTED_LOCALES.includes(targetLocale)) ? targetLocale : currentLocale;
    if (loc === 'ja') return rawCat;

    const key = CATEGORY_MAP[rawCat];
    if (key) {
      const translated = t(key, '', loc);
      if (translated && translated !== key) return translated;
    }

    // 複合カテゴリの分解翻訳 (例: '論理・討論' -> 'Logic & Debate')
    if (rawCat.includes('・')) {
      const parts = rawCat.split('・').map(p => CATEGORY_PART_MAP[p.trim()] || p.trim());
      if (parts.length > 0 && !/[\u3040-\u30ff]/.test(parts.join(''))) {
        return parts.join(' & ');
      }
    } else if (CATEGORY_PART_MAP[rawCat]) {
      return CATEGORY_PART_MAP[rawCat];
    }

    // 目標言語が非日本語の場合、未翻訳の日本語文字列の露出を防止
    if (/[\u3040-\u30ff]/.test(rawCat)) {
      return t('cat.general', 'General', loc);
    }
    return rawCat;
  }

  let currentBillingInterval = 'month';

  /**
   * 課金サイクルの取得
   */
  function getBillingInterval() {
    return currentBillingInterval;
  }

  /**
   * 課金サイクルの設定とUI連動
   */
  function setBillingInterval(interval) {
    currentBillingInterval = interval === 'year' ? 'year' : 'month';
    updatePricingUI();
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.dispatchEvent === 'function' && typeof CustomEvent !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('vocab-billing-interval-changed', {
          detail: { interval: currentBillingInterval }
        }));
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  /**
   * 通貨表示フォーマッタ
   */
  function getPlanPriceInfo(interval = currentBillingInterval) {
    const isEn = currentLocale !== 'ja';
    const isYear = interval === 'year';
    if (isEn) {
      return {
        currency: 'usd',
        symbol: '$',
        priceMonthly: '$3.99',
        priceAnnual: '$39.00',
        priceAnnualPerMonth: '$3.25',
        intervalText: isYear ? '/ yr' : '/ mo',
        currentDisplay: isYear ? '$39.00' : '$3.99',
        perMonthDisplay: isYear ? '$3.25/mo' : '$3.99/mo',
        saveText: 'Save 17% (2 Months Free)'
      };
    } else {
      return {
        currency: 'jpy',
        symbol: '¥',
        priceMonthly: '¥480',
        priceAnnual: '¥4,800',
        priceAnnualPerMonth: '¥400',
        intervalText: isYear ? '/ 年' : '/ 月',
        currentDisplay: isYear ? '¥4,800' : '¥480',
        perMonthDisplay: isYear ? '月換算 ¥400' : '¥480/月',
        saveText: '年払いで2ヶ月分無料'
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * 価格表示UIの同期
   */
  function updatePricingUI() {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;

    const isYear = currentBillingInterval === 'year';
    const isEn = currentLocale !== 'ja';
    const p = getPlanPriceInfo(currentBillingInterval);

    // 1. Settings モーダルのタブ切り替え
    const setMonthBtn = document.getElementById('settingsBillingMonthlyBtn');
    const setYearBtn = document.getElementById('settingsBillingAnnualBtn');
    if (setMonthBtn && setYearBtn) {
      setMonthBtn.className = isYear ? 'btn-xs btn-o' : 'btn-xs active';
      setYearBtn.className = isYear ? 'btn-xs active' : 'btn-xs btn-o';
    }

    // 2. Upsell モーダルのタブ切り替え
    const upMonthBtn = document.getElementById('upsellBillingMonthlyBtn');
    const upYearBtn = document.getElementById('upsellBillingAnnualBtn');
    if (upMonthBtn && upYearBtn) {

    // 3. Settings Pro価格テキスト

  /**

  function translateSettingsModal(isEn) {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;

    // 1. モーダルタイトル
    const titleEl = document.getElementById('cfgModalTitle');

    const uiLangBadge = document.getElementById('uiLangBadge');
    if (uiLangBadge) {
      const badgeNames = {
        en: 'Global (EN)',

        de: 'Deutsch (DE)',

        pt: 'Português (PT)',
        nl: 'Nederlands (NL)',
        zh: '中文 (ZH)',
        ko: '한국어 (KO)'
      };
      uiLangBadge.textContent = badgeNames[currentLocale] || 'Global';
    }

    // 3. 音声設定チェックボックス
    const chkAutoSpeak = document.getElementById('chkAutoSpeak');
    if (chkAutoSpeak && chkAutoSpeak.parentElement && chkAutoSpeak.parentElement.childNodes) {
      try {
        const parent = chkAutoSpeak.parentElement;
        const nodes = Array.from(parent.childNodes || []);
        const textNode = nodes.find(n => n && (n.nodeType === 3 || (typeof Node !== 'undefined' && n.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE)));
        if (textNode) {
          textNode.nodeValue = t('settings.auto_speak');
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // 4. 音声速度セレクタ
    const ttsRateSel = document.getElementById('ttsRateSel');
    if (ttsRateSel && ttsRateSel.options) {
      try {

          if (opt.value === '0.85') opt.textContent = t('settings.tts_rate_slow');
          else if (opt.value === '0.95') opt.textContent = t('settings.tts_rate_natural');
          else if (opt.value === '1.05') opt.textContent = t('settings.tts_rate_fast');

    // 5. アカウント認証フォームプレースホルダー & ボタン

    // 6. バッジ類

      it: 'Italian (IT)',

    const tgtLangSel = document.getElementById('tgtLangSel');
    if (tgtLangSel && tgtLangSel.options) {

          else if (opt.value === 'due') opt.textContent = isEn ? 'Sort: Due for Review' : '並び順: 復習期日が近い順';

      de: 'German Only',
      es: 'Spanish Only',
      it: 'Italian Only',
      pt: 'Portuguese Only',
      nl: 'Dutch Only',
      zh: 'Chinese Only',
      ko: 'Korean Only',
      ja: 'Japanese Only'
    };
    const graphFilterJa = {
      all: '全言語',
      en: '英語のみ',
      fr: '仏語のみ',
      de: '独語のみ',
      es: '西語のみ',
      it: '伊語のみ',
      pt: '葡語のみ',
      nl: '蘭語のみ',
      zh: '中国語のみ',
      ko: '韓国語のみ',

          if (lbl) opt.textContent = lbl;

    }

    // 4. 単語編集モーダルの語源確実性セレクタ
    const editConf = document.getElementById('editConf');
    if (editConf && editConf.options) {
      try {
        Array.from(editConf.options).forEach(opt => {
          if (!opt) return;
          const k = 'edit.conf_' + (opt.value || 'none');
          const trans = t(k);
          if (trans) opt.textContent = trans;
        });
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // 5. フィードバックモーダルのセレクタ
    const fbCategory = document.getElementById('fbCategory');
    if (fbCategory && fbCategory.options) {
      try {
        Array.from(fbCategory.options).forEach(opt => {
          if (!opt) return;
          const k = 'fb.opt_' + opt.value;
          const trans = t(k);
          if (trans) opt.textContent = trans;
        });
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    const fbWtp = document.getElementById('fbWtp');
    if (fbWtp && fbWtp.options) {
      try {
        Array.from(fbWtp.options).forEach(opt => {
          if (!opt) return;

    // 6. 長文抽出モーダルの最大抽出数セレクタ & 対象レベルセレクタ
    const extMaxCnt = document.getElementById('extMaxCnt');
    if (extMaxCnt && extMaxCnt.options) {
      try {
        Array.from(extMaxCnt.options).forEach(opt => {

    if (global.VocabModal?.refreshExtractLevelOptions) {

    } else if (global.refreshExtractLevelOptions) {

    // 7. 言語ペアタブおよびサイドバーの再描画
    if (global.VocabSearch?.renderPairFileTabs) {

    }
    if (global.VocabSearch?.renderSidebarTree) {

    }

    // 8. クラウドUI・キーUI・統計情報の再描画
    if (global.VocabEvents?.updCloudUI) {
      try { global.VocabEvents.updCloudUI(); } catch (e) {}
    } else if (global.updCloudUI) {
      try { global.updCloudUI(); } catch (e) {}
    }
    if (global.updKeyUI) {
      try { global.updKeyUI(); } catch (e) {}
    }
    if (global.updStats) {

    if (global.VocabModal?.updateFSRSOptimizerUI) {
      try { global.VocabModal.updateFSRSOptimizerUI(); } catch (e) {}
    }
    if (global.VocabModal?.updateSmartNotifyUI) {
      try { global.VocabModal.updateSmartNotifyUI(); } catch (e) {}
    }

    // 9. アナリティクス・ダッシュボードの動的再描画（モーダルが開いている時のみ実行）
    const analyticsModal = document.getElementById('analyticsModal');
    const analyticsBody = document.getElementById('analyticsDashboardBody');
    const isModalOpen = analyticsModal && (
      (typeof analyticsModal.classList?.contains === 'function' && analyticsModal.classList.contains('active')) ||
      analyticsModal.style?.display === 'flex' ||
      analyticsModal.style?.display === 'block'
    );
    if (analyticsBody && isModalOpen && global.VocabAnkiView?.renderAnalyticsDashboard) {
      try { global.VocabAnkiView.renderAnalyticsDashboard('analyticsDashboardBody'); } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  /**
   * DOM 一括翻訳バインディング
   */
  function applyI18nToDOM(root) {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;

    const isEn = currentLocale !== 'ja';
    if (document.documentElement) {
      document.documentElement.lang = currentLocale;
    }

    const scope = (root && typeof root.querySelectorAll === 'function') ? root : document;

    // テキスト置換 [data-i18n]
    scope.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el => {
      const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n');
      if (key) {
        const trans = t(key);
        if (trans) el.textContent = trans;
      }
    });

    // ツールチップ置換 [data-i18n-title]
    scope.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-title]').forEach(el => {
      const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n-title');
      if (key) {
        const trans = t(key);
        if (trans) el.setAttribute('title', trans);
      }
    });

    // プレースホルダー置換 [data-i18n-ph]
    scope.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-ph]').forEach(el => {
      const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n-ph');
      if (key) {
        const trans = t(key);
        if (trans) el.setAttribute('placeholder', trans);
      }
    });

    // 画像 alt 置換 [data-i18n-alt]
    scope.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-alt]').forEach(el => {
      const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n-alt');
      if (key) {
        const trans = t(key);
        if (trans) el.setAttribute('alt', trans);
      }
    });

    // HTML置換 [data-i18n-html]
    scope.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-html]').forEach(el => {
      const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n-html');
      if (key) {
        const trans = t(key);
        if (trans) el.innerHTML = trans;
      }
    });

    // root が明示的に指定されている場合はサブツリーの部分翻訳なので、グローバルUI全件の再帰的再翻訳はスキップ
    if (root && root !== document && root !== document.body) {
      return;
    }

    // 言語セレクタがある場合の同期
    const langSel = document.getElementById('uiLanguageSel');
    if (langSel) langSel.value = currentLocale;

    // 設定モーダル & メインUIの詳細翻訳パス
    translateSettingsModal(isEn);
    translateMainUI(isEn);

    // 価格表示の同期
    updatePricingUI();
  }

  // 初期化時に DOM 読み込み完了後に適用
  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', applyI18nToDOM);
    } else {
      setTimeout(applyI18nToDOM, 0);
    }
  }

  global.VocabI18n = {
    t,
    setLocale,
    getLocale,
    translateCategory,
    getBillingInterval,
    setBillingInterval,
    getPlanPriceInfo,
    updatePricingUI,
    applyI18nToDOM,
    SUPPORTED_LOCALES,
    TRANSLATIONS
  };

  // 互換短縮エイリアス
  global.t = t;

})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);
```

<a id="file-supabase-schema-sql"></a>
### File: `supabase/schema.sql`

```sql
-- ==============================================================================
-- Vocab Vault — Supabase Database Schema (supabase/schema.sql)
-- 本番運用仕様: RLS、厳格な権限管理、事前予約＆補償返還クォータ、
-- アトミックWebhook、カラムグループ別LWW分散同期、GDPR完全抹消
-- ==============================================================================

-- 1. profiles テーブル（プラン判定・月間クォータ・Stripe契約情報・法務証跡）
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.profiles (
  id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE PRIMARY KEY,
  email TEXT,
  plan TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'free' CHECK (plan IN ('free', 'pro', 'academic')),
  monthly_quota INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5,
  usage_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  pro_monthly_cap INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3000,
  quota_reset_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT (date_trunc('day', NOW()) + INTERVAL '1 day'),
  stripe_customer_id TEXT,
  stripe_subscription_id TEXT,
  subscription_status TEXT DEFAULT 'inactive',
  cancel_at_period_end BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  current_period_end TIMESTAMPTZ,
  grace_period_until TIMESTAMPTZ,
  stripe_last_event_created BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  terms_accepted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  terms_version TEXT DEFAULT '1.0.0',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_profiles_stripe_customer
  ON public.profiles (stripe_customer_id)
  WHERE stripe_customer_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_profiles_stripe_subscription
  ON public.profiles (stripe_subscription_id)
  WHERE stripe_subscription_id IS NOT NULL;

-- Stripe Webhook 冪等性（Idempotency）保証用テーブル
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.stripe_events (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 新規ユーザー作成時に profile を自動生成するトリガー
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.profiles (
    id, email, plan, monthly_quota, usage_count, pro_monthly_cap,
    quota_reset_at, terms_accepted_at, terms_version
  )
  VALUES (
    NEW.id,
    NEW.email,
    'free',
    5,
    0,
    3000,
    (date_trunc('day', NOW()) + INTERVAL '1 day'),
    NULL, -- ユーザーがUI上で明示同意した時にのみ記録（法務証跡の厳格化）
    '1.0.0'
  )
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS on_auth_user_created ON auth.users;
CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created
  AFTER INSERT ON auth.users
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user();

-- 2. user_vocab_entries テーブル（単語帳データ・差分同期・Tombstone論理削除・カラム別LWW）
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.user_vocab_entries (
  user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL,
  id TEXT NOT NULL,
  lang TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (lang IN ('en', 'ja', 'fr', 'de', 'es', 'it', 'pt', 'nl', 'zh', 'ko')),
  pair TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en_ja',
  word_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  num INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  word TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(word) <= 255),
  homograph_index INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  folder TEXT,
  category TEXT DEFAULT 'その他',
  interval NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  repetition INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  efactor NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 2.5,
  next_review BIGINT NOT NULL,
  card_data JSONB NOT NULL CHECK (length(card_data::TEXT) <= 100000),
  updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
  review_updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  is_deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  server_updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) * 1000)::BIGINT,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_uve_user_server_sync
  ON public.user_vocab_entries (user_id, lang, server_updated_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_uve_user_pair_sync
  ON public.user_vocab_entries (user_id, pair, server_updated_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_uve_user_wordkey
  ON public.user_vocab_entries (user_id, word_key);

-- 3. user_tombstones テーブル（旧互換用削除ログ）
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.user_tombstones (
  user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL,
  lang TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (lang IN ('en', 'ja', 'fr', 'de', 'es', 'it', 'pt', 'nl', 'zh', 'ko')),
  pair TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en_ja',
  tomb_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  deleted_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
  server_updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM clock_timestamp()) * 1000)::BIGINT,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, pair, tomb_key)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ut_user_pair_del ON public.user_tombstones (user_id, pair, deleted_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ut_user_lang_del ON public.user_tombstones (user_id, lang, deleted_at);
-- [P0-4 解決] サーバー時刻基準でのTombstone差分Pull用インデックス
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ut_user_pair_server_sync ON public.user_tombstones (user_id, pair, server_updated_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ut_user_lang_server_sync ON public.user_tombstones (user_id, lang, server_updated_at);

-- 4. user_lang_watermarks テーブル（言語全削除ウォーターマーク）
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.user_lang_watermarks (
  user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL,
  lang TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (lang IN ('en', 'ja', 'fr', 'de', 'es', 'it', 'pt', 'nl', 'zh', 'ko')),
  pair TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en_ja',
  cleared_at BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, pair)
);

-- 既存テーブル移行マイグレーション（テーブルが既に存在する場合に pair カラムと server_updated_at を追加）
ALTER TABLE public.user_tombstones ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pair TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en_ja';
ALTER TABLE public.user_tombstones ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS server_updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM clock_timestamp()) * 1000)::BIGINT;
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.table_constraints 
    WHERE constraint_name = 'user_tombstones_pkey' AND table_name = 'user_tombstones'
  ) THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.key_column_usage 
      WHERE constraint_name = 'user_tombstones_pkey' AND column_name = 'pair'
    ) THEN
      ALTER TABLE public.user_tombstones DROP CONSTRAINT user_tombstones_pkey;
      ALTER TABLE public.user_tombstones ADD PRIMARY KEY (user_id, pair, tomb_key);
    END IF;
  END IF;
END $$;

ALTER TABLE public.user_lang_watermarks ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pair TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en_ja';
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.table_constraints 
    WHERE constraint_name = 'user_lang_watermarks_pkey' AND table_name = 'user_lang_watermarks'
  ) THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.key_column_usage 
      WHERE constraint_name = 'user_lang_watermarks_pkey' AND column_name = 'pair'
    ) THEN
      ALTER TABLE public.user_lang_watermarks DROP CONSTRAINT user_lang_watermarks_pkey;
      ALTER TABLE public.user_lang_watermarks ADD PRIMARY KEY (user_id, pair);
    END IF;
  END IF;
END $$;

-- user_tombstones と user_lang_watermarks の ON CONFLICT (user_id, pair, ...) を100%成功させるユニークインデックス保証
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_user_tombstones_user_pair_key
  ON public.user_tombstones (user_id, pair, tomb_key);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_user_lang_watermarks_user_pair
  ON public.user_lang_watermarks (user_id, pair);

-- 4.5. user_app_settings テーブル（FSRS重み・学習ログ・クラウド設定同期）
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.user_app_settings (

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_user_app_settings_key
  ON public.user_app_settings (user_id, setting_key);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_gdc_lang_wordkey ON public.global_dictionary_cache (lang, word_key);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.wiktionary_references (

-- 7. user_feedbacks テーブル（需要検証・ヒアリング回答）
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.user_feedbacks (
  id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  category TEXT NOT NULL,
  rating INTEGER DEFAULT 5,
  content TEXT,
  email TEXT,
  willingness_to_pay TEXT,
  app_version TEXT,
  active_lang TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  CONSTRAINT chk_feedback_lengths CHECK (
    length(COALESCE(category, '')) <= 50 AND
    length(COALESCE(content, '')) <= 5000 AND
    length(COALESCE(email, '')) <= 255 AND
    length(COALESCE(willingness_to_pay, '')) <= 50 AND
    length(COALESCE(app_version, '')) <= 50 AND
    length(COALESCE(active_lang, '')) <= 20
  )
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.guest_rate_limits (
```
