```typescript
${safeFName ? `Subject field: ${safeFName}` : ""}`;
      } else if (sLang === "fr") {
        serverSystemPrompt = `Vous êtes un dictionnaire étymologique académique et un lexique d'histoire des concepts de langue française (style Littré / Le Robert).
Expliquez chaque mot français STRICTEMENT EN FRANÇAIS avec ses racines indo-européennes, origines gréco-latines et son évolution philosophique.
1. Étymologie et image centrale (core) rédigées en français. ${rootInstructionEn}
2. Définitions rigoureuses (meanings.text) en français.
3. Exemple en français (example.foreign) et explication/reformulation en français (example.ja & example.trans).
${safeFName ? `Domaine: ${safeFName}` : ""}`;
      } else if (sLang === "de") {
        serverSystemPrompt = `Sie sind ein maßgebliches deutsches Begriffsgeschichte- und etymologisches Wörterbuch (Stil Duden / Grimm).
Erklären Sie deutsche Stichwörter AUSSCHLIESSLICH AUF DEUTSCH mit indogermanischen Wurzeln und geistesgeschichtlichen Zusammenhängen.
1. Etymologie und semantischer Kern auf Deutsch. ${rootInstructionEn}
2. Präzise Definitionen (meanings.text) auf Deutsch.
3. Deutsches Beispiel (example.foreign) und deutsche Paraphrase (example.ja & example.trans).
${safeFName ? `Fachbereich: ${safeFName}` : ""}`;
      } else if (sLang === "ja") {
        serverSystemPrompt = `あなたは学術的な日本語の語源・概念史・国語大辞典エンジンです。
各日本語の見出し語について、漢字・漢語の成り立ち（字源）、仏教・東洋思想・近代西欧語翻訳史（明治期の翻訳語形成）の変遷を深く日本語で解説してください。
1. 語源（etymology）およびコアイメージ（core）の解説。${rootInstructionJa}
2. 現代および歴史的な語義の解説。
3. 自然な用例・例文（example.foreign）とその現代語解説（example.ja & example.trans）。
${safeFName ? `分野: ${safeFName}` : ""}`;
      } else {
        serverSystemPrompt = `You are an authoritative academic monolingual etymological and conceptual history dictionary for ${sInfo.en}.
Explain each ${sInfo.en} headword STRICTLY IN ${sInfo.en} with its deep etymological roots, historical evolution, and precise definitions.
1. ${rootInstructionEn}
2. Provide definitions (meanings.text), core imagery (core), and example paraphrases (example.ja & example.trans) in ${sInfo.en}.
${safeFName ? `Field: ${safeFName}` : ""}`;
      }
    } else {
      // 異言語ペア（英和、仏和、独和、西和、伊和、葡和、蘭和、中和、韓和、その他全ペア）
      if (tLang === "ja") {
        serverSystemPrompt = `あなたは最高峰の学術的${sInfo.ja}から日本語への語源・概念史辞典および高度な単語帳データ生成エンジンです。
各${sInfo.ja}の対象語について、以下の学術的基準を厳守した正確なJSON配列を出力してください。

【厳格な学術基準・ハルシネーション完全排除】
1. 語源・字源の照合:
   - ${isCjkSource ? "東アジア漢字文化圏の字源（説文解字・形声文字の音符と意符・近代日韓中翻訳語史）を正確に解説すること。" : "印欧祖語(PIE)や古典諸語（ラテン語・ギリシャ語・ゲルマン祖語等）の実在が言語学的に広く認められている真の語根のみを記載（Pokorny, LIV, Mallory-Adams, OED, Wiktionary Etymology準拠）。"}
   - 実在しない語根の捏造・無理なこじつけ（ハルシネーション）を厳禁。語根が不詳の単語は率直に「語根不明」または借用元の言語から解説し、etymologyConfidenceを "disputed" または "unknown" とすること。
   - 民間語源（俗説）を事実として解説することを厳禁。
2. etymologyTagsの厳格化:
   - ${rootInstructionJa}
3. 【歴史的・文脈的用法の反映】:
   - 見出し語に特定の時代・歴史的出来事・制度的変遷に根ざす顕著な歴史的・政治的・思想的用法がある場合、現代標準語義に加えて必ずmeaningsに歴史的語義を含め、history_noteに時代背景や制度的文脈を具体的に記述すること（最大70字）。特筆すべき歴史的用法がない一般的な語彙はhistory_noteを空文字""とすること。
4. 自然な例文(example.foreign)と日本語訳(example.ja & example.trans):
   - 例文には必ず見出し語を含めること。外国語例文(example.foreign)はHTMLタグを付与せずプレーンテキストとすること。
   - 日本語訳(example.ja)では、見出し語に対応する訳語箇所を必ず <b>訳語</b> のように <b> タグで囲むこと。
   - used_form には外国語例文中で実際に使われている活用形を記載すること。
${!useHist ? "※歴史補足(history_note)は簡潔にとどめ、現代の主要語義と基本語根を優先すること。\n" : ""}
5. Unicode文字化け防止:
   - 発音記号(IPA・ピンイン・ハングル発音変化)、ウムラウト、アクサン記号などは壊れたエスケープを避け、UTF-8正規化された正確な文字で出力すること。
6. 品詞(pos)は ${sInfo.pos} 等に準拠すること。
${safeFName ? `分野の指定: ${safeFName}` : ""}`;
      } else if (tLang === "en") {
        serverSystemPrompt = `You are a high-level academic dictionary from ${sInfo.en} to English specializing in etymology, cognate networks, and conceptual history.
For each ${sInfo.en} word, provide definitions, root connections, and historical context STRICTLY IN ENGLISH.
1. Etymology and core semantic concept explained in English. ${rootInstructionEn}
2. English translation and definition (meanings.text).
3. Example in ${sInfo.en} (example.foreign) with accurate English translation (example.ja & example.trans). Keep example.foreign as plain text.
${safeFName ? `Field: ${safeFName}` : ""}`;
      } else if (tLang === "fr") {
        serverSystemPrompt = `Vous êtes un dictionnaire académique de ${sInfo.fr} vers le français, spécialisé en étymologie et histoire conceptuelle.
Expliquez les mots ${sInfo.fr} EN FRANÇAIS avec leurs racines étymologiques et leurs équivalents français.
1. Étymologie et concept central expliqués en français. ${rootInstructionEn}
2. Définition et traduction en français (meanings.text).
3. Exemple en ${sInfo.fr} (example.foreign) avec traduction française (example.ja & example.trans).
${safeFName ? `Domaine: ${safeFName}` : ""}`;
      } else if (tLang === "de") {
        serverSystemPrompt = `Sie sind ein akademisches Wörterbuch von ${sInfo.de} ins Deutsche, spezialisiert auf Etymologie und Begriffsgeschichte.
Erklären Sie ${sInfo.de} Wörter AUF DEUTSCH mit ihren Wurzeln und semantischen Vergleichen.
1. Etymologie und Kernkonzept auf Deutsch erklärt. ${rootInstructionEn}
2. Deutsche Übersetzung und Definition (meanings.text).
3. Beispiel auf ${sInfo.de} (example.foreign) mit deutscher Übersetzung (example.ja & example.trans).
${safeFName ? `Fachbereich: ${safeFName}` : ""}`;
      } else {
        serverSystemPrompt = `You are a high-level academic dictionary from ${sInfo.en} to ${tInfo.en} specializing in etymology, cognate networks, and conceptual history.
For each ${sInfo.en} word, provide definitions, root connections, and historical context STRICTLY IN ${tInfo.en}.
1. Etymology and core semantic concept explained in ${tInfo.en}. ${rootInstructionEn}
2. ${tInfo.en} translation and definition (meanings.text).
3. Example in ${sInfo.en} (example.foreign) with accurate ${tInfo.en} translation (example.ja & example.trans). Keep example.foreign as plain text.
${safeFName ? `Field: ${safeFName}` : ""}`;
      }
    }
    serverSystemPrompt += `\nCategory ID (category): MUST be an integer from 0 to 29 matching: ${CAT_PROMPT_MAP}.`;

    const serverResponseSchema = {
      type: "ARRAY",
      items: {
        type: "OBJECT",
        properties: {
          reqIndex: { type: "INTEGER" },
          word: { type: "STRING" },
          homographIndex: { type: "INTEGER" },
          category: { type: "INTEGER" },
          phonetic: { type: "STRING" },
          grammar_forms: { type: "STRING" },
          etymologyConfidence: { type: "STRING", enum: ["certain", "probable", "disputed", "unknown"] },
          etymology: { type: "STRING" },
          etymologyTags: { type: "ARRAY", items: { type: "STRING" } },
          history_note: { type: "STRING" },
          core: { type: "STRING" },
          meanings: {
            type: "ARRAY",
            items: {
              type: "OBJECT",
              properties: {
                pos: { type: "STRING" },
                text: { type: "STRING" },
              },
              required: ["pos", "text"],
            },
          },
          example: {
            type: "OBJECT",
            properties: {
              foreign: { type: "STRING" },
              ja: { type: "STRING" },
              trans: { type: "STRING" },
              used_form: { type: "STRING" },
            },
            required: ["foreign", "ja"],
          },
          phrases: {
            type: "ARRAY",
            items: {
              type: "OBJECT",
              properties: { foreign: { type: "STRING" }, ja: { type: "STRING" } },
              required: ["foreign", "ja"],
            },
          },
          derivatives: {
            type: "ARRAY",
            items: {
              type: "OBJECT",
              properties: {
                word: { type: "STRING" },
                phonetic: { type: "STRING" },
                pos: { type: "STRING" },
                meaning: { type: "STRING" },
                sub_phrase: { type: "STRING" },
                sub_trans: { type: "STRING" },
              },
              required: ["word", "meaning"],
            },
          },
        },
        required: ["word", "meanings", "example", "etymology", "core"],
      },
    };

    // --- 1. 共有辞書キャッシュの検索 (Unicode NFC 正規化 & 言語ペア対応 & マルチキーウォームアップ) ---
    const pairCode = `${sLang}_${tLang}`;

    // [P0-4 & P0-5 修正] makeWordKey の一貫定義（getCandidateKeys の第1キーと完全一致）
    const makeWordKey = (w: string, pair: string, h: number = 1): string => {
      const normW = w.normalize("NFC").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase();
      return `${pair}:${normW}#${h > 1 ? h : 1}`;
    };

    // [P0-4 解決] 異言語ペア間のキャッシュ汚染を100%防止するキー生成
    const getCandidateKeys = (w: string, pair: string, h: number = 1): string[] => {
      const normW = w.normalize("NFC").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toLowerCase();
      const keys = [
        `${pair}:${normW}#${h > 1 ? h : 1}`,
        ...(h === 1 ? [`${pair}:${normW}`] : []),
      ];
      // レガシーキー（ペア指定なし）は解説言語が日本語(ja)かつ同形#1の場合のみフォールバック許容
      if (tLang === "ja" && h === 1) {
        keys.push(`${sLang}:${normW}`, normW);
      }
      return Array.from(new Set(keys));
    };

    // 共有辞書キャッシュのバッチ検索 (言語ペアごとに独立)
    // 一度誰かが生成した標準語彙は共有キャッシュとして採用し、Gemini API費用0円・生成枠消費なしで即時返却
    const allKeys = Array.from(new Set(sanitizedItems.flatMap(it => getCandidateKeys(it.reqWord, pairCode, it.homographIndex || 1))));
    const { data: cachedRows } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from("global_dictionary_cache")
      .select("card_data, hit_count, word_key, verified")
      .eq("lang", sLang)
      .in("word_key", allKeys);

    const cachedMap = new Map((cachedRows || []).map((r: any) => [r.word_key, r]));
    const cachedResults: any[] = [];
    itemsToGenerate = [];
    const cacheUpdatePromises: Promise<any>[] = [];

    // [P1-3 解決] 一般的な整理用フォルダ名（TOEFL, お気に入り, 日付など）は専門分野指定ではないためキャッシュを優先ヒット（APIコスト防衛）
    const GENERIC_FOLDER_NAMES = new Set([
      "default", "デフォルト", "未分類", "その他", "general", "all", "words", "単語", "単語帳",
      "favorite", "favorites", "お気に入り", "ブックマーク", "starred", "star",
      "toefl", "toeic", "ielts", "eiken", "英検", "大学受験", "受験", "高校英語", "中学英語",
      "my words", "folder", "フォルダー", "フォルダ"
    ]);
    const isGenericFolder = !safeFName ||
      GENERIC_FOLDER_NAMES.has(safeFName.trim().toLowerCase()) ||
      /^\d{4}[-_/]?\d{1,2}([-_/]?\d{1,2})?$/.test(safeFName.trim()); // 2026-10 等の日付フォルダ
    const hasDomainContext = Boolean(safeFName && !isGenericFolder);

    for (const item of sanitizedItems) {
      const hIdx = item.homographIndex || 1;
      const candidateKeys = getCandidateKeys(item.reqWord, pairCode, hIdx);
      let cached: any = null;
      let matchedKey = "";
      for (const k of candidateKeys) {
        if (cachedMap.has(k)) {
          cached = cachedMap.get(k);
          matchedKey = k;
          break;
        }
      }

      const hasRealCustomSense = item.targetSenseOrMeaning && !DUMMY_OCR_SENSES.has(item.targetSenseOrMeaning.trim());
      const isCompleteCard = cached?.card_data &&
        Array.isArray(cached.card_data.meanings) &&
        cached.card_data.meanings.length > 0 &&
        Boolean(cached.card_data.etymology || cached.card_data.core);

      // キャッシュ即時返却（検証済み、または意味・語源等の必須項目が完全整合している場合）
      if (cached && cached.card_data && (cached.verified || isCompleteCard) && !hasRealCustomSense && !hasDomainContext) {
        cachedResults.push(sanitizeCard(cached.card_data, item));
        // [P2-2 解決] hit_count更新を確実に完了させるため Promise 配列へ格納
        cacheUpdatePromises.push(
          supabaseAdmin
            .from("global_dictionary_cache")
            .update({ hit_count: (cached.hit_count || 0) + 1, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
            .eq("lang", sLang)
            .eq("word_key", matchedKey)
        );
      } else {
        itemsToGenerate.push(item);
      }
    }

    let quotaRemaining = 9999;
    let generatedResults: any[] = [];
    let usedModel = "shared-cache";

    // --- 2. 未キャッシュ分のみクォータ事前予約 (Reserve) & Gemini API呼び出し ---
    reservedUser = false;
    reservedGuest = false;

    if (itemsToGenerate.length > 0) {
      if (!geminiApiKey) {
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Gemini API key is not configured on server" }), {
          status: 500,
          headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        });
      }

      // [P0-2 解決] TOCTOU排除: ログインユーザーのみアトミックにクォータを事前仮引き落とし（Reserve）
      if (user) {
        const { data: quotaReserve, error: quotaError } = await supabaseAdmin.rpc("reserve_or_refund_quota", {
          p_user_id: user.id,
          p_item_count: itemsToGenerate.length,
          p_is_refund: false,
          p_request_id: `${requestId}_generate`,
        });

        const isJa = tLang === "ja";
        if (quotaError || !quotaReserve?.allowed) {
          const quotaErrMsg = isJa
            ? `本日のAI新規生成無料枠（1日5語）に達しました（残り: ${quotaReserve?.remaining ?? 0}語）。Proプラン（月480円）にアップグレードすると実質無制限（月3,000語）でご利用いただけます。（※共有辞書キャッシュ内の単語は消費ゼロで登録可能）`
            : `Daily free AI generation quota reached (5 words/day, remaining: ${quotaReserve?.remaining ?? 0}). Upgrade to Pro ($3.99/mo or $39/yr) for unlimited generations and real-time cloud sync. (Shared dictionary cache words require zero quota).`;
          return new Response(
            JSON.stringify({
              code: "QUOTA_EXCEEDED",
              error: quotaErrMsg,
              quotaRemaining: quotaReserve?.remaining ?? 0,
            }),
            { status: 429, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
          );
        }

        reservedUser = true;
        quotaRemaining = quotaReserve.remaining;
      } else {
        const isJa = tLang === "ja";
        // [P0-⑦ 防衛] クライアント接続元IPが特定できない直接偽装リクエストは未認証生成を拒絶
        if (clientIp === "unknown_guest") {
          const authRequiredMsg = isJa
            ? "安全な接続元IPを特定できないため、AI生成には無料アカウント登録（30秒）またはログインが必要です。"
            : "Sign-in is required for AI generation from unverified network sources.";
          return new Response(
            JSON.stringify({
              error: authRequiredMsg,
              requiresAuth: true
            }),
            { status: 403, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
          );
        }

        // [API Drain防衛] 未ログインゲストは1リクエスト最大3語に制限
        if (itemsToGenerate.length > 3) {
          const guestBatchErrMsg = isJa
            ? "未ログインでのAI新規一括生成は1回3語までです。無料アカウントを作成すると1日5語まで利用可能になり、Proプラン（月480円）で実質無制限（月3,000語）になります。"
            : "Guest AI generation without sign-in is limited to 3 words per request. Create a free account for 5 words/day, or upgrade to Pro ($3.99/mo) for unlimited access.";
          return new Response(
            JSON.stringify({
              error: guestBatchErrMsg,
              requiresAuth: true
            }),
            { status: 400, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
          );
        }

        // [P0-6 解決] 未ログインゲストの日次クォータ判定（1日3語上限）
        let guestAllowed = true;
        let currentUsage = 0;
        const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        const rateKey = `${clientIp}_${todayStr}`;
        const currentMemoryCount = guestRateMemory.get(rateKey) || 0;
        if (currentMemoryCount + itemsToGenerate.length > GUEST_DAILY_LIMIT) {
          const guestMemQuotaErrMsg = isJa
            ? `未ログインでの本日のAI新規生成お試し枠（1日${GUEST_DAILY_LIMIT}語）に達しました（本日利用: ${currentMemoryCount}語）。無料アカウント登録（30秒）で1日5語まで利用可能になり、Proプラン（月額480円）で実質無制限（月3,000語）にアップグレードできます。（※共有辞書キャッシュ内の単語は完全無制限）`
            : `Daily guest quota reached (${GUEST_DAILY_LIMIT} words/day). Sign up for a free account (30 seconds) for 5 words/day, or upgrade to Pro ($3.99/mo) for unlimited AI generations. (Shared dictionary cache is always unlimited).`;
          return new Response(
            JSON.stringify({
              code: "QUOTA_EXCEEDED",
              error: guestMemQuotaErrMsg,
              quotaRemaining: 0,
              requiresAuth: true
            }),
            { status: 429, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
          );
        }

        try {
          const { data: gqData, error: gqErr } = await supabaseAdmin.rpc("consume_guest_quota", {
            p_ip: clientIp,
            p_count: itemsToGenerate.length,
            p_daily_limit: GUEST_DAILY_LIMIT,
          });

          if (gqErr) {
            console.error(`[Guest Quota RPC Error] ${gqErr.message}`);
            // [P1-2 解決] Fail-Closed: DB障害・高負荷時はAPIコスト流出を防ぐため安全側に倒してブロック
            const busyErrMsg = isJa
              ? "現在クォータ認証サーバーが混み合っています。数分後に再試行してください。"
              : "Quota verification server is currently busy. Please retry in a few moments.";
            return new Response(
              JSON.stringify({ error: busyErrMsg }),
              { status: 503, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
            );
          }

          if (gqData) {
            guestAllowed = Boolean(gqData.allowed);
            currentUsage = Number(gqData.usage_count) || 0;
            if (!guestAllowed) {
              const guestQuotaErrMsg = isJa
                ? `未ログインでの本日のAI新規生成お試し枠（1日${GUEST_DAILY_LIMIT}語）に達しました（本日利用: ${currentUsage}語）。無料アカウント登録（30秒）で1日5語まで利用可能になり、Proプラン（月額480円）で実質無制限（月3,000語）にアップグレードできます。（※共有辞書キャッシュ内の単語は完全無制限）`
                : `Daily guest quota reached (${GUEST_DAILY_LIMIT} words/day). Sign up for a free account (30 seconds) for 5 words/day, or upgrade to Pro ($3.99/mo) for unlimited AI generations. (Shared dictionary cache is always unlimited).`;
              return new Response(
                JSON.stringify({
                  code: "QUOTA_EXCEEDED",
                  error: guestQuotaErrMsg,
                  quotaRemaining: 0,
                  requiresAuth: true
                }),
                { status: 429, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
              );
            }
          }
          guestRateMemory.set(rateKey, Math.max(currentMemoryCount + itemsToGenerate.length, currentUsage));
          reservedGuest = true;
        } catch (rpcEx: any) {
          console.error(`[Guest Quota Exception] ${rpcEx.message}`);
          // [P1-2 解決] Fail-Closed: 予期せぬ例外時も安全側に倒して即座に遮断
          const errFallbackMsg = isJa
            ? "現在サーバーが混み合っています。数分後に再試行してください。"
            : "Server is currently experiencing high load. Please retry in a few moments.";
          return new Response(
            JSON.stringify({ error: errFallbackMsg }),
            { status: 503, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
          );
        }
      }

      // Gemini呼び出し (モデル自動フォールバックチェーン: 2.0-flash -> 1.5-flash)
      const candidateModels = [
        Deno.env.get("GEMINI_MODEL") || "gemini-2.0-flash",
        "gemini-1.5-flash",
      ].filter(Boolean);

      const userContent = `<user_request>\n対象語(${itemsToGenerate.length}件):\n${JSON.stringify(itemsToGenerate)}\n${safeFName ? `分野:${safeFName}\n` : ""}</user_request>`;
      const dynamicMaxTokens = itemsToGenerate.length === 1 ? (useHist ? 3000 : 2500) : (itemsToGenerate.length <= 3 ? 4500 : (itemsToGenerate.length <= 6 ? 6000 : 8192));
      const reqPayload = JSON.stringify({
        systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: serverSystemPrompt }] },
        contents: [{ role: "user", parts: [{ text: userContent }] }],
        generationConfig: {
          temperature: 0.1,
          maxOutputTokens: dynamicMaxTokens,
          responseMimeType: "application/json",
          responseSchema: serverResponseSchema,
        },
        safetySettings: [
          { category: "HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT", threshold: "BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH" },
          { category: "HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH", threshold: "BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH" },
          { category: "HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT", threshold: "BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH" },
          { category: "HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT", threshold: "BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH" },
        ],
      });

      let aiResponse: Response | null = null;
      let lastErrText = "";
      let successfulModel = candidateModels[0];

      for (const m of candidateModels) {
        // [P1-4 修正] APIキーをクエリURLから排除し、x-goog-api-key ヘッダーでセキュアに送信 & 15秒タイムアウト設定
        const endpoint = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${m}:generateContent`;
        try {
          const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
            method: "POST",
            headers: {
              "Content-Type": "application/json",
              "x-goog-api-key": geminiApiKey,
            },
            body: reqPayload,
            signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000),
          });

          if (res.ok) {
            aiResponse = res;
            successfulModel = m;
            break;
          }

          lastErrText = await res.text();
          console.warn(`[Gemini Model Warning] Model ${m} returned HTTP ${res.status}: ${lastErrText}. Trying fallback...`);
          if (res.status === 429 || res.status >= 500) {
            continue; // インフラ負荷時は次のモデルへ
          }
        } catch (fetchErr: any) {
          lastErrText = fetchErr?.message || String(fetchErr);
          console.warn(`[Gemini Fetch Error] Model ${m} network failed: ${lastErrText}`);
        }
      }

      if (!aiResponse || !aiResponse.ok) {
        if (user && reservedUser) {
          await supabaseAdmin.rpc("reserve_or_refund_quota", {
            p_user_id: user.id,
            p_item_count: itemsToGenerate.length,
            p_is_refund: true,
            p_request_id: `${requestId}_generate`,
          });
          reservedUser = false;
        } else if (!user && reservedGuest) {
          await supabaseAdmin.rpc("consume_guest_quota", {
            p_ip: clientIp,
            p_count: -itemsToGenerate.length,
            p_daily_limit: GUEST_DAILY_LIMIT,
          }).catch(() => {});
          refundGuestMemory(clientIp, itemsToGenerate.length);
          reservedGuest = false;
        }
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: `Gemini API呼び出しに失敗しました (${lastErrText})` }), {
          status: 502,
          headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        });
      }

      const aiData = await aiResponse.json();
      const rawText = aiData.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text ?? "[]";
      let parsedAi: any;
      try {
        parsedAi = JSON.parse(cleanJsonString(rawText));
      } catch (parseErr: any) {
        if (user && reservedUser) {
          await supabaseAdmin.rpc("reserve_or_refund_quota", {
            p_user_id: user.id,
            p_item_count: itemsToGenerate.length,
            p_is_refund: true,
            p_request_id: `${requestId}_generate`,
          });
          reservedUser = false;
        } else if (!user && reservedGuest) {
          await supabaseAdmin.rpc("consume_guest_quota", {
            p_ip: clientIp,
            p_count: -itemsToGenerate.length,
            p_daily_limit: GUEST_DAILY_LIMIT,
          }).catch(() => {});
          refundGuestMemory(clientIp, itemsToGenerate.length);
          reservedGuest = false;
        }
        return new Response(
          JSON.stringify({ error: "AI応答の解析に失敗しました。クォータは全額返還されました。" }),
          { status: 502, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
        );
      }

      const rawArr = Array.isArray(parsedAi) ? parsedAi : [parsedAi];

      // [P0-5 修正] モデル出力の検証: reqIndex または reqWord が一致するカードのみ抽出（無関係カードの3段目フォールバック割当を完全排除）
      const validCards: any[] = [];
      const assignedRawItems = new Set<any>();

      for (const origItem of itemsToGenerate) {
        let match = rawArr.find((c: any) => !assignedRawItems.has(c) && c?.reqIndex === origItem.reqIndex);
        if (!match) {
          const origNorm = origItem.reqWord.toLowerCase().trim();
          match = rawArr.find((c: any) => !assignedRawItems.has(c) && String(c?.word || "").toLowerCase().trim() === origNorm);
        }
        // AIが正しく内容（意味・語源・コア概念）を生成できた場合のみ採用（無関係カードは割り当てない）
        if (match && (Array.isArray(match.meanings) && match.meanings.length > 0 || match.etymology || match.core)) {
          assignedRawItems.add(match);
          validCards.push(sanitizeCard(match, origItem));
        }
      }

      generatedResults = validCards;
      usedModel = successfulModel;

      // [NEW-P0-2 解決] 部分失敗差分の自動返還（二重返金を排除し1回のみ実行）
      const failedCount = itemsToGenerate.length - generatedResults.length;
      if (failedCount > 0) {
        if (user && reservedUser) {
          const { data: refundData } = await supabaseAdmin.rpc("reserve_or_refund_quota", {
            p_user_id: user.id,
            p_item_count: failedCount,
            p_is_refund: true,
            p_request_id: `${requestId}_generate_partial_refund`,
          });
          if (refundData?.remaining !== undefined) quotaRemaining = refundData.remaining;
        } else if (!user && reservedGuest) {
          await supabaseAdmin.rpc("consume_guest_quota", {
            p_ip: clientIp,
            p_count: -failedCount,
            p_daily_limit: GUEST_DAILY_LIMIT,
          }).catch(() => {});
          refundGuestMemory(clientIp, failedCount);
        }
      }
      // 正常に精算完了したため予約フラグをクリア
      reservedUser = false;
      reservedGuest = false;

      // [P0-5 修正] 共有辞書キャッシュへの保存:
      // verified: true で初期保存し、同綴異義語キーと完全整合させ、EdgeRuntime.waitUntil で確実に保存
      const cacheRows = generatedResults
        .filter((card) => {
          const orig = itemsToGenerate.find(it => it.reqIndex === card.reqIndex);
          const hasCustom = orig?.targetSenseOrMeaning && !DUMMY_OCR_SENSES.has(orig.targetSenseOrMeaning.trim());
          return !hasCustom && !orig?.contextSentence && !hasDomainContext && card.word && card.meanings?.length > 0;
        })
        .map((card) => {
          const hIdx = card.homographIndex || 1;
          const wk = makeWordKey(card.word, pairCode, hIdx);
          return {
            lang: sLang,
            word: card.word,
            homograph_index: hIdx,
            word_key: wk,
            card_data: card,
            hit_count: 1,
            // [P1-① 解決] verified=true は学術的裏付け（certain かつ 語根タグ非空、または Wiktionary整合）に厳格限定
            verified: Boolean(
              card.word &&
              card.meanings?.length > 0 &&
              card.etymology &&
              ((card.etymologyConfidence === 'certain' && Array.isArray(card.etymologyTags) && card.etymologyTags.length > 0) || card.wiktGrounded === true)
            ),
          };
        });

      if (cacheRows.length > 0) {
        // [P1-7 解決] verified: false の未検証キャッシュ行が存在しても最新の完全カードで確実に上書き更新
        const cachePromise = supabaseAdmin
          .from("global_dictionary_cache")
          .upsert(cacheRows, { onConflict: "lang,word_key", ignoreDuplicates: false });

        // [P0-5 修正] レスポンス後もEdgeランタイムで確実にタスクを完了
        if (typeof (globalThis as any).EdgeRuntime?.waitUntil === "function") {
          (globalThis as any).EdgeRuntime.waitUntil(cachePromise);
        } else {
          cachePromise.catch(() => {});
        }
      }
    } // [P0-4 修正] if (itemsToGenerate.length > 0) ブロックの閉じカッコ

    // [P1-8 解決] キャッシュ hit_count 更新などの非同期処理をレスポンスブロックから解放しバックグラウンド実行
    if (cacheUpdatePromises.length > 0) {
      const bgUpdates = Promise.allSettled(cacheUpdatePromises);
      if (typeof (globalThis as any).EdgeRuntime?.waitUntil === "function") {
        (globalThis as any).EdgeRuntime.waitUntil(bgUpdates);
      } else {
        bgUpdates.catch(() => {});
      }
    }

    // 全結果をマージ
    const finalItems = [...cachedResults, ...generatedResults];

    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        items: finalItems,
        usedModel,
        cachedCount: cachedResults.length,
        generatedCount: generatedResults.length,
        quotaRemaining,
      }),
      { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
    );
  } catch (err: any) {
    // [P0-4 解決] 予期せぬ例外発生時も、予約済みクォータ（単語生成、OCR、長文抽出）を確実に自動補償返金
    if (supabaseAdmin) {
      if (itemsToGenerate.length > 0) {
        if (user && reservedUser) {
          try {
            await supabaseAdmin.rpc("reserve_or_refund_quota", {
              p_user_id: user.id,
              p_item_count: itemsToGenerate.length,
              p_is_refund: true,
              p_request_id: `${requestId}_generate`,
            });
          } catch {}
        } else if (!user && reservedGuest) {
          try {
            await supabaseAdmin.rpc("consume_guest_quota", {
              p_ip: clientIp,
              p_count: -itemsToGenerate.length,
              p_daily_limit: GUEST_DAILY_LIMIT,
            });
            refundGuestMemory(clientIp, itemsToGenerate.length);
          } catch {}
        }
      }

      if (reservedOcrUser && user) {
        try {
          await supabaseAdmin.rpc("reserve_or_refund_quota", {
            p_user_id: user.id,
            p_item_count: 1,
            p_is_refund: true,
            p_request_id: `${requestId}_ocr`,
          });
        } catch {}
      } else if (reservedOcrGuest && !user) {
        try {
          await supabaseAdmin.rpc("consume_guest_quota", {
            p_ip: clientIp,
            p_count: -1,
            p_daily_limit: GUEST_DAILY_LIMIT,
          });
          refundGuestMemory(clientIp, 1);
        } catch {}
      }

      if (reservedExtractUser && user) {
        try {
          await supabaseAdmin.rpc("reserve_or_refund_quota", {
            p_user_id: user.id,
            p_item_count: 1,
            p_is_refund: true,
            p_request_id: `${requestId}_extract`,
          });
        } catch {}
      } else if (reservedExtractGuest && !user) {
        try {
          await supabaseAdmin.rpc("consume_guest_quota", {
            p_ip: clientIp,
            p_count: -1,
            p_daily_limit: GUEST_DAILY_LIMIT,
          });
          refundGuestMemory(clientIp, 1);
        } catch {}
      }
    }
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message || "Unknown internal error" }), {
      status: 500,
      headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    });
  }
});
```

### File: `supabase/functions/stripe-webhook/index.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * Vocab Vault — Supabase Edge Function: stripe-webhook
 * 本番仕様: process_stripe_webhook_atomic による完全アトミック処理
 * 順序逆転ガード、invoice.payment_failed (Grace Period)、invoice.paid 対応
 */
import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.177.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2.39.8";
import Stripe from "https://esm.sh/stripe@14.18.0?target=deno";

serve(async (req) => {
  try {
    const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL") ?? "";
    const supabaseServiceKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") ?? "";
    const stripeSecretKey = Deno.env.get("STRIPE_SECRET_KEY") ?? "";
    const stripeWebhookSecret = Deno.env.get("STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET") ?? "";

    if (!stripeSecretKey || !stripeWebhookSecret) {
      return new Response("Webhook secret not configured", { status: 500 });
    }

    const signature = req.headers.get("stripe-signature");
    if (!signature) {
      return new Response("Missing signature header", { status: 400 });
    }

    // [DoS/OOM 防衛] Content-Length に依存せず、req.body をストリームで直接読み込み 256KB 超過で即座に中断
    const MAX_WEBHOOK_BYTES = 256 * 1024;
    let body = "";
    if (req.body) {
      const reader = req.body.getReader();
      const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
      let totalBytes = 0;
      try {
        while (true) {
          const { done, value } = await reader.read();
          if (done) break;
          if (value) {
            totalBytes += value.byteLength;
            if (totalBytes > MAX_WEBHOOK_BYTES) {
              await reader.cancel("Payload too large");
              return new Response("Payload too large", { status: 413 });
            }
            chunks.push(value);
          }
        }
      } finally {
        reader.releaseLock();
      }
      const merged = new Uint8Array(totalBytes);
      let offset = 0;
      for (const chunk of chunks) {
        merged.set(chunk, offset);
        offset += chunk.byteLength;
      }
      body = new TextDecoder("utf-8").decode(merged);
    } else {
      body = await req.text();
      if (body.length > MAX_WEBHOOK_BYTES) {
        return new Response("Payload too large", { status: 413 });
      }
    }

    const stripe = new Stripe(stripeSecretKey, {
      apiVersion: "2023-10-16",
      httpClient: Stripe.createFetchHttpClient(),
    });

    let event: Stripe.Event;
    try {
      event = await stripe.webhooks.constructEventAsync(body, signature, stripeWebhookSecret);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(`Webhook signature verification failed: ${err.message}`);
      return new Response(`Webhook Error: ${err.message}`, { status: 400 });
    }

    const supabaseAdmin = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseServiceKey);
    const eventCreated = event.created || Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);

    let userId: string | null = null;
    let customerId: string | null = null;
    let subscriptionId: string | null = null;
    let plan = "free";
    let subStatus = "inactive";
    let cancelAtPeriodEnd = false;
    let periodEndIso: string | null = null;
    let gracePeriodUntilIso: string | null = null;

    switch (event.type) {
      case "checkout.session.completed": {
        const session = event.data.object as Stripe.Checkout.Session;

        // [P1-3 解決] 即時決済（paid）でない場合はProに昇格させない（未入金ただ乗り防止）
        if (session.payment_status !== "paid") {
          console.warn(`[Stripe] Checkout session not paid: ${session.id}, status=${session.payment_status}`);
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ received: true, ignored: true, reason: "payment_status_not_paid" }), {
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            status: 200,
          });
        }

        userId = session.client_reference_id || session.metadata?.supabase_user_id || null;
        customerId = (session.customer as string) || null;
        subscriptionId = (session.subscription as string) || null;
        plan = "pro";
        subStatus = "active";
        cancelAtPeriodEnd = false;

        if (subscriptionId) {
          try {
            const sub = await stripe.subscriptions.retrieve(subscriptionId);
            subStatus = sub.status;
            if (sub.current_period_end) {
              periodEndIso = new Date(sub.current_period_end * 1000).toISOString();
            }
          } catch (e: any) {
            console.warn(`[Stripe] Could not fetch sub ${subscriptionId}:`, e.message);
          }
        }
        break;
      }

      case "customer.subscription.updated": {
        const subscription = event.data.object as Stripe.Subscription;
        userId = (subscription.metadata?.supabase_user_id as string) || null;
        customerId = (subscription.customer as string) || null;
        subscriptionId = subscription.id;
        subStatus = subscription.status;
        cancelAtPeriodEnd = Boolean(subscription.cancel_at_period_end);
        if (subscription.current_period_end) {
          periodEndIso = new Date(subscription.current_period_end * 1000).toISOString();
        }

        // active または trialing なら Pro
        if (subStatus === "active" || subStatus === "trialing") {
          plan = "pro";
        } else if (subStatus === "past_due") {
          // past_due の場合は 3 日間の猶予期間を付与して Pro を維持
          plan = "pro";
          gracePeriodUntilIso = new Date(Date.now() + 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
        } else {
          plan = "free";
        }
        break;
      }

      case "customer.subscription.deleted": {
        const subscription = event.data.object as Stripe.Subscription;
        userId = (subscription.metadata?.supabase_user_id as string) || null;
        customerId = (subscription.customer as string) || null;
        subscriptionId = subscription.id;
        plan = "free";
        subStatus = "canceled";
        cancelAtPeriodEnd = false;
        periodEndIso = null;
        break;
      }

      case "invoice.payment_failed": {
        const invoice = event.data.object as Stripe.Invoice;
        userId = (invoice.subscription_details?.metadata?.supabase_user_id as string) || (invoice.metadata?.supabase_user_id as string) || null;
        customerId = (invoice.customer as string) || null;
        subscriptionId = (invoice.subscription as string) || null;
        subStatus = "past_due";
        plan = "pro";
        // 支払い失敗時は請求書作成日時（初回失敗日）を基準として3日間の猶予期間を算定（再試行による延長を防止）
        const firstFailedTs = invoice.created ? (invoice.created * 1000) : Date.now();
        gracePeriodUntilIso = new Date(firstFailedTs + 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
        if (invoice.lines?.data?.[0]?.period?.end) {
          periodEndIso = new Date(invoice.lines.data[0].period.end * 1000).toISOString();
        }
        break;
      }

      case "invoice.paid": {
        const invoice = event.data.object as Stripe.Invoice;
        userId = (invoice.subscription_details?.metadata?.supabase_user_id as string) || (invoice.metadata?.supabase_user_id as string) || null;
        customerId = (invoice.customer as string) || null;
        subscriptionId = (invoice.subscription as string) || null;
        subStatus = "active";
        plan = "pro";
        gracePeriodUntilIso = null; // 支払い成功により猶予期間クリア
        if (invoice.lines?.data?.[0]?.period?.end) {
          periodEndIso = new Date(invoice.lines.data[0].period.end * 1000).toISOString();
        }
        break;
      }

      case "invoice.payment_action_required": {
        // 3Dセキュア等の追加カード認証が必要な場合: 猶予期間を付与して一時的にPro維持
        const invoice = event.data.object as Stripe.Invoice;
        userId = (invoice.subscription_details?.metadata?.supabase_user_id as string) || (invoice.metadata?.supabase_user_id as string) || null;
        customerId = (invoice.customer as string) || null;
        subscriptionId = (invoice.subscription as string) || null;
        subStatus = "past_due";
        plan = "pro";
        gracePeriodUntilIso = new Date(Date.now() + 2 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(); // 2日間猶予
        break;
      }

      case "customer.subscription.trial_will_end": {
        // トライアル終了前の通知受領（状態はactiveを維持し、解約予約フラグや期間終了を正確に反映）
        const subscription = event.data.object as Stripe.Subscription;
        userId = (subscription.metadata?.supabase_user_id as string) || null;
        customerId = (subscription.customer as string) || null;
        subscriptionId = subscription.id;
        subStatus = subscription.status || "trialing";
        plan = "pro";
        cancelAtPeriodEnd = Boolean(subscription.cancel_at_period_end);
        if (subscription.current_period_end) {
          periodEndIso = new Date(subscription.current_period_end * 1000).toISOString();
        }
        break;
      }

      case "charge.dispute.created": {
        // チャージバック発生時: 調査のため即時警告ログと無料プラン差し戻し
        const dispute = event.data.object as Stripe.Dispute;
        customerId = (dispute as any).customer || null;
        if (dispute.charge) {
          try {
            const ch = await stripe.charges.retrieve(dispute.charge as string);
            if (!customerId) customerId = (ch.customer as string) || null;
            if (!userId) userId = (ch.metadata?.supabase_user_id as string) || null;
          } catch (e: any) {
            console.warn(`[Stripe Dispute] Could not retrieve charge ${dispute.charge}:`, e.message);
          }
        }
        if (!customerId && (dispute as any).payment_intent) {
          try {
            const pi = await stripe.paymentIntents.retrieve((dispute as any).payment_intent as string);
            if (!customerId) customerId = (pi.customer as string) || null;
            if (!userId) userId = (pi.metadata?.supabase_user_id as string) || null;
          } catch (e: any) {
            console.warn(`[Stripe Dispute] Could not retrieve payment_intent:`, e.message);
          }
        }
        console.warn(`[Stripe CRITICAL] Charge dispute created: ${dispute.id} for customer ${customerId}, user ${userId}`);
        subStatus = "unpaid";
        plan = "free";
        break;
      }

      default:
        console.log(`[Stripe] Unhandled event type: ${event.type}`);
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ received: true, ignored: true }), {
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          status: 200,
        });
    }

    // サブスクリプション変更系イベントで、同一秒着信や前後関係が不明瞭な場合に備えStripe最新状態を直接再照会
    if (subscriptionId && ["customer.subscription.updated", "invoice.payment_failed"].includes(event.type)) {
      try {
        const liveSub = await stripe.subscriptions.retrieve(subscriptionId);
        if (liveSub && liveSub.status) {
          subStatus = liveSub.status;
          cancelAtPeriodEnd = Boolean(liveSub.cancel_at_period_end);
          if (liveSub.current_period_end) {
            periodEndIso = new Date(liveSub.current_period_end * 1000).toISOString();
          }
          if (liveSub.status === "active" || liveSub.status === "trialing") {
            plan = "pro";
          } else if (liveSub.status === "past_due") {
            plan = "pro";
          } else {
            plan = "free";
          }
        }
      } catch (e: any) {
        console.warn(`[Stripe Sync] Failed to retrieve latest subscription ${subscriptionId}:`, e.message);
      }
    }

    // [P0-3 解決] 単一トランザクション内で stripe_events 記録 ＆ 順序逆転ガード ＆ profiles 更新を実行
    const { data: result, error: rpcError } = await supabaseAdmin.rpc("process_stripe_webhook_atomic", {
      p_event_id: event.id,
      p_event_type: event.type,
      p_event_created: eventCreated,
      p_user_id: userId,
      p_stripe_customer_id: customerId,
      p_stripe_subscription_id: subscriptionId,
      p_plan: plan,
      p_subscription_status: subStatus,
      p_cancel_at_period_end: cancelAtPeriodEnd,
      p_current_period_end: periodEndIso,
      p_grace_period_until: gracePeriodUntilIso,
    });

    if (rpcError) {
      console.error(`[Stripe Webhook RPC Error] ${rpcError.message}`);
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: rpcError.message }), {
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        status: 500,
      });
    }

    console.log(`[Stripe Webhook Processed] Event: ${event.id} -> Result:`, result);

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ received: true, result }), {
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      status: 200,
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error(`Webhook processing error: ${err.message}`);
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message }), {
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      status: 500,
    });
  }
});
```

```typescript
/**
 * Vocab Vault — Supabase Edge Function: delete-account
 * 本番仕様: GDPR / 法令準拠のアカウント完全抹消 ＆ Stripe サブスクリプション即時解約
 * 幽霊課金（Phantom Billing）の完全防止
 */
import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.177.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2.39.8";
import Stripe from "https://esm.sh/stripe@14.18.0?target=deno";

const corsHeaders = {
  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type",
};

serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response("ok", { headers: corsHeaders });
  }

  try {
    const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL") ?? "";
    const supabaseAnonKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY") ?? "";
    const supabaseServiceKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") ?? "";
    const stripeSecretKey = Deno.env.get("STRIPE_SECRET_KEY") ?? "";

    const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization");
    if (!authHeader) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Missing authorization header" }), {
        status: 401,
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    // 1. ユーザー認証の確認
    const supabaseUserClient = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseAnonKey, {
      global: { headers: { Authorization: authHeader } },
    });
    const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabaseUserClient.auth.getUser();
    if (authError || !user) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Unauthorized" }), {
        status: 401,
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    const supabaseAdmin = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseServiceKey);

    // 2. Stripe サブスクリプション情報の取得
    const { data: profile } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from("profiles")
      .select("stripe_customer_id, stripe_subscription_id, plan")
      .eq("id", user.id)
      .single();

    // 3. [P0-4 解決] Stripe サブスクリプションの即時解約（幽霊課金防止）
    // stripe_customer_id または stripe_subscription_id から紐づく全契約を確実にキャンセル
    if (stripeSecretKey && (profile?.stripe_customer_id || profile?.stripe_subscription_id)) {
      try {
        const stripe = new Stripe(stripeSecretKey, {
          apiVersion: "2023-10-16",
          httpClient: Stripe.createFetchHttpClient(),
        });

        const failedCancellations: string[] = [];
        if (profile?.stripe_customer_id) {
          const subs = await stripe.subscriptions.list({
            customer: profile.stripe_customer_id,
            status: "all",
            limit: 100,
          });
          for (const sub of subs.data) {
            if (["active", "trialing", "past_due", "unpaid"].includes(sub.status)) {
              try {
                console.log(`[Account Deletion] Canceling active Stripe sub: ${sub.id} (status: ${sub.status})`);
                await stripe.subscriptions.cancel(sub.id);
              } catch (oneErr: any) {
                if (!oneErr.message?.includes("No such subscription") && !oneErr.message?.includes("resource_missing")) {
                  failedCancellations.push(`${sub.id}: ${oneErr.message}`);
                }
              }
            }
          }
        } else if (profile?.stripe_subscription_id) {
          try {
            console.log(`[Account Deletion] Canceling Stripe subscription directly: ${profile.stripe_subscription_id}`);
            await stripe.subscriptions.cancel(profile.stripe_subscription_id);
          } catch (oneErr: any) {
            if (!oneErr.message?.includes("No such subscription") && !oneErr.message?.includes("resource_missing")) {
              failedCancellations.push(`${profile.stripe_subscription_id}: ${oneErr.message}`);
            }
          }
        }

        if (failedCancellations.length > 0) {
          return new Response(
            JSON.stringify({
              error: `Stripe定期課金の一部解約に失敗しました（${failedCancellations.length}件）。幽霊課金防止のため退会処理を中断しました。カスタマーポータルより解約後に再度お試しください。`,
              details: failedCancellations,
            }),
            { status: 502, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
          );
        }
        // [レースコンディション完全防止] Stripe解約完了をDBプロファイルに即時反映
        // これにより delete_user_account RPCの ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION 例外を確実に回避
        await supabaseAdmin
          .from("profiles")
          .update({
            subscription_status: "canceled",
            plan: "free",
            cancel_at_period_end: false,
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          })
          .eq("id", user.id);
      } catch (stripeErr: any) {
        console.warn(`[Account Deletion Warning] Failed to cancel Stripe sub: ${stripeErr.message}`);
        // サブスクが既に解約済み（resource_missing）等のエラー以外でアクティブ課金が残っている恐れがある場合は安全優先でエラー
        if (!stripeErr.message?.includes("No such subscription") && !stripeErr.message?.includes("resource_missing")) {
          return new Response(
            JSON.stringify({ error: `Stripe定期課金の解約処理中にエラーが発生しました (${stripeErr.message})。幽霊課金防止のため退会処理を中断しました。カスタマーポータルより解約後に再度お試しください。` }),
            { status: 502, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
          );
        }
      }
    }

    // 4. Supabase DB データおよび auth.users の完全抹消
    // トランザクション・整合性保護: service_role 権限でアトミックな delete_user_account RPC を実行
    let dbWiped = false;
    try {
      const { error: rpcErr } = await supabaseAdmin.rpc("delete_user_account", {
        p_user_id: user.id,
      });
      if (!rpcErr) {
        dbWiped = true;
      } else {
        console.warn(`[Account Deletion RPC Warning] ${rpcErr.message}`);
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.warn(`[Account Deletion RPC Exception] ${e.message}`);
    }

    if (!dbWiped) {
      // フォールバック: service_role による全テーブルの確実な抹消
      await Promise.all([
        supabaseAdmin.from("user_vocab_entries").delete().eq("user_id", user.id),
        supabaseAdmin.from("user_tombstones").delete().eq("user_id", user.id),
        supabaseAdmin.from("user_lang_watermarks").delete().eq("user_id", user.id),
        supabaseAdmin.from("user_feedbacks").delete().eq("user_id", user.id),
        supabaseAdmin.from("user_app_settings").delete().eq("user_id", user.id),
      ]);
      await supabaseAdmin.from("profiles").delete().eq("id", user.id);
    }

    // auth.users から物理削除（カスケード削除も発火）
    const { error: deleteUserErr } = await supabaseAdmin.auth.admin.deleteUser(user.id);
    if (deleteUserErr && !deleteUserErr.message.includes("User not found")) {
      console.error(`[Account Deletion Error] Failed to delete auth user: ${deleteUserErr.message}`);
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: deleteUserErr.message }), {
        status: 500,
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    console.log(`[Account Deletion] User ${user.id} and all related data completely wiped.`);

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, message: "Account and all data wiped permanently" }), {
      headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      status: 200,
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error(`[Account Deletion Internal Error] ${err.message}`);
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message || "Internal server error" }), {
      status: 500,
      headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    });
  }
});
```

```typescript
/**
 * Vocab Vault — Supabase Edge Function: stripe-checkout
 * ステップ6: Stripe サブスクリプション決済セッション生成
 */
import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.177.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2.39.8";
import Stripe from "https://esm.sh/stripe@14.18.0?target=deno";

const corsHeaders = {
  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type",
};

serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response("ok", { headers: corsHeaders });
  }

  try {
    const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL") ?? "";
    const supabaseServiceKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") ?? "";
    const stripeSecretKey = Deno.env.get("STRIPE_SECRET_KEY") ?? "";

    if (!stripeSecretKey) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Stripe secret key is not configured" }), {
        status: 500,
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization");
    if (!authHeader) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Unauthorized" }), {
        status: 401,
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    const supabaseAdmin = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseServiceKey);
    const token = authHeader.replace("Bearer ", "");
    const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabaseAdmin.auth.getUser(token);

    if (authError || !user) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Invalid token" }), {
        status: 401,
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    const body = await req.json();
    const { priceId = "price_pro_monthly", returnUrl, currency = "jpy", interval = "month" } = body;

    // [セキュリティ修正] Open Redirect 防止: 許可されたオリジンまたは https URL のみ許可
    const ALLOWED_ORIGINS = [
      "https://vocabvault.app",
      "https://kohei519y-arch.github.io",
      "http://localhost:3000",
      "http://localhost:8080",
      "http://127.0.0.1:8080",
    ];
    let safeReturnUrl = "https://kohei519y-arch.github.io/vocab-vault/";
    if (typeof returnUrl === "string" && returnUrl.trim()) {
      try {
        const parsedUrl = new URL(returnUrl.trim());
        const isAllowedVercel = /^https:\/\/vocab-vault(?:-[a-z0-9-]+)?\.vercel\.app$/i.test(parsedUrl.origin);
        if (ALLOWED_ORIGINS.includes(parsedUrl.origin) || isAllowedVercel) {
          safeReturnUrl = `${parsedUrl.origin}${parsedUrl.pathname}`;
        }
      } catch {
        // 無効なURLはデフォルトへフォールバック
      }
    }

    const stripe = new Stripe(stripeSecretKey, {
      apiVersion: "2023-10-16",
      httpClient: Stripe.createFetchHttpClient(),
    });

    // ユーザープロファイル確認（既存の契約状態とstripe_customer_idがあるか）
    const { data: profile } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from("profiles")
      .select("stripe_customer_id, email, plan, subscription_status")
      .eq("id", user.id)
      .single();

    if (profile?.plan === "pro" && ["active", "trialing"].includes(profile?.subscription_status || "")) {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ error: "既に有効なProプラン契約が存在します。設定画面の契約管理ポータルよりご確認ください。" }),
        { status: 400, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
      );
    }

    let customerId = profile?.stripe_customer_id;

    if (!customerId) {
      const customer = await stripe.customers.create({
        email: user.email || profile?.email,
        metadata: { supabase_user_id: user.id },
      });
      customerId = customer.id;
      await supabaseAdmin
        .from("profiles")
        .update({ stripe_customer_id: customerId })
        .eq("id", user.id);
    } else {
      // Stripe 側に既に active / trialing のサブスクリプションが存在しないか直接検証（Webhook遅延時の二重課金防止）
      const existingSubs = await stripe.subscriptions.list({
        customer: customerId,
        status: "all",
        limit: 10,
      });
      const activeSub = existingSubs.data.find((s: any) => ["active", "trialing"].includes(s.status));
      if (activeSub) {
        return new Response(
          JSON.stringify({ error: "既に有効なStripeサブスクリプションが存在します。設定画面の契約管理ポータルよりご確認ください。" }),
          { status: 400, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
        );
      }
    }

    const envPriceIdMonthly = Deno.env.get("STRIPE_PRO_PRICE_ID") ?? "";
    const envPriceIdYearly = Deno.env.get("STRIPE_PRO_PRICE_ID_YEARLY") ?? "";
    
    // クライアント主導のPriceID改ざん防止 & マルチカレンシー動的生成
    let selectedPriceId: string | null = null;
    const isYearly = interval === "year" || priceId === "price_pro_yearly" || (envPriceIdYearly && priceId === envPriceIdYearly);
    const isUsd = (currency || "").toLowerCase() === "usd";

    if (isYearly && envPriceIdYearly && priceId === envPriceIdYearly) {
      selectedPriceId = envPriceIdYearly;
    } else if (!isYearly && envPriceIdMonthly && priceId === envPriceIdMonthly) {
      selectedPriceId = envPriceIdMonthly;
    }

    const unitAmount = isUsd
      ? (isYearly ? 3900 : 399) // $39.00 / $3.99
      : (isYearly ? 4800 : 480); // ¥4,800 / ¥480
    const currencyCode = isUsd ? "usd" : "jpy";
    const productName = isUsd
      ? (isYearly ? "Vocab Vault Pro (Annual Plan)" : "Vocab Vault Pro (Monthly Plan)")
      : (isYearly ? "Vocab Vault Pro プラン (年額)" : "Vocab Vault Pro プラン (月額)");
    const productDesc = isUsd
      ? "Unlimited generative AI etymology, 2,000 academic roots catalog, real-time cross-device sync & full OCR extraction."
      : "AI新規生成・概念史深掘り無制限、長文/画像OCR抽出無制限、複数端末リアルタイム同期";

    const lineItems = selectedPriceId
      ? [{ price: selectedPriceId, quantity: 1 }]
      : [
          {
            price_data: {
              currency: currencyCode,
              product_data: {
                name: productName,
                description: productDesc,
              },
              unit_amount: unitAmount,
              recurring: { interval: isYearly ? "year" : "month" },
            },
            quantity: 1,
          },
        ];

    // Stripe Checkout Session 作成
    const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create({
      customer: customerId,
      client_reference_id: user.id,
      payment_method_types: ["card"],
      mode: "subscription",
      line_items: lineItems,
      subscription_data: {
        metadata: { supabase_user_id: user.id, plan: "pro" },
      },
      metadata: { supabase_user_id: user.id, plan: "pro" },
      success_url: `${safeReturnUrl}?checkout=success&session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}`,
      cancel_url: `${safeReturnUrl}?checkout=cancel`,
    });

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ url: session.url }), {
      headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message || "Stripe Checkout creation failed" }), {
      status: 500,
      headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    });
  }
});
```

```typescript
/**
 * Vocab Vault — Supabase Edge Function: stripe-portal
 * Proプラン契約管理・解約・請求書確認用 Stripe Billing Portal Session 生成
 */
import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.177.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2.39.8";
import Stripe from "https://esm.sh/stripe@14.18.0?target=deno";

const corsHeaders = {
  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type",
};

const ALLOWED_ORIGINS = [
  "https://vocabvault.app",
  "https://kohei519y-arch.github.io",
  "http://localhost:3000",
  "http://localhost:8080",
  "http://127.0.0.1:8080",
];

serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response("ok", { headers: corsHeaders });
  }

  try {
    const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL") ?? "";
    const supabaseServiceKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") ?? "";
    const stripeSecretKey = Deno.env.get("STRIPE_SECRET_KEY") ?? "";

    if (!stripeSecretKey || !supabaseUrl || !supabaseServiceKey) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Server configuration missing" }), {
        status: 500,
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization");
    if (!authHeader || !authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Unauthorized" }), {
        status: 401,
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    const supabaseAdmin = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseServiceKey);
    const token = authHeader.replace("Bearer ", "");
    const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabaseAdmin.auth.getUser(token);

    if (authError || !user) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Invalid token" }), {
        status: 401,
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    let safeReturnUrl = "https://kohei519y-arch.github.io/vocab-vault/";
    if (typeof body?.returnUrl === "string" && body.returnUrl.trim()) {
      try {
        const parsed = new URL(body.returnUrl.trim());
        const isAllowedVercel = /^https:\/\/vocab-vault(?:-[a-z0-9-]+)?\.vercel\.app$/i.test(parsed.origin);
        if (ALLOWED_ORIGINS.includes(parsed.origin) || isAllowedVercel) {
          safeReturnUrl = `${parsed.origin}${parsed.pathname}`;
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    const { data: profile } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from("profiles")
      .select("stripe_customer_id")
      .eq("id", user.id)
      .single();

    if (!profile?.stripe_customer_id) {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ error: "Stripeの契約顧客情報が見つかりません。" }),
        { status: 400, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
      );
    }

    const stripe = new Stripe(stripeSecretKey, {
      apiVersion: "2023-10-16",
      httpClient: Stripe.createFetchHttpClient(),
    });

    const portalSession = await stripe.billingPortal.sessions.create({
      customer: profile.stripe_customer_id,
      return_url: safeReturnUrl,
    });

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ url: portalSession.url }), {
      status: 200,
      headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({ error: err.message || "Failed to create portal session" }),
      { status: 500, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
    );
  }
});
```

```typescript
/**
 * Vocab Vault — Supabase Edge Function: feedback
 * ステップ0: フィードバック・ヒアリング応募受付
 */
import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.177.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2.39.8";

const corsHeaders = {
  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type",
};

serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response("ok", { headers: corsHeaders });
  }

  try {
    const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL") ?? "";
    const supabaseServiceKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") ?? "";
    const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseServiceKey);

    // 認証情報があればユーザーID取得（匿名でも可）
    let userId: string | null = null;
    const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization");
    if (authHeader) {
      const token = authHeader.replace("Bearer ", "");
      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser(token);
      if (user) userId = user.id;
    }

    const body = await req.json();
    const { category, rating, content, email, willingnessToPay, appVersion, activeLang } = body;

    const { data, error } = await supabase.from("user_feedbacks").insert({
      user_id: userId,
      category: category || "opinion",
      rating: Number(rating) || 5,
      content: content || "",
      email: email || null,
      willingness_to_pay: willingnessToPay || null,
      app_version: appVersion || "unknown",
      active_lang: activeLang || "en",
    }).select();

    if (error) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: error.message }), {
        status: 500,
        headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, feedback: data }), {
      headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: err.message || "Internal error" }), {
      status: 500,
      headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    });
  }
});
```

```objc
#import <Cocoa/Cocoa.h>

    [self.webView setUIDelegate:self];

    [appMenu addItemWithTitle:@"About Vocab Vault" action:@selector(orderFrontStandardAboutPanel:) keyEquivalent:@""];

    [appMenuItem setSubmenu:appMenu];

    [windowMenu addItemWithTitle:@"Zoom" action:@selector(performZoom:) keyEquivalent:@""];

    // 4. ロード対象URLの選定 (アプリ内バンドルWebリソース直接ロード)
    NSBundle *mainBundle = [NSBundle mainBundle];
    NSString *bundleResPath = [mainBundle resourcePath];
    NSString *resDev = [bundleResPath stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"web/dev.html"];
    NSString *resIndex = [bundleResPath stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"web/index.html"];

    NSFileManager *fm = [NSFileManager defaultManager];
    NSURL *targetUrl = nil;
    NSURL *readAccessUrl = nil;

    if ([fm fileExistsAtPath:resDev]) {
        targetUrl = [NSURL fileURLWithPath:resDev];
        readAccessUrl = [NSURL fileURLWithPath:[bundleResPath stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"web"]];
    } else if ([fm fileExistsAtPath:resIndex]) {
        targetUrl = [NSURL fileURLWithPath:resIndex];
        readAccessUrl = [NSURL fileURLWithPath:[bundleResPath stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"web"]];
    } else {
        targetUrl = [NSURL URLWithString:@"https://kohei519y-arch.github.io/vocab-vault/"];
    }

    if (readAccessUrl && targetUrl.isFileURL) {
        [self.webView loadFileURL:targetUrl allowingReadAccessToURL:readAccessUrl];
    } else if (targetUrl) {
        [self.webView loadRequest:[NSURLRequest requestWithURL:targetUrl]];
    }

    [self.window makeKeyAndOrderFront:nil];
    [NSApp activateIgnoringOtherApps:YES];

// 6. ネイティブファイル保存 (JSON保存 / PNG画像保存 / NSSavePanel 対応)
- (void)userContentController:(WKUserContentController *)userContentController didReceiveScriptMessage:(WKScriptMessage *)message {
    if ([message.name isEqualToString:@"nativeSave"]) {
        NSDictionary *body = message.body;
        if (![body isKindOfClass:[NSDictionary class]]) return;
        NSString *filename = [body[@"filename"] isKindOfClass:[NSString class]] ? body[@"filename"] : @"vocab_vault_backup.json";
        NSString *content = [body[@"content"] isKindOfClass:[NSString class]] ? body[@"content"] : nil;
        NSString *base64 = [body[@"base64"] isKindOfClass:[NSString class]] ? body[@"base64"] : nil;
        BOOL isBase64DataUrl = [body[@"isBase64DataUrl"] respondsToSelector:@selector(boolValue)] ? [body[@"isBase64DataUrl"] boolValue] : NO;

        NSSavePanel *savePanel = [NSSavePanel savePanel];
        [savePanel setNameFieldStringValue:filename];
        NSString *ext = [filename pathExtension];
        if (ext.length > 0) {
#pragma clang diagnostic push
#pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wdeprecated-declarations"
            [savePanel setAllowedFileTypes:@[ext]];
#pragma clang diagnostic pop
        }
        [savePanel beginSheetModalForWindow:self.window completionHandler:^(NSModalResponse result) {
            if (result == NSModalResponseOK) {
                NSURL *saveUrl = [savePanel URL];
                if (saveUrl) {
                    NSError *err = nil;
                    if (base64.length > 0) {
                        NSData *binData = [[NSData alloc] initWithBase64EncodedString:base64 options:NSDataBase64DecodingIgnoreUnknownCharacters];
                        [binData writeToURL:saveUrl options:NSDataWritingAtomic error:&err];
                    } else if ((isBase64DataUrl || [content hasPrefix:@"data:"]) && content != nil) {
                        NSRange commaRange = [content rangeOfString:@","];
                        NSString *b64Str = (commaRange.location != NSNotFound) ? [content substringFromIndex:commaRange.location + 1] : content;
                        NSData *imgData = [[NSData alloc] initWithBase64EncodedString:b64Str options:NSDataBase64DecodingIgnoreUnknownCharacters];
                        [imgData writeToURL:saveUrl options:NSDataWritingAtomic error:&err];
                    } else if (content != nil) {
                        [content writeToURL:saveUrl atomically:YES encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding error:&err];
                    }
                }
            }
        }];
        return;
    }
    if ([message.name isEqualToString:@"nativePrint"]) {
        NSPrintOperation *op = [self.webView printOperationWithPrintInfo:[NSPrintInfo sharedPrintInfo]];
        [op setShowsPrintPanel:YES];
        [op runOperationModalForWindow:self.window delegate:nil didRunSelector:NULL contextInfo:NULL];
        return;
    }
    if ([message.name isEqualToString:@"nativeCheckForUpdates"]) {
        [self checkForUpdates:nil];
        return;
    }
}

- (void)applicationWillTerminate:(NSNotification *)notification {
    [self.webView.configuration.userContentController removeScriptMessageHandlerForName:@"nativeSave"];
    [self.webView.configuration.userContentController removeScriptMessageHandlerForName:@"nativePrint"];
    [self.webView.configuration.userContentController removeScriptMessageHandlerForName:@"nativeCheckForUpdates"];
}

// 6.5 バージョン確認・自動アップデート通知 (GitHub Releases API)
- (void)checkForUpdates:(id)sender {
    NSString *currentVer = [[NSBundle mainBundle] objectForInfoDictionaryKey:@"CFBundleShortVersionString"] ?: @"2.4.0";
    NSURL *url = [NSURL URLWithString:@"https://api.github.com/repos/kohei519y-arch/vocab-vault/releases/latest"];
    NSMutableURLRequest *req = [NSMutableURLRequest requestWithURL:url];
    [req setValue:@"VocabVault-MacApp" forHTTPHeaderField:@"User-Agent"];
    [req setTimeoutInterval:10.0];

    NSURLSessionDataTask *task = [[NSURLSession sharedSession] dataTaskWithRequest:req completionHandler:^(NSData *data, NSURLResponse *response, NSError *error) {
        dispatch_async(dispatch_get_main_queue(), ^{
            if (error || !data) {
                if (sender != nil) {
                    NSAlert *alert = [[NSAlert alloc] init];
                    [alert setMessageText:@"アップデート確認エラー"];
                    [alert setInformativeText:@"サーバーとの通信に失敗しました。ネットワーク接続を確認してください。"];
                    [alert addButtonWithTitle:@"OK"];
                    [alert beginSheetModalForWindow:self.window completionHandler:nil];
                }
                return;
            }

            NSDictionary *json = [NSJSONSerialization JSONObjectWithData:data options:0 error:nil];
            NSString *tag = json[@"tag_name"] ?: @"";
            NSString *cleanTag = [tag stringByTrimmingCharactersInSet:[NSCharacterSet characterSetWithCharactersInString:@"vV "]];
            NSString *htmlUrl = json[@"html_url"] ?: @"https://github.com/kohei519y-arch/vocab-vault/releases";

            if (cleanTag.length > 0 && [cleanTag compare:currentVer options:NSNumericSearch] == NSOrderedDescending) {
                NSAlert *alert = [[NSAlert alloc] init];
                [alert setMessageText:@"新しいバージョンが利用可能です"];
                [alert setInformativeText:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"Vocab Vault v%@ が公開されています（現在: v%@）。\n最新バージョンへアップデートしますか？", cleanTag, currentVer]];
                [alert addButtonWithTitle:@"アップデートをダウンロード"];
                [alert addButtonWithTitle:@"後で"];
                [alert setAlertStyle:NSAlertStyleInformational];
                [alert beginSheetModalForWindow:self.window completionHandler:^(NSModalResponse returnCode) {
                    if (returnCode == NSAlertFirstButtonReturn) {
                        [[NSWorkspace sharedWorkspace] openURL:[NSURL URLWithString:htmlUrl]];
                    }
                }];
            } else if (sender != nil) {
                NSAlert *alert = [[NSAlert alloc] init];
                [alert setMessageText:@"最新バージョンです"];
                [alert setInformativeText:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"Vocab Vault v%@ は最新の状態です。", currentVer]];
                [alert addButtonWithTitle:@"OK"];
                [alert beginSheetModalForWindow:self.window completionHandler:nil];
            }
        });
    }];
    [task resume];
}

// 7. ナビゲーションポリシー (blob: URL誤動作の根絶 & 外部リンク安全化)
- (void)webView:(WKWebView *)webView decidePolicyForNavigationAction:(WKNavigationAction *)navigationAction decisionHandler:(void (^)(WKNavigationActionPolicy))decisionHandler {
    NSURL *url = navigationAction.request.URL;
    NSString *scheme = url.scheme.lowercaseString;

    // blob: や data:、about: は外部アプリに回さずWebコンテキスト内で正常処理
    if ([scheme isEqualToString:@"blob"] || [scheme isEqualToString:@"data"] || [scheme isEqualToString:@"about"]) {
        decisionHandler(WKNavigationActionPolicyAllow);
        return;
    }

    if (navigationAction.navigationType == WKNavigationTypeLinkActivated) {
        if (![scheme isEqualToString:@"file"] && ![url.host containsString:@"github.io"] && ![url.host containsString:@"vercel.app"]) {
            [[NSWorkspace sharedWorkspace] openURL:url];
            decisionHandler(WKNavigationActionPolicyCancel);
            return;
        }
    }
    decisionHandler(WKNavigationActionPolicyAllow);
}

// 8. ページ読み込み完了時の自動復元 (端末内限定: アプリと同階層に救出ファイルが明示的に存在する場合のみ自動マージ)
- (void)webView:(WKWebView *)webView didFinishNavigation:(WKNavigation *)navigation {
    NSString *appDir = [[NSBundle mainBundle] bundlePath];
    NSString *parentDir = [appDir stringByDeletingLastPathComponent];
    NSString *backupFile1 = [parentDir stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"VocabVault_Recovered_Full_Backup.json"];

    NSFileManager *fm = [NSFileManager defaultManager];
    NSString *targetFile = nil;
    if ([fm fileExistsAtPath:backupFile1]) {
        targetFile = backupFile1;
    }

    if (targetFile) {
        NSData *data = [NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:targetFile];
        if (data && data.length > 0) {
            NSString *base64 = [data base64EncodedStringWithOptions:0];
            NSString *injectJs = [NSString stringWithFormat:
                @"(function() {"
                @"  function runNativeRestore() {"
                @"    try {"
                @"      if (localStorage.getItem('vv_native_restored_v1')) return;"
                @"      if (!window.VocabStorage || !window.VocabStorage.setJson || !window.App) return;"
                @"      var b64 = '%@';"
                @"      var bin = atob(b64);"
                @"      var bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);"
                @"      for (var i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);"
                @"      var decoded = new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(bytes);"
                @"      var payload = JSON.parse(decoded);"
                @"      var curCount = (App.entries || []).length;"
                @"      if (curCount <= 25) {"
                @"        localStorage.setItem('vv_native_restored_v1', '1');"
                @"        var en = payload.en || [];"
                @"        var fr = payload.fr || [];"
                @"        var de = payload.de || [];"
                @"        if (en.length > 0) {"
                @"          var curEn = VocabStorage.getJson('distinction_entries');"
                @"          var mergedEn = VocabStorage.mergeWords(curEn, en, 'distinction_entries', false);"
                @"          VocabStorage.setJson('distinction_entries', mergedEn);"
                @"        }"
                @"        if (fr.length > 0) {"
                @"          var curFr = VocabStorage.getJson('distinction_entries_fr');"
                @"          var mergedFr = VocabStorage.mergeWords(curFr, fr, 'distinction_entries_fr', false);"
                @"          VocabStorage.setJson('distinction_entries_fr', mergedFr);"
                @"        }"
                @"        if (de.length > 0) {"
                @"          var curDe = VocabStorage.getJson('distinction_entries_de');"
                @"          var mergedDe = VocabStorage.mergeWords(curDe, de, 'distinction_entries_de', false);"
                @"          VocabStorage.setJson('distinction_entries_de', mergedDe);"
                @"        }"
                @"        setTimeout(function() {"
                @"          if (typeof App.reload === 'function') App.reload();"
                @"          else location.reload();"
                @"        }, 150);"
                @"      } else {"
                @"        localStorage.setItem('vv_native_restored_v1', '1');"
                @"      }"
                @"    } catch(e) { console.error('Native Auto Restore Err:', e); }"
                @"  }"
                @"  function checkAndRun(attempt) {"
                @"    if (window.VocabStorage && window.VocabStorage.state && window.VocabStorage.state.isReady) {"
                @"      runNativeRestore();"
                @"    } else if (attempt < 30) {"
                @"      setTimeout(function() { checkAndRun(attempt + 1); }, 150);"
                @"    } else {"
                @"      runNativeRestore();"
                @"    }"
                @"  }"
                @"  checkAndRun(0);"
                @"})();", base64];
            [webView evaluateJavaScript:injectJs completionHandler:nil];
        }
    }
}

@end

int main(int argc, const char * argv[]) {
    @autoreleasepool {
        NSApplication *app = [NSApplication sharedApplication];
        [app setActivationPolicy:NSApplicationActivationPolicyRegular];
        AppDelegate *delegate = [[AppDelegate alloc] init];
        [app setDelegate:delegate];
        [app run];
    }
    return 0;
}
```
